title: Paid Media Specialist (Meta) | ECommerce | Remote (LATAM)
description:
About the Role

We’re hiring a hands-on Paid Media Specialist who can own Meta Ads for eCommerce accounts end-to-end. This is a performance role (not a CMO/manager role): you’ll be in-platform daily, launching and optimizing campaigns, and you’ll be expected to clearly explain what you did, why you did it, and what results you drove.

What success looks like in the first 60–90 days

  • Take over (or build) a Meta account structure that can scale profitably: prospecting + retargeting, clear campaign/ad set logic, clean naming, and reporting.

  • Improve efficiency and scale: better MER/ROAS, lower CPA, improved CTR/CVR through testing.

  • Establish a repeatable creative testing system in partnership with creative (briefs, angles, iterations, learnings).

  • Own measurement hygiene: pixel/CAPI checks, events, attribution approach, and clear performance readouts.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, launch, and optimize Meta Ads campaigns for eCommerce (prospecting, retargeting, catalog/DPA when relevant).

  • Manage budgets and pacing; make clear tradeoffs between volume vs efficiency.

  • Create and maintain testing roadmaps (creative, audiences, offers, landing pages) and summarize learnings.

  • Analyze performance daily/weekly and communicate actions taken (what changed, why, impact).

  • Partner with creative/CRO/analytics to improve conversion rate and post-click performance.

  • Ensure tracking and reporting are reliable (Pixel + CAPI, GA4 basics, UTMs, attribution discussion).

Must-Have Experience

  • 3+ years running Meta Ads hands-on (not just overseeing).

  • Proven eCommerce performance experience (not lead gen only) with clear examples.

  • Experience managing monthly spend on Meta for a single account (tell us the largest monthly Meta budget you personally managed in one account).

  • Strong fundamentals: audience strategy, creative testing, account structure, scaling methods, and performance diagnosis.

  • Clear English communication: concise answers, structured thinking, and ability to explain decisions.

Nice-to-haves

  • Google Ads experience (Search/Shopping/YouTube) is a plus, but Meta is the priority.

  • Experience working with U.S.-based eCommerce brands/agencies.

  • Experience with Shopify, GA4, Tag Manager, and basic attribution troubleshooting.

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive pay based on experience and location.

  • 100% remote with flexible hours.

  • Direct ownership of high-value accounts (budgets scaling to $500K+/mo).

  • Strategic influence over campaign direction and creative planning.

  • Opportunity to help brands scale beyond $10M+ in annual revenue.

If you’re strongest on Google Ads and only occasionally run Meta, this likely won’t be the right fit. We need someone who can lead Meta performance from day one.

title: Lead PHP Engineer
description:

We are on a mission to revolutionize the digital landscape with our state-of-the-art technology and creative solutions. Join us and be a part of a team that values excellence, creativity, and collaboration.

The ideal candidates will have extensive experience in PHP and related technologies, focusing strongly on Laravel, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and more.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications using PHP and Laravel.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth deployment processes.
  • Utilize Kubernetes and Docker for containerization and orchestration.
  • Optimize application performance using Redis and Guzzle.
  • Develop and maintain front-end components using Vue.js.
  • Work with MongoDB and MySQL databases for efficient data management.
  • Integrate and manage Facebook API for various functionalities.
  • Perform reverse engineering tasks as required.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Troubleshoot and debug applications to ensure optimal performance.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior PHP Engineer or similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP and Laravel framework.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and processes.
  • Proficiency in Kubernetes and Docker for container management.

  • Expertise in working with MongoDB and MySQL databases.
  • Experience with Facebook API integration.
  • Strong reverse engineering skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication skills.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work with a talented and diverse team.
  • Fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

How to Apply

If you meet the above criteria and can start immediately, we would love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your experience and why you would be an excellent fit for this role. Join Blackscale Media and be a part of a team pushing the boundaries of digital innovation!

Blackscale Media is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Combat Designer (Enemies / Bosses)
description:
This position is for temporary engagement through our staffing partner, Yoh Enterprise Solutions. This is a 6-month contract.

Insomniac Games is looking for a Senior Combat Designer (Enemies/Bosses). In this role, the Senior Combat Designer (Enemies/Bosses) is accountable for the quality and on-time delivery of combat gameplay, specifically focused on enemies, mini-bosses, and bosses. Designer will be responsible for initial pitches, prototyping, implementation, iteration, polish and balance for AI enemies, smaller-scale mini-bosses, and larger boss encounters, as needed. Work will be done in a highly collaborative, cross-disciplinary pod, under the direction and review of combat and design leads.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

  • Hands-on implementation work on initial design, prototyping, iteration, balance and polish of AI enemy combatants, mini-boss characters, and large-scale boss encounters.
  • Directly implements and iterates on Enemy AI and bosses through proprietary internal tools and scripting systems.
  • Works within a cross-disciplinary pod. Collaborates directly with Gameplay Programming, Animation, and other pod members to best leverage skills and creativity across all departments.
  • Writes and regularly updates clear gameplay system documentation detailing functionality and best practices for using Enemy AI across missions and levels.
  • Gathers and prioritized feedback from multiple sources. Proactively implements changes and improvements in enemy / boss design to respond to issues around clarity, balance, and playability. Drives continual improvement on assigned combat work.
  • Supports Mission Designers, as needed, through best practices, training, and model encounters. May also work on combat encounters directly within Missions.
  • Coordinates with other combat design staff on game-wide combat issues, including difficulty, balance, enemy differentiation, enemy introductions, etc.
  • Contributes to a safe, supportive, and creative work environment that exemplifies our studio values.
  • Other creative duties as needed.

Experience and Education

  • Five or more years of professional game design experience, with at least one shipped title as a Combat Designer.
  • Expertise in the current state of combat design craft across the games industry.
  • Experience in designing, prototyping, implementing, and polishing enemy AI combatants and boss characters.
  • High proficiency with modern game engines, such as Unreal or proprietary engines. Proven experience in scripting, prototyping, and iterating gameplay systems directly. Experience in 3D layout a plus.
  • Strong skills in written, verbal, and visual communication across disciplines.

Mathematical Skills

  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

Reasoning Ability

  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Computer Skills: 

  • Intermediate knowledge and experience with level editing tools and scripting (Unreal Engine, Unity, or similar editors). 
  • Intermediate knowledge of Maya or other major 3D modeling programs. 
  • Adobe Illustrator experience and UE4 Blueprint scripting skills are a plus. 
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

Other Skills: 

  • Individual must have very good interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with team members and other developers. 
  • Strong communication skills including verbal and written skills are required. 

At SIE, working with our partners, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the individual base pay range may vary based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for benefit offerings that include medical, dental, and vision. Click here to learn more.

The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below, this is an hourly rate.
$70—$90 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

title: Account Executive
description:
Why Joint Academy (Remote Role)

Joint Academy is redefining how musculoskeletal (MSK) care is delivered. Our AI-powered platform combines Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) with a Home Exercise Program, helping PT, orthopedic, and pain-management clinics create new reimbursable revenue streams while improving patient outcomes.

We have a first-mover advantage in a brand-new category and are winning multiple deals as we speak. The opportunity is massive were positioned to become the category leader in a rapidly emerging market that will shape the future of MSK and physical therapy.

To date, we've treated 200,000+ patients, published 40 peer-reviewed clinical studies, and onboarded thousands of clinicians across many of the worlds largest health systems. Backed by $50 million from leading global investors, were scaling fast and looking for elite SaaS closers ready to make a mark.

Why Join Our Sales Team

  • Huge market: <1% of 40,000 PT clinics in the U.S. currently monetize RTM correctly.

  • Clear value proposition: new revenue streams, improved engagement, better outcomes.

  • Uncapped commission with potential to earn $250k-$300k+ OTE.

  • Small, high-performance team where your impact directly shapes our growth.

The Role

You'll own the full sales cycle across the U.S. for PT clinics, orthopedic groups, and MSK networks. This is a hunter role with a mix of warm inbound leads and self-sourced outbound opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Prospect, qualify, and close new accounts across the U.S.

  • Deliver impactful demos showing how clinics can add new revenue streams, improve patient engagement, and elevate clinical outcomes.

  • Execute sales plans to consistently hit and exceed quota.

  • Partner with our Customer Success team to ensure rapid implementation and fast time-to-value (<30 days to first RTM payment).

  • Build and manage pipeline through outbound (LinkedIn, email, events) while converting inbound leads.

  • Represent Joint Academy at conferences and industry events.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in HubSpot.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience.

  • Documented track record of exceeding quota (top 10-20% performer).

  • Self-starter with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset and drive to win.

  • Strong communicator who builds trust quickly with decision-makers.

  • Experience in healthcare or digital health is a plus, not required.

  • Willingness to travel 20-30% for conferences and key meetings.

Compensation & Perks

  • Base $120k - $160k + uncapped commission (OTE $250k$300k+).

  • Meaningful stock options.

  • Full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) with match, HSA/FSA.

  • Unlimited PTO, remote-first culture, home-office stipend.

  • Optional off-sites + wellness perks (cold plunge & sauna access at HQ).

Bottom Line

Join the company thats setting a new global standard in digital MSK care.
You'll sell a product that transforms clinic economics and patient outcomes while positioning yourself in a category thats just beginning to explode.

title: Domain Delivery Lead
description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Domain Delivery Lead transverse

[FR]

Environnement de travail

Dans le cadre d'un programme de transformation numérique, une administration fédérale modernise en profondeur son environnement de travail digital. L'objectif est de faire évoluer les applications métier, de renforcer la collaboration entre équipes et de bâtir un environnement IT plus intégré et plus agile.

Dans ce rôle de Domain Delivery Lead, vous fédérez plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'une vision commune, pilotez la réalisation d'applications métier stratégiques et contribuez à renforcer leur autonomie, leur expertise et leur capacité à délivrer de la valeur.

Vous évoluez dans un contexte de transformation où les nouvelles idées, la remise en question des pratiques existantes et l'amélioration continue ont une place concrète. Cette fonction s'adresse à une personne qui aime structurer, faire progresser et aligner plusieurs équipes dans un environnement complexe.

Description des tâches

Au sein du programme, vous intervenez comme chef de projet et Domain Lead. Vous guidez les équipes par la vision, l'influence et la confiance afin de soutenir la delivery et la création de valeur pour le métier.

  • Fédérer plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'objectifs communs et garantir l'alignement entre les priorités métier et la delivery.
  • Créer un cadre clair qui favorise l'autonomie des squads et accompagner leur montée en maturité dans une logique de servant leadership.
  • Construire la planification globale avec les équipes, coordonner les dépendances et arbitrer les priorités de manière transparente.
  • Animer les rituels transverses du domaine, notamment les synchronisations inter-équipes, les revues et les rétrospectives.
  • Identifier les blocages et faciliter la collaboration entre les équipes IT, les interlocuteurs métier et les autres parties prenantes.
  • Coacher les collaborateurs, encourager le feedback et entretenir une culture de confiance, de transparence et d'amélioration continue.
  • Gérer les demandes de changement en concertation avec les parties prenantes concernées.
  • Rapporter l'avancement, les risques et les difficultés aux instances concernées.
  • Escalader à temps les sujets qui dépassent les seuils de tolérance définis.
  • Assurer le suivi des fournisseurs et collaborer avec eux comme partenaires du delivery.
  • Prendre en charge le suivi budgétaire et la gestion de capacité.

📝 Votre profil

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à traduire des concepts IT complexes en messages compréhensibles pour le métier.
  • Aptitude à transformer une vision stratégique et des besoins business en roadmap opérationnelle et en priorités claires.
  • Leadership de type servant leadership, avec une capacité à guider les équipes sans recourir à l'autorité hiérarchique.
  • Solide expérience du stakeholder management dans un environnement public complexe.
  • Bonne maîtrise des cadres de gouvernance IT et de leur application dans la delivery.

Expérience et expertise attendues

  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, avec une expérience confirmée dans la coordination et le pilotage de plusieurs équipes.
  • Expérience solide dans une interface business-IT, par exemple comme Product Owner senior, Business Relationship Manager, Agile Delivery Manager confirmé ou directeur de programme.
  • Expérience dans la direction de grandes équipes pluridisciplinaires réparties en plusieurs squads autonomes.
  • Expérience avérée en gestion budgétaire et allocation de capacité dans un cadre public.
  • Maîtrise des méthodes agiles et itératives appliquées à des projets IT complexes, avec une pratique concrète de Scrum.
  • Très bonne connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet, du leadership de projet et des pratiques de gouvernance et de delivery.
  • Expérience significative dans des projets de digitalisation avec gestion complexe des parties prenantes.
  • Expérience en optimisation et réingénierie des processus métier.
  • Bonne compréhension du change management dans des contextes de transformation organisationnelle et digitale.
  • Connaissance de la gestion du cycle de vie applicatif, de la maintenance et de l'évolution des applications.

Connaissances techniques

  • Architecture de solutions et intégration : gestion des dépendances et du chemin critique, patterns d'intégration tels que API, messaging et batch, contrats d'interface, versioning, données de référence et moteurs de workflow comme Camunda.
  • Release et environnements : stratégie DTAP, coordination des releases inter-équipes, planification des cutovers et rollbacks, stratégie de tests end-to-end.
  • Cloud et plateforme : Azure Landing Zone, Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Kubernetes, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code et bases de FinOps.
  • Outillage DevOps : maîtrise avancée d'Azure DevOps, y compris les hiérarchies de work items, Delivery Plans, dépendances et reporting, ainsi qu'une bonne compréhension des pipelines CI/CD et des stratégies de branching.
  • Sécurité, conformité et résilience : NIS2, RGPD dans le secteur public, exigences non fonctionnelles comme RPO/RTO, rétention, logging et acceptation formalisée des risques.
  • Data et migration : compréhension des flux vers une plateforme de données, notamment CDC et ETL, ainsi que de la migration de données comme chantier distinct.
  • Atout : connaissance de grands systèmes IT européens, de l'intégration biométrique, de l'observabilité, des frameworks d'architecture d'entreprise, ainsi que notions de KQL ou OData.

Compétences et aptitudes

  • Capacité à structurer, planifier et prioriser les activités selon les objectifs stratégiques, les besoins métier et la capacité de delivery.
  • Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
  • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs équipes et à renforcer une collaboration efficace entre IT, métier, direction et partenaires externes.

Qualités humaines et leadership

  • Vous influencez et mobilisez sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
  • Vous adaptez votre communication à des interlocuteurs variés.
  • Vous créez un climat de confiance et de sécurité psychologique.
  • Vous gérez les tensions avec diplomatie et recherchez des solutions pragmatiques.
  • Vous intervenez comme facilitateur et coach auprès des équipes.
  • Vous restez serein sous pression et gardez une approche orientée solutions.
  • Vous agissez avec intégrité et transparence.

Langues

  • Vous êtes néerlandophone ou francophone, avec une bonne connaissance de l'anglais.

Certifications

  • Obligatoire : Scrum et ITIL.
  • Atout : certification Microsoft Azure.

Description technique

Compétences attendues :

  • Agile : 5 ans.
  • Gestion complexe des parties prenantes dans un projet de digitalisation : 10 ans.
  • Leadership d'équipe projet : 10 ans.

Début : dès que possible, après la procédure de sélection.

[NL]

Werkomgeving

Binnen een digitaal transformatieprogramma moderniseert een federale administratie haar digitale werkomgeving grondig. De focus ligt op het vernieuwen van bedrijfstoepassingen, het versterken van de samenwerking tussen teams en het uitbouwen van een meer geïntegreerde en wendbare IT-omgeving.

In deze rol als Domain Delivery Lead brengt u meerdere agile teams samen rond een gedeelde visie, stuurt u de realisatie van strategische bedrijfstoepassingen aan en helpt u de teams groeien in autonomie, expertise en leveringscapaciteit.

U komt terecht in een veranderende omgeving waar ruimte is om werkmethoden, processen en samenwerking verder vorm te geven. Deze functie is geschikt voor iemand die graag structuur brengt, teams laat groeien en complexe transversale afhankelijkheden beheersbaar maakt.

Taakomschrijving

Binnen het programma treedt u op als projectleider en Domain Lead. U stuurt via visie, invloed en vertrouwen, met als doel de delivery te ondersteunen en duurzame waarde voor de business te realiseren.

  • Meerdere agile teams rond gemeenschappelijke doelstellingen samenbrengen en de afstemming tussen businessprioriteiten en delivery bewaken.
  • Een duidelijk kader creëren dat autonomie ondersteunt en squads begeleiden in hun verdere maturiteit vanuit servant leadership.
  • Samen met de teams de globale planning uitwerken, afhankelijkheden coördineren en prioriteiten transparant afwegen.
  • Transversale rituelen faciliteren, zoals interteam-synchronisaties, reviews en retrospectives.
  • Belemmeringen identificeren en samenwerking tussen IT-teams, business en andere betrokken partijen vlotter maken.
  • Medewerkers coachen, feedback stimuleren en een cultuur van vertrouwen, transparantie en continue verbetering versterken.
  • Wijzigingsaanvragen beheren in overleg met de betrokken stakeholders.
  • Rapporteren over voortgang, risico's en knelpunten aan de relevante overlegorganen.
  • Belangrijke problemen of wijzigingen tijdig escaleren wanneer tolerantiedrempels worden overschreden.
  • Leveranciers opvolgen en hen betrekken als partners in de delivery.
  • Budgetopvolging en capaciteitsbeheer opnemen.

📝 Jouw profiel

Kerncompetenties

  • Het vermogen om complexe IT-concepten te vertalen naar duidelijke en begrijpelijke businesstaal.
  • Inzicht om strategische visie en businessnoden om te zetten in een operationele roadmap en heldere prioriteiten.
  • Servant leadership: teams begeleiden en versterken zonder te steunen op hiërarchische autoriteit.
  • Sterke ervaring in stakeholdermanagement binnen een complexe publieke context.
  • Goede beheersing van IT-governancekaders en hun toepassing binnen delivery.

Ervaring en expertise

  • Minstens 10 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie, met bewezen ervaring in de coördinatie en aansturing van meerdere teams.
  • Stevige ervaring in een brugfunctie tussen business en IT, bijvoorbeeld als senior Product Owner, Business Relationship Manager, Confirmed Agile Delivery Manager of programmadirecteur.
  • Ervaring met het leiden van grote multidisciplinaire teams, verdeeld over meerdere autonome squads.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in budgetbeheer en capaciteitsplanning binnen een publieke context.
  • Grondige kennis van agile en iteratieve werkmethoden in complexe IT-projecten, met praktische ervaring met Scrum.
  • Zeer goede kennis van projectmanagementmethodologieën, project leadership en governance- en deliverypraktijken.
  • Ervaring in digitaliseringsprojecten met complex stakeholdermanagement.
  • Ervaring in procesoptimalisatie en business process reengineering.
  • Goede kennis van change management binnen organisatorische en digitale transformaties.
  • Inzicht in applicatiebeheer, onderhoud en de volledige levenscyclus van toepassingen.

Technische kennis

  • Oplossingsarchitectuur en integratie: beheer van afhankelijkheden en kritiek pad, integratiepatronen zoals API, messaging en batch, interfacecontracten, versiebeheer, referentiedata en workflow-engines zoals Camunda.
  • Release- en omgevingsbeheer: DTAP-strategie, releasecoördinatie tussen teams, planning van cutovers en rollbacks en end-to-end teststrategie.
  • Cloud en platform: Azure Landing Zone, Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Kubernetes, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code en basisprincipes van FinOps.
  • DevOps-tooling: gevorderde beheersing van Azure DevOps, met work item-hiërarchieën, Delivery Plans, afhankelijkheden en reporting, aangevuld met inzicht in CI/CD-pipelines en branchingstrategieën.
  • Beveiliging, compliance en veerkracht: NIS2, GDPR in de publieke sector, niet-functionele vereisten zoals RPO/RTO, retentie, logging en formele risicoaanvaarding.
  • Data en migratie: inzicht in stromen naar een dataplatform, waaronder CDC en ETL, en in datamigratie als afzonderlijk werkpakket.
  • Pluspunt: kennis van grootschalige Europese IT-systemen, biometrische integratie, observability, enterprise-architectuurframeworks en noties van KQL of OData.

Competenties en vaardigheden

  • U kunt activiteiten structureren, plannen en prioriteren in functie van strategische doelstellingen, businessnoden en deliverycapaciteit.
  • U beschikt over sterke analytische, synthetische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden.
  • U kunt meerdere teams coördineren en de samenwerking tussen IT, business, management en externe partners versterken.

Menselijke kwaliteiten en leiderschap

  • U beïnvloedt en mobiliseert zonder directe hiërarchische macht.
  • U past uw communicatie aan verschillende gesprekspartners aan.
  • U creëert een klimaat van vertrouwen en psychologische veiligheid.
  • U gaat diplomatisch om met spanningen en zoekt werkbare oplossingen.
  • U treedt op als facilitator en coach voor teams en medewerkers.
  • U blijft rustig onder druk en behoudt een oplossingsgerichte aanpak.
  • U handelt met integriteit en transparantie.

Talen

  • U bent Nederlandstalig of Franstalig, met een goede kennis van het Engels.

Certificering

  • Vereist: Scrum en ITIL.
  • Pluspunt: Microsoft Azure-certificering.

Technische beschrijving

Verwachte competenties:

  • Agile: 5 jaar.
  • Complex stakeholdermanagement binnen een digitaliseringsproject: 10 jaar.
  • Leiderschap van projectteams: 10 jaar.

Start: zo snel mogelijk, na afronding van de selectieprocedure.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.

STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

JOB SUMMARY:

Intro to the Crisis Prevention and Response (CPR) Team

Our Crisis Response and Prevention team envisions and enables our mission of A World Without Suicide. It is our goal that all of our clients find unwavering support and hope. Rooted in our core values of Connection, Commitment, and Congruence, we strive to transform crises into opportunities for growth and healing. With cutting-edge best practices and compassionate care, our team empowers individuals to seek help fearlessly. Our clients never give up, and neither do we. Together, we are driving the democratization of mental health treatment each and every day.

Why is the CPR Team important?

  • Immediate Intervention: Prompt assistance during moments of acute distress or emotional upheaval.
  • Safety and Stabilization: Ensuring the well-being and stability of participants during critical situations.
  • Continuity of Care: Ensuring support during acute moments whilst in treatment ensuring continuity from the group experience to the individual/family experience.
  • Preventing Relapses and Hospitalizations: Reducing the risk of relapses and the need for hospitalizations.
  • Suicide and Self-Harm Prevention: Identifying warning signs and intervening to prevent self-harm or suicide.

What does a Crisis Intervention Specialist do?

A part-time Crisis Intervention Specialist at Charlie Health plays a crucial role in ensuring the safety and stability of our clients during acute mental health crises. They are responsible for immediate screening and intervention when clients exhibit severe emotional distress or harmful behaviors. Crisis Intervention Specialists collaborate with the clinical team to screen risk of highly acute clients, develop crisis intervention plans, de-escalate dysregulated clients, and connect patients with appropriate resources to facilitate their recovery and well-being within the IOP setting.


DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Monitors crisis queues for clients receiving individual therapy, family therapy, and participating in group sessions
  • Responds to inbound crisis calls providing real-time risk assessment, de-escalation, and safety planning
  • Screen risk and collaborates on stabilization planning for clients at risk of harm to themselves or others
  • Completes all required documentation in alignment with compliance standards and Charlie Health's best practices
  • Serves as key point of contact for crisis triage during client group sessions in collaboration with Senior Care Coaches and Care Coaches
  • Conducts case consults with Care Team members as needed
  • Supports all Care Team members (i.e., Primary Therapists, Care Coaches, Group Facilitators, etc.) in collaboration regarding the client's care
  • Other care coordination tasks as needed
  • Other tasks and duties as assigned by the Director of Crisis Response and Prevention or the Chief Clinical Officer

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must reside and be licensed in the state of Oregon
  • Independently licensed clinician
  • Previous experience in crisis preferred

  • Motivated individual who is passionate about mental health, able to perform in a high-paced environment, and eager to play a formative role in shaping a growing business.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills required. Familiarity with cloud-based communication and relevant software—Gmail, Slack, Dropbox, Zoom, EMR.

You'll design and maintain the transformation layer behind our data to drive decisions across the company. As part of Beast Industries, MrBeast's family of companies, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12-24 months, and this role will build the data foundation that has to hold as our customer base multiplies.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and maintain Step's core analytics data models, the transformation layer connecting raw user, product, banking, and risk data to every dashboard and BI tool at the company, serving as the single source of truth teams make decisions from.

  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and platform engineers as the Data team grows, helping to align modeling standards with broader engineering considerations.

  • 6+ years of experience across analytics engineering, data engineering, and analytics roles with real modeling ownership, including time at a consumer product or fintech company.

  • Hands-on experience making AI part of how you work — you already use AI tools daily to build faster and go deeper, you've automated real pieces of your own workflow, and you have a point of view on where AI can transform analytics engineering.
  • A demonstrated ability to take full ownership of a workstream and drive it independently from question to decision, without significant supervision.
  • A bias toward simple, effective solutions — you resist complexity that hasn't earned its keep, and you'd rather ship a clear model than a clever one.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to distill complex data topics for non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred) and fluency with modern transformation and orchestration tooling.

Even better if you have:

  • Experience with consumer fintech, banking, or lending data — card transactions, ledgers, credit performance, or fraud and risk signals.
  • Familiarity with dbt, BigQuery, Looker, and data observability tooling.
  • Experience setting up CI and testing frameworks for data pipelines.

Logistics

Location: Remote (US), or hybrid out of our San Mateo, CA office, with occasional travel for team onsites

Reports to: Analytics Manager

Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

The candidate should be capable of interpreting complex requirements, optimizing query performance, and ensuring data quality through proper testing and documentation.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain intricate T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions.
  • Analyze and convert business requirements into efficient, accurate SQL code, with correct handling of NULLs, outer joins, and date/time ranges.
  • Execute data transformations, cleansing, validation, and enrichment tasks.
  • Compose and schedule custom data scripts for insertion, updating, deletion, and movement operations, using transactions and appropriate isolation levels to guarantee consistent results.
  • Design, generate, and maintain reports using business intelligence and reporting tools, and validate report output against source data.
  • Engage in code reviews, peer programming, and unit testing cycles.
  • Enhance existing queries to improve performance and scalability by analyzing execution plans, statistics, and index usage.

  • Participate in sprint planning, refinements, and collaborative solution development.

  • Four or more years of practical experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.
  • Strong expertise in crafting optimized queries, procedures, and scripts.
  • Solid understanding of SQL logical query processing, three-valued logic (NULL handling), and inner vs. outer join semantics.

  • Experience in migrating reports across different tools.

Plus ++

title: Data Analyst II - Marketing & Customer Analytics
description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an opportunity for a Data Analyst II – Marketing & Customer Analyticsto join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. The Data Analyst II – Marketing & Customer Analytics will partner closely with Marketing and other business stakeholders on customer and marketing activities. In this role, you will help evaluate performance, analyze customer behavior and acquisition, support testing and measurement, and identify opportunities to attract, retain, and delight customers. You will leverage your skills in data analysis, reporting, and storytelling to deliver quality analytical work that informs business decisions and drives measurable outcomes.
Tailored Brands is a collaborative environment where people who are comfortable with ambiguity, curious about the business, and motivated to solve problems with data will thrive. If you enjoy working across business and technical teams, can connect the details to the big picture, and are excited to turn insights into action, we are looking for you.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders on customer and marketing analytics, helping answer key business questions and supporting initiatives that improve performance.
  • Interpret data to identify business trends, customer behaviors, and opportunities across acquisition, retention, loyalty, and marketing performance.
  • Support analysis of customer segments, churn, retention, and buying behaviors to generate actionable recommendations.
  • Build, maintain, and improve recurring reporting and dashboards, while identifying the metrics that matter most to the business.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses to evaluate marketing tactics, campaign performance, and customer outcomes.
  • Support test design, measurement, and readouts for A/B testing and other marketing experiments, helping translate results into practical next steps.
  • Improve and automate data preparation and reporting processes so more time can be spent on high-value analysis.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and partners across Analytics to improve data quality, standardized definitions, governance, tools, and ways of working.
  • Manage multiple priorities across projects and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and insights effectively.
  • Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and practical way that can be shared broadly with both technical and non-technical audiences.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or analytical field such as Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Marketing Analytics, or related experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business analysis, or a similar role supporting cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, including data extraction, transformation, and quality checks.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.
  • Experience analyzing customer, marketing, or digital performance data to uncover trends and opportunities.
  • Familiarity with marketing channels and external agencies including social, search, display, CRM, and other digital channels.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing methodology, test measurement, and interpreting results to improve marketing outcomes.
  • Comfort working with AI-enabled tools and technologies to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and support business decision-making, including developing practical methodologies to QA AI-generated outputs and assess their reliability before use.
  • Strong ability to interpret data and turn it into practical business actions, recommendations, and prioritization decisions.
  • Strong practical business sense, with the ability to balance analytical rigor with real-world tradeoffs and translate insights into decisions that improve customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to act as a bridge among business, analytics, and engineering teams.
  • Confidence to scrutinize analyses, identify limitations, and communicate where data quality or methodology may affect interpretation.
  • Familiarity with agile ways of working and tools such as Jira, GitHub, or Confluence is a plus.
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:
  • Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
  • Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
  • Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday
The starting salary for this position is $92,810 – $142,350. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $193,294. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.
Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer

  • Work Type: Full-time.

  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, US Business Hours (Central Time).

  • Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview

We are seeking a multifaceted Graphic Designer to serve as a creative pillar for our marketing efforts. This role is focused on producing high-quality "top of funnel" resources and professional collateral for both digital and print distribution. The ideal candidate is a proficient designer capable of managing custom projects from concept to final delivery, ensuring all visual assets are engaging, effective, and perfectly aligned with brand standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Custom Design Production: Create and manage custom designs using Canva and the Adobe Creative Suite, with a specific focus on Adobe Photoshop.

  • Marketing Collateral: Design professional flyers, brochures, and promotional materials tailored for both digital and print platforms.

  • Long-Form Content: Develop engaging, highly readable layouts for high-value resources, including e-books, white papers, and case studies.

  • Strategic Visuals: Produce specialized resources designed for the top of the sales funnel (e.g., educational guides for senior living facilities) to support lead generation and marketing initiatives.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong, hands-on working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Canva is strictly essential.

  • Design Versatility: Proven ability to handle diverse design requests and seamlessly transition between creating digital assets and print-ready files.

  • Core Competencies: Meticulous eye for detail to ensure all custom designs meet professional standards and strict brand alignment. Highly deadline-driven, with the ability to work efficiently and autonomously to meet project timelines and immediate business needs.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

  • Performance-based raises.

  • Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

  • Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

title: Senior IAP Monetization Manager
description:
Description

With more than 8 billion downloads, CrazyLabs is a leading publisher of casual and hybrid-casual games.

We have proven that real success comes from staying ahead with the latest technology, having fun with what we do, and building excellent teams. That’s where you come in!

CrazyLabs is looking for a highly analytical and commercially driven Senior IAP Monetization Manager to own and optimize in-app purchase monetization across our mobile games.

You will drive IAP revenue growth through pricing, offers, bundles, player segmentation, personalization, and A/B testing, with a strong focus on maximizing IAP ARPDAU while maintaining a great player experience.

﻿As a Senior Monetization Manager, you will:

  • Own and optimize IAP monetization strategy, driving ARPDAU, payer conversion, and LTV.
  • Design and optimize in-game offers, bundles, promotions, and pricing strategies.
  • Develop player segmentation and personalized offers based on spending behavior, engagement, and progression.
  • Identify revenue opportunities through data analysis and player behavior insights.
  • Lead A/B testing across pricing, offers, targeting, timing, and purchase experiences.
  • Build and execute a monetization roadmap focused on measurable business impact.
  • Collaborate with Product, Analytics, Economy, LiveOps, and Development teams to deliver monetization improvements.

Requirements

The Senior Monetization Manager role requires:

  • ﻿4+ years of experience in mobile gaming monetization, with a strong focus on IAP.
  • Proven track record of driving IAP revenue growth and improving monetization KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of F2P game economies, purchasing behavior, and player psychology.
  • Hands-on experience with pricing, offers, bundles, segmentation, and personalization.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience designing and evaluating A/B tests.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with analytics tools.
  • Commercially minded, creative, proactive, and comfortable taking end-to-end ownership.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in casual, hybrid-casual, simulation, or content-driven mobile games.
  • SQL knowledge and experience with revenue forecasting.
  • Experience with LiveOps and offer management platforms.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if you can consistently identify and execute opportunities that drive measurable IAP revenue growth.

This includes increasing first-time payer conversion, improving monetization efficiency across player segments, optimizing offer and pricing performance, and building a strong experimentation pipeline that continuously improves IAP ARPDAU.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage existing monetization systems, but actively challenges, improves, and evolves them.

CrazyLabs Commitments

Employee benefits are part of our love language. Annual team trip, global holiday celebrations and presents, birthday, and job anniversary presents… And so so much more!

Remote but not alone. While you are enjoying flexibility with the remote position, we make sure you always feel as a part of our Crazy team. From the first day at CrazyLabs you will be supported by an experienced people’s team to ensure your integration and journey is on the highest level.

Our approach to AI. At CrazyLabs, AI isn’t scary, and it isn’t a buzzword. We’ve assembled an AI Lead team dedicated to teaching, training, and helping all Crazies to be ahead of the curve and use AI smartly. CrazyLabs is an AI slop-free zone.

The Future is Crazy, Join the Lab!

title: Producer
description:
About High Scale We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Producer who can manage the pulse of our production engine, turning ambitious concepts into delivered assets from anywhere in the world.

Why This Role Matters Order, velocity, and execution are your playground. As a Remote Producer, you are the central nervous system of the project. You are the bridge between the client's business goals (via the Account team) and the creative magic happening in the edit bay or on the studio floor.

You don't just update spreadsheets; you engineer the workflow that allows us to scale. You ensure that despite the speed and volume of our output, quality never slips and deadlines are never missed. If you thrive on solving complex logistical puzzles and shepherding campaigns to the finish line, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Manage End-to-End Production

    • oversee the full lifecycle of multiple video campaigns simultaneously—from the initial creative brief to post-production and final file delivery.

    • Build and enforce detailed production schedules, ensuring Art Directors, Editors, and Creators are aligned on milestones.

    • Act as the primary project owner, ensuring all blockers are removed before they impact the timeline.

  2. Resource & Budget Oversight

    • Allocate resources efficiently, managing project budgets and tracking actuals vs. estimates to ensure profitability.

    • Coordinate with the Sourcing team to book voice-over talent, UGC creators, or specific post-production specialists as needed.

  3. Bridge Strategy & Creative

    • Translate high-level strategy and client feedback into clear, actionable tasks for the production and post-production teams.

    • Facilitate seamless communication between departments, ensuring that the "creative vision" aligns with the "production reality."

    • Manage quality control (QC) checkpoints, ensuring deliverables meet High Scale’s technical and aesthetic standards.

  4. Optimize Remote Workflows

    • Master our project management ecosystem (Asana, ClickUp, Slack,).

    • Proactively identify bottlenecks in our remote processes and propose solutions to make us faster and more efficient.

Who You Are

  1. A Seasoned Campaign Leader

    • 3–6 years of experience as a Producer in a digital agency, production company, or high-growth tech environment.

    • Proven track record of delivering high-volume video campaigns for social media or TV.

  2. Master of Organization

    • You are obsessed with details. You know where every file lives, when every deadline is, and who is working on what.

    • You can manage complex timelines and competing priorities without losing your cool.

  3. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You are clear, concise, and persuasive in your written and verbal communication.

    • You are capable of managing expectations and de-escalating issues with a solution-first mindset.

  4. Tech-Fluent

    • You are comfortable working with remote collaboration tools. You understand post-production workflows (proxies, render times, codecs) enough to communicate effectively with editors.

  5. Adaptable & Resilient

    • You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift. You don't get frustrated by change; you pivot and keep moving.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the operational efficiency of a global agency and manage top-tier campaigns for major brands.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one perfectly managed project at a time.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we’re expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures, we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

About the Role

    We're looking for a GTM Engineer to design, build, and maintain the agentic GTM motions that generate pipeline at scale. Sales or marketing ops and domain experience is helpful, but this is not a traditional sales or marketing ops role. You will deploy agents that book meetings and generate pipeline, while building the shared knowledge layer that powers every GTM agent across the team.

    Success in this role will be measured in pipeline dollars sourced to motions you built, BDR and AE time saved, and a robust system of context that makes every agent in the org smarter over time.

    This is a builder role in an emerging field. We're heavily prioritizing learning velocity and a growth mindset over years of experience. We’re especially interested in seeing what you’ve built in this recent window of dramatic LLM-driven technological and market change. The landscape is shifting fast, and we need someone who ships, measures, iterates, and isn't waiting for a playbook to be written for them.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize automated outbound sequences with agentic workflows that personalize at scale.

  • Work alongside marketing and GTM teams to generate pipeline from agentic GTM motions end to end: prospecting logic, enrichment, sequencing, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  • Build and maintain a shared system of context that powers agents used by Marketing, BDRs, and AEs across the organization.

  • Deploy automations that multiply BDR and AE effectiveness: auto-research, meeting prep, call briefings, and follow-up workflows that increase logged activity (emails, calls, meetings).

  • Instrument and report on sequence performance (open rates, reply rates, meeting set rates, pipeline sourced), translating metrics into an experimentation roadmap to drive continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate with BDR leadership and Marketing to align agentic motions with target segments, campaigns, and the buyer journey, ensuring automated outreach complements human-led efforts.

  • Evaluate, integrate, and maintain the tech and tool stack (Clay, coding agents, enrichment providers, sequence platforms) required to run agentic GTM at scale.

Requirements

  • You’ve vibe-coded something interesting. Show us what you’ve made!

  • Demonstrated projects using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), Clay, or similar martech tools to build genuinely agentic solutions, not just templates or simple automations.

  • Domain experience in GTM Engineering, Sales Development, Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, or Revenue Operations, with hands-on experience building automated workflows.

  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to instrument experiments, read results, and iterate quickly.

  • Excellent written communication: you'll be authoring the templates, prompts, and frameworks that agents use to represent the company.

Nice to Have

  • Strong working knowledge of B2B outbound sales motions: sequencing, prospecting, enrichment, intent signals, and pipeline measurement.

  • Comfort writing and debugging code (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to connect APIs, manipulate data, and build custom automations. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be fluent enough to ship.

  • Familiarity with MAPs, CRM, and sales engagement platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, or similar).

  • Familiarity with enrichment tools (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit), intent data platforms (UserGems, Bombora, 6sense), or building multi-step AI agent workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Builder instinct: builds solutions to problems rather than waiting for a vendor or a process to be handed down. Ships fast, measures, iterates.

  • Learning velocity: picks up new technology quickly and adapts as the landscape shifts. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and figuring things out in a nascent field.

  • Systems thinking: sees how individual automations connect to the broader GTM motion and builds with composability and shared context in mind.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: works fluidly with BDRs, AEs, marketing, and ops to align automated motions with human-led efforts.

  • Operational rigor: maintains quality standards across agent outputs, data flows, and reporting.

  • Growth mindset: treats every sequence as an opportunity to learn. Curious about what's working, honest about what isn't, and energized by the pace of change in AI-powered GTM.

title: Account Director, Health Systems
description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc's most important asset is our people. As an Account Director, Health Systems, you'll identify, develop, and close new partnerships with some of the nation's largest and most sophisticated health systems. You'll build relationships with executive stakeholders, lead complex enterprise sales cycles, and guide customers from initial engagement through signed agreement while navigating the clinical, operational, financial, legal, procurement, and technical stakeholders involved in every decision.

This is an opportunity to shape how leading health systems connect patients to care while expanding Zocdoc's footprint across the country. Working alongside Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, you'll influence go-to-market strategy, help solve complex customer challenges, and bring new strategic partnerships to life. If you're energized by building relationships from the ground up, thrive in executive conversations, and enjoy being in the field with customers, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on one of Zocdoc's highest-priority growth initiatives.


You’ll enjoy this role if you...

  • Love building relationships from the ground up and are energized by opening new doors with prospective clients
  • Thrive in complex enterprise sales environments where success requires patience, strategy, and persistence
  • Enjoy engaging executive stakeholders and influencing decisions across clinical, operational, financial, IT, legal, and procurement teams
  • Are naturally curious and enjoy understanding your clients' biggest challenges before proposing solutions
  • Excel at partnering cross-functionally to navigate complex deals and deliver exceptional client experiences
  • Prefer spending time in the field building relationships face-to-face and are excited by regular travel
  • Are motivated by ambitious revenue goals and take pride in winning strategic, high-impact partnerships

Your day to day is…

  • Identifying, prospecting, and developing new business opportunities across large health systems
  • Building strategic relationships with executive stakeholders and establishing yourself as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process
  • Owning the full enterprise sales cycle—from initial outreach through contract negotiation and signed agreement
  • Leading complex, multi-threaded sales motions across clinical, operational, financial, IT, legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders
  • Developing account strategies and territory plans to prioritize high-value opportunities and drive sustainable pipeline growth
  • Delivering compelling executive presentations and building business cases that demonstrate measurable value for prospective clients
  • Forecasting pipeline, revenue, and deal progression with a high degree of accuracy
  • Partnering closely with Product, Marketing, Solutions, Finance, Legal, and Client Success to navigate complex deals and ensure a seamless transition to long-term partnership
  • Representing Zocdoc at client meetings, industry events, and conferences while traveling up to 75%

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • 7-10+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a proven track record of sourcing, developing, and closing net-new business within large health systems
  • Demonstrated success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive, clinical, operational, financial, IT, legal, and procurement leaders
  • A history of consistently meeting or exceeding ambitious revenue targets in a quota-carrying role
  • Exceptional executive presence with experience building trusted relationships and influencing C-suite decision-makers
  • Strong account planning, territory strategy, and pipeline management skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and executive audiences
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with teams including Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Solutions, and Client Success to drive successful outcomes
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred), Google Workspace, and AI-powered productivity tools

Benefits

  • Flexible work environment
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
  • 401(k) with employer funded match
  • Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
  • Great Place to Work Certified

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity.

Remote Base Salary Range
$144,500—$218,500 USD

About usZocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by oursix core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Sr Customer Success Manager
description:
At Skillsoft, we believe skills fuel growth. Our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress.

Senior Customer Success Manager

Skillsoft is seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) to work with our customers to translate business and workforce priorities into a clear success strategy. The role combines executive engagement, skills and workforce strategy, data-led value realization, commercial acumen, and cross-functional orchestration in an increasingly AI-enabled and skills-based world.

In this role, the CSM will have the opportunity to serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of enterprise customers, helping them maximize the value of Skillsoft’s workforce transformation and skills development solutions. Partner with learning, talent, HR, and business leaders to accelerate adoption, deliver measurable outcomes, strengthen retention, and identify opportunities for long-term growth.

The successful candidate will own the customer success plan across onboarding, adoption, value realization, expansion readiness, and renewal, while partnering closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product and internal specialists to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Customer Leadership

  • Act as a strategic advisor to learning, talent, HR, and business leaders, aligning skills development and workforce transformation priorities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships across customer organizations, including with executive sponsors, and translate platform, engagement, and skills insights into relevant strategic recommendations.
  • Create and maintain customer success plans with clear goals, milestones, success measures, owners, and review cadences.
  • Partner with customers to shape skills-based workforce strategies using Skillsoft’s learning, coaching, skills intelligence, and related capabilities to address priority capability gaps.

Value realization & business outcomes

  • Guide customers through implementation, launch, promotion, adoption, and ongoing optimization of their learning and skilling programs.
  • Guide and manage customers through platform evolution, AI-powered experiences, and program or operating-model change by establishing adoption strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, and success measures.
  • Analyze engagement, adoption, skills, and outcome data to identify trends, produce actionable insights, and demonstrate value to operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Oversee outcome-focused business reviews that assess progress against the customer’s strategy, key performance measures, risks, opportunities, and next priorities.
  • Articulate Skillsoft’s value proposition and connect learning and skills development to organizational transformation, business growth, workforce readiness, and competitive differentiation.

Retention, growth, and account health

  • Own customer health and success across the assigned portfolio, proactively identifying adoption barriers, risk signals, and potential churn and coordinating timely mitigation plans.
  • Drive retention and expansion readiness by understanding customer priorities, maturity, outcomes, and evolving business needs.
  • Proactively identify white-space and growth opportunities and partner with the Account Executive on account strategy, timing, readiness, value, renewal, and expansion motions.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer plans, health assessments, risks, outcomes, opportunities, and follow-up actions in the designated systems.

Cross-functional orchestration and customer advocacy

  • Serve as the customer advocate and orchestrator across Sales, Solutions, Product, Professional Services, Support, and other internal teams to drive coordinated execution and customer outcomes.
  • Lead or facilitate resolution of customer issues and concerns, ensuring clear ownership, communication, and follow-through with both customer and internal stakeholders.
  • Capture and communicate customer feedback, market insight, and content or product needs to the appropriate Skillsoft teams to inform prioritization and repeatable customer-success practices.
  • Stay current on digital learning, skills, AI, technology, and workforce trends, and apply relevant insights in customer conversations.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, Sales, or Professional Services, in enterprise software, digital learning, talent, or HR technology with a Bachelor’s degree in business, education, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience managing a high-volume portfolio of 30+ enterprise customers \ up to $ 7m book of business within an assigned territory.
  • Demonstrated experience advising senior leaders and executives on learning, talent, workforce upskilling, organizational capability, or business transformation priorities.
  • Strong understanding of digital learning, skills development, learning strategy, talent management, skills taxonomies, and competency development.
  • Ability to interpret engagement, adoption, skills, and business outcome data and turn it into a concise, compelling value story and practical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen, including identifying growth signals, influencing account strategy, and supporting retention and expansion outcomes.
  • Strong executive communication, consulting, facilitation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Effective project and stakeholder management, with the ability to prioritize across a complex customer portfolio and operate with clear follow-through.
  • Critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills that balance data with responsive, independent, and solution-focused action.
  • Ability to adapt to changing customer strategies, platform capabilities, team relationships, and organizational priorities.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and ChurnZero or equivalent customer-success platforms.
  • Working knowledge of technology and developer skills, current AI trends, and their relevance to workforce development.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills, with proficiency in Word and Outlook.
  • Experience working across distributed teams and engaging customers and internal stakeholders across ANZ.

Success in this role

Success will be demonstrated through measurable customer outcomes, sustained adoption, strong executive sponsorship, proactive risk management, high-quality renewal readiness, and well-qualified growth opportunities developed in partnership with Sales.

MORE ABOUT SKILLSOFT:

Skillsoft (NYSE: SKIL) is a global leader in AI-native skills management for the human + AI era. By unifying learning, real-time skills intelligence, and workforce insights, Skillsoft helps enterprises build their Skillforce™ — humans and AI working together to drive measurable business outcomes. Through personalized, interactive learning across leadership, technology, and compliance, Skillsoft enables organizations to close critical skill gaps and accelerate transformation. Skillsoft is trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 1000, and supports a global community of more than 105 million learners. Learn more at skillsoft.com.
