You’ll work with in-house teams (including other Security Engineers on our team, and SOC Analysts) to identify the right mix of tools, techniques, and procedures to translate our customer’s needs and future goals into a plan that will enable secure and effective solutions. In determining the best solutions, you will investigate new techniques, break free from the legacy model, and help customers exceed industry standards. As a team, we’ll take a critical approach to solution design, identifying gaps, providing alternatives, and customizing solutions to maintain a balance of security and business needs. This position is open to remote personnel anywhere within the U.S.

Specific Job Responsibilities

  • Administer multi-tenant consoles (Falcon Flight Control parent/child CIDs, Defender multi-tenant management, SentinelOne sites and groups), including RBAC, policy inheritance, and sensor update rings
  • Tune prevention and detection policies to cut noise without opening gaps
  • Track sensor health and coverage: Unmanaged hosts, reduced-functionality mode, stale sensors, and version drift
  • Administer EDR-to-SIEM pipelines into Sumo Logic Cloud SIEM, Microsoft Sentinel, and Stellar Cyber
  • Build and maintain API integrations between EDR platforms, SOAR, ticketing, and threat intel
  • Plan and run EDR deployments and migrations for new customers: Sensor rollout through Intune, SCCM, GPO, or Jamf; policy design; exclusions

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years deploying or administering an enterprise EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or comparable) in production, plus 2+ years of systems administration
  • At least one EDR deployment or migration you ran end to end: Rollout, policy, exclusions, and handoff to operations
  • Experience with Windows internals and macOS/Linux administration to troubleshoot sensor problems, such as service failures, system extensions, eBPF, AV conflicts, proxies, and TLS inspection
  • Active experience with SIEM work, e.g. onboarding of log sources, event parsing, field extractions, and query creation across a variety of tools
  • PowerShell plus Python or Go, including scripting API access and endpoint deployment scripts
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and how attacker techniques show up in endpoint telemetry
  • Excellent writing skills for creating runbooks, incident summaries, and configuration guides

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years focused on CrowdStrike Falcon or SentinelOne, or production experience with more than one of the following EDR products: Falcon, Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne
  • MSSP or other multi-tenant operations experience
  • Sysmon deployment and configuration tuning, for customers without a commercial EDR or as extra visibility alongside one
  • Experience supporting federal or public-sector environments: NIST SP 800-53 controls, the Risk Management Framework, FedRAMP, and federal security authorization and assessment processes

Perks

  • Start-up company in a growth phase with opportunity for advancement based on performance
  • Start-up culture with an office in downtown Salt Lake City, UT
  • Competitive medical and dental benefits for employee and family members
  • Other company-provided benefits such as short-term disability, basic life insurance, children’s orthodontia, with additional voluntary benefits available, and 401K match
  • Flexible Paid Time Off policy
  • Professional Development opportunities specific to role

title: Account Executive
description:
Who We Are

Learning something new can open doors, bring people together, and change a life. At CourseStorm, we help make those opportunities easier to find and join.

Since 2012, our software has helped arts, culture, and education organizations simplify class registration, reach more students, and grow their programs. That means less administrative work for the people running those programs, and more time for the communities they serve.

We’re a small, friendly team that cares about doing good work and helping one another succeed. Our values (Simplicity, Helpfulness, and Growth) guide how we build our product, work with customers, and treat each other. As an Account Executive, you’ll get to know people doing meaningful work and help them decide whether CourseStorm is the right fit for their organization.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Account Executive to help generate and close new opportunities. You’ll own the full sales cycle, helping arts, culture, and education organizations simplify class registration and grow their programs.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and engaging prospects through discovery, demos, proposals, and closing new business.
  • Lead discovery conversations that uncover business challenges, goals, and decision-making processes, helping prospects connect their needs to the value CourseStorm can deliver.
  • Deliver personalized demos that show how CourseStorm can solve each organization’s challenges and support its goals.
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders and guide opportunities forward with clear next steps and an understanding of what each organization needs to make a decision.
  • Develop proposals, navigate objections, and lead pricing conversations to close business.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, manage your pipeline, and provide reliable forecasts of expected sales.
  • Develop expertise in CourseStorm’s platform, customers, competitors, and market, and sharpen your sales skills through regular coaching, call reviews, and role-playing.
  • Research organizations that could benefit from CourseStorm and develop thoughtful outbound plans for your book of accounts.
  • Generate qualified pipeline through cold calling, personalized email, and other creative prospecting strategies while meeting activity, pipeline, and revenue goals.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

At least one year of experience as an Account Executive in a closing role at a SaaS company is required.

We’re looking for someone with the drive, curiosity, and coachability to build on that experience and continue developing their skills.

You’ll likely thrive here if you are:

  • Coachable and eager to learn. You seek feedback, apply it quickly, and enjoy developing new skills.
  • Motivated to grow in SaaS sales. You’re driven by goals, continuous improvement, and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility.
  • Curious and thoughtful. You ask good open-ended questions and seek to understand before offering solutions.
  • Creative. You look for personalized, compelling ways to stand out and earn a prospect’s attention.
  • Comfortable with outbound. You’re willing to pick up the phone, start conversations, and stay resilient when you hear “no.”
  • Hardworking and consistent. You believe sustained effort creates opportunities and take ownership of your results.
  • Organized and proactive. You can manage multiple opportunities, prioritize your time, and keep commitments to prospects and teammates.
  • A strong communicator and teammate. You communicate clearly, share ideas, and enjoy helping others succeed.

Preferred qualifications: Familiarity with HubSpot and experience working with education, arts and culture, or nonprofit organizations are a plus.

Benefits

Why Join CourseStorm?

We care about the work we do and the lives we lead outside it. You’ll join a team that shares ideas, offers honest feedback, celebrates progress, and makes room to learn. You’ll have ownership of your work, hands-on coaching, and colleagues you can turn to for help.

Our benefits support that same approach:

  • Keep learning, just for you. A $1,000 annual personal learning stipend to buy books, take a class with a friend, or explore something you’ve always wanted to learn.
  • Grow professionally. Paid professional development, along with regular sales coaching and feedback.
  • Make your workspace work for you. A $1,200 home-office budget.
  • Have room for life outside work. Take-what-you-need paid time off, paid holidays, and parental leave.
  • Work remotely, stay connected. A U.S.-based remote role with occasional travel to Maine.
  • Support your health and future. Medical, dental, and vision insurance; short-term disability and life insurance; and a retirement plan.

CourseStorm has been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in Maine. We want to keep earning that recognition through how we support our people every day.

Our Hiring Philosophy

We believe everyone has a role to play in building a better world through education. The unique experiences, perspectives, and talents of our team members aren’t just welcomed, they’re essential to our success.

CourseStorm is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities to join us in expanding access to lifelong learning. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or national origin.

title: Senior Shopify Plus Developer (025 - 1453)
description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Senior Shopify Plus Developer

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Compensation range:$2,000 AUD - $3,000 AUD / Monthly (before tax and deductions)

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian digital commerce consultancy that helps retailers and consumer brands build, improve, and scale their online businesses. They combine technical development, digital strategy, and customer experience expertise to deliver tailored e-commerce solutions, integrations, and ongoing platform improvements. With growing demand for online store development, they are expanding their technical capabilities to support a diverse range of projects and clients.

Role Overview: The Shopify Developer is a senior, hands-on developer who builds and ships Shopify work to a high standard, working to direction set by a Shopify Tech Lead (STL). This is a delivery role rather than a consulting one: the Developer does not own scoping, solutioning with the client, or the client relationship. They own the quality, accuracy and timeliness of what they build.

The role is expected to be deeply capable on Shopify Plus: Liquid and theme architecture, the Plus extension surfaces including Checkout UI Extensions and Customer Account Extensions, Functions, Markets, and the Storefront and Admin APIs. Hydrogen and React experience is valuable where middleware, an API proxy layer or headless components form part of a solution.

The Developer works within scope that has already been defined, but is not expected to consume a ticket passively. They estimate it honestly, interrogate it for gaps, ambiguity and hidden dependencies before starting, flag anything that looks like scope movement, and test their own work properly before it leaves their hands.

Client communication sits with the Shopify Tech Lead and the Project Manager. The Developer is not client-facing, but is expected to be an excellent communicator internally: clear written updates, early flags, and the confidence to challenge a task that does not make sense.

This role does not own: client relationships or client communication, scoping and requirements definition, solution architecture, commercial estimates issued to the client, or project coordination. Those sit with the Shopify Tech Lead, the Shopify Solution Architect and the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

Development Delivery

  • Build Shopify storefront, theme, app and integration work to the agreed technical approach, meeting Amblique's coding standards and the client's acceptance criteria.
  • Work from scope and solutions defined by the Shopify Tech Lead or Solution Architect. Deliver to that design, and surface any point where it does not survive contact with implementation.
  • Deliver across BAU support, dedicated team retainers, mini projects and implementation projects, understanding that the engagement model changes the process and the tolerance for scope movement.
  • Fix defects raised in QA, UAT and post-go-live on own work within the agreed defect process, distinguishing genuine defects from change requests and raising the latter per Change Management Processes
  • Support deployment, release and go-live activity for own work, including environment checks and post-release verification.
  • Triage and resolve assigned incidents promptly, with sound judgment about severity and when to escalate.

Estimation & Scope Protection

  • Produce accurate, defensible estimates for assigned work, including allowance for testing, review and deployment, and provide them within the turnaround agreed with the Shopify Tech Lead & PM.
  • Interrogate a ticket before starting it. Where requirements are ambiguous, incomplete, or assume work that is not described, raise it before development begins rather than filling the gap silently.
  • Protect agreed scope. Where a request grows beyond what was estimated or approved, stop and flag it rather than absorbing it.
  • Flag risk to date or budget as soon as it is visible, not at the point of impact.
  • Re-estimate and communicate immediately where new information materially changes the effort required.

Quality & Developer QA

  • Test own work before it is handed on: functional testing against acceptance criteria, cross-browser and responsive checks, and regression checks on the areas touched.
  • Record evidence of developer QA on the ticket so the Shopify Tech Lead and QA can see what was covered and what was not.
  • Participate in code review, both as author and reviewer, and act on feedback rather than relitigating it.
  • Treat a defect found in own work after handover as a signal to tighten developer QA, not simply something to fix.
  • Leave the codebase in a state another developer can pick up: readable, consistent with standards, and documented where behaviour is non-obvious.

Internal Process & Communication

  • Treat Jira as the system of record. Work, decisions, blockers and time logging belong on the ticket, not in chat threads.
  • Keep tickets accurate as they move. Status and assignee updated whenever work changes hands, and priorities honoured as set, with any proposed reordering raised with the Shopify Tech Lead first.
  • Log time daily and accurately against the correct ticket.
  • Resolve confusion at the earliest point. Where direction or priority is unclear, ask in standup or directly rather than proceeding on assumption.
  • Communicate in writing, clearly and early. A blocker raised at the start of the day costs far less than the same blocker raised at the end of the week.
  • Escalate properly. If something should be solved and is not moving, raise it with the Shopify Tech Lead & PM, and escalate further if it stays stuck.
  • Handle client access and data responsibly. Use only the access granted for the account, follow the agreed environment and credential practices, and never move production customer data into local or test environments.
  • Client communication sits with the Shopify Tech Lead and the Project Manager. The Developer does not communicate directly with clients unless an alternative arrangement is agreed.

Technical Standards & AI Enablement

  • Work to the practice's coding standards, theme architecture and deployment tooling, and feed back where a standard is not working in practice.
  • Maintain awareness of Shopify platform changes, including API changes and deprecations, and flag implications for the accounts worked on.
  • Use AI tooling in development in line with the agency's AI-first direction, and contribute to improving how the team applies it.
  • Engage in internal R&D and capability-building activities during lower-workload periods.

Career Path

This is a senior individual contributor role, and the most senior development role that is not clientfacing. The pathway from here is to Shopify Tech Lead, where the engagement model allows.

Progression is based on demonstrated accuracy, the quality of delivered work, reliability of communication, and a growing ability to hold a technical conversation about a client's wider context rather than a single ticket.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5 or more years of hands-on Shopify development, with significant time on Shopify Plus and enterprise merchant configurations.
  • Deep Liquid and theme architecture capability, including performance-conscious storefront development.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify Plus extension surfaces, including Checkout UI Extensions and Customer Account Extensions.
  • Strong working knowledge of Shopify Functions, Markets, and the Storefront and Admin APIs.
  • Experience with custom Shopify app development, public and private.
  • Exposure to third party integration patterns such as ERP, loyalty, fulfilment and POS.
  • Hydrogen and React experience, particularly where used for middleware, an API proxy layer or headless components, is an advantage.
  • Understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD deployment pipelines in a Shopify context.
  • Proven ability to produce accurate estimates and deliver to a defined scope in an agency or professional services environment.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tooling such as Cursor.
  • Excellent written and verbal English: able to explain technical detail clearly in writing and verbally, and to raise problems early and directly.
  • Comfortable working as part of a distributed team, with sufficient overlap with Australian Eastern business hours for daily collaboration.

Reporting Structure

  • Solid line: Shopify Practice Lead, who owns standards, tooling, workflow and team capability.
  • Day to day direction: Shopify Tech Lead on each assigned account. The Tech Lead sets the technical approach, assigns and prioritises work, and provides performance input to the Practice Lead.
  • Works closely with: Shopify Solution Architect, Shopify Tech Lead, Project Managers, Delivery Managers, other Developers, and QA.
  • Alongside the Project Manager. The Project Manager owns the commercial and delivery wrapper: scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, change control and client reporting. The Shopify Developer surfaces anything that moves date, cost or scope to the Shopify Tech Lead, who carries it to the PM and the client. Where a problem is structural or beyond the Developer's remit, the Tech Lead and PM own the client conversation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Delivery Performance - Assigned work delivered within estimate and to agreed dates. Blockers raised the day they appear rather than at the point of impact. Incidents actioned within the agreed SLA for the account
  • Estimate Accuracy - Actual versus estimated variance under 15% on own work, excluding approved scope changes and work paused by external dependency. Estimates provided within the turnaround agreed with the Shopify Tech Lead, with testing, review and deployment effort included rather than assumed away.
  • Developer QA - Evidence of developer QA recorded on the ticket for all work, covering acceptance criteria, cross-browser and responsive checks, and regression on areas touched.
  • Technical Lead Feedback - Positive qualitative feedback from the Shopify Tech Lead and Practice Lead on code quality, reliability, responsiveness to review, and clarity of written communication.
  • Software Quality - Defects attributable to own work are found in developer QA before handover. Under 10% of defects on own work are first raised by the client during UAT or after go-live. Defects found by QA are tracked as a trend rather than a threshold, and are expected to reduce over time. No repeat defects of the same root cause. No unplanned hotfix within 48 hours of a release.
  • Scope Protection - Scope gaps, ambiguous requirements and out-of-scope requests raised before development starts, not after. Work that grows beyond what was estimated is stopped and flagged rather than absorbed
  • Jira Hygiene & Capacity Visibility - Time logged daily against the correct ticket. Status and assignee current as work moves. Capacity risk flagged at least one business day prior
  • Practice & AI Contribution - At least one meaningful internal contribution per quarter across tooling, the theme framework, R&D or AI initiatives, with time allocated by the Practice Lead rather than absorbed outside client hours.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up via an Employer of Record (EOR) service.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile

title: Marketing Coordinator | Regulated DTC Consumer Brand
description:
Company Overview:

Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that's left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.

Your Role:

This is a hands-on marketing generalist role for someone who likes building things, not just planning them. Part of your week goes to using AI tools like Claude Code to connect systems, clean up lists, and automate repetitive work. The rest goes to running campaigns with the sales, field, and partnerships teams. You’ll work directly with the two founders, with plenty of ownership and visibility.

Success looks like:

  • An outreach process for retail and partners that mostly runs on its own

  • A field team that has what it needs and gets better each round

  • Search, email, retention, and referral programs driving steady growth

  • Numbers the whole team can trust

About the category: This is a regulated product, so a few rules are fixed. No health, quit-smoking, or performance claims. All marketing stays 18+ and UK-only. No paid social or paid search. If you enjoy creative problem-solving within clear boundaries, you’ll like it here.

You'll:

  • Build and run outreach to retailers and partners: finding the right contacts, writing the emails, and tracking what works

  • Support the field team with target lists, routes, one-pagers, and follow-up emails after visits

  • Own email and SMS, subscription retention (win-back and pause offers), referral programs, and search/content

  • Create marketing visuals with AI tools, using the brand’s existing look and feel

  • Automate recurring manual tasks so nobody has to do them by hand

  • Track results from the company’s own order and subscription data, and flag anything that looks off

You Bring:

  • Hands-on experience using Claude Code (or a similar AI coding tool) to build something real that’s still in use today. This is the one must-have; most of the rest can be learned on the job

  • 3+ years in marketing. Many great fits started in a coordinator role and taught themselves to pull data or set up tools instead of waiting on someone else

  • Experience running cold email outreach yourself, using a tool like Apollo plus an email sequencing tool

  • Comfort working with spreadsheets and data; SQL is a plus, and getting there with help is fine

  • Some scripting in Python or JavaScript, or experience directing AI to write it for you

  • Familiarity with connecting tools through APIs

  • A good marketing eye and clear, simple writing

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with tools like Apollo, n8n, SQL databases, SEO tools, or AI image tools

  • Marketing experience in a regulated industry (alcohol, supplements, pharma, gambling, etc.)

  • DTC, subscription, or ecommerce experience, especially retention and referral programs

What’s Offered:

  • Based in Austin, TX, or remote with 9–5 CT overlap

  • Work directly with the two founders

  • Real ownership and autonomy over the growth strategy

  • The chance to help build the company’s AI and automation setup from the ground up

  • Compensation based on experience and location

Interview Process:

  • 1️⃣ Apply with a short note naming one thing you've built with Claude Code and what it does today (link it if you can)

  • 2️⃣ Screening call (30 minutes) — walking through that build in detail

  • 3️⃣ Paid exercise (about 3 hours) — given a target segment and API access, produce a scored, enriched contact list, a three-touch sequence, and the script or flow that generated it; one touch has to survive a claims review

  • 4️⃣ Working session with a founder — pick the exercise apart together and build one more thing live in Claude Code

We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

State and local government is in the middle of a generational shift in how it operates. Agencies and departments that have run on legacy systems for decades are now modernizing their finance, HR, payroll, and procurement functions, with legacy ERP migrations representing one of the largest replacement cycles the public sector has ever seen. All of this while the promise and reality of AI is changing the way we deliver and the opportunities for functional transformation inside and outside of the ERP.

The stakes are significant. These are not technology projects in isolation. They determine how a state pays its workforce, manages its budget, processes federal grants, and delivers services to the public. Done well, they free up capacity and give agencies the operational foundation to do more with what they have. Done poorly, they create disruption that is difficult to undo and politically costly to explain.


Our State Government practice is at the forefront in driving this reinvention, working with state agencies, departments, and county governments on the strategy, readiness, and implementations that matter most to them. If this market excites you and you have the experience to make a difference in it, we would like to meet you.

THE WORK

As a state government transformation lead, you combine state and local government functional expertise with the ability to lead complex, technology-enabled institutional transformation, from strategy and readiness through design, implementation, stabilization, and value realization. We are seeking individuals who have demonstrated this through overall program delivery or deep experience in a specific functional domain. Finance, HR, payroll, or procurement is where you built your career and where your credibility lives.

State government implementations fail for predictable reasons, and they are almost never about the technology. They fail because the complexity of civil service constraints was underestimated. Because change management in a government culture was treated as a project task instead of a sustained leadership responsibility. Because integration dependencies with statewide financial systems, federal reporting environments, and legislative systems were scoped too late. Because data migration, including payroll history, position control records, and appropriations structures, was underplanned and politically underestimated.


The practitioners we are looking for understand all of this before the project kickoff. We are looking for Finance leaders who know that a state close cycle feeds legislative reporting and audit requirements, and design accordingly. HR leaders who have navigated civil service frameworks and built adoption strategies that work in a workforce where change is viewed with skepticism. Payroll leaders who understand multi-jurisdiction compliance and deduction complexity from the inside. Procurement leaders who know what state agencies actually need from a sourcing system and how regulatory constraints shape every design decision.


You will own senior client relationships in your domain, lead high-stakes engagements, work collaboratively across teams and for our clients, help shape markets before the RFP is written, and raise the functional quality of everything the team delivers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead Cloud ERP engagements, with a lens on business transformation, for state and county government clients, either as an overall delivery lead or as the senior owner of the functional tower in your domain, with accountability for quality, client relationships, and outcomes.
  • Own senior client relationships in your functional area, engaging as a peer who understands what they are managing, not just what they have asked for.
  • Drive functional design decisions that account for the full complexity of how state government actually operates: appropriations-driven budgeting, civil service workforce structures, multi-jurisdiction payroll compliance, procurement regulations, and legislative and audit reporting obligations.
  • Lead change management strategy within your domain, building adoption approaches that account for civil service culture, union considerations, and the reality that government workforces have seen technology promises come and go.
  • Own integration strategy within your tower, understanding how your functional domain connects to statewide financial systems, federal reporting environments, legislative systems, and other agency platforms, and ensuring those dependencies are designed for, not discovered late.
  • Lead data migration strategy within your domain, addressing payroll history, position control records, appropriations structures, and other historically and politically sensitive data with the rigor and stakeholder care that government environments require.
  • Bring AI-assisted delivery, platform-native AI capabilities, and responsible workflow automation into engagements as standard practice, and help clients think through what governed AI adoption looks like in a public sector context. Outside of ERP toolsets, bring modernization and functional opportunities for AI process redesign and automation.
  • Contribute to must-win pursuits and proposals, bringing the kind of domain credibility that changes what a state government evaluator thinks of us, because they can tell within the first ten minutes whether someone understands their agency or is pitching a generic playbook.
  • Help shape the market well before RFP: build relationships with state functional leaders, engage with platform account teams on joint pipeline, and represent the practice at NASACT, GFOA, NGA, and related forums.
  • Contribute to practice development including solutions, services, and client outcomes for use on future engagements.
  • Develop junior and mid-level practitioners in your functional area, helping them build the domain depth, change management instincts, and platform fluency that make the whole team more credible.

Travel: Ability to travel 50%+

WHAT YOU NEED

Required:

  • Minimum 7 years of consulting or functional experience in state or county government environments engaging directly with senior functional executives with Senior-level functional expertise in at least one domain: state government finance and budget operations, HR and workforce transformation, payroll administration, or procurement and contract management.
  • Minimum 7 years of hands-on delivery experience with Cloud ERP in a functional capacity, including demonstrated experience as a delivery lead or senior functional tower owner on large, complex ERP engagements or similar government-wide transformations, with accountability for design quality, senior relationships, and outcomes in your domain.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience in a senior functional operating role within state or county government, such as a state budget official, Controller, HR Director, Payroll Director, or Chief Procurement Officer. People who have sat in the chair.
  • Finance: Cloud ERP Financials delivery experience in a state or multi-agency context. Deep familiarity with GASB fund accounting, all-funds budgeting, appropriations management, federal grant compliance, and the legislative and audit reporting cycles that govern state finance.
  • HR: Cloud ERP HCM delivery experience in a civil service or large workforce context. Experience with position management, classification reform, or workforce transformation design, and building adoption strategies that work in a civil service environment.
  • Payroll: Cloud ERP Payroll delivery experience with exposure to state-specific compliance, deduction and benefit complexity, or multi-jurisdiction payroll environments.
  • Procurement: Cloud ERP Procurement delivery experience with knowledge of state procurement regulations, sourcing transformation, or contract lifecycle management.
  • Experience managing data migration complexity in government environments, including payroll history, position control records, appropriations structures, and other sensitive data that requires both technical rigor and careful stakeholder management.
  • Experience with integration design in complex government environments, connecting ERP platforms to statewide financial systems, federal reporting databases, legislative systems, or other agency applications.
  • Experience contributing to competitive state government pursuits, including pre-RFP positioning, SLED market relationships, and engagement with platform account teams. Familiarity with the government procurement and RFP process from the client side is a significant differentiator.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred. Equivalent experience considered.

title: GTM Engineer (f/m/d) Revenue Operations
description:
At aedifion, you will actively shape the future of energy-efficient building operations. Our mission is to make existing buildings smarter, more sustainable, and easier to manage making a real contribution to CO₂ reduction. You'll join an innovative tech company that uses cutting-edge technologies like IoT, AI, and cloud solutions to enable sustainable real estate. Our culture? Open, diverse, and team-oriented. With more than 100 colleagues from various nations, we combine a wide range of expertise and perspectives to achieve big things together.

Your impact in this position:

As our GTM Engineer (f/m/d) - Revenue Operations, your mission is to make sure our revenue organization grows in a way that is strong, predictable and scalable. You combine data analysis with consistent process automation, and you play a key part in giving Sales more time for what actually matters, in raising forecast quality to a new level, and in building a go-to-market (GTM) structure that scales with aedifion.

What you can expect:

  • Sales enablement roadmap: Take ownership of the prioritized sales enablement roadmap and drive it forward, so that manual work in Sales goes down step by step through workflow automation.

  • Forecast and pipeline: Define what good pipeline quality and forecast accuracy mean at aedifion, track how both develop, and turn what you see into concrete measures that make our planning more reliable.

  • Turning data into decisions: Analyze GTM data from different sources, spot patterns and connections, and translate them into clear recommendations that revenue leaders and the C-level can act on.

  • GTM process architecture: Design and improve the processes along the entire GTM funnel, set clear definitions and handovers between teams, and keep developing them based on your own analyses.

  • Building agents and governance: Build and roll out AI agents for recurring steps in GTM work, establish one common standard for how AI automation is used, and keep quality and oversight across all teams.

  • GTM tech stack: Evaluate tools against defined criteria, prepare well-founded decision papers, and shape together with our Head of Business Operations how new solutions fit into our existing tool landscape.

  • Strategic GTM planning: Create the analytical basis for decisions on growth, market coverage and compensation, so they rest on solid data and set the right incentives for our team.

At aedifion we foster an open and appreciative culture where everyone can develop freely, regardless of background, gender, age, ability or orientation. We offer a safe space for personal growth and independent work. Flexibility and openness matter to us, so that everyone can work with authenticity and enjoy what they do. We especially welcome applications from women.

Requirements

What you bring along:

  • Experience: You hold a university degree and have already taken ownership in Revenue Operations with results you can point to, ideally in a scale-up or start-up environment.

  • Automation and AI: You know process automation and AI-supported workflows from your own hands-on work, you have implemented concrete use cases yourself, and you know where they add the most value in GTM.

  • Data analysis: You bring complex data from different sources together, see the patterns in it and turn them into recommendations that revenue leaders and the C-level can act on.

  • CRM and BI tools: You know your way around Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and you have experience presenting data clearly with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Metabase.

  • Stakeholder coordination: You have worked with different teams before, you know how to moderate competing requirements, communicate priorities clearly and make complex topics understandable for everyone involved.

  • GTM expertise: You know the key metrics of a revenue organization, you understand how pipeline, forecast and stage velocity work, and you have a solid grasp of retention metrics such as NRR, renewal rate and expansion.

  • Languages and tools: With very good German and English (C1 each) you communicate confidently across the team. Experience with Confluence or a comparable tool and with the Microsoft 365 environment rounds off your profile.

Benefits

  • Make a difference: Your work helps to reduce CO₂ emissions and make buildings more sustainable and energy-efficient.

  • Mobile work: Organise your working day according to your needs – with flexible working hours, short core working hours and the freedom to work from our modern office in Cologne, remotely from anywhere in Germany or up to 10 days a year from other European countries.

  • Feel-good offer: With 30 days of annual leave, you can relax and unwind, while fresh organic fruit, regional coffee, free drinks and our monthly team breakfast provide you with your daily energy boost.

  • Further training: We support you with tailor-made training opportunities to advance your career.

  • Tech stack: You will receive modern work equipment of your choice – whether Microsoft or Apple – as well as high-quality noise-cancelling headphones for focused work.

  • Mobility package: Always mobile: you can choose between the Germany Ticket or a Jobrad bike – for your commute or private use.

  • Pension provision: Subsidies for capital-forming benefits (VWL) or company pension schemes (bAV).

  • Stay active: With our Urban Sports Club membership, you have access to a wide range of sports and fitness offers – to help you recharge and stay healthy inside and outside of work.

  • #teamaedifion: Regular team events, working on an equal footing, actively sharing experiences and flat hierarchies promote strong teamwork and open communication within our team.

  • Dog-friendly office: Bring your dog along – we look forward to some animal support.

Highlights

GTM Engineer (f/m/d) - Revenue Operations at aedifion, RevOps for a B2B SaaS scale-up, Salesforce, pipeline and forecasting, GTM process automation with AI agents

title: Enrollment Specialist
description:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark’s comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark’s groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation’s foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Enrollment Specialist, you will be a frontline ambassador for Daymark Health—building trust with healthcare providers, enrolling new patients, and helping individuals access compassionate, team-based care. You’ll spend time over the phones in our office introducing our services to potential patients, supporting patient referrals and enrollment, and delivering an exceptional first experience to those joining Daymark’s program.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Make 50+ outbound calls per day to prospective patients and caregivers to introduce Daymark’s services and support.
  • Guide patients through our enrollment process, surfacing goals and concerns to help tailor support.
  • Respond to inbound communications, triage requests, and ensure patients are connected to the right team members.
  • Obtain patient consent, complete enrollment surveys, and escalate urgent needs to our clinical teams.
  • Share feedback with internal teams based on patient and provider needs, referral trends, and barriers to access.
  • Work a structured schedule with coverage to ensure patient access

What Success Looks Like in 3 Months

  • You’ve become a go-to resource for both patients and providers, known for your professionalism, warmth, and follow-through.
  • You’ve contributed to improvements in our enrollment process and patient experience by identifying gaps and opportunities.
  • You’re hitting your daily, weekly, and monthly enrollment goals day, while ensuring a great patient experience
  • You’re passing regular call audits for compliance and quality

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Sales/Enrollment experience - you have 3+ years of experience in an enrollment, patient outreach, call center, or SDR role with high phone volume and are motivated to help patients access better care and hit enrollment targets.
  • Relational & Empathetic: You know how to build trust—quickly and genuinely—with both providers and patients. You lead with curiosity, empathy, and clarity.
  • Organized & Proactive: You take initiative, stay on top of details, and bring structure to dynamic or ambiguous situations.
  • Excited about Startups: You can make a big impact at a start up, but you need to be comfortable with frequent change!
  • Strong Communicator: You write and speak clearly and professionally. You tailor your communication to fit your audience and situation.
  • Tech-Savvy: You have documented in a CRM such as Salesforce and know how to use tools like Slack, Salesforce, Zoom, Google Suite, and EHRs. You adapt easily to new systems and workflows
  • Bilingual: While not required, fluency in multiple languages is a plus.

Location: This role is fully remote but candidates must be based within Southern California. Hours for the role are Mon-Fri, 8:30 AM to 5 PM Eastern with flexibility for evening or weekend coverage.

Compensation: This role will be compensated with a base + commission structure. We anticipate the base to be approximately $60,000 to $70,000 (depending on location & experience) with an opportunity for a $10,000-$15,000 commission, should you hit performance and enrollment targets.

Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

All Daymark Health patient-facing roles require Basic Life Support (BLS) certification and compliance with Daymark's Employee Vaccination and Testing policy. Candidates without these at the time of hire should coordinate with their recruiter and hiring manager to ensure they meet the requirements by their start date.

All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.

title: VP, Client Success
description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable

Overview

Most Client Success leaders are asked to keep things running.

We're asking you to rethink how it runs.

The Opportunity

HealthEquity is changing how we serve our clients and the value we create for them. We need a leader to help shape what comes next for Client Success. As Vice President, Client Success, you'll lead about 250 team members who serve about 5,000 mid-market and enterprise clients. Those clients represent about 80% of HealthEquity's client revenue. The organization covers COBRA, Reimbursement Accounts, and Public Sector, across our full range of Consumer-Driven Benefits.

You'll have a clear mandate: build a Client Success organization that is more proactive, strategic, digital, data-driven, and scalable. You'll own the strategy, the operating model, the financial results, and the client outcomes. Success shows up in retention, client health, service performance, and cost to serve. This role isn't about managing the current model. It's about building the next one.

Why This Role Is Different

Scale: You'll lead one of the company's largest client-facing organizations and the relationships behind most of its client revenue.

Mandate: You'll have room to challenge legacy practices, redesign service models, and solve problems at the source.

Technology: You'll set the data, automation, and AI vision for Client Success and lead the change that makes it real.

Influence: You'll be an enterprise leader who brings the client's voice into product, technology, process, and policy decisions.

What Success Looks Like

Our clients feel the difference. They see a HealthEquity that understands their needs, spots risk early, makes things easier, and keeps proving the value of the relationship. We'll measure success by:

  • Stronger retention, renewal readiness, and protected revenue
  • Better Client NPS, Client Health Index (CHI), and executive relationships
  • Client risks spotted and resolved earlier
  • Fewer escalations, faster resolution, and fewer defects
  • Lower cost to serve, with more productivity and capacity
  • A scalable service model that is proactive, digital-first, and built on clear measures
  • Strong leaders, real succession depth, and an engaged team

What You'll Do

Reimagine Client Success

  • Set the multiyear vision and strategy for the next generation of Client Success at HealthEquity.
  • Design service models built around each client's complexity, value, risk, and growth potential.
  • Build the roles, playbooks, decision rights, and operating rhythms needed to deliver consistently at scale.
  • Simplify complexity and retire practices that no longer serve our clients.

Drive Client and Commercial Outcomes

  • Own service, executive relationships, renewals, retention, and support for account growth.
  • Use client health signals and predictive insights to act before issues become escalations.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client leaders and with brokers, consultants, and partners.
  • Turn every signal (survey, operational, or digital) into an owner, a fix, and a verified outcome.
  • Make sure clients are ready to deliver on performance guarantees and that commitments are visible to leadership.

Lead with Data, Automation, and AI

  • Set the technology and AI roadmap for Client Success.
  • Use automation to cut administrative work and free up capacity for strategic client engagement.
  • Give teams insights and recommended next steps that make every client interaction more proactive and personal.
  • Lead the change needed to make new ways of working stick.

Own the Economics

  • Own the budget, workforce plan, technology investments, and cost-to-serve strategy.
  • Set clear measures for client health, retention, service, productivity, and organizational health.
  • Turn operating improvements into measurable gains in protected revenue, cost, and risk.
  • Prove that a better client experience and better economics can happen together.

Build an Exceptional Organization

  • Lead, develop, and plan succession for directors and senior leaders across the organization.
  • Build a high-performance culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and data-driven decisions.
  • Create a team that is energized by change and focused on outcomes, not activity.

Lead Across HealthEquity Our clients experience one HealthEquity, no matter how we're organized internally.

  • Partner with Commercial, Implementation, Product & Technology, Customer Experience, Finance, and Operations.
  • Strengthen the handoff from onboarding to ongoing service so every client starts strong.
  • Resolve cross-functional tradeoffs and drive clear ownership of systemic issues.

The Leader We're Looking For

You've transformed an organization, not just managed one.

You bring:

  • 10+ years leading client service delivery or operations in healthcare, benefits administration, or financial services, including 5+ years in senior leadership
  • A track record of meaningful operating-model transformation and scaling an account management function at an enterprise level
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, and you know how client experience drives retention, growth, and enterprise value
  • Experience using data, digital tools, automation, and AI to improve outcomes
  • Knowledge of Consumer-Driven Benefits (HSA, FSA, COBRA, Commuter) and the regulations that govern them
  • Experience with large employer clients, brokers, and TPAs, plus familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to drive results across organizational boundaries
  • A record of developing strong leaders, along with a bias for action and real curiosity

If you've rebuilt a service organization and have the results to show for it, we'd like to talk.

Travel Requirements:

  • Moderate travel may be required (20-30%).

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$193500.00 To $256000.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. title: Product Analyst - Pendo (Europe, Remote)
description:
Company Overview:

Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using the real-time insights about adversaries, their relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. The company’s platform collects, interprets, structures, and validates human-led, automation-enhanced intelligence, which fuels our external attack surface and advanced behavioral threat hunting solutions. Customers utilize this operationalized intelligence to drive a proactive response to neutralize threats and mitigate risk. Organizations across the globe leverage Intel 471’s world-class intelligence, our trusted practitioner engagement and enablement, and globally-dispersed ground expertise as their frontline guardian against the ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats to fight the adversary — and win.

The Role:

Intel 471 is looking for a Product Analyst (Pendo) to join our world-class team, supporting our Product organization through better product data, and operational insight. This role reports to the Chief Product Officer and can be located in any of the following countries in Europe on a remote basis (Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, Poland, Denmark, and Romania).

This is a hands-on role with a strong focus on Pendo and product usage analytics. You will help Product Managers understand how customers use our products, track adoption of new capabilities, maintain dashboards and reporting, and ensure our product analytics data remains accurate and useful.

Pendo will be your primary platform, while data from tools such as Grafana, BI platforms, and internal systems may be used to provide additional context. You will also support the Product team in tracking KPIs and OKRs by helping maintain the reporting and measurement mechanisms used to monitor progress.

Depending on performance and business needs, this role may develop toward a Product Owner capacity over time. As you build a deep understanding of our products, customers, and data, there will be opportunities to expand your scope beyond analytics and into product ownership activities.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day operation of Pendo, including tagging, configuration, dashboards, reports, and data quality.
  • Build and maintain Pendo dashboards and reporting that help Product Managers understand product usage, feature adoption, and customer behavior.
  • Help ensure new product capabilities are appropriately tagged and measurable after release, and provide ongoing adoption and usage reporting.
  • Assist Product Managers with analytics questions, investigate trends or changes in usage, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Use data from sources such as Grafana, BI tools, and internal systems to supplement Pendo data when additional context is needed.
  • Support Product and leadership reporting, including the dashboards and recurring measurements used to track Product KPIs.

Education, Experience & Qualifications:

Essential

  • 2-4 years of demonstrable experience in Product Operations, Product Analytics or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience with Pendo is required, including working with tagging, dashboards, reports, and product usage analytics.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, or recurring analytics used by business or product teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity about how customers use software products and an ability to investigate questions using data.
  • Good attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively with Product Managers and clearly communicate useful findings.

Desirable

  • Experience with Grafana, SQL, BI platforms, or other analytics tools is helpful but not required.

Success in this role means Pendo is well maintained, product analytics are reliable, and Product Managers can easily access the information they need to understand product usage and adoption.

You will help make product data easier to use across the team by keeping reporting current, supporting KPI and OKR measurement, and surfacing useful insights when the data shows something worth investigating.

The role will report to our Chief Product Officer but will be expected to interact and work closely with other areas of the company as needed. The role is available anywhere in Europe and involves occasional travel within the United States, Europe and Asia. The role requires regular contact with our international team located in the United States, South America, Western and Eastern Europe, and Asia so a comfort working with diverse professional and cultural backgrounds is required.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Wellness programs
  • Employee recognition program
  • A variety of professional development opportunities
  • Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation

Our Culture:

The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing.

We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all – and foster a unique team spirit. View our Culture Guide to find out more about us and what it’s like to work for Intel 471!

title: Azure SQL DB SME
description:
Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Azure SQL DB SME to serve as the technical authority for the design, deployment, security, performance, and operation of Azure SQL database solutions supporting federal programs. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise across the Azure SQL family, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines, along with strong T-SQL, performance tuning, high availability/disaster recovery, and database migration skills. You'll architect and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available database environments in Azure Government, lead migrations from on-premises SQL Server, and partner with developers, data engineers, and DevOps teams to ensure applications and data pipelines are built on a reliable data foundation. By joining our organization, you'll help federal agencies modernize their data platforms and deliver better services to the people who depend on them!

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure VMs, advising on the right deployment option, service tier, and purchasing model (vCore, DTU, serverless, elastic pools, and Hyperscale).
  • Design, provision, and configure secure, scalable Azure SQL environments in Azure Government using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform), PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
  • Plan and lead database migrations from on-premises SQL Server and other platforms to Azure SQL using Azure Database Migration Service, Azure Migrate, Data Migration Assistant, SQL Server Migration Assistant (SSMA), and BACPAC/DACPAC tooling.
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF).
  • Develop and optimize ETL processes to ingest, transform, and store data in Azure Data Lake, SQL, and Synapse Analytics.
  • Write, review, and optimize complex T-SQL, including stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and indexing strategies.
  • Design and maintain relational data models and database schemas that support application, reporting, and analytics workloads.
  • Implement database security best practices, including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) authentication, managed identities, RBAC, Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Always Encrypted, Dynamic Data Masking, Row-Level Security, SQL auditing, Private Link/private endpoints, firewall rules, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Manage capacity planning, scaling, and cost optimization across Azure SQL resources, including reserved capacity and right-sizing recommendations.
  • Automate database maintenance and operational tasks using Elastic Jobs, SQL Agent (Managed Instance), Azure Automation, and PowerShell.
  • Implement database DevOps practices, including SQL Database Projects, SqlPackage, schema versioning, and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Support integration of Azure SQL with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI for data movement, reporting, and analytics.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve database incidents, including blocking, deadlocks, connectivity issues, and resource contention, and conduct root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, architects, data engineers, and DevOps teams, and participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Document database architecture, configurations, runbooks, standards, and best practices, and mentor team members on Azure SQL capabilities.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience with Microsoft SQL Server database administration, development, or engineering.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure SQL Database and/or Azure SQL Managed Instance in production environments.
  • Expert-level T-SQL skills, including query optimization, indexing, and database performance tuning.
  • Deep understanding of Azure SQL deployment options, service tiers (General Purpose, Business Critical, Hyperscale), and purchasing models (vCore, DTU, serverless).
  • Experience with performance troubleshooting tools such as Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and execution plan analysis.
  • Experience migrating SQL Server schemas and data to Azure using Azure Database Migration Service, Data Migration Assistant, or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure SQL security features, including Microsoft Entra ID authentication, TDE, Always Encrypted, auditing, Private Link, and Key Vault.
  • Proficiency with SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and Visual Studio Code with the MSSQL extension.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Azure CLI, and Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for databases using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and SAFe methodologies.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements.
  • Careful, reliable, and detail-oriented when performing high-impact administration tasks.

Preferred Skills

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) or Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900).
  • Experience with Azure Government Cloud and federal compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP High, NIST 800-53, and DISA STIGs.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric (including mirroring), and Power BI integration.
  • Experience with Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, or other Azure data platforms.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), including SSIS in Azure Data Factory.
  • Experience with Azure SQL features such as ledger tables, elastic pools, elastic query, and Azure SQL Database Hyperscale.
  • Knowledge of application authorization methods for applications and APIs connecting to Azure SQL (e.g., managed identities, service principals, OAuth).
  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs or other federal agencies.

Agentic AI Systems

Observability & Reliability

Platform & Pipelines

Technical Leadership

  • Set architectural standards for AI systems across the group; conduct design reviews and own ADRs for major decisions

  • Mentor ML engineers and applied scientists; grow the team's capabilities in production AI, not just prototype AI

  • Collaborate with Product and Commercial teams to translate business problems into ML problem formulations with clear success metrics

  • Engage with external research partners and track emerging work (arXiv, conference proceedings, open-source releases) to identify signals worth productionizing

Profile

  • Fluent in Python and the core ML stack: PyTorch, Transformers (HuggingFace), PEFT/LoRA

  • Real experience with LLM inference serving — vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or TGI — in a latency-sensitive production environment

  • Practical knowledge of agentic frameworks: multi-agent coordination, tool-call orchestration, context/memory management, and observability (Langfuse, Opik, or equivalent)

  • Experience with speech AI (ASR/TTS pipelines) or real-time audio systems is a strong plus

  • Solid understanding of MLOps: experiment tracking (MLflow/W&B), model registries, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD for ML

  • Awareness of LLM-specific risk: hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, fairness, and privacy — and how to mitigate them in production

  • Strong communication skills: you can write a crisp design doc, run a productive architecture review, and explain tradeoffs to a non-technical stakeholder

Nice to have

  • Experience with voice pipelines end-to-end: VAD → ASR → LLM → TTS → SIP/RTP telephony

  • Multi-hop RAG with self-consistency, chain-of-thought reranking, or RAPTOR-style hierarchical retrieval

  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server design and tool-use contracts

  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or published work (arXiv, NeurIPS, ACL, Interspeech, etc.)

  • Experience with multimodal models (vision-language, audio-language)

  • Knowledge of quantization techniques (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF) and their quality/latency tradeoffs

Right to Work

At any stage, please be prepared to provide proof of eligibility to work in the country you’re applying for. Unfortunately, we can't support relocation packages or visa sponsorship.

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

title: Infrastructure Monitoring & Data Protection Engineer
description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

Client Technology Operations (CTO) is RTI's client-focused technology organization responsible for delivering and operating the technology platforms, infrastructure, governance, engineering, and digital capabilities that enable RTI to develop, secure, and deliver technology-enabled solutions for clients.

This role supports enterprise infrastructure monitoring and data protection across on-premises and cloud environments. You will work with technologies such as SolarWinds and Cohesity to monitor system health and performance, support backup and recovery operations, troubleshoot technical issues, and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. This position offers the opportunity to build technical expertise across infrastructure monitoring, systems administration, and data protection while contributing to the reliability and availability of RTI's IT systems.

This position offers flexible work arrangements, including remote work within the U.S., hybrid, or on-site in our Research Triangle Park, NC headquarters location. Some geographic locations may not be available for remote work based on business and operational requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of the SolarWinds Platform (NPM, SAM, NTA, NCM) and Cohesity Data Platform (Cohesity Helios).

  • Configure and monitor daily backup policies protecting on-premises assets (VMware, physical servers) and cloud workloads (AWS, Azure) using Cohesity.

  • Customize SolarWinds alerting thresholds, maintain dashboards, and support integration of alerts with ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira) to maintain high environment visibility.

  • Leverage PowerShell, Python, or Bash to automate routine monitoring, backup checks, and system administration tasks.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure alerts, resolve backup failures, and perform routine data restoration requests to verify system integrity.

  • Maintain network configuration backups (via SolarWinds NCM), update standard operating procedures, and support compliance reporting activities.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs, system standards, business continuity plans, system test plans, and capacity plans.

  • Research technical solutions and contribute to evaluations and recommendations, including pros/cons and pricing, as needed.

  • Support the installation and configuration of hardware or software in accordance with manufacturer's recommendations and technical specifications.

  • Conduct quality assurance testing to validate installed configurations and operations against technical specifications, documenting results and identifying issues as needed.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve problems in response to alerts from monitoring tools or trouble reports from other ITS staff, escalating issues as appropriate.

  • Communicate status to impacted stakeholders, including end users, ITS support staff, and ITS management, before, during, and after installation or problem resolution, as appropriate and in accordance with SOPs.

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field and at least one year of relevant experience supporting IT infrastructure, systems administration, infrastructure monitoring, backup/recovery, or a related technical area.

  • Experience supporting and troubleshooting IT infrastructure, including servers, virtual environments, storage, networked systems, or cloud-based technologies.

  • Experience using at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash, for automation, system administration, or troubleshooting.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure monitoring concepts, including system health, performance monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting.

  • Working knowledge of data protection concepts, including backups, restores, recovery, system availability, and business continuity.

  • Experience investigating technical issues, identifying potential causes, and implementing or recommending solutions, with guidance or escalation as appropriate.

  • Experience developing or maintaining technical documentation, including system configurations, troubleshooting procedures, or standard operating procedures.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage assigned tasks, prioritize competing responsibilities, and work both independently and collaboratively within a technical team.

  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.). 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SolarWinds or another enterprise infrastructure monitoring platform.

  • Experience with Cohesity or another enterprise backup and recovery platform.

  • Experience supporting VMware or other virtualization environments.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or other cloud infrastructure environments.

  • Experience using APIs or scripting to automate monitoring, backup, reporting, or system administration activities.

  • Familiarity with IT service management or ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira.

  • Familiarity with network monitoring, system configuration management, or backup technologies.

  • Experience supporting technical documentation, compliance reporting, system testing, or disaster recovery exercises.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below. Our pay ranges represent national averages and may vary by location as a geographic differential may be applied to some locations within the United States. RTI considers multiple factors when making an offer including, for example: established salary range, internal budget, business needs, and education and years of work experience possessed by the applicant. Further, salary is merely one element to our offer.

At RTI, we demonstrate our commitment to rewarding individual and team achievement through a total rewards package. This package includes (among other things) a competitive base salary, a generous paid time off policy, merit based annual increases, bonus opportunities and a robust recognition program. Other benefits include a competitive range of insurance plans (including health, dental, life, and short-term and long-term disability), access to a retirement savings program such as a 401(k) plan, paid parental leave for all parents, financial assistance with adoption expenses or infertility treatments, financial reimbursement for education and developmental opportunities, an employee assistance program, and numerous other offerings to support a healthy work-life balance.
