title: Enterprise AI Transformation Manager
description:
We Are

Accenture is recognized as a global leader in AI and cloud transformation, helping businesses across industries design, build, and operationalize AI at enterprise scale.


Technology Strategy & Transformation (TS&T) - Digital Foundations builds innovative AI solutions that turn strategy into production. We Advise, Design, Build and operationalize AI solutions to deliver tangible, real results - on programs that affect how entire industries operate. Our work spans agentic AI architecture, composable and event-driven platforms, AI-assisted engineering, and the operating models and business cases that make AI adoption durable.


You Are

A hands-on technologist with the range to operate across design, delivery, and client work within complex transformation programs. You understand how enterprise IT organizations work and bring the drive to translate that understanding into AI solutions that ship and deliver value.


The Work

AI is reshaping what enterprises can build, how fast they can move, and where competitive advantage comes from. Capturing that opportunity requires architecture that holds at estate scale, engineering that ships to production, and the leadership to connect both to measurable business outcomes.


As a Manager, you lead solution design and workstream delivery within transformation programs, develop client relationships, and own architecture decisions from design through to production:


  • Design and architect AI solutions: Design multi-agent systems (planning, execution, evaluation, and coordination roles), LLM integrations, and RAG pipelines on vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate), and own those decisions through to production delivery. Build with LLM APIs (Claude/Anthropic, GPT-4), prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration built for production). Design and implement MCP Server/Client. Judge where AI adds value in an enterprise context and where it does not.
  • Own AI quality and observability: Apply LLM tracing, failure mode analysis, LLMOps, and prompt versioning. Run AI evaluation, quality assurance, risk assessment, and compliance for enterprise AI deployments.
  • Design and enable the foundation for agentic transformation: Own solution-level architecture on technology or AI programs. Define integration patterns (microservices, event-driven design, API-led integration, with containerization and orchestration on Docker and Kubernetes and streaming on Kafka, Kinesis, or EventBridge where the solution needs them), data flows, and data foundations (knowledge graphs and graph databases such as Neo4j and Neptune, ontologies, data integration patterns, semantic layers). Fit the solution into major enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, data platforms, cloud infrastructure), the core services and deployment patterns of AWS, Azure, and GCP, and the operating model structures that make AI adoption work in practice, not just on paper.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering: Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and AI-augmented development workflows hands-on, and set how they change delivery speed and engineering governance.
  • Advise and contribute to the business case: Translate client requirements into architecture decisions and communicate the reasoning, with solution design and architecture documentation. Contribute to ROI and efficiency estimation, token cost modeling, spend optimization, and business cases for AI investments, and show how cost structure shapes architecture choices.
  • Lead workstream delivery: Own a delivery workstream end-to-end: scope, tasks, dependencies, risk management, and reporting to program leadership. Track delivery commitments, surface blockers early, and coordinate across team members.

title: Vocational Case Manager
description:
Vocational Case Manager - CT08HE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

Job Title: Vocational Case Manager

Summary

The Vocational Case Manager plays a critical role in supporting disability claimants through three core functions: return-to-work planning and intervention, employability and transferable skills analysis, and occupational analysis of job duties and functional demands. Through collaboration with claimants, healthcare providers, employers, and internal business partners, the Vocational Case Manager evaluates work capacity, identifies vocational options, addresses barriers to employment, and develops strategies that support successful work outcomes and informed disability claim determinations.

Key Responsibilities

Return-to-Work Coordination

  • Design and execute transitional RTW plans, including job accommodations, worksite modifications, and vocational retraining.
  • Coordinate job placement services and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful workforce reintegration.
  • Engage claimants in RTW planning, set expectations, and guide participation in preparatory activities.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Communicate with treating physicians to clarify functional capabilities and incorporate RTW into treatment plans.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Ability Analysts, Clinical Case Managers) and external partners to identify tools and resources that expedite RTW efforts.
  • Advocate for claimant needs while balancing employer and insurer expectations.

Vocational Counseling & Training

  • Provide job-seeking skills training, including resume development, interview preparation, and application strategies.
  • Offer vocational guidance, counseling, and education to enhance claimant confidence and readiness.
  • Coordinate vocational training or retraining programs, ensuring cost-effectiveness and timely completion.

Labor Market Research & Placement

  • Conduct ongoing research of local labor markets to identify viable employment opportunities.
  • Analyze transferable skills and recommend alternative job placements aligned with claimant capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s degree in Counseling or related field.
  • Certification: Certified Rehabilitation Counselor (CRC) designation required.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of clinical or vocational rehabilitation experience preferred, ideally in Employee/Group Benefits, workers’ compensation, disability management, or related settings.
  • Knowledge:
    • Strong understanding of RTW best practices, ergonomics, FMLA, ADA / Accommodations and related HR topics.
    • Familiarity with labor market analysis tools and vocational assessment methodologies.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication, counseling, and interpersonal skills.
    • Ability to analyze complex vocational barriers and develop creative solutions.
    • Proficiency in case management systems and documentation standards.

About IREC

IREC is an independent nonprofit that builds the foundation for rapid adoption of clean energy and energy efficiency to benefit people, the economy, and our planet. Our vision is a 100% clean energy future that is reliable, resilient, and equitable. IREC develops and advances the regulatory reforms, technical standards, and workforce and community-based solutions needed to enable the streamlined integration of clean energy. IREC provides independent leadership and trusted clean energy expertise through three interrelated strategies:

  • Workforce Development - IREC leads initiatives to build a diverse and qualified clean energy workforce while ensuring that clean energy workers have access to family-sustaining careers.
  • Local Initiatives - IREC supports communities to develop policies and promote best practices that accelerate the equitable deployment of clean energy.
  • State Regulatory Engagement - IREC represents the public interest in state regulatory proceedings and develops and disseminates best practices to ensure that distributed energy resources (DERs) can be equitably and efficiently integrated on the electric grid.

Program Manager – Charging Smart (limited term role until July 2027)

Type: Full-time; exempt. This position is grant-funded and currently contracted and budgeted through July 2027, with continuation contingent on future funding.

Salary: $60,000–$75,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications

Location: Remote (U.S.-based)

Reports to: Senior Director, Local Initiatives
Benefits: Health, dental, vision insurance, retirement contribution, paid time off, flexible work schedule

About the Position

The Interstate Renewable Energy Council (IREC) is seeking a highly motivated Program Manager to support the Local Initiatives team in achieving aggressive goals to increase the adoption of electric vehicles (EV) and EV charging. The Program Manager will work with partners to recruit communities and provide technical assistance to local governments pursuing designation under the U.S. Department of Energy-funded Charging Smart program. You will work as part of a small, dynamic team to help communities reduce local barriers to the adoption of EV charging. You will focus on permitting and inspection, planning and zoning, government operations, utility engagement, and market development as well as other federal, state, and local EV and EV charging topics. You will also work with a broad coalition of other stakeholders, demonstrating thought leadership at both the strategic and tactical levels. The Program Manager will occasionally perform other duties and support other programs as needed to meet the objectives of a small and dynamic national nonprofit organization.

  • Support outreach efforts and work with partner organizations to recruit new communities to the Charging Smart program;
  • Promote the Charging Smart program by effectively communicating program benefits to stakeholders;
  • Assist local governments in identifying and implementing programs and practices to build robust local EV and EV charging markets;

  • Develop and refine program-related supporting documents;
  • Provide research, writing, and coordination support for Charging Smart and other projects at IREC;
  • Support accurate, timely program reporting in compliance with federal grant requirements; and
  • Support other IREC programs and initiatives as needed.

IREC team members collaborate primarily in a virtual environment, leveraging remote meeting, project management, and other collaboration tools to stay connected and on task.

Knowledge, Skills, Experience, and Qualities for This Role:

Required:

  • An undergraduate degree in public policy, economics, planning, local government management, public affairs, environmental studies, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience;

T&E is now expanding its work across the Asia-Pacific region, with Indonesia as one of our priority markets. Indonesia’s rapidly growing transport and energy sectors present both a major decarbonization challenge and an opportunity to demonstrate how zero-emission transport can support economic development, energy security, cleaner air and industrial transformation.

We are seeking an Indonesia Program Lead to develop and deliver T&E’s growing programme in Indonesia. The Program Lead will lead our policy and advocacy work, build relationships with government, industry and civil society, manage partnerships and projects, and identify opportunities to translate T&E’s research into tangible policy and implementation outcomes.

Initially, the programme will have a strong focus on zero-emission road freight, transport electrification, charging infrastructure and maritime electrification, while the portfolio may expand as T&E develops its regional strategy.

The Indonesia Program Lead will report to T&E’s Regional Policy and Program Director – Asia-Pacific and work closely with T&E policy, research and campaign teams across Asia-Pacific and Europe.

Job Description

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Indonesia Strategy and Programme Development

  • Lead the development and implementation of T&E’s policy and advocacy strategy in Indonesia, in coordination with the Regional Policy and Program Director – Asia-Pacific.

  • Translate T&E’s regional and global priorities into strategies that respond to Indonesia’s political, economic and institutional context.

  • Identify emerging policy opportunities and develop new projects and workstreams that can accelerate transport and energy decarbonization.

  • Develop pathways from policy research and analysis to advocacy, demonstration and implementation.

Policy and Advocacy

  • Lead T&E’s engagement on policies supporting zero-emission transport, including vehicle standards, electrification, charging infrastructure, fiscal measures, energy policy and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

  • Develop clear policy recommendations based on T&E research and international experience and adapt them to the Indonesian context.

  • Engage national and sub-national policymakers and regulators to advance T&E’s policy objectives.

  • Monitor political, regulatory and market developments and identify opportunities for T&E to influence policy debates.

Programme and Project Management

  • Lead and coordinate T&E projects in Indonesia, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery against agreed objectives, milestones and budgets.

  • Manage relationships with research institutions, consultants and implementing partners.

  • Commission and oversee research, policy analysis and other technical work where required.

  • Monitor programme impact, identify risks and recommend adjustments to strategy and implementation.

  • Support the development of pilot and demonstration initiatives that can help move zero-emission transport solutions from policy concepts towards implementation.

Stakeholder and Partnership Development

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with national and local government agencies, industry, research institutions, NGOs, civil society organizations and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Develop coalitions and strategic partnerships capable of advancing transport decarbonization in Indonesia.

  • Engage businesses and investors where their participation can help accelerate deployment of zero-emission technologies and infrastructure.

  • Connect T&E’s Indonesia programme with relevant regional and international initiatives.

Communications and Representation

  • Represent T&E in meetings with government, industry, civil society and other stakeholders.

  • Represent T&E at conferences, workshops and other public forums in Indonesia and internationally when appropriate.

  • Work with T&E communications colleagues and partners to translate technical research into clear and compelling policy narratives.

  • Support media engagement and act as a spokesperson for T&E’s Indonesia programme where appropriate.

Regional Collaboration

  • Work closely with T&E’s Asia-Pacific team and policy experts in Europe to bring international experience and policy expertise into the Indonesian debate.

  • Contribute Indonesian insights and experience to T&E’s broader Asia-Pacific strategy.

  • Identify opportunities where developments in Indonesia can inform or influence transport decarbonization across Southeast Asia and other emerging markets.

Fundraising and Budget Management

  • Support the APAC Regional Policy and Program Director in developing funding proposals and identifying opportunities to expand T&E’s work in Indonesia.

  • Contribute to donor engagement, grant reporting and communication of programme results.

  • Manage project budgets and ensure expenditure is consistent with funding agreements and T&E financial procedures.

Team Development

  • Coordinate consultants and project partners working on T&E’s Indonesia programme.

  • As the programme grows, support recruitment and management of additional policy, research or campaign staff.

  • Manage the Indonesian staff.

Job Requirements

  • At least 7–10 years of relevant professional experience in public policy, climate, transport, energy, international development or related fields.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and delivering policy or advocacy strategies in Indonesia.

  • Experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and external partners.

  • Experience working with government institutions, NGOs, research organizations or industry.

  • Experience in an international organization or NGO is an advantage.

Contract Duration and Location

  • Duration: This is a one-year consultant contract, with a high possibility of conversion to a full-time position upon successful completion of the term and depending on future project needs.

  • Work Arrangement: [e.g., Consultant Contract/Flexible arrangement, including required travel for meetings/data gathering.

About T&E

T&E is the independent expert in enabling clean transport for all. Our vision is a zero-emissions mobility system that is affordable and has minimal impacts on our health and environment. Since we were created 30 years ago, T&E has shaped some of Europe’s most important environmental laws. We got the EU to set the world's most ambitious CO2 standards for cars and trucks but also helped uncover the Dieselgate scandal; we campaigned successfully to end palm oil diesel, secured a global ban on dirty shipping fuels and the creation of the aviation ETS, the world's largest carbon market for aviation, to name just a few.

We combine the power of robust, science-based evidence and a deep understanding of transport with powerful communications and impactful advocacy. Our staff in Brussels, Paris, Rome, Madrid, Berlin, Warsaw and London collaborate with our 49 national members. From 2024, T&E has been enhancing our collaboration between Asia and Europe, starting from our Singapore office, to accelerate zero-emission transport and energy transition, helping ensure that global decarbonization efforts are both inclusive and regionally grounded. Altogether, our members represent more than 3.5 million people.

Job Family

Customer Service

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Serves as the initial point of contact for customers seeking financial guidance related to retirement, personal insurance, savings and investment options. Triage inbound calls and place prospects with financial planning and retirement planning advisors.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Handle calls from new customer prospects (via phone, video, email, etc.) to introduce the Advice Center and match customers with the appropriate advisor; refer complex inquiries to higher level staff.

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $44,000 - $46,000 annually. This range is an estimate, based on potential qualifications and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at Company discretion.

This position is also currently eligible for performance incentives.

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. Giving Back 

 

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.

description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, technical consultants dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike Services team offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of engagements including front page incident response investigations for organizations you’ll find on the annual Fortune 100 list.

Am I a Principal Consultant Candidate?

  • Do you find yourself interested in and keeping up with the latest vulnerabilities and breaches?

  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?

  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?

  • Do you have an Incident Response or Information Security background that you’re not fully utilizing?

  • Are you capable of leading teams and interacting with customers?

  • Do you love working around like-minded, smart people who you can learn from and mentor on a daily basis?

What You'll Do:

  • Lead incident response engagements

  • Develop and use new methods to hunt for bad actors across large sets of data.

  • Work under the direction of outside counsel to conduct intrusion investigations

  • Perform host and/or network-based forensics across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms.

  • Perform basic malware analysis.

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings to key stakeholders including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel .

  • Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, and other public speaking events.

What You'll Need:

Successful candidates will have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Team leadership experience in a matrixed consulting environment

  • Incident Response: experience conducting or managing incident response investigations for organizations, investigating targeted threats such as the Advanced Persistent Threat, Organized Crime, and Hacktivists.

  • Computer Forensic Analysis: a background using a variety of forensic analysis tools in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise.

  • Network Forensic Analysis: strong knowledge of network protocols, network analysis tools like Bro/Zeek or Suricata, and ability to perform analysis of associated network logs.

  • Reverse Engineering: ability to understand the capabilities of static and dynamic malware analysis.

  • Incident Remediation: strong understanding of targeted attacks and able to create customized tactical and strategic remediation plans for compromised organizations.

  • Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: strong understanding of secure network architecture and strong background in performing network operations.

  • Cloud Incident Response: knowledge in any of the following areas: AWS, Azure, GCP incident response methodologies.

  • Communications: strong ability to communicate executive and/or detailed level findings to clients; ability to effectively communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology with internal teams.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Additionally, all candidates must possess the following qualifications:

  • Capable of completing technical tasks without supervision.

  • Desire to grow and expand both technical and soft skills.

  • Strong project management skills.

  • Contributing thought leader within the incident response industry.

  • Ability to foster a positive work environment and attitude.

  • Ability to travel on short notice, up to 30% of the time.

Education:

BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related field. Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered.

This role may require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass alcohol and/or drug test(s) during the course of employment.

description:
At Associated Bank we strive to create an inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued and recognized as strengths critical to our success. If you thrive in an environment where your growth and development are encouraged and supported, then Associated Bank may be the right place for you.

Associated Bank requires you to directly represent yourself and your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process. Associated Bank conducts a thorough background check on all new hires.

Role Summary

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll design, automate, and support critical infrastructure that keeps applications and data running securely, reliably, and efficiently. You’ll partner with application and technology teams to improve deployment, performance, availability, and resilience while serving as a technical resource and mentor for other engineers.

Key Accountabilities

  • Design and automate private cloud infrastructure and technology solutions that support reliable, scalable applications.

  • Manage incident and problem resolution by troubleshooting connectivity, infrastructure, and communication issues and identifying root causes.

  • Automate testing, configuration, release, and deployment processes using infrastructure-as-code and modern DevOps practices.

  • Monitor infrastructure capacity, availability, and performance to identify issues and recommend improvements.

  • Maintain hardware and software inventories, network diagrams, technical documentation, and system records to support ongoing operations.

  • Partner with service providers, technology teams, business partners, and leadership to resolve issues and strengthen infrastructure solutions.

  • Support business resilience efforts by maintaining disaster recovery documentation and participating in Business Resumption Readiness testing.

  • Coach and mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and training while helping shape technology direction.

Education & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 8+ years of experience with the VMware portfolio, including VCF, SRM, vSAN, NSX, and HCX.

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management such as Ansible, GitHub Actions, and container solutions.

  • 5+ years of experience with PowerShell, HashiCorp HCL, RESTful APIs, YAML/JSON, and PowerCLI.

Preferred

  • 2+ years of experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI, and Group Policy.

  • 2+ years of experience with SAN arrays, NAS, Cisco UCS, Dell PowerFlex, and Pure Storage.

  • 2+ years of experience supporting Windows Server and Red Hat operating systems.

  • VMware VCF, Microsoft, HashiCorp, Ansible, or other relevant vendor certifications.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

You’ll have opportunities to grow your technical expertise, mentor others, and influence the direction of technology that supports a leading regional bank. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and people who take ownership and turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Apply today to make an impact.

We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified parties, including but not limited to people returning to the workforce, people with disabilities, those without a college degree, and veterans or those with military experience.

In addition to core traditional benefits, we take pride in offering benefits for every stage of life.

  • Retirement savings including both 401(k) and Pension plans.

  • Paid time off to volunteer in your community.

  • Opportunities to connect with others through our diversity-focused Colleague Resource Groups.

  • Competitive salaries with professional development and advancement opportunities.

  • Bonus benefits including well-being programs and incentives, parental leave, an employee stock purchase plan, military benefits and much more.

  • Personal banking, loan, investment and insurance benefits.

Associated Bank serves more than 120 communities throughout Wisconsin, Illinois, Minnesota, and Missouri and we consider our colleagues critical to our continued success. See why our colleagues continually vote us a best place to work in the Midwest. Join our community on Facebook, LinkedIn and X. 

Compliance Statement

Associated Bank is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse workforce. We support a work environment where colleagues are respected and given the opportunity to perform to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, among other factors.

Fully complies with all applicable enterprise policies and procedures. Acts in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as outlined in training materials, including but not limited to Bank Secrecy Act. Responsible for reporting suspicious activity to Financial Intelligence. Responsible to report all customer complaints as prescribed and procedure violations to management or HR.

Responsible to report ethical concerns as needed to Associated Bank’s anonymous Ethics Hotline.

Associated Bank provides additional assistance throughout the application, interview and hiring process. Please contact if you need an accommodation at any time during the process.

  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.

  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:



  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks two Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. These positions receive incidents and service requests, resolve approved first-contact issues, perform Tier 2 system-support activities within their authorized scope, and escalate problems requiring advanced technical or engineering assistance.

The Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts serve as initial points of contact for issues involving computer hardware, software, networks, telecommunications, websites, portals, system access, audio-visual equipment, and connectivity. Analysts document each interaction in ServiceNow, perform approved diagnostic and recovery procedures, keep customers informed, and confirm that service has been restored before closing tickets.

These positions also play an important role in outage identification. Analysts recognize patterns and mission-impacting symptoms, preserve relevant information, and rapidly escalate potential outage signals to service-desk leadership and the Outage Response Team.

These positions are remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Analysts must be able to work assigned shifts within the program’s operating schedule and support after-hours or surge coverage when required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analyst will:

  • Serve as an initial point of contact for USMEPCOM users requiring technical support.
  • Receive incidents and service requests through approved channels, including telephone, email, website, self-service portal, monitoring notification, or direct escalation.
  • Create complete and accurate ServiceNow records for all customer contacts, incidents, requests, and technical actions.
  • Verify customer information, contact details, affected services, location, urgency, business impact, and relevant equipment or system identifiers.
  • Categorize, prioritize, assign, and route incidents and requests according to approved procedures.
  • Resolve approved first-contact issues using established technical procedures, scripts, diagnostic tools, and knowledge articles.
  • Provide Tier 1 and authorized Tier 2 support for computer hardware, software, operating systems, networks, telecommunications, websites, portals, system access, audio-visual equipment, and connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, zero clients, thin clients, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and related end-user equipment.
  • Diagnose basic LAN, WAN, VPN, wireless, internet, remote-access, and network-connectivity issues.
  • Support approved account, password, authentication, and access-management requests.
  • Troubleshoot common email, collaboration, browser, productivity software, and enterprise-application issues.
  • Provide remote technical assistance and guide users through approved diagnostic and corrective procedures.
  • Use approved knowledge articles, known-error information, field guides, and standard operating procedures to resolve incidents consistently.

title: Principal Engineer - Data Retrieval
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an engineering lead to architect and scale the data acquisition infrastructure that powers our foundation models. Starting with code and STEM data for Nemotron, you will build the systems that discover valuable sources, crawl the open web at scale, and deliver reliable, high-quality data to training pipelines. This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning distributed systems, crawl infrastructure, and third-party data ingestion. You will own the architecture of a unified platform covering source discovery, URL indexing, crawl frontiers, predictive ranking, scheduling, distributed fetching, and ingestion. We have existing infrastructure to build on, and the goal is to bring it to pretraining scale and extend it to additional model families, modalities, and acquisition workflows over time. Along the way, you will lead architecture reviews and critical implementation work, mentor engineers, and help build the team.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Work with storage and scaling teams to design scalable frontier storage and queueing systems with high-throughput writes, efficient lookups, deduplication, and scheduling based on data quality, diversity, and freshness. Build a continuous discovery loop that extracts links and feeds new candidates back into the crawl frontier.
  • Develop a shared crawl execution layer that fetches reliably and politely at scale, handling dynamic websites while keeping resource use under control.
  • Build extensible pipelines for open-web, licensed, and partner content, including text, PDFs, code repositories, and multimodal assets. Define stable interfaces for source connectors so teams can add sources without rebuilding the platform.
  • Partner with parsing and curation teams to preserve valuable code, math, and structured content, and improve accepted data yield.
  • Implement provenance and policy enforcement with legal, privacy, security, and data governance partners. Translate approved publisher preferences, opt-outs, licensing terms, and use restrictions into auditable controls that follow the data downstream.
  • Own production readiness, including capacity planning, observability, fault tolerance, recovery, and cost efficiency. Instrument the pipeline end to end and set service objectives for throughput, freshness, reliability, and meeting training cutoffs.
  • Work with research and product teams to evaluate internal crawls and external datasets through comparable pilots. Deliver reproducible data releases that tie source coverage and processing quality to controlled training experiments.
  • Coordinate dependencies across teams and make clear tradeoffs between immediate data delivery and long-term platform development.

What we need to see:

  • A BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 15+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, including designing and operating large-scale distributed systems, setting technical direction, and delivering complex infrastructure across multiple teams.
  • Deep experience with web crawling or closely related discovery, indexing, or ingestion infrastructure, including distributed scheduling, stateful services, storage, and high-throughput data processing.
  • Strong hands-on engineering and system design skills. Ability to move between architecture, implementation, performance analysis, and production debugging.
  • Experience building batch or streaming pipelines and reasoning about consistency, retries, duplicate processing, backpressure, and recovery. A track record of improving throughput, latency, resource efficiency, or operational reliability.
  • Experience delivering data platforms for research, ML, search, or other demanding technical users. Ability to translate evolving requirements into clear interfaces and measurable engineering outcomes.
  • Strong technical communication and leadership through influence across engineering, product, research, and governance teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience architecting a web-wide crawl platform, scaling crawl frontier storage, or consolidating multiple acquisition systems into shared infrastructure.
  • Direct experience supplying foundation-model pretraining data, including targeted discovery, quality-aware crawl ranking, and acquisition of code or technical content.
  • Experience implementing publisher consent, training-use opt-outs, dataset licensing controls, or provenance infrastructure at scale.
  • Background with browser-based or agentic data collection, programmable extraction, and sandboxed environments for tool-use data or post-training evaluation.
  • Experience onboarding licensed or multimodal datasets, building reusable partner integrations, or delivering streaming feeds with low latency for retrieval and grounding.

The platform is a core capability for NVIDIA’s AI models and directly shapes the reach and quality of our training data. If you enjoy solving difficult distributed systems problems and building platforms that other teams depend on, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD.

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-facing role that serves as a trusted scientific partner to key external experts, conducting frequent scientific exchanges to enhance understanding of Sanofi's products. The MSL executes stakeholder engagement plans to gather insights that inform medical strategies and future research, while staying current on therapeutic developments to identify research opportunities and support evidence generation.


This role involves recognizing and sharing insights about patient and healthcare provider needs, maintaining effective communication with internal stakeholders across Medical Affairs and Commercial Operations, and ensuring full compliance with company, industry, legal, and regulatory requirements through excellent governance and risk management.


Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world and are supported and enhanced through our diverse portfolio of medical device and diagnostic products. With more than 54,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 56,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion (at the go-forward perimeter), operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

About the Practice

Our Programme & Project Management Practice helps organisations deliver complex transformation programmes that drive measurable business outcomes. We partner with customers across government and industry to provide expert leadership, governance, and delivery excellence for large-scale, business-critical initiatives. Our teams combine deep programme management expertise with commercial focus, innovation, and a commitment to delivering lasting value.

Where Purpose Meets Career

  • Lead large-scale transformation programmes that make a meaningful impact across critical public and private sector services.
  • Shape strategic outcomes by working directly with senior stakeholders, customers, and delivery teams on complex, high-profile engagements.
  • Grow your career within a collaborative and supportive environment that invests in professional development, leadership capability, and continuous learning.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced PMO Lead to coordinate and lead the effective delivery of Project Management Office (PMO) services across projects, programmes and accounts within the UK&I PPM function. The role will support the consistent application of the PMO service catalogue, standards and controls, translating agreed PMO requirements into reliable day-to-day delivery.

The successful candidate will provide hands-on leadership across governance, reporting, planning, RAID, financial and resource controls. Working closely with delivery teams and stakeholders, the PMO Lead will improve the quality and visibility of management information, support informed decision-making and contribute to continuous improvement across PMO services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day delivery of PMO services for assigned projects, programmes or accounts, ensuring activities are completed accurately and to agreed timescales.
  • Coordinate governance cycles, reporting, RAID management, planning, resource management and financial control activities in line with agreed PPM standards and contractual requirements.
  • Produce and quality-assure clear, accurate and decision-focused management information, highlighting trends, dependencies, exceptions and emerging delivery concerns.
  • Support project, programme and account leadership by providing practical PMO guidance, analysis and constructive challenge on governance, controls, planning and performance visibility.
  • Monitor adherence to PMO processes and controls, addressing gaps and escalating material issues through the appropriate governance route.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of standard PMO processes, tools, templates and methodologies across the assigned delivery environment.
  • Coordinate PMO activities across multiple workstreams and stakeholders, maintaining priorities and ensuring dependencies and deadlines are actively managed.
  • Provide task leadership, coaching and quality oversight to PMO team members, sharing good practice and supporting capability development.
  • Identify and implement proportionate improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, data quality and stakeholder value.
  • Maintain effective working relationships across delivery, commercial, finance, resource and account teams to support integrated project and programme controls.

Skills We Can’t Do Without

  • Proven experience delivering PMO services within complex project or programme environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of governance, reporting, RAID management, planning, resource management and project controls.
  • Ability to analyse information, identify exceptions and translate data into concise, actionable insight.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to provide constructive challenge and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to organise and coordinate multiple priorities, activities and deadlines in a structured manner.
  • Experience of quality-assuring PMO outputs and promoting consistent standards across a delivery environment.
  • Ability to guide, support and coach colleagues while maintaining accountability for the quality and timeliness of PMO delivery.
  • Good financial and commercial awareness, including an understanding of budget, forecast and resource information.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify practical opportunities to simplify and strengthen PMO services.
  • Working knowledge of relevant PPM tools and systems, such as OneProject, RAID tools and financial systems.
  • Relevant project, programme or PMO qualifications, such as PRINCE2, MSP, P3O or Agile, are desirable.

Additional Requirements

  • Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC clearance.
  • Location: UK-based. Remote working is available, with national mobility required.

Benefits

  • 25 days paid leave + National Holidays
  • Pension Scheme – contributions matched up to 10%
  • Private Medical Cover
  • Income Protection
  • Life Assurance
  • Flex Benefits Program

description:

At Rehlko, our team members are the essential energy that powers our organization’s success. Why You Will Love this Job

As a Data Center Sales Executive for Power Generation within our Power Solutions Sales group at Rehlko Power Systems, this is your unique opportunity to set your mark and live on the leading edge of design. This Data Center Sales Executive will be responsible and accountable for developing key partnerships and executing complex projects in the Data Center vertical segment. Success in this position will require a keen understanding of the segment and continual interaction with key influencers throughout the entire sales phase at all levels within the organizations.


Do you consider yourself a relationship manager who can guide excellence by not only maintaining existing relationships, but also building new ones? Do you have experience selling industrial products to data centers or their suppliers? Apply today to join Rehlko Power Systems sales team!


Location: Remote with 30-40% travel, domestically within the US, with the potential for international travel.


This Data Center Sales Executive will be responsible for aggressively growing profitable sales of Rehlko Power System Solutions (Gensets, automatic transfer switches, paralleling switchgear, packaging solutions, etc).


This Data Center Sales Executive for Power Generation will be focusing efforts to targeted data center end users, engineering consultants and contractors with the capability to review project specifications, quotation preparation, customer interaction, frequent distributor engagement and ultimately developing long term partnerships and sales growth.


SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for developing and executing the go-to-market strategy for solutions sales to and/or through Distribution Partners, End Users, Contractors and EPC firms for Data Center clients
  • Work with Marketing, Operations and Engineering to maintain and build strong market and competitive intelligence enabling high quality presentations and effective value propositions
  • Lead sales activities supporting the entire influencing chain from End Users, EPC, Contractors and consulting firms with a primary focus on the data center segment with Regional and Global Customers
  • Capability to work and effectively communicate at all levels within an organization from the C Suite throughout the company, including, but not limited to: Operations, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction.
  • Establish long-term working relationships with key individuals at the targeted accounts by becoming a trusted advisor and an integral part of their success.
  • Provide guidance during the initial design stage and assist with developing project requirements, drawings, and specifications, bringing projects to order
  • Review project specifications and drawings and serve as Rehlko Power Systems’ application engineering expert for assigned and targeted accounts.
  • Work with the inside sales team, suppliers, and distribution network to prepare quotes and preliminary drawings for projects.
  • Participate in project review meetings and pre-quote project requirements meeting
  • Must be knowledgeable in industry power products (generators, ATS, paralleling switchgear, custom enclosures etc.), pertinent codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, UL, IBC, etc.) and overall on-site power system design and integration
  • Must be capable of managing key End User clients across time zones, globally
  • Must be comfortable and competent in providing presentations to large audiences
  • Plan and provide training programs to enhance the Rehlko Power Systems segment knowledge for fellow Rehlko Energy associates and channel partners
  • Participate in Rehlko Power Systems forecasting effort and coordinate with other Rehlko team members via the Sales Operations processes, including daily and weekly CRM tracking and information input
  • Maintain centralized documentation for tracking requests and quotations via active CRM tools
  • Play active role prospecting targets and promoting KPS in the data center segment trade events and associations.
  • Work with Marketing and Engineering to create, prepare, and present technical papers and other application specific white papers for marketing collateral, trade journals and conferences
  • Perform other related assignments as required

Skills/Requirements

  • BS (Electrical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering preferred) / equivalent degree or w/ 5 years of relevant industry experience
  • BS Engineering and/or MBA is preferred.
  • 5+ years’ experience in technical quoting, reading prints and working with product lines of similar technical complexity preferred.
  • Proven leadership, results-oriented professional, an aggressive self-starter and a solid communicator are essential characteristics.
  • Demonstrated people skills required to lead & motivate professionals in a matrix organization who are not direct reports.
  • Must be a “high impact” executive, able to establish instant trust and credibility with shareholders, customers, and vendors.
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills.
  • Additional spoken languages a plus, but not required.
  • Frequent engagement with Power Systems Application Engineering, Design
  • Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Operations and Manufacturing
  • This position requires travel up to 30-40%, domestically, with the potential for international travel.
  • Ability to travel internationally as requested.
  • Self-motived and driven required

Automation Solutions Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Automation Solutions Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are seeking an Automation Solutions Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers.   • Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Strong Git-based workflows including code review, branching, and release management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cloud Terraform (AWS + Azure or AWS + GCP).

  • Experience with policy-as-code engines (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov).

Adjunct Instructors provide effective and substantive feedback that promotes mastery of program outcomes. Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Cloud-Native Architect with 10+ years of software engineering experience, including extensive experience designing cloud-native platforms and distributed systems. The ideal candidate will lead the architecture and modernization of enterprise-scale applications using microservices, Kubernetes, container platforms, and cloud-native technologies while driving engineering standards, platform strategy, and technical excellence across multiple teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define enterprise-wide microservices architecture standards, service boundaries, and domain-driven design (DDD) principles.

  • Define data ownership strategies, distributed transaction models, and scalable persistence architectures.
  • Design and implement cloud-native platform capabilities, including Kubernetes, service mesh, API gateways, identity management, observability, and platform automation.
  • Drive performance engineering, scalability planning, capacity management, and system reliability across mission-critical services.
  • Establish CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automated testing, and deployment strategies for cloud-native applications.
  • Define enterprise observability standards leveraging distributed tracing, centralized logging, metrics, dashboards, and SLO/SLI-based monitoring.
  • Partner with security teams to implement Zero Trust architecture, secrets management, runtime security, compliance, and cloud governance.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and technology evaluations across multiple engineering organizations.
  • Mentor architects, technical leads, and senior engineers while promoting cloud-native engineering best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud-native technologies and recommend strategic adoption based on business value and technical maturity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in software architecture and cloud-native solution design.
  • Deep expertise in microservices architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, Docker, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more backend programming languages such as Java, Go, C#, or Python.
  • Strong knowledge of API design, asynchronous messaging, event streaming technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or similar), and distributed application architecture.
  • Experience designing and operating highly available, latency-sensitive production systems at enterprise scale.
  • Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and technical mentoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and platform engineering capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, Envoy, or Consul Connect.
  • Knowledge of GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
  • Experience with FinOps, cloud governance, and enterprise cloud cost optimization.
  • Public speaking, open-source leadership, published technical content, or conference presentations.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as Healthcare, Financial Services, Insurance, or Government.
  • Cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

title: AI Content Creator
description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an AI Content Creator who lives on the bleeding edge of generative technology to build visuals that were previously impossible, expensive, or slow to produce.

Why This Role Matters

The barrier between imagination and reality has dissolved. As our AI Content Creator, you are the pioneer of our "Synthetic Production" arm. You aren't just writing prompts; you are integrating generative video, image, and audio tools into professional commercial workflows.

You will help us scale content production by generating hyper-realistic B-roll, impossible environments, and rapid-fire concepts that speed up our entire creative engine. If you spend your nights on Discord testing new models and your days dreaming of ComfyUI workflows, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Generate High-Fidelity Assets

    • Create stunning, photo-real images and video clips using Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Runway (Gen-2/Gen-3), Pika, and Sora (as available).

    • Generate specific creative assets: product backgrounds, atmospheric B-roll, and surreal visual effects that blend seamlessly with live-action footage.

    • Utilize AI audio tools (ElevenLabs, Suno) to generate realistic voice-overs and custom background tracks for testing and final delivery.

  2. Hybrid Editing & Compositing

    • Take AI-generated assets and integrate them into video timelines.

    • Use After Effects and Photoshop to "fix" AI artifacts (glitchy hands, text errors) and composite products into AI-generated environments.

    • Upscale and interpolate footage (Topaz Video AI) to ensure all AI output meets broadcast 4K standards.

  3. Rapid Concepting & Storyboarding

    • Replace traditional stick-figure storyboards with fully rendered AI animatics, allowing clients to visualize the final commercial before we even turn on a camera.

    • Speed up the pre-production process by visualizing lighting setups and set designs virtually.

  4. Stay on the Bleeding Edge

    • Constantly test new models, LoRAs, and control nets. You are the agency's R&D department for creativity.

    • Build efficient workflows (e.g., ComfyUI pipelines) that allow other editors to utilize AI tools easily.

Who You Are

  1. A "Prompt Engineer" & Artist

    • You have a deep understanding of prompt syntax, negative prompting, seeds, and weights. You know how to get exactly what you want from the AI.

    • You have a strong foundation in traditional art/photography principles (composition, lighting, color theory)—AI is just your brush.

  2. Technically Versatile

    • Proficiency in Midjourney, Runway, and ElevenLabs is required.

    • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. You need to be able to use what you generate.

    • Experience with Stable Diffusion (Automatic1111 or ComfyUI) is a massive plus.

  3. Problem Solver

    • AI is unpredictable. You have the patience to iterate 50 times to get the perfect 3-second clip.

    • You know how to troubleshoot consistency issues (keeping a character's face the same across multiple shots).

  4. Ethically Aware

    • You understand the legal landscape of AI. You know how to create commercially safe content (avoiding copyright infringement or deepfaking real celebrities without permission).

Perks & Benefits

  • Tool Access: We provide enterprise access to the top AI tools and unlimited compute credits.

  • Growth Opportunities: Define the AI strategy for a major agency and lead the shift toward hybrid production.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one generation at a time.

We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Conversion Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle — extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover — to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP.   • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.

title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

      1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
      2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
      5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.
