title: Commercial Account Executive, New York
description:
Who We Are

Spectro Cloud is redefining how organizations manage Kubernetes, virtualization, and AI infrastructure across data centers, public cloud, edge, and distributed environments.

Our Palette platform gives organizations the flexibility and control to build, deploy, and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure anywhere while simplifying operations at scale. As infrastructure evolves to support AI and GPU-intensive workloads, Spectro Cloud is helping customers modernize their environments while improving operational efficiency and economics.

We are growing quickly and looking for high-energy, accountable sellers who want to build pipeline, win new customers, and help shape our continued growth.

Who We Are Seeking

We are looking for a results-driven US Commercial Account Executive based in the New York Area to drive new-logo growth across the commercial market.

This is a high-velocity, new-business role with a clear mandate: consistently acquire new customers, achieve quarterly new-logo goals, and deliver quarterly revenue targets with strong linearity throughout the quarter.

We want a seller who is willing to participate in their own success.

You will have support from Marketing, Sales Development, Sales Engineering, leadership, and our partner ecosystem—but you are ultimately accountable for creating pipeline, progressing opportunities, winning new logos, and delivering your number.

The successful candidate doesn't wait until the final weeks of the quarter to produce results. You build enough pipeline and maintain enough deal velocity to consistently close business throughout the quarter.

Job Responsibilities

As a Commercial Account Executive, you will own your territory and your results.

You will:

  • Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly new-logo goals.

  • Deliver strong quarterly linearity, with new customers and revenue closing throughout the quarter.

  • Build, develop, and manage a healthy pipeline that supports both the current quarter and future quarters.

  • Own your territory from both a revenue and go-to-market perspective.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan identifying high-potential accounts, industries, partners, and use cases.

  • Proactively prospect and create your own opportunities in addition to working inbound and SDR-generated opportunities.

  • Maintain a consistent cadence of in-person customer meetings, discovery sessions, demos, technical evaluations, and executive conversations.

  • Sell across multiple lines of business and buying centers within target accounts.

  • Build relationships across infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, virtualization, DevOps, AI, application, and executive teams.

  • Work closely with channel partners, VARs, systems integrators, cloud providers, and technology partners to generate and accelerate opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to land with an initial use case and expand into additional teams, business units, and workloads.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and demonstrate complete command of your business.

Quarterly Execution & Linearity

Success in this role requires more than simply hitting an annual number. We expect consistent quarterly execution.

You will be responsible for:

  • Achieving quarterly new-logo and revenue targets.

  • Maintaining sufficient pipeline coverage for both the current and following quarter.

  • Creating new pipeline every week.

  • Progressing opportunities with urgency and clearly defined next steps.

  • Closing business throughout the quarter rather than relying on end-of-quarter concentration.

  • Maintaining a balanced pipeline across early-, mid-, and late-stage opportunities.

  • Building enough opportunity volume to overcome normal deal slippage without compromising the quarter.

  • Identifying pipeline gaps early and taking action to address them.

  • Maintaining disciplined deal inspection and forecasting.

  • Entering each new quarter with meaningful pipeline already developed. Linearity matters.

We are looking for sellers who build predictable businesses—not sellers whose results depend on a last-minute end-of-quarter push.

What You Will Sell

You will position Spectro Cloud's portfolio across a broad range of modern infrastructure initiatives, including:

  • Enterprise Kubernetes management

  • Hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure

  • Virtualization modernization

  • VMware alternatives and modernization

  • Data center modernization

  • Edge and distributed computing

  • Platform engineering

  • GPU infrastructure

  • AI infrastructure

  • AI workload orchestration

  • Infrastructure efficiency and economics

  • Tokenomics and AI inference economics

You should be comfortable identifying an initial business or technical problem and expanding the conversation across multiple lines of business and use cases.

Sales Execution

This is not a role where pipeline is simply handed to you.

Successful Commercial AEs at Spectro Cloud actively participate in creating their own success.

You will:

  • Prospect consistently into targeted commercial accounts.

  • Convert outbound, inbound, partner, and SDR-generated opportunities into qualified pipeline.

  • Conduct effective discovery across technical and business stakeholders.

  • Build meaningful customer relationships through regular in-person, face-to-face engagement.

  • Identify compelling events and measurable business outcomes.

  • Develop strong internal champions.

  • Establish access to decision-makers and Economic Buyers.

  • Create urgency and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.

  • Manage technical evaluations and POCs against clearly defined success criteria.

  • Use MEDDPICC principles to qualify and manage opportunities.

  • Utilize Mutual Action Plans where appropriate to establish clear customer and Spectro Cloud commitments.

  • Work closely with Sales Engineering to efficiently move technical evaluations toward business decisions.

  • Maintain disciplined opportunity management and next steps.

  • Forecast accurately and consistently.

Channel & Partner Execution

Our partner ecosystem should amplify your ability to win.

You will:

  • Develop productive relationships with strategic channel partners within your territory.

  • Work with VARs, systems integrators, cloud providers, and technology partners to identify new opportunities.

  • Build joint pipeline with partners rather than treating the channel simply as a fulfillment mechanism.

  • Develop joint account strategies for priority commercial accounts.

  • Leverage partners to gain access, accelerate opportunities, and expand Spectro Cloud's reach.

  • Hold partners accountable while giving them compelling reasons to bring Spectro Cloud into their customers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of successful B2B enterprise technology sales experience in an in-person, customer-facing role.

  • Proven experience developing relationships and selling directly to customers through face-to-face meetings, executive briefings, onsite discovery sessions, presentations, and strategic account engagements.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding quarterly quota.

  • Demonstrated success acquiring new-logo customers.

  • Evidence of strong quarterly execution and sales linearity.

  • Strong prospecting and pipeline-generation skills.

  • Experience managing a high-velocity commercial sales motion.

  • Ability to manage multiple active opportunities simultaneously without sacrificing sales discipline.

  • Experience selling across multiple lines of business and buying centers.

  • Experience working with channel partners to generate and accelerate pipeline.

  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, virtualization, or related infrastructure technologies.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

  • Exposure to GPU and AI infrastructure is highly desirable.

  • Ability to connect technical capabilities to business value, operational efficiency, TCO, and infrastructure economics.

  • Experience with MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology.

  • Strong CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, and territory-planning discipline.

  • Established customer and partner relationships in New York and the Northeast are highly desirable.

What Makes You Successful Here

You are a hunter.

You like winning new customers and understand that new logos are the lifeblood of a growing company.

Engagement: Independent Contractor / Consulting
Seniority: Principal / Senior Technology Advisory
Industry: Canadian Credit Unions, Banking Technology and Financial Services

About Aequilibrium

Aequilibrium is a Canadian digital transformation and technology consulting company helping financial institutions modernize their technology platforms, improve member experiences, and deliver complex transformation programs. We combine business and technology strategy, solution architecture, experience design, software engineering, quality assurance, and AI-enabled innovation.

We are seeking an experienced, client-facing Principal Banking Technology & Solution Architect to advise Canadian credit unions on critical platform decisions, architecture modernization and complex technology migrations.

The Opportunity

You will work directly with credit union CTOs, CIOs and transformation leaders as a trusted technical advisor.

Our clients are navigating significant changes across digital banking, core banking integrations, enterprise data and analytics, payments, CRM and cloud platforms. Several are migrating away from Central 1 Forge while simultaneously modernizing other components of their technology landscape.

Your role is to help these institutions make informed technology decisions, manage architectural complexity and reduce delivery risk. This is a hands-on advisory role requiring strong architecture judgment, banking domain knowledge, vendor evaluation experience and the ability to translate technical complexity into practical executive recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy and Platform Selection

  • Lead structured evaluations of enterprise technology platforms, including data analytics, digital banking, CRM, payments and integration solutions.

  • Define business and technical evaluation criteria, requirements, architecture principles and vendor scorecards.

  • Assess products such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Fiserv and Finastra analytics solutions, as well as relevant digital banking platforms.

  • Facilitate vendor demonstrations, technical due diligence, reference checks and proof-of-concept evaluations.

  • Assess functional fit, interoperability, security, scalability, operational complexity, licensing and total cost of ownership.

  • Prepare decision papers, target architectures and recommendations for CTOs and executive steering committees.

2. Enterprise and Solution Architecture

  • Assess current-state enterprise architectures and design pragmatic future-state architectures.

  • Evaluate integration dependencies across core banking, digital banking, CRM, payments, data warehouses, fraud systems and third-party services.

  • Define integration patterns, API strategies, data flows, architectural boundaries and transition roadmaps.

  • Review vendor solution designs, identify architectural gaps and challenge unsupported technical assumptions.

  • Provide architecture oversight across multiple vendors and implementation partners.

3. Digital Banking and Forge Migration Advisory

  • Advise credit unions transitioning from Central 1 Forge to modern digital banking platforms.

  • Evaluate replacement capabilities, functional parity, integration requirements and migration dependencies.

  • Assess the implications of different platform versions, vendor configurations and customization approaches.

  • Support migration planning, technical readiness assessments and architectural risk management.

  • Work with delivery and QA leaders to define technical acceptance criteria and evidence-based go-live readiness.

4. Data and Analytics Modernization

  • Lead assessments of legacy banking analytics and reporting environments.

  • Evaluate modern data warehouses, lakehouses, data integration platforms and banking-specific analytics products.

  • Define data migration approaches, data quality controls, governance, security and reporting continuity requirements.

  • Assess data integration with banking core systems, digital channels and enterprise applications.

  • Develop architecture recommendations that support future AI, advanced analytics and member personalization.

5. Executive Advisory and Delivery Assurance

  • Build trusted relationships with CTOs, CIOs, business sponsors and technology leadership teams.

  • Communicate complex architecture and technology decisions in clear business language.

  • Work alongside project managers, delivery directors, business analysts, designers and QA leads.

  • Provide independent technical oversight without duplicating the responsibilities of existing implementation partners.

  • Identify emerging risks early and recommend practical mitigation options.

  • Produce concise architecture assessments, executive presentations, technical recommendations and implementation roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, solution architecture, technical consulting or banking technology delivery.

  • Significant experience in banking, credit unions or regulated financial services.

  • Demonstrated experience leading technology platform evaluations and vendor selections.

  • Strong understanding of digital banking architectures, core banking integrations, APIs, data integration and cloud platforms.

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake or comparable technologies.

  • Ability to evaluate architecture trade-offs across security, scalability, maintainability, cost and implementation risk.

  • Experience working with multiple technology vendors and complex transformation programs.

  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder facilitation and technical documentation skills.

  • Ability to operate independently as a senior advisor across multiple client engagements.

  • Based in Canada and available to work with Canadian credit union clients.

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Direct experience with Central 1 Forge or Canadian credit union digital banking migrations.

  • Familiarity with VeriPark, Intellect Design, Backbase, ebankIT, Plumery or comparable digital banking platforms.

  • Knowledge of Fiserv DNA, RFS360 or other credit union core banking systems.

  • Experience with Temenos analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Fiserv analytics or Finastra platforms.

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Power BI and enterprise data governance.

  • Familiarity with Canadian financial services regulatory, security and privacy requirements.

  • Experience with migration readiness, technical assurance, QA strategy and release governance.

  • Previous experience as a CTO, Chief Architect, Principal Architect or senior technology consultant in a financial institution or consulting organization.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the consultant should be able to:

  • Lead at least one structured technology platform assessment and produce an executive-ready recommendation.

  • Establish a current-state and target-state architecture for a credit union modernization initiative.

  • Identify material integration, vendor dependency and migration risks for active client programs.

  • Provide practical architecture guidance that improves decision quality and reduces avoidable delivery risk.

  • Build trusted working relationships with multiple credit union technology leaders.

Success will be measured by the quality of decisions supported, risks reduced, client confidence and tangible progress toward modernization outcomes—not by the volume of documentation produced.

Engagement Model

This is a flexible, part-time or full-time consulting engagement depending on client demand. The successful candidate may support multiple Canadian credit union engagements concurrently, combining remote advisory work with occasional stakeholder workshops or on-site sessions.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As the Head of Marketing, you will play a critical role in supporting an AI-native pharmaceutical technology company that is transforming formulation development through proprietary Causal AI. You'll work closely with the founders and Chief Commercial Officer to build and own the company's marketing function—from defining brand positioning and messaging to driving demand generation, marketing operations, and qualified pipeline growth.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic marketing leadership with hands-on execution, and who thrives in fast-moving startup environments where ownership, experimentation, and measurable business impact are expected. Rather than functioning as a traditional marketing manager, you'll act as a strategic growth partner responsible for building scalable marketing systems, translating complex scientific concepts into compelling commercial narratives, and driving marketing performance from end to end.

Accountability

Your success as the Head of Marketing will be defined by your ability to build a scalable marketing engine, generate qualified pipeline, and establish marketing as a key driver of commercial growth. Here's how you'll make an impact:

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the company's end-to-end marketing strategy across brand, demand generation, and commercial growth.
  • Build a scalable marketing engine that supports long-term business objectives.
  • Define positioning and messaging for highly technical pharmaceutical products.
  • Translate complex scientific concepts into compelling, commercially relevant narratives.
  • Continuously refine the company's value proposition based on customer insights and market feedback.

Brand & Positioning

  • Own the company's brand identity, messaging architecture, and positioning strategy.
  • Ensure consistency across the website, presentations, sales collateral, campaigns, and digital channels.
  • Develop messaging tailored to biotech and pharmaceutical audiences.
  • Balance scientific credibility with clear, engaging commercial storytelling.

Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Transform the company website into a high-performing lead generation platform.
  • Partner with external design and development agencies to improve website performance.
  • Optimize messaging, user experience, and conversion pathways.
  • Run A/B tests and landing page experiments to improve conversion rates.
  • Identify friction points throughout the customer journey and implement data-driven improvements.

Demand Generation

  • Build scalable inbound and outbound marketing campaigns that generate qualified opportunities.
  • Develop LinkedIn thought leadership and content strategies.
  • Create email nurture sequences and outbound marketing initiatives.
  • Support Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs targeting strategic prospects.
  • Partner closely with Sales to improve lead quality and conversion.

Agency & Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with external agencies, freelancers, and marketing partners.
  • Develop creative briefs and project requirements.
  • Ensure high-quality execution, accountability, and timely delivery.
  • Evaluate agency performance using measurable business outcomes.

Sales Enablement & Marketing Operations

  • Partner closely with the Chief Commercial Officer and founders to support commercial initiatives.
  • Develop sales presentations, case studies, marketing collateral, and customer-facing assets.
  • Translate customer feedback into marketing improvements.
  • Strengthen alignment between Sales and Marketing through scalable processes and enablement resources.

Marketing Analytics & AI Operations

  • Build dashboards, attribution models, and marketing reporting frameworks.
  • Measure marketing effectiveness through qualified pipeline, conversion, and ROI metrics.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve productivity, streamline execution, and optimize workflows.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies that enhance marketing performance.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with the founders, Chief Commercial Officer, external agencies, sales stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, acting as the strategic marketing leader responsible for driving brand growth, demand generation, and commercial success.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As the Head of Marketing, your vertical focus will be on marketing strategy, demand generation, and brand leadership, while your horizontal focus will include analytics, sales enablement, AI-powered marketing operations, and commercial growth.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience leading B2B marketing initiatives within high-growth startups or fast-paced technology environments.
  • Marketing Leadership: Demonstrated experience developing marketing strategy, building demand generation programs, and owning marketing outcomes from planning through execution.
  • Brand & Messaging: Strong ability to position complex technical products, develop compelling messaging, and communicate effectively with sophisticated B2B audiences.
  • Demand Generation: Experience driving inbound and outbound marketing campaigns, lead generation initiatives, and Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs.
  • Website & Conversion Optimization: Proven success improving website performance, conversion rates, user journeys, and marketing funnel effectiveness.
  • Marketing Analytics: Strong analytical capabilities with experience building dashboards, attribution models, and KPI frameworks to guide marketing decisions.
  • Agency & Stakeholder Management: Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, and cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining high execution standards.
  • AI Fluency: Strong familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms, with experience integrating AI into marketing workflows and productivity.
  • Industry Experience: Experience in Pharma, Biotech, Healthcare Technology, Deep Tech, CDMO, CRO, or other highly technical B2B industries is strongly preferred.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Marketing Strategy & Growth: How you develop scalable marketing strategies that drive commercial growth.
  • Brand Positioning & Messaging: How you translate complex technical concepts into compelling customer value propositions.
  • Demand Generation & Conversion Optimization: How you build campaigns, optimize funnels, and generate qualified pipelines.
  • Marketing Analytics & Performance: How you use data, attribution, and experimentation to improve marketing effectiveness.
  • AI-Enabled Marketing Operations: How you leverage AI to improve execution, automate workflows, and increase productivity.
  • Leadership & Ownership: How you independently drive marketing initiatives, manage stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role where you'll be expected to work with meaningful overlap with European and UK business hours. You will also be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us.

During the offer process, we'll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

title: Senior Software Engineer - Application Development
description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Do you enjoy turning complex technical challenges into reliable, well-designed software? Are you passionate about building applications, integrations, and services that power your organization? If so, then we want you on our team!


We’re looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer, Application Development to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll help design, build, deploy, and support software services that power network observability across Zayo. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will own complex services and cross-service capabilities, translate ambiguous operational needs into scalable solutions, mentor other engineers, and establish practical engineering standards. You will partner with Software Architecture, Network Operations, SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, product stakeholders, and network-domain experts to ensure services are secure, testable, deployable, observable, resilient, and supportable in production.


Technology Environment

Our environment includes technologies such as:

  • Backend: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, gRPC, Pydantic, Protobuf, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic
  • Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, NATS, Redis and asynchronous messaging
  • Platform and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI, Helm, and Terraform
  • Observability and networking: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elasticsearch, VictoriaMetrics, gNMI, SNMP, NETCONF, and vendor APIs

The technology mix varies by service. Equivalent experience with comparable frameworks, messaging platforms, databases, and infrastructure technologies is welcome.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and operation of complex backend Python services, APIs, and data-processing workflows, translating ambiguous requirements into clear technical approaches while remaining hands-on in the codebase.
  • Design asynchronous and event-driven integrations and establish scalable patterns for API and event contracts, schema evolution, validation, error handling, database migrations, backward compatibility, and distributed-system reliability.
  • Make and document technical decisions that balance delivery speed, operational risk, maintainability, scalability, and long-term platform direction; contribute to technical roadmaps and modernization efforts.
  • Lead design and code reviews, establish practical standards for Python, testing, security, observability, and documentation, and mentor engineers in breaking down complex work and delivering incrementally.
  • Improve CI/CD practices and partner with SRE and DevOps on container images, Kubernetes deployments, infrastructure as code, secrets management, environment configuration, deployment verification, and rollback.
  • Define production-readiness expectations through service-level indicators, metrics, dashboards, alerts, performance testing, capacity analysis, and resilience testing.
  • Lead complex incident investigations, address root causes and corrective actions, and drive systemic risks spanning multiple services, repositories, teams, or environments to resolution.
  • Coordinate technical dependencies across internal projects and platforms, working with Network Operations and other users to ensure solutions measurably improve operational outcomes.

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced Python development experience, including structuring, testing, packaging, and operating long-lived backend applications.
  • Experience leading the design or delivery of distributed services, APIs, data platforms, network tools, or automation systems, including asynchronous or event-driven integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data modeling, transaction behavior, indexing, and controlled schema migrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux, Docker, containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, and automated software-quality and security controls.
  • Experience implementing production observability and diagnosing complex problems across application code, infrastructure, databases, messaging systems, and external dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ownership of production software through delivery, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continual improvement.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture, mentoring, project leadership, design reviews, code reviews, or cross-team influence, with the ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing software solutions within the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of carrier networks, network operations, service assurance, network inventory, provisioning, transport/IP technologies, or telecommunications operational support systems (OSS).
  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, gRPC, Protobuf, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, or another production messaging platform.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, GitLab CI, GitOps, or progressive-delivery tooling.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elasticsearch, Loki, VictoriaMetrics, service-level objectives, or advanced performance and resilience testing.
  • Experience with network telemetry protocols such as gNMI, SNMP, or NETCONF and integrations with network inventory, alarming, service-assurance, or orchestration platforms.
  • Experience processing high-volume operational telemetry or building software for NOC, SRE, infrastructure, network-engineering, or telecommunications environments.

Education And Experience

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience designing and operating complex production systems.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology OR equivalent relevant professional experience.

title: AI Engineer- Applied AI
description:
Summary

About the Product
Concierge is Guidewire's omnichannel AI agent for P&C carriers. It answers the phone when a policyholder has just had an accident, takes first notice of loss, asks the questions a good adjuster would ask, and writes a clean claim into ClaimCenter. It runs in production today with real carriers and real policyholders, not as a demo.

Two things make this harder than a typical chatbot. First, it has synchronous voice: latency is a product requirement, not a metric on a dashboard. Second, FNOL is a regulated event where the quality of the intake determines the eventual cost of the claim. A missed question early is a bigger loss reserve later.

The Role:

You will build, evaluate, and harden the agent itself: the orchestration, the context it sees, the tools it can call, and the evals that tell us whether a change made it better or just different.

Our rollout philosophy is a dimmer, not a light switch. We widen the agent's autonomy one notch at a time, and every notch has to be earned with evidence. Much of your work is producing that evidence, then acting on what it says.

Job Description

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end slices of the agent: prompt and context architecture, retrieval over policy and coverage data, tool and API calls into core claims systems, and handoff to a human when the agent should stop.

  • Build and run the eval loop, golden sets, trajectory evaluation, LLM-as-judge, error analysis on real production call traces, and make it the thing that gates releases.

  • Drive containment and resolution rates up without trading away accuracy, and instrument the system well enough that we can tell which of the two moved.

  • Work directly on the voice path: turn-taking, interruption, latency budgets, and the telephony layer underneath (LiveKit, SIP).

  • Sit in on carrier calls and listen to recordings. The best fixes usually come from hearing where the conversation went sideways, not from reading the logs.

What we're looking for

1. Building and deploying AI applications. You've shipped an LLM application that real users depend on, and you know that the hard part is that the output is not predictable. You're fluent in the building blocks LLMs, context engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, and you have real ML and deep learning depth underneath that fluency. Most importantly, you know how to make an unpredictable system behave predictably enough to trust: disciplined evals, error analysis, and statistical measurement rather than vibes and a handful of spot checks.

2. Software engineering fundamentals. You can reason about cost, latency, reliability, and scalability as tradeoffs rather than goals, and you know which ones you're making. You've designed data stores and distributed systems, you write tests, and you take security and privacy seriously while advocating CI/CD process automation. We handle claims data, recorded calls, and PII under carrier and regulatory scrutiny.

3. Using coding agents. You work with coding agents daily and you're good at it: managing their context, deciding when a spec is worth writing and when it isn't, giving them verifiers so they can close their own loops, and knowing when to intervene versus leave them alone. You also keep changing how you work as the tooling changes, rather than settling into a 2025 workflow.

  • The Billing Coordinator is responsible for accurate charge posting, payment posting, denial resolution, and AR follow-up for services. This role plays a critical part in maintaining AR health and ensuring timely reimbursement.

The Zoom productivity team is building a new AI-native way to work—helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables. As the product grows, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We're a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.


Responsibilities — Focus: Acquisition & Sign-up

  • Develop deep working knowledge of Zoom's productivity products: who uses them, what problems they solve, how they compare to alternatives, and where their real advantages lie.
  • Translate product positioning and messaging for PLG audiences that starts with the user problem, not the feature list—translating product capabilities into clear, outcome-oriented value.
  • Own end-to-end content creation and publication—including demos, tutorials, comparisons, social posts, emails, and web copy—from concept through measurement.
  • Use AI tools across the full content workflow—research, scripting, demo creation, editing, and iteration—to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Own the acquisition and sign-up funnel: build a repeatable content and distribution engine to drive organic discovery, landing page conversion, and sign-up completion.
  • Optimize landing pages, signup flows, and run CRO experiments to improve conversion rates.
  • Execute SEO and AEO content to improve organic discoverability and drive qualified traffic.
  • Create and distribute platform-native content across X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and Instagram Reels—matching format and depth to each platform's audience while maintaining Zoom brand guidelines.
  • Track what's working using engagement, trial, subscription, and adoption signals—then use those findings to improve content and calls to action.
  • Partner with Online Marketing on email campaigns and in-product activation—ensuring messaging consistency and coordinated user journeys.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing teams to keep product stories accurate and moving at the pace of product development.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years PLG experience in product marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, or social content, with focus on digital products (SaaS, AI tools, productivity platforms, or creator products).
  • Strong product instincts: ability to identify the most important user problems, recognize genuine differentiators, and turn those into product stories that are simple, specific, and credible.
  • Practical fluency using AI tools for research, scripting, demo creation, video editing, and content iteration—demonstrated through shipped work, not just familiarity.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create and publish end-to-end work: product videos, screen-recorded demos, and social content for digital products.
  • Strong understanding of how audiences, content formats, and distribution differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn—with demonstrated depth on multiple platforms.
  • Track record of building from scratch: cold-starting a content channel, product launch, or distribution system and driving it forward through ambiguity (candidates who have built and grown their own content channels with measurable results are encouraged to apply).
  • Comfort with rapid experimentation and scrappy execution: a willingness to test unconventional approaches, learn from what doesn't work, and iterate quickly without needing perfect conditions or established playbooks.
  • Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred—though not required if the work demonstrates the right instincts and execution ability.

title: Director of Quality Assurance
description:
Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

The Director of Quality Assurance is responsible for defining and leading the global quality strategy across the company’s product portfolio. This role provides horizontal/dotted-line leadership to approximately 150 QA and Automation QA engineers across 10 global product teams. The position drives consistent quality practices, modernization of QA capabilities, AI-enabled testing, and a culture of efficiency and innovation. This leader plays a critical role in driving business growth, competitive advantage, and customer retention by ensuring reliable, scalable, and high-performing product experiences. The Senior Director will also prepare and deliver executive-level quality reports, insights, and recommendations to C-level stakeholders.

Security Clearance Requirement: Candidates must hold a valid and active security clearance appropriate to the requirements of the role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Quality Strategy, Governance & Innovation

  • Develop and maintain a unified quality strategy aligned with organizational and product goals.
  • Define QA standards, processes, tools, and governance mechanisms across all product lines.
  • Lead quality improvement initiatives, audits, and transformation programs.
  • Drive the adoption of AI/ML-based quality, testing, and risk assessment tools.
  • Champion a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Define, track, and report key quality metrics including defect rates, release stability, automation effectiveness, and customer-reported issues.
  • Prepare clear, concise executive-level reports and dashboards for C-level leadership.

Global QA Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide dotted-line leadership to ~150 QA/AQA professionals across 10 distributed product teams.
  • Mentor QA managers, leads, and senior engineers, fostering talent development and capability growth.
  • Build and maintain a competency framework emphasizing automation (UI, backend, e2e), quality engineering, AI literacy, and modern testing disciplines.
  • Promote collaboration, consistency, and best-practice adoption across globally distributed teams.
  • Instill an efficiency-first mindset and passion for quality, innovation, and customer value.

Quality Engineering, Automation & AI Enablement

  • Oversee functional, regression, integration, performance, security, and automated testing practices.
  • Advance automation strategies and frameworks to support CI/CD pipelines and modern engineering delivery models.
  • Support risk-based test planning and strategic testing for complex, multi-product environments.
  • Lead integration of AI-assisted testing, generative AI tools, intelligent automation, and predictive quality insights.
  • Introduce tools and technologies that improve test effectiveness, coverage, and speed.
  • Ensure continuous learning and adaptation to emerging QA technologies, tools, and industry trends.

Release Quality, Delivery Readiness & Risk Management

  • Ensure alignment on release criteria, quality gates, and readiness standards across product teams.
  • Partner with Engineering and Product to improve release stability, predictability, and performance.
  • Oversee defect detection mechanisms and provide visibility into quality risks throughout the SDLC.
  • Participate in critical release reviews, escalations, and post-release evaluations.
  • Utilize AI tools and analytics to enhance release risk assessment and decision-making.
  • Ensure timely communication of risks, priorities, and release readiness to senior leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Impact

  • Work with Product Management to ensure requirements are testable and quality expectations are defined.
  • Collaborate with Customer Support and Customer Success to resolve customer-found issues efficiently and sustainably.
  • Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Services teams during escalations or customer-critical engagements.
  • Communicate quality risks, priorities, and metrics to stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Identify cross-functional opportunities for automation, AI-enabled improvements, and operational efficiency.
  • Strengthen customer retention and competitive positioning through improved product quality and reliability.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of QA, Quality Engineering, or Software Testing experience.
  • 7+ years in QA leadership roles with responsibility across multiple products and global teams.
  • Experience with automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and modern SDLC practices.
  • Proven ability to lead in a matrixed/dotted-line environment.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted testing or ML-driven quality tools.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business functions.
  • Passion for quality, innovation, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience preparing and presenting reports and insights to C-level executives.

Preferred:

  • Experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise software.
  • Knowledge of generative AI, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation technologies.
  • Experience in large-scale QA modernization and organizational change initiatives.

*Please submit your resume and application in English

Security Clearance Requirement: Candidates must hold a valid and active security clearance appropriate to the requirements of the role.


WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.

OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction.

Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks


Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented.   • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Professional Sales or Promotional Activity

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Global Education Department enables Motorola Solutions’ technologies to be deployed, used, and supported with confidence. We create scalable training and learning experiences for customers, partners, and employees worldwide. Through clear, effective education on our products and solutions, we directly support safer communities and more resilient organizations.


Job Description

The Senior Instructional Designer is an end-to-end learning architect and author within the Online Training Team. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle—from front-end performance analysis and learner persona creation to hands-on development and portfolio maintenance—of high-quality online technical product training.


This is a full-stack, hands-on instructional design and development role. The ideal candidate does not just write storyboards or manage vendors; they directly author interactive eLearning, translate complex software UI changes into task-based user workflows, and own learning products from strategy to finished build. Success requires deep instructional design theory, advanced proficiency in authoring tools like Articulate Storyline 360, and comfort leveraging emerging technologies—including generative AI—to accelerate output.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Instructional Design: Conduct needs analysis, build targeted learner personas, map task workflows, define measurable learning objectives, create instructional strategies, and build assessments that drive performance outcomes.
  • Hands-On eLearning Development: Directly author interactive, visually compelling online training modules, simulations, and software walkthroughs in Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise 360.
  • UI & Workflow Translation: Analyze complex hardware and software updates, release notes, and UI changes to evaluate their impact on user workflows and update learning materials accordingly.
  • Multimedia Production: Produce supporting multimedia assets—including software demo videos, animations, and graphics—using tools like Camtasia and the Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Portfolio & Asset Lifecycle Management: Manage, prioritize, and maintain the ongoing accuracy of training assets across a product portfolio to align with rapid release cycles and product roadmaps.
  • SME & Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Technical SMEs across global time zones to gather inputs, validate technical accuracy, and manage project timelines.
  • Instructional Quality & Standards: Apply solid adult learning principles, performance-based design, and modular content architecture while adhering to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • AI Tool Integration: Actively use AI-enabled tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) to accelerate scripting, scenario generation, media creation, and content optimization.
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze post-launch learner analytics, assessment data, and feedback to continuously optimize learning experiences.


Basic Requirements

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5+ years of professional experience in Instructional Design or Learning Experience Design, owning the full instructional design lifecycle (ADDIE/SAM) from front-end needs analysis to final build.
  • Advanced, hands-on technical proficiency in Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise 360 with a proven track record of authoring custom interactions, variables, conditions, and state changes from scratch (this role requires direct building, not hand-offs to external developers).
  • Mandatory Portfolio/Work Samples: Must present a portfolio showcasing work samples of interactive technical training, custom Storyline builds, task-based simulations, and clear instructional design decisions.
  • Solid, demonstrable grasp of adult learning theories, learner persona development, and performance support frameworks.
  • Experience designing and developing training for software, SaaS, hardware, telecommunications, enterprise technology, or complex technical product environments.

Preferred Qualifications & Competitive Advantages

  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical UI changes, system updates, and architecture diagrams into intuitive, scenario-based learning.
  • Proven experience using Generative AI tools in active workflows (e.g., rapid scripting, prototyping, prompt engineering, or media generation).
  • Advanced video editing and screencast production skills (Camtasia, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working across cross-functional, global teams and managing multi-product training portfolios.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong SME interview and stakeholder management capabilities.


Travel Requirements

None


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

No

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: AI Business Partner Senior Principal
description:
Role Purpose

The Senior Principal AI Business Partner (AIBP) is a senior technical and product leader who shapes AI investment, portfolio prioritization, and delivery standards across business units. This role combines executive problem framing with enterprise solution design—setting direction for complex, multi-stakeholder AI programs while remaining credible in architecture and early-stage delivery.

Senior Principal AIBPs operate at portfolio and cross-BU scope: they align SBU sponsors, technology leaders, and AI IO delivery teams on where to invest, how to structure engagements, and how to scale what works. They mentor Principal AIBPs and contribute reusable patterns to the enterprise AI operating model.

AI-native practice is expected at a leadership level—spec-driven development, agentic tooling, and the judgment to know when to engage hands-on versus when to orchestrate teams and forums.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Problem Framing & Portfolio Prioritization

  • Partner with SBU executive sponsors and functional leadership across domains to identify fundamental business problems with enterprise-scale AI potential.

  • Frame AI opportunities with financial, strategic, and technical rigor to enable confident investment decisions at portfolio and SteerCo forums.

  • Stack-rank and socialize AI initiatives across the portfolio based on value potential, feasibility, execution risk, and strategic alignment.

  • Provide Gate 1–ready recommendations and executive briefings that support sponsor decision-making.

Enterprise AI Solution Design & Standards

  • Engage CIOs and technology leaders as a credible AI solution architect—contributing to architectural decisions, trade-off analysis, and solution design for the most complex initiatives.

  • Define and evolve reusable AI patterns, engagement models, and reference architectures adopted across AIBPs and delivery teams.

  • Shape enterprise build, buy, and adapt decisions with accountability for scale, security, and responsible AI.

Product & Specification Leadership at Scale

  • Set the bar for execution-ready use case definition, specs, and acceptance criteria across programs you sponsor or oversee.

  • Review and coach Principal AIBPs and initiative teams on product thinking, user value, viability, and iteration paths.

  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise AI frameworks—not only local strategic fit.

Complex Program & Early-Stage Leadership

  • Lead or oversee the most complex POCs, pilots, and early production efforts—engaging hands-on when risk or novelty requires it, and orchestrating cross-functional teams when scale requires it.

  • Normalize AI-first development practices across business units; model spec-driven and agentic workflows for the AIBP cohort.

  • Guide business units through the full AI lifecycle—from discovery and qualification through value realization and transition to run-state.

Portfolio Leadership, Mentorship & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Co-lead portfolio management with PMO and AI Enablement—owning prioritization views, value realization tracking, and escalation paths for at-risk initiatives.

  • Mentor Principal AIBPs; contribute to hiring bar, onboarding, and capability development for the AIBP function.

  • Communicate progress, risk, and impact to C-suite and technology executive stakeholders.

  • Champion adoption of enterprise AI frameworks, governance, and best practices across business and technology teams.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Demonstrated technical foundation with at least two of the following:

  • Formal education in engineering, computer science, data science, or related field

  • Professional training in AI/ML

  • Hands-on experience building AI or data-intensive systems

  • Proven experience working in an AI-first way, actively using modern agentic development tools.

  • Senior product management, product engineering, or technical program leadership experience—from executive narrative to portfolio outcomes and shipped solutions at scale. Fundamentally understands what it means to build great products.

  • Experience partnering with engineering and data science leaders as a technical peer and thought partner.

  • Financial and analytical acumen to assess portfolio-level value, trade-offs, and execution risk.

  • Executive presence with credibility at C-suite, CIO, and engineering leadership levels.

  • Typically 12+ years of relevant experience, including leading AI or digital initiatives in complex enterprise environments.

  • Demonstrated experience mentoring senior ICs or leading a cohort of technical product leaders.

Preferred

  • Experience spanning multiple business units, domains, or enterprise portfolio governance.

  • Familiarity with LLM application design, enterprise AI architecture patterns, and responsible AI principles at scale.

  • Track record of taking multiple AI initiatives from POC to production and transitioning ownership to business operations.

  • Experience contributing to operating models, playbooks, or COE standards adopted beyond a single team.

Core Competencies

  • AI-Native Technical Leadership: Deep practitioner understanding plus judgment on when and how to apply AI at enterprise scale.

  • Product Engineering at Scale: Sets standards for specs, prototypes, and iterations across programs.

  • Executive Problem Framing: Identifies enterprise-worthy problems and structures AI opportunities for investment forums.

  • Enterprise Solution Architecture: Engages technology executives as a peer on the hardest architectural decisions.

  • Portfolio Judgment: Balances value, feasibility, risk, and capacity across a multi-initiative portfolio.

  • Force Multiplier: Elevates other AIBPs and delivery teams through mentorship, patterns, and governance clarity.

  • Trusted Executive Advisor: Earns trust through depth, delivery, integrity, and consistent follow-through at senior forums.

What Success Looks Like

  • Executive sponsors and technology leaders view the Senior Principal AIBP as a strategic advisor and credible architect—not a coordinator.

  • The enterprise AI portfolio is prioritized, visible, and progressing with clear ownership and value tracking.

  • Complex POCs and pilots reach production with measurable business impact and clean transition paths.

  • Principal AIBPs and engineering teams benefit from clearer patterns, faster decisions, and accelerated delivery.

  • Enterprise AI frameworks and AI-first practices are adopted consistently across business units.

title: Financial Systems Lead
description:
About Teamshares

Teamshares is a technology-enabled acquirer of small and midsize businesses. We buy companies with $0.5 million to $5 million in EBITDA, integrate them with our platform, and help employees become owners. Founded in 2019, we operate 90+ subsidiaries with approximately $490 million in consolidated revenue across 40+ industries and 30 states.

The Role

We're looking for a Financial Systems Lead to own the financial-systems strategy and execution across our network of companies. You'll design and implement ERP solutions, evaluate financial-systems tools and platforms, advise leadership on technology investments, and ensure each company has the systems and processes to manage its own finances effectively.

This is an individual contributor role focused on strategy, design, and hands-on execution. You'll work directly with company finance teams and implementation partners, troubleshoot technical problems, establish best practices, and build the financial-systems foundation that enables our companies to operate independently.

You'll have significant influence over how we approach financial systems across the network. As we grow, you'll build and lead a small team. We're looking for someone who can handle the immediate hands-on work while growing into broader leadership of this function.

About two-thirds of our network uses QuickBooks Online. We have several companies on NetSuite and others on industry-specific platforms. You'll think strategically about the entire financial-systems landscape, not just one platform. You'll evaluate payment processors, sales tax software, accounting automation, and specialized tools as the need arises.

Responsibilities

Financial-Systems Strategy & Platform Selection: Help leadership evaluate and decide which financial platforms are right for which companies. Make recommendations on QuickBooks Online vs. NetSuite vs. industry-specific ERPs. Build a long-term vision for standardization across the network. Evaluate new tools and technologies as opportunities arise.

Implementation Leadership & Design: Work with implementation partners and company finance teams to design and execute ERP transitions. Make recommendations on configuration vs. customization vs. process change. Ensure implementations deliver real business value and companies can operate independently.

Financial-Systems Standards & Governance: Establish best practices and standards for financial systems across the network. Define how we handle common financial scenarios: multi-subsidiary accounting, intercompany transactions, reporting structures, tax compliance. Document these approaches so they scale.

Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Work as a peer with implementation consultants and technology vendors. Evaluate their recommendations and proposals. Challenge over-engineered or unnecessary solutions. Support leadership with technical assessment of partners and vendors.

Problem-Solving & Technical Leadership: When companies encounter financial-systems challenges, you're the escalation point. Diagnose problems, work with partners and vendors to find solutions, and make recommendations. Roll up your sleeves on troubleshooting and hands-on work as needed.

What We're Looking For

7-12 years of experience in ERP implementations, financial-systems leadership, enterprise accounting, or related fields.

Deep hands-on knowledge of Netsuite and practical experience with other financial-systems tools.

Strong judgment about financial-systems architecture. You can evaluate trade-offs between different platforms, vendors, and approaches. You make decisions based on what the business actually needs.

Experience evaluating and advising on technology vendors and solutions. You can assess whether a vendor's proposal is sound and spot over-engineering.

Comfortable working with ambiguity and in growing organizations. You're not constrained by perfect upfront planning and can adapt as circumstances change.

Able to communicate clearly with different audiences: finance teams, implementation partners, technology leaders, and business executives.

Willing to be hands-on. You're an individual contributor who troubleshoots problems, reviews implementation details, and supports execution directly.

Nice to Have

You have led ERP implementations or modernization initiatives for companies with multiple subsidiaries or complex financial needs.

You have experience as a financial-systems consultant, solution architect, or in-house finance technology leader.

You have evaluated and managed multiple financial-systems platforms and tools.

You have a background in financial operations, corporate accounting, or finance technology.

You have hands-on expertise in NetSuite, QuickBooks, or similar cloud platforms.

Work Location and Language Requirements

This role is open to candidates in Quebec and Ontario. It's primarily remote, with the option to work from any of our offices across both provinces. French is a strong asset, as we have partners across Canada.

Why We Are Hiring

We enable our partners to improve and streamline their mortgage lending operations through the Nesto Mortgage Cloud. As the most advanced cloud-based mortgage technology in Canada, our SaaS solution offers a world-class omnichannel experience that consistently boosts volume, increases productivity, and reduces technology costs.

Maestro, our AI-powered underwriting platform, already runs inside nesto, with AI agents making real-time, policy-based decisions, and we are now bringing it to financial institution clients through Nesto Cloud. To drive the execution of our upcoming projects, we are looking for an AI Delivery Manager for Maestro specifically, who will focus on functional mastery and SaaS delivery.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Implementation across the condition families. You support every agent in the workstream from start to finish: scoping, process mapping, golden-set (reference dataset) labeling queues, config logs, tuning, and shadow divergence queues (cases where agent output differs from underwriter decisions).
  • The client underwriter pod. You lead the client’s underwriter pod as an extended part of your team. First comes a calibration exercise: both pods label the same 50 documents, you measure disagreement, and you write the adjudication rules. Then production labeling begins, and you manage throughput.
  • Adjudication. You close every ambiguous label or policy question within SLA. You triage rigorously so only true policy calls reach the UW Expert.
  • Process mapping and value baselines. You co-own the signed process blueprints and the value baselines (touches, cycle time, rework). All results are measured against them.
  • The playbook. You document the patterns from the first workstream and build the repeatable playbook for future implementations.
  • Program artifacts and dependencies. You co-own the RAID and decision logs with the Project Manager. You run the bi-weekly platform-program dependency sync (live client data, environments, release schedules) and escalate risks early.

What You Bring

  • Relevant Experience: 3–5 years as an Implementation Manager, Functional Consultant, Solutions-Oriented Analyst, or a similar role focused on technology implementation or operational transformation.
  • System Mastery: You learn complex software platforms quickly and turn that knowledge into practical solutions for the client’s operations.
  • Client-facing Experience: You run client workshops and manage client teams with confidence.
  • Technical comfort: You don’t need to code. You do speak the language of Technical Product Managers and can lead in-depth discussions on system logic.
  • Ownership: You’ve led client implementations as the primary person responsible for the functional outcome, and you’ve owned deliveries end to end.
  • Influence: You guide executive client decisions and push product improvements back to our team.

Nice-to-Have

  • Knowledge of the lending lifecycle or the mortgage industry.
  • Experience with AI or automation rollouts in operations (labeling, QA sampling, exception handling).
  • Fluency in French and English.

You Shouldn’t Apply If

  • You are not interested in a role that involves frequent client-facing work or extensive communication with numerous internal and external stakeholders.
  • You prefer working with legacy or simple systems.
  • You have no passion for the fintech or mortgage technology space and are unwilling to develop domain expertise.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): A quick intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (30 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Case Study: A chance to showcase your skills through an open-ended, scenario-based exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Non-Technical Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background and role-specific vetting checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards – Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.

  • Learning & Growth – Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success – Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training - United States
description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client.

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview
