title: Program Manager, Network Convenings
description:
About the Organization - Beyond100K

To solve the world's most pressing problems, we need tomorrow's problem-solvers equipped with Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM) knowledge, skills, and inspiration. And tomorrow's problem-solvers need excellent STEM teachers today to guide them. In 2021, Beyond100K (formerly 100Kin10) successfully met its first 10-year goal by preparing more than 108,000 excellent STEM teachers for America's classrooms, surpassing the audacious goal set by President Obama a decade prior. To do this, we built a new type of networked-impact effort that rethinks how organizations collaborate, learn from one another, and together identify and tackle challenges that none could successfully address on its own. We achieved this goal in the midst of a growing national teacher shortage and a global pandemic, uniting over 300 leading agencies and organizations and 3,000 individuals across the country to tackle something seemingly intractable — ending the STEM teacher shortage, so that all kids could have access to a great STEM education and contribute their spark to a brighter future.

Beyond100K- To decide our next goal, we undertook a national, participatory listening process asking young people, primarily Black, Latinx, and Native American young people, to share their experience in PK-12 STEM education. More than 600 young people responded to our call. Their stories and the resulting goal position us to decrease the STEM teacher shortage and center belonging, while focusing on the students, teachers, and schools that have been least well-served in STEM education. By 2032, our goal is to increase student and teacher belonging and to reduce the shortage by one-third, mobilizing a growing network to prepare 150,000 STEM teachers and retain 150,000 STEM teachers beginning with schools in Black, Latinx, and Native American communities — where the shortage has been the hardest to solve.

How we work now - We pursue that goal through our whole network programming as well as our CoLabs: bounded communities of partners who go deep on one high-leverage challenge. Four CoLabs are underway: Classrooms of Belonging / AI, Foundational Math, Dream to Teach, and Teacher Work Environment, surrounded by whole-network programming that helps partners find one another, share what works, and carry it into the field while anchoring in our moonshot goal.

About the Role

The Network Community Team is focused on how partners find their way into Beyond100k, how they meet each other and connect in the network, and design community building experiences that strengthen connections and relationships between partners so that good work travels without us in the middle. We are seeking a Program Manager to lead the experience design of our whole-network convening spaces: the gatherings, spaces of learning, inspiration, and connection that turn more than 250 partner organizations into an actual network rather than a list.

The core of the role is designing how we bring people together both in person and virtually. You will design and manage our network gatherings including our flagship annual summit, regional meet-ups, virtual learning sessions, and strategize with the network community team to develop pathways for partners to deepen their engagement through 1:1 connection, our virtual community platform, and through deeper engagement into our micro-communities.

Expected travel is 10-15% and includes bi-annual team retreats, our annual Summit and partner convening, regional meet-ups, and select in-person partner engagements. The Program Manager sits within the Network Community Team, and reports to the Associate Director, Network Development & Impact.

Your Responsibilities will Include

Network Gatherings and Events

  • Lead the user-experience design, strategy, budgeting, and delivery of whole-network gatherings including virtual convenings such as our annual network launch and new partner onboarding, and our annual in-person Summit, from concept to implementation to follow-up.
  • Design the participant experience, session architecture, and the partner journey through all whole network Beyond100K events, grounding in equitable and human-centered design.
  • Lead event execution: produce smaller and virtual gatherings and manage our event vendors to deliver the Summit and other large events on time and on budget.
  • Own the convening calendar: what we gather people for, how often, in what format, ensuring that we have a consistent cadence of events throughout the year in support of our goals.
  • Manage internal stakeholders, event vendors, venues, and consultants as needed across the gathering portfolio.
  • Evaluate gathering and program outcomes and partner engagement, and use what you find to change what we do next.

Community Design and Activation

  • Support the development of engagement pathways that move partners into deeper contributions and peer connection over time along with members of the network community team.
  • Design recruitment and mobilization strategies for whole-network programs and events, against defined participation targets, work collaboratively with the Network Coordinator to execute on the plan.
  • Set the strategy and design for Circle, our network community platform, what the space is for, how it is structured, and what strong engagement looks like.

Contribute to the Strategy and Design for Other Partner Touchpoints

  • Act as a thought partner and expert on other key partner experiences checking for alignment with the CoLab calendar.
  • Support whole-network program outcomes and opportunities through progress monitoring, evaluation, and coordination with internal teammates, external vendors, consultants, and network partners.

Requirements

About You

Experience

The ideal candidate will have a minimum of four years of related professional experience, including experience in the following areas:

  • Equitable and human centered design practitioner
  • Designing and delivering convenings and events, virtual and in person, at a range of sizes, including at least one flagship-scale event you were responsible for.
  • Program design and management in one of the following areas: adult learning, leadership development, network or community management, and/or community organizing along with group facilitation experience (in-person and virtual).
  • Managing virtual communities or networks, including responsibility for engagement and participation outcomes.
  • Managing vendors, consultants, and event budgets.
  • Nice to have: Experience in STEM education, K-12 or teacher-focused organizations, or a membership or network organization.

Skills

  • Project & Program Manager: You have demonstrated program and project management skills. You are highly organized with strong follow-through, and you nail the details, so nothing falls through the cracks on a complex, high-visibility event.
  • Experience Designer: You design experiences that build community. You craft, produce, and facilitate inclusive, engaging and memorable gatherings that bring diverse groups of organizations and individuals together, and that inspire, delight, and catalyze action.
  • Analytical Problem-Solver: You use data and partner feedback to understand what is working, diagnose what is not, and make sound decisions. When plans change or problems come up, you find practical solutions quickly.
  • Strategic Communicator & Facilitator: You are an excellent communicator. You excel at facilitating rich conversations on complex issues and synthesizing insights from gatherings.
  • Impact Player & Team Member: You are able to work independently and as part of a remote team. You are self-directed and proactive in an environment with dynamic priorities. You are team-oriented, open-minded, creative and flexible.

Mindsets

  • Solution-Oriented: You focus on what will work. You ask good questions, test ideas, gather data, and adjust course, and you are never afraid to rethink an approach.
  • Continuous Improvement: You are someone who is continually striving to improve and regularly create and take advantage of learning opportunities. You collect data and determine opportunities to better meet the needs of partners and the Network.
  • People First: You lead with a human-centered approach, with colleagues and network partners alike. You prioritize relationships with individuals and organizations and believe in the power of bringing groups together around a common charge.
  • Self-motivation: The drive to proactively take the initiative, identifying problems and opportunities across your portfolio, developing recommendations, and taking action on those recommendations.
  • Adaptability: The ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment where you have autonomy to drive your work.
  • Passion for Social Change: The drive to contribute to change in education and beyond, and the ability to lead and design in a way that is centered on racial justice and diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Benefits

Working at Beyond100K

People who thrive at Beyond100K are team-oriented, open-minded, creative, and flexible and possess a strong desire to learn and grow in a feedback-rich remote work environment. Our culture embraces colleagues with genuine warmth, a curiosity to learn, a drive toward excellence, the ability to laugh at themselves, an eagerness for feedback to spur growth and impact, and an interest in co-workers as colleagues and as human beings.

We believe in community. We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds create a rich work environment that is essential to our work. We are committed to building an organization with raised consciousness in order to impact how we collaborate with our partners, support our network, and work together as a team. We aim to build each other up, empower each other, and give each other what we need to grow and thrive. We hope you will join us as we continue to build a diverse organization that fosters a work environment where people from all backgrounds are welcomed, valued, and supported.

The salary band for this role is $75,500-$85,500. This role will pay in that band, commensurate to the experience of the individual who is hired. Beyond100K offers a comprehensive benefits program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, short-term & long-term disability, and a 403(b) retirement plan with up to 5% employer match. We also offer 15 paid vacation days in the first year and 20 vacation days in year 2, plus 12 observed holidays. Additionally, our offices are closed between December 25th and January 1st.

description:
As vCluster’s Regional Sales Director, you aren’t just managing a territory; you are building the engine of a category-defining company. We have moved past the "early adopter" phase and are now the architectural standard for AI Factories and GPU-heavy enterprises. In this role, you will be the strategic architect of your region, tasked with hiring an elite team, instilling a high-octane hunting mentality, and owning the GTM strategy. You will be leading a team that sells a mission-critical platform to the world's most sophisticated Engineering, DevOps, and AI leaders.

As a Regional Sales Director, your role will include:

  • Strategic Leadership & Recruitment: Recruit, hire, and lead a regional team of Enterprise and Strategic AEs. You are responsible for their professional growth, their quotas, and building a high-performance culture from the ground up.

  • Operationalize "Land & Expand": Direct our land motion and ensure the team is positioned to capitalize on our massive NRR potential within accounts

  • Instill a Hunting Cadence: Drive a relentless focus on pipeline generation. You will set the standard for outbound excellence, ensuring your team is actively penetrating the Fortune 500 and global enterprise markets.

  • Strategic Deal Orchestration: Act as a "player-coach" on the region's largest opportunities.

  • GTM Partnership: Act as the strategic lead for regional field events and demand generation. You won’t just attend events; you will help design them to ensure they convert into high-quality pipeline.

  • Methodical Execution: Ensure the region operates with high forecast accuracy and rigor, partnering with your team to navigate complex organizations using frameworks like MEDDPICC or Command of the Message.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in sales leadership, specifically within Kubernetes, AI infrastructure, or high-growth cloud platforms.

  • Start-Up Grit: You are a "Series A/B" builder who has successfully scaled sales teams from early stages to predictable, high-growth engines. You are comfortable building the playbook while running at 100mph.

  • Technical Gravity: You are "technically fluent" in the cloud-native ecosystem and can hold your own in a room with a CTO or Lead Platform Architect.

  • Pipeline Mentality: You believe pipeline is the lifeblood of a startup. You have a proven system for encouraging, tracking, and maintaining a relentless "hunting" culture.

  • Executive Presence: Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to operate at the C-level with our most strategic partners and global customers.

Bonus points for:

  • Ecosystem Expertise: Direct experience selling alongside Hyperscalers (AWS/Azure/GCP).

  • Domain Knowledge: A proven track record at category-defining infrastructure companies

  • Local Network: A strong existing "book of business" or a deep network of elite sales talent in your respective region.

  • AI Infrastructure Savvy: Deep understanding of how vCluster integrates in environments to solve skyrocketing GPU costs.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $400K - $440K

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Identity & Access Management
description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

As a Senior Software Engineer, Identity & Access Management, you will build and modernize the authentication and authorization capabilities that protect McKesson's healthcare technology platforms.


This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on modern identity architecture, secure application development, and infrastructure automation. You will help migrate applications and identity capabilities from legacy authentication systems to modern identity platforms such as Okta while engineering identity infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform.


You will own complex identity capabilities from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support, while helping establish scalable patterns that other engineering teams can adopt.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy secure authentication and authorization capabilities, including SSO, MFA, federation, provisioning, and identity lifecycle integrations.
  • Lead the technical migration of applications and user populations from legacy authentication and directory systems to Okta or comparable modern identity platforms.
  • Build and maintain identity infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, establishing reusable, version-controlled patterns for identity configuration and deployment.
  • Design and implement identity integrations using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and SCIM.
  • Develop secure services, APIs, and integrations that support authentication, authorization, provisioning, and identity workflows.
  • Partner with application engineers, architects, product owners, and security teams to translate identity and access requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Integrate identity configuration and security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing and deployment practices.
  • Review code and technical designs with particular attention to authentication and authorization correctness, secrets management, session handling, and secure engineering practices.
  • Diagnose complex production identity issues involving tokens, sessions, federation, provisioning, application integrations, and access policies.
  • Contribute to the architecture and roadmap for consolidating identity capabilities and retiring legacy authentication technologies.
  • Mentor engineers on secure software development, identity patterns, IaC practices, and authentication architecture.
  • Create clear technical documentation, identity-flow diagrams, deployment patterns, and operational runbooks.
  • Partner with security, risk, and compliance teams to build identity solutions appropriate for a regulated healthcare environment.

Minimum Qualifications

Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience

Critical Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications, services, platforms, or distributed systems.
  • 2+ years of hands-on identity, authentication, authorization, or security engineering experience.
  • Strong programming experience in at least one language such as Java, C#, Python, or a comparable object-oriented/backend language.
  • Production experience integrating applications with a modern identity provider such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Auth0, Ping Identity, or a comparable platform.
  • Hands-on experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML in production systems.
  • Experience modernizing or migrating applications from legacy authentication technologies such as LDAP, Active Directory, SiteMinder, or custom authentication services.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform to provision and manage infrastructure or platform configuration as code, including reusable modules, source control, review, testing, and deployment practices.
  • Experience building or supporting REST APIs, microservices, or distributed applications in security-sensitive production environments.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD and automated software-delivery practices.
  • Experience implementing secure engineering practices involving authentication, authorization, secrets, sessions, or access controls.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep hands-on experience with Okta, including SSO, MFA, lifecycle management, provisioning, policies, and application integrations.
  • Experience managing Okta configuration through Terraform.
  • Experience with SCIM-based provisioning and identity lifecycle automation.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other cloud-native technologies.
  • Experience working with relational or NoSQL persistence technologies used in distributed applications.
  • Experience with identity-related threat modeling, Zero Trust, least-privilege, or policy-based access controls.
  • Experience building software in healthcare, financial services, insurance, life sciences, or another regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with regulatory or security frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable controls.
  • Okta certification or equivalent identity-platform certification.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver secure, production-ready identity capabilities that engineering teams can reliably integrate with.
  • Increase the use of repeatable, version-controlled Terraform/IaC patterns for identity configuration rather than relying on manual platform administration.
  • Successfully move applications and identity capabilities away from legacy authentication technologies without compromising application availability or access.
  • Establish reusable authentication, authorization, federation, and provisioning patterns that reduce one-off identity implementations.
  • Improve the reliability, maintainability, and security of identity integrations through automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and operational standards.
  • Become a technical resource for engineers working through complex authentication and authorization problems

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

TechnologyAdvice is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who can turn hiring needs into strong candidate pipelines and successful hires. You’ll recruit across business functions, partner directly with hiring managers, and take ownership of moving your searches forward.

This role is a good fit if you enjoy finding candidates who aren’t actively applying, learning what a team needs, and changing your approach when a search stalls. You’ll have support from the recruiting team, with the expectation that you bring recommendations and take action without waiting for someone to outline every next step.

Experience recruiting B2B sales professionals is especially valuable for this role.

Location: United States

What you'll do

  • Own multiple searches from the hiring-manager intake through offer acceptance and the handoff to onboarding.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define what success looks like in each role, and agree on interview criteria and timelines.
  • Build a sourcing plan for each opening and actively engage qualified candidates through LinkedIn, direct outreach, referrals, and relevant professional communities.
  • Write personalized outreach that gives candidates a clear reason to consider TechnologyAdvice, and maintain relationships with promising candidates for future openings.
  • Conduct structured phone and video screens, assess evidence against role requirements, and share clear recommendations with hiring managers.
  • Keep interviews and assessments moving, follow up on feedback, and address delays before they put a candidate or hiring timeline at risk.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records and next steps in Greenhouse, and provide useful updates on pipeline health, sourcing results, and blockers.
  • Use recruiting data and hiring-manager feedback to adjust the search when the current approach is not producing qualified candidates.
  • Guide candidates through the process with clear expectations and timely communication, including offer discussions and closing.
  • Use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work such as outreach drafting, scheduling reminders, and reporting, while reviewing outputs and applying your own judgment to candidate assessments.
  • Work with the recruiting team, HR, and hiring managers to improve workflows and make the transition from accepted offer to onboarding smooth.

Who you are

  • At least two years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including in-house corporate recruitment and direct partnership with hiring managers.
  • Experience recruiting professional roles across business functions, with the ability to adapt sourcing and screening approaches to different searches.
  • A track record of finding and engaging passive candidates through personalized outreach, Boolean searches, and LinkedIn or similar tools.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, identify which searches need attention, and maintain momentum across multiple openings.
  • Clear communication with candidates and hiring managers, including asking useful questions and providing specific recommendations supported by evidence.
  • A proactive approach to difficult searches, consistent follow-through on commitments, and the ability to raise problems early with a proposed next step.
  • Experience using an ATS to manage candidate pipelines and recruiting data; Greenhouse experience preferred.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Google Workspace and Slack, with a willingness to learn AI and automation tools that improve recruiting workflows.

What success looks like

  • Your searches have clear plans and active pipelines built through consistent, targeted sourcing.
  • Qualified candidates move through the process promptly, with clear next steps and useful hiring-manager feedback.
  • Hiring managers can rely on your updates and recommendations, and candidates receive a thoughtful, well-organized experience.

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Flexible PTO: Take the time you need, when you need it.
  • Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family.
  • Insurance Protection: Life, AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability coverage.
  • 401K with Match: Secure your future with our company-matched retirement savings.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for new parents during life’s special moments.
  • Wellness Perks: Access Headspace and enjoy monthly fitness reimbursements.
  • Pet Insurance: Care for your furry family members.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.
  • Book Reimbursement: Get up to 12 books reimbursed per year to fuel your learning.
  • Bucket List Benefit: Celebrate milestones with annual contributions toward your dream adventures after 3 years.
  • In-Office Perks: Enjoy catered lunches for our in-office team.

Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire in an employer approved US state and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.

Salary Range
We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.

$65,000—$75,000 USD

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pre-employment screening required.

Senior Software Engineer, Grading Operations

About the Role

The Grading Operations software engineering team builds and operates the internal software that runs our grading and authentication business. That means the applications our operations teams work in every day, the services and APIs behind them, the scheduled and event-driven processes that move items through the grading lifecycle, and the integrations that connect all of it to adjacent systems across the platform.

Volume climbs every year and the systems have kept up. As our grading operations reach more markets, keeping pace means solving for distance as well as volume.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can help build and evolve the services, event-driven pipelines, and internal applications that keep a high-volume physical operation running. This role is especially well-suited for an engineer who is strongest on the backend, but comfortable working in the frontend to take features all the way to the people who use them.

  • Use AI tooling, with a preference for Claude, routinely across software design, architecture, and implementation, while owning the quality of what ships

  • Build backend services, APIs, and data models that power the internal applications our grading and authentication teams rely on every day

  • Work across a mix of architectures, from a large containerized .NET application to smaller serverless APIs and Python background processing jobs, and help decide which is the right fit for new work

  • Design and implement event-driven and asynchronous systems that keep operational data flowing reliably at high volume

  • Contribute to frontend application development using JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue.js to deliver features end to end

  • Collaborate with Product, Tech, and Operations teams to translate business requirements into clean technical designs across both backend and frontend systems

  • Troubleshoot data, integration, service, and UI issues across a large, long-lived codebase

  • Share in an on-call rotation supporting the services the team owns

  • Contribute to technical documentation to improve maintainability, knowledge sharing, and team velocity

  • Help raise the bar on system design, code quality, observability, and engineering best practices across the team

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building production applications, with substantial experience in backend systems and some hands-on experience delivering frontend work

  • 3+ years experience / strong proficiency in C# and .NET

  • Routine use of AI tooling as part of how you design and build software, with the judgment to review and take responsibility for what it produces

  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and service integrations

  • Sound judgment about where code belongs, including how to draw module boundaries inside a large application and when a capability warrants its own service

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for services running in production

  • Strong fundamentals working with relational databases and data modeling (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL)

  • Hands-on experience building and operating production services in the cloud, including container orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, ECS), serverless compute behind an API gateway, and managed messaging and data stores

  • Comfortable working in a modern frontend codebase, with hands-on experience in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and a component-based framework

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation), and monitoring and observability tooling (e.g. CloudWatch, Datadog)

  • Strong communication and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to document what you build

  • Experience turning complex requirements from Product and Operations partners into clean, extensible systems

  • Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing asynchronous, event-driven, and distributed systems

  • Experience with any of AWS, Python (including test frameworks such as pytest or unittest), Apache Kafka, DynamoDB, or Vue.js

  • Experience partnering closely with Product, and comfort working directly with the operations and business teams who use what you build

  • Experience making high-volume workflows faster, in the interface or behind it, where shaving seconds off a repeated task adds up across thousands of items

We are only considering candidates who sit within the Eastern Time Zone of the United States.

Global Accounting & Financial Reporting

Treasury & Cash Management

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Docuvera builds technology that supports the highly regulated pharmaceutical industry, where quality, trust, and compliance genuinely matter.

Our people contribute to work that really matters, collaborate with talented people globally, and help shape the future of digital content in life sciences.

Let us tell you more about what we do at Docuvera, why we do it, and what it means for you -

More about Docuvera

Docuvera is the industry leader in governed, structured content authoring for the life sciences industry and as a pioneer in this space, we are proud to support top global Pharma companies. Born out of Author-it in 2017, Docuvera is now a member of the cormeo family of companies, an exciting step that strengthens our global reach and long-term growth.

Our mission

We are on a mission to help our customers harness the power of digital innovation, accelerating their ability to safely get their life changing products to market faster.

For our customers, Docuvera empowers them to drive digital transformation in how they manage their content. Docuvera turns their content into small, reusable components (building blocks). A component is written and approved once, then reused confidently and consistently across many documents, projects, and regions.

For our team, it means delivering real world impact through ground-breaking solutions to technically complex problems.

About this role and why it matters

This role serves as a critical bridge between commercial sales, customer success, and product teams. It plays a central role in early-to-mid pipeline activities and supports seamless transition into implementation, ensuring technical and business alignment with our pharma and life sciences customers.

Acting as both a sales consultant and a technical architect, you’ll collaborate with Account Executives on value-based discovery and business case development, while also engaging with the Customer Success team to define readiness and scope post-sale. You will help prospects understand the strategic value of structured content platforms in regulatory and clinical. CMC and other pharma use-cases for Docuvera and ensure that proposed solutions align with enterprise-scale deployment requirements including security, compliance, metadata design, and structured reuse.

This is an influence-only, non-quota-carrying pre-sales role that is essential to closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals, often involving global pharmaceutical organizations and six- to seven-figure SaaS investments.

What you'll focus on

Pre-Sales and Sales Collaboration

  • Partner with Account Executives to drive early-stage discovery and align Docuvera’s capabilities with customer needs across labeling, CMC, clinical, safety, quality, and medical affairs.
  • Independently deliver tailored solution demonstrations, technical walkthroughs, and business case development in collaboration with Product Marketing and Solutions Consulting.
  • Serve as the technical and regulatory voice during deal cycles, helping reduce friction in InfoSec, IT, and Procurement reviews.

Technical Architecture & Readiness Scoping

  • Lead early architecture design sessions to map integration, content reuse, structured authoring, and metadata alignment strategies.
  • Support proof-of-concept or sandbox efforts by configuring and demonstrating platform workflows that address client-specific use cases.
  • Partner with Customer Success teams to assess readiness and define early implementation scope, particularly for large enterprise programs.

Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Participate in global workshops, industry events, webinars, and customer advisory activities as a subject matter expert.
  • Track deal progression, surface technical blockers, and collaborate with Engineering and Product to ensure roadmap alignment.
  • Lead RFP/RFI responses. Assist in InfoSec reviews, and validation documentation across regulated content workflows.

What you'll bring to the role

You'll have some or all of these technical skills, experience and knowledge

  • 7–12 years in one or more of the following roles:
    • Solution Consulting or Sales Engineering for B2B SaaS
    • Regulatory Information Management or Digital Transformation within pharma
    • Technical product management or implementation consulting
  • Proven experience working with structured content platforms and/or traditional content management systems such as Veeva, OpenText, CARA is desirable
  • Demonstrated success supporting large, global clients with complex regulatory and operational requirements
  • Strong storytelling, communication, and executive presentation capabilities
  • Comfortable leading both strategic discussions and technical validations
  • Skilled in quickly configuring platform instances based on customer technical requirements, creating custom workflows that demonstrate structured content authoring, metadata management, and regulatory compliance automation based on best practice strategies.
  • Able to translate complex features into commercial, regulatory, and operational value
  • Adept at managing multiple workstreams and communicating across cross-functional teams

We're seeking this key regulatory & technical knowledge

  • Deep understanding of life sciences regulatory frameworks, including GxP, eCTD, IDMP, 21 CFR Part 11, and EMA/FDA guidance
  • Strong knowledge of FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) standards as applied to pharmaceutical regulatory contexts, including electronic Product Information (ePI), ICH M11 technical specifications, M4Q(R2) Quality implementation, and PQI/PQ-CMC data exchange formats
  • Deep understanding of metadata modeling, ontology design, and taxonomy frameworks; ability to architect solutions that leverage controlled vocabularies, semantic relationships, and structured data to enable intelligent content reuse and automated compliance validation
  • Proficient in building, configuring, and managing RESTful API transactions between enterprise SaaS platforms, with demonstrated ability to interpret technical specifications and API documentation to create Proof-Of-concept integrations; able to navigate and troubleshoot JSON, HTML and XML structures
  • Ability to create and manage custom scripts, write Proof-Of-Concept level code using popular scripting and development tools, example: Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS etc.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML enablement in pharma workflows a strong plus; must be able to learn and quickly incorporate Docuvera AI strategy, technology and vision into demonstrable solutions
  • Strong understanding of information security (ISO 27001, SOC 2) and data privacy (GDPR, HIPAA)

We’re seeking these certifications or qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Information Systems).
  • Preferred: Advanced degree (MBA, MS) or certifications such as RAC (Regulatory Affairs Certification), PMP, or TOGAF.
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SAFe, or similar) are a plus.
  • Big 4 consulting or previous Pharma/Lifesciences IT transformation experience a plus

What you can expect working with us

How we operate

We're a global team working across New Zealand, Asia, the UK, Europe, and the United States. Our CEO is based in the USA, with the rest of our leadership team based across both the USA and New Zealand. Most of our technical teams are in New Zealand and Asia, with our customer facing and sales teams predominantly based in the USA and Europe. We have consciously built our workforce with a diversity of experience, perspective, and background to shape a really well rounded company.

We're a pretty down to earth team where influence is not limited by hierarchy so you can expect that everyone's virtual door is always open. As a distributed, mostly remote team, we have a lot of time zones to connect across so we work hard to stay connected and collaborate asynchronously to keep progress moving.

The experience we want for our people

We want our people to do meaningful work and keep growing their careers, in a place full of likeminded people. Since Docuvera is part of the ever-changing software industry, but with customers in the highly regulated pharma industry, there's no shortage of interesting technical challenges that have a significant customer impact.

What we provide

  • Flexible: genuine flexibility and trust in how you manage your work, helping you balance professional and personal commitments. Your contribution is more important than where you work or how visible you are.
  • Tools: we continue to heavily invest in modern systems and AI technology to support you to do your best work.
  • Growth: we have a strong track record of internal career progression, with growth shaped by access to both funded and free learning, coaching, and mentoring opportunities.
  • Leave: a range of leave benefits, including year-end appreciation leave, birthday leave, parental leave, long-service leave, and the use of confidential, fully funded employee assistance support. Other entitlements may vary depending on location and eligibility (such as unlimited PTO and healthcare benefits for the US).

What we'll expect of you

We expect you to bring a positive, curious mindset, take ownership of meaningful outcomes, embrace new technologies and ways of working, and use the flexibility and trust we offer responsibly—staying connected across our global team, valuing different perspectives, and helping others succeed as we grow together.

Mindset wins every time

As we scale and use new technologies to collectively deliver our outcomes, the mindset and approach you have to your work and interactions with others is where the value truly lies.

The qualities or traits that drive this mindset, which directly impacts our culture, performance, and how we get work done day to day are captured in these six words: Go-Getter, Torchbearer, Trailblazer, Shapeshifter, Elevator, and Steward.

Go-Getters and Torchbearers own it and deliver. They focus on what matters most and drive results without chasing perfection, while leading with initiative and accountability, communicating early and acting in the team’s best interests.

Trailblazers and Shapeshifters improve and adapt. They're curious, proactive, and seek continuous improvement, adapting with positivity and calm, helping others find clarity and momentum through change.

Elevators and Stewards lead by example. They lift others up by listening, collaborating, and giving credit where it's due giving credit where it’s due, acting as role models who lead with professionalism, optimism, and integrity.

Keen to know more?

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information about working with us and follow us on LinkedIn to check out what we've been up to recently.

Key information about our recruitment process

  • Accessibility: if there’s anything we can do to make our recruitment process more inclusive or accessible for you, please let us know. We’re happy to accommodate different needs where we can.
  • Use of AI: we use AI tools to complement our recruitment process but all interviews and hiring decisions are made by our people. We may use AI to support certain stages of the hiring process, but they do not replace human interaction or decision making.
  • Process outline: we usually run two online interviews, each about an hour long, with one or two members of our team. Some roles may also include a technical exercise to help us understand your approach and skills.
  • Timing: we’ll keep applications open until we find the right person and we’ll do our best keep you updated how things are progressing.
  • Checks: we’ll also ask for at least two professional references and complete a background and/or verification check prior to finalising an offer.
  • For recruitment agencies: we work with a select group of preferred partners, so please don’t send unsolicited CVs as we won’t be able to consider them.

description:

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. MetaMask is launching an official VIP programme in early 2027. Our pilot showed that high volume traders bring their trading to MetaMask when someone owns the relationship with them. Swaps, Memecoins, RWA and Perps are at the heart of our business, and a small number of traders drive a large share of it.

As the China Relationship Manager, you will own MetaMask's relationships with Mandarin speaking high volume traders and high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) across our Trade and Money VIP programmes. This is a market where trust and personal introductions decide everything, and established exchanges have strong VIP teams. You will win people over with trust, product access and time spent in person.

What you will own

  • Finding, recruiting, onboarding and retaining VIP traders and high-net-worth-individuals across Mainland China/ Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Singapore.
  • Building relationships across Mandarin speaking traders, HNWI and community networks, including industry networks, referrals, events and inbound interest.
  • Negotiating and agreeing VIP terms with candidates, within MetaMask's programme guidelines.
  • Acting as each VIP's main point of contact, and bringing in Support, Product, Marketing and leadership when needed.
  • Hosting and joining VIP gatherings across Greater China and the wider region, working with our Events team.
  • Turning conversations with VIPs into insight on trading behaviour, competitor offers, market shifts and product gaps, and sharing it with Product.
  • Adapting VIP materials and communications for a Chinese speaking audience, in line with Legal guidance.
  • Tracking and reporting on pipeline, volume, fees and retention.

What success looks like

  • A growing, active and engaged VIP community across Greater China.
  • Strong retention and a healthy flow of referrals.
  • VIP feedback that shapes what Product builds.
  • Relationships handled in full compliance with our policies.

What you bring

  • Experience in VIP, account management or business development in crypto, exchanges, brokerages or fintech.
  • A credible network among high volume Mandarin speaking traders, HNWIs or communities, or a track record of building one.
  • Native Mandarin and strong professional English. Cantonese is a plus.
  • A good understanding of the regional market dynamics and how traders and HNWIs compare offerings.
  • Comfort working towards volume, fee and deposit targets.
  • Solid knowledge of on-chain trading and DeFi.
  • Sound judgement on local regulation, and comfort working with Legal guidance.

Nice to have

  • Experience hosting private events or community gatherings in the region.
  • Japanese or Korean language skills.
  • A product mindset: you can turn feedback into clear requirements.

title: Film a Whole Shop Transaction (Paid Data Task, Remote, Contract)
description:
ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Film a Whole Shop Transaction". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

If you run or work in a shop or stall, film one whole sale, customer asks, you find it, money changes hands.

Steps

  1. Ask the customer if they are happy to be filmed, and confirm in the app

  2. Set your phone where it sees the counter and your hands

  3. Record the whole thing, the request, finding the item, the money, the change

  4. Stop when the customer leaves

  5. Upload

What gets rejected

  • Never film a customer who has not agreed

  • Do not film children

  • Do not cut the money handling out, that is the core of it

  • Do not stage a fake customer

Accepted: One unbroken take covering request, retrieval, payment and change, with consent confirmed in the app.

Pay

$1.80 per accepted clip. At a typical pace of about 6 minutes per clip, that is about $18 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 3 clips pays about $5.40. One clip of 2 to 4 minutes per submission. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open in 11 Southeast Asian countries, including Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Somewhere to prop your phone so it sees your hands and the work

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Film a Whole Shop Transaction", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

description:

Viant is a global medical device partner providing design, development, manufacturing, and assembly services through capabilities in materials, plastics, metals, extrusion, and automation. The Senior Program Manager (SPM) is responsible for leading the execution, strategy, and delivery of New Product Introduction (NPI), product transfers, cost-reduction initiatives, integrations, insourcing projects, and strategic corporate programs across Viant Medical’s manufacturing network. This role requires significant experience in medical device manufacturing, preferably within a contract medical device manufacturing environment, combined with strong program management leadership and technical manufacturing experience.   • Remote position based in the United States, with preference for candidates located within reasonable proximity to a major airport, particularly Atlanta, Miami, Dallas, or San Diego, due to the travel requirements of the role.

  • Lead cross-functional teams on key strategic projects including, but not limited to, New Product Introduction (NPI), product transfers, cost reduction, integrations, insourcing, and strategic corporate programs.

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Teams.

Grow our AI image service.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.

  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Mexico.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

    1. 1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.
    2. Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.
    3. On top of that:
      1. A one-month annual bonus.
      2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
      3. Paid sick leave.
      4. A health allowance.
      5. A coworking allowance.
    4. Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Native / Desktop Engineer

The role. Build Desktop Intercept — the native Windows driver and app that acts as a virtual mic/speaker, replaces audio in real time, and (Phase 1 Phase C) reads the DOM and drives Computer Use. Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward.

What you'll own. Windows native driver (WASAPI, virtual audio devices, kernel-adjacent hooks) · real-time bidirectional audio routing · the user-space app (audio router, DOM scraper, MCP server) · the desktop-to-cloud path onto the event bus (NATS-class, WebSocket) under a sub-300ms budget · AV co-existence and mass-deployment · your committed timelines.

Who you are. Self-starter, hacker, grit. You consider yourself exceptional at the systems level and can show it. You love new technology, adapt fast when it changes, demonstrate ideas with working code, and use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity. Team player who makes and hits committed timelines. Loves solving the problems nobody else can — and winning.

Requirements

  • 8+ years systems / native development; shipped a Windows desktop agent at real scale (>10k seats) with audio.
  • Strong C/C++ — mandatory. Strong Go for the service side — mandatory.
  • Comfortable building and interacting with drivers — virtual audio devices, virtual microphones/speakers, WASAPI / Core Audio, kernel-adjacent hooks.
  • Real-time audio pipelines under a sub-300ms budget — buffering, resampling, drift, glitch-free capture/playback.
  • Understands high-efficiency systems end-to-end — event-driven architecture, pub/sub, WebSocket streaming, and what state, race conditions, and locking mean at the native layer (lock-free audio buffers, real-time threads, priority inversion).

  • Browser / DOM internals and process injection a strong plus (Phase C).
  • Enterprise mass-deployment craft — MSI/installer engineering, silent deploys, fleet upgrades across 10k+ locked-down seats.
  • Driver/code signing and AV/EDR co-existence — WHQL, EV certs, and staying invisible to CrowdStrike-class agents without tripping them.
  • Crash-dump and telemetry discipline — WinDbg/minidumps, symbolized crash reporting from the field; you debug machines you'll never touch.
  • Security posture — least-privilege service design; this app hears customer audio and reads screens, so it must be provably tight.
  • A master debugger at the systems level — kernel logs, crash dumps, audio glitches, AV interference; you see it.
  • SIP / RTP a strong plus. Mid-tier or better hands-on AI-in-product experience a plus (the desktop app hosts an MCP server and drives Computer Use).

This role combines Account Management, Customer Success, Support, and Onboarding responsibilities. The ideal candidate is tech-savvy, AI-enabled, adaptable, and comfortable working across Sales, Support, Product, Finance, Support, and Onboarding teams. This person will be cross-trained in onboarding and provide backup onboarding support when needed.

Key Responsibilities

Account Management

  • Build strong relationships with customers and become a trusted advisor.

  • Proactively identify churn risks and develop retention strategies.

  • Conduct account reviews, customer success check-ins, and business reviews.

  • Drive product adoption, customer engagement, and account growth.

  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities.

Customer Support & Onboarding

  • Manage inbound support requests through tickets, phone calls, and email.

  • Troubleshoot platform issues and coordinate with Product and Engineering teams when necessary.

  • Conduct customer training sessions and onboarding meetings via Zoom or Google Meet.

  • Educate customers on best practices and platform functionality.

  • Complete onboarding training and serve as a backup onboarding specialist when needed.

  • Assist with implementations, account setup, and customer training.

  • Ensure a smooth transition from onboarding to ongoing account management.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Support, and Onboarding teams.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally.

  • Share customer feedback, feature requests, and product improvement opportunities.

  • Assist with special projects and process improvement initiatives.

You Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Support, or a related customer-facing role within a B2B SaaS company.

  • Proven success in retention, churn prevention, and customer relationship management.

  • Experience managing support tickets, phone support, and customer training sessions.

  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn software platforms quickly.

  • Experience with CRM systems (ideally Zoho).

  • Familiarity with AI tools and automation platforms.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Fluent English.

Ideal Candidate

  • Customer-obsessed and relationship-driven.

  • Comfortable switching between strategic account management and hands-on customer support.

  • Strong collaborator who works effectively across teams.

  • Tech-savvy, adaptable, and eager to leverage AI.

  • Takes ownership, solves problems, and thrives in a dynamic environment.

What’s Offered:

  • Fully remote contractor role

  • Open to candidates across LATAM

  • Work aligned with U.S. business hours (overlap required)

  • 20 days PTO + U.S. holidays

  • Competitive USD compensation (based on experience)

  • High ownership and visibility within a small team

  • Opportunity to build and shape the support system from the ground up

Interview Process

1️⃣ Intro call — experience, communication, and approach to support

2️⃣ Hiring manager interview — systems thinking and escalation judgment

3️⃣ Short challenge — propose workflows, automations, and metrics for sample scenarios

title: Food Labels (Paid Data Task, Remote, Contract)
description:
ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Food Labels". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Photograph the nutrition or ingredients label on food packaging. Straight on, no glare.

Steps

  1. Find a food product

  2. Photograph the nutrition or ingredients panel straight on

  3. Check every row is readable and there is no glare

  4. Upload

What gets rejected

  • Do not cut off any rows

  • Do not shoot through plastic wrap that causes glare

  • Do not photograph at an angle that curves the text

Accepted: Full panel in frame, no glare, every row readable.

Pay

$0.10 per accepted photo. At a typical pace of about 35 seconds per photo, that is about $10 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 34 photos pays about $3.40. Up to 100 photos per upload. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open in 11 Southeast Asian countries, including Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Your phone camera, used inside the Kled app

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Food Labels", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

    • Workday reporting tools (e.g., Advanced, Matrix, Composite reports) and data analysis

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across functional teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a growing ability to see interdependencies across modules
  • Troubleshoot complex system and data issues and the ability to communicate technical concepts in a business-friendly way
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current on Workday functionality and best practices

CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

CentralReach's Data Products team is seeking a Senior Sales Consultant to own the technical side of every data opportunity we pursue. You will partner with Account Managers across our existing provider base and with new business Account Executives to understand customer data problems, design credible solutions and lead the technical evaluation from first discovery through close. You should be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with a CFO as you are discussing data architecture with a head of data.

The Data Products team is a startup operating inside CentralReach. We are establishing our own playbook and processes as we build. We are looking for someone with low patience for heavy process and a high ownership mentality. You challenge weak requirements, you kill poorly scoped evaluations early and you do not wait for a playbook to be handed to you. You will have meaningful influence over product direction and the data sales process.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Own the technical portion of the sales process from discovery through technical validation and close
  • Partner with Account Managers and new business Account Executives on account strategy, qualification, deal planning and stakeholder management
  • Work with the VP of Data Products to evaluate the existing customer base, identify which accounts are ready for which products and help build target lists with Account Managers
  • Lead technical discovery to uncover the customer's architecture, workflows, pain points, decision criteria and business objectives, then translate what you find into clear solution designs across Advanced BI, Data Warehouse, APIs and Benchmarking
  • Deliver tailored demos that connect capability to measurable customer outcomes rather than scripted product tours
  • Scope and run proofs of concept and technical evaluations with success criteria defined up front, and drive each one to a yes or a no on a timeline
  • Build and defend the business case, including TCO and ROI comparisons against a customer building the capability in-house
  • Map each customer to the right product for their current stage and name what they will need at the next one
  • Handle technical objections spanning architecture, security, data access, scalability, deployment, APIs, entitlements and integration, and test what competitors actually deliver rather than absorbing what prospects believe they deliver
  • Create reusable evaluation plans, ROI models, solution patterns and technical collateral that let the broader sales organization participate
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering from customer conversations, competitive evaluations and recurring technical requirements, and support handoff after close so expectations, architecture decisions and success criteria are documented
  • Use AI tooling (LLMs, code copilots, semantic search) as a core part of your workflow. This is how the team works, not a nice-to-have

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years in sales engineering, solutions consulting or pre-sales architecture supporting a technical B2B product in data infrastructure, analytics, developer tools, observability or enterprise AI
  • A track record of evaluations that ended in a decision rather than in an indefinite pilot, and of deals you can point to as technically won
  • Experience selling to data and engineering leaders alongside business buyers such as CEOs, CFOs and COOs
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex methodology to a non-technical executive without losing precision
  • Comfortable in a team still building its processes, with a bias toward action

Commercial Judgment

  • Understanding of how architecture and delivery decisions affect pricing, packaging and renewal outcomes, including consumption-based models
  • Sound instincts about where technical effort is worth spending across several live opportunities at once
  • Low ego, with real curiosity about how customers work rather than about what the product does

Technical Skills

  • Understanding of data governance, de-identification, suppression, entitlements and the audit requirements of externally facing analytics
  • Enough architecture depth to hold a credible conversation with a head of data who has already stood up their own stack, without reaching for unnecessary complexity
