title: TikTok Content Manager
description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition. That’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we're constantly pushing the boundaries of creative production.

We're looking for a TikTok Content Manager who lives and breathes social media, understands what makes content go viral, and knows how to turn creative ideas into engaging videos that drive measurable results.

Why This Role Matters

TikTok moves fast, and so do we.

As our TikTok Content Manager, you'll take ownership of TikTok content strategy, planning, publishing, and performance. You'll work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, and Creative Strategists to develop content that captures attention, builds audiences, and drives engagement.

We're looking for someone who understands TikTok beyond trends and viral sounds. You know how to identify content opportunities, develop repeatable formats, analyze performance, and turn insights into better creative decisions.

If you're constantly discovering new creators, experimenting with content formats, and finding ways to make every video perform better than the last, you'll thrive in this role.

What You'll Do

Develop & Execute TikTok Content Strategies

  • Develop and manage TikTok content strategies aligned with brand objectives, target audiences, and growth goals.

  • Create and maintain content calendars, publishing schedules, and campaign plans.

  • Research trending formats, sounds, hashtags, creators, and emerging content opportunities.

  • Develop creative concepts, content series, and video ideas tailored to each brand's identity.

  • Identify opportunities to improve organic reach, audience engagement, and follower growth.

Manage Content Production

  • Work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, Copywriters, and Creative Strategists to produce engaging TikTok videos.

  • Prepare creative briefs, scripts, references, and production guidelines.

  • Coordinate content production to ensure videos are delivered on schedule.

  • Review videos before publishing to ensure quality, accuracy, and alignment with brand guidelines.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve content quality and performance.

Oversee Publishing & Account Management

  • Manage daily TikTok publishing activities across assigned brand accounts.

  • Write engaging captions, select relevant hashtags, and optimize posts for discoverability.

  • Ensure content is published consistently and according to the content calendar.

  • Monitor comments, audience interactions, and emerging conversations to identify engagement opportunities.

  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all published content.

Analyze Content Performance

  • Monitor key performance metrics, including views, watch time, retention, engagement rate, follower growth, and conversions.

  • Identify top-performing content and develop strategies to replicate successful formats.

  • Analyze underperforming videos and recommend improvements to hooks, pacing, storytelling, and creative execution.

  • Prepare regular performance reports highlighting key insights, trends, and opportunities.

  • Use performance data to continuously refine content strategies and improve results.

Stay Ahead of TikTok Trends

  • Monitor TikTok trends, algorithm updates, platform features, and changes in audience behavior.

  • Research competitors and successful creators to identify emerging content strategies.

  • Experiment with new formats, storytelling techniques, and creative approaches.

  • Identify trends early and translate them into relevant content opportunities for our brands.

Who You Are

Experienced TikTok Content Professional

  • 1-3 years of experience in TikTok content management, social media management, content strategy, or digital marketing.

  • Proven experience managing TikTok accounts and developing content that generates meaningful engagement and audience growth.

  • Experience working with DTC, eCommerce, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer brands is highly preferred.

  • A portfolio or examples of TikTok accounts you've managed and their performance results are required.

Strong Creative Instincts

  • Deep understanding of TikTok culture, trends, algorithms, and content formats.

  • Strong ability to identify engaging hooks, compelling storytelling techniques, and creative concepts.

  • Comfortable developing ideas for both organic content and performance-driven advertising.

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop, creator collaborations, and influencer marketing is a plus.

Data-Driven & Results-Oriented

  • Experience using TikTok Analytics and social media management platforms.

  • Strong understanding of content performance metrics and how to translate insights into actionable strategies.

  • Comfortable testing different creative approaches and making decisions based on performance data.

Organized & Collaborative

  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, content calendars, and production deadlines.

  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with creators, editors, and cross-functional teams.

  • Comfortable providing creative feedback and managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Creative, Resourceful & Adaptable

  • You're constantly exploring new ideas and finding opportunities to improve content performance.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new formats and aren't afraid to challenge conventional creative approaches.

  • You anticipate production needs, take ownership of projects, and find solutions when priorities change.

  • You bring fresh ideas and energy to every project and enjoy working with a team that's always looking to raise the bar.

Perks & Benefits

Work with Leading Brands: Develop TikTok strategies and content for exciting lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wellness, and DTC brands.

Creative Ownership: Take an active role in shaping content strategies, developing original concepts, and experimenting with new creative formats.

Career Growth: Expand your expertise in social media strategy, creative production, influencer marketing, and performance advertising, with opportunities to advance into senior content and creative leadership roles.

Collaborative Creative Environment: Work alongside talented Content Creators, Video Editors, Creative Strategists, and marketing professionals.

A Culture of Innovation: Join a team that moves quickly, embraces experimentation, and values people who bring fresh ideas and turn them into results.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe exceptional creative work comes from different perspectives, experiences, and ideas. If you're passionate about TikTok, excited by creative experimentation, and motivated by building content that delivers measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.

What you will do

Own a fake and a real version of the same thing? Photograph both from the same four angles and tell us which is which.

Steps

  1. Put both items side by side in the same light

description:
Cargo

Gerenciamento de Projetos Pleno/Sênior

Contratação: Remoto - PJ

Objetivo da Contratação

Contratar profissional para atuar no planejamento, acompanhamento, coordenação e orientação de projetos institucionais e estratégicos, promovendo a adoção de boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos, governança e gestão de portfólio, apoiando equipes com diferentes níveis de maturidade organizacional.

O profissional deverá desempenhar papel estratégico de facilitador e agente de transformação, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das equipes, para a melhoria da comunicação entre áreas, para a gestão eficaz de riscos, prazos, custos e entregas, bem como para o fortalecimento da cultura de gestão de projetos orientada a resultados.

Será responsável por conduzir iniciativas, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos institucionais, promovendo previsibilidade na execução dos projetos, apoiando a tomada de decisão das lideranças e assegurando a geração de valor para a organização por meio da implementação de metodologias, indicadores e processos estruturados de gerenciamento de projetos

Principais Atribuições

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo dos projetos, desde a iniciação até o encerramento.
  • Planejar, acompanhar e monitorar projetos institucionais, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, escopo, qualidade, orçamento, recursos, riscos e resultados.
  • Orientar gestores, coordenadores e equipes na aplicação de metodologias preditivas, ágeis e híbridas, ferramentas e boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Atuar como facilitador na comunicação entre as diversas áreas envolvidas, promovendo alinhamento e integração entre as partes interessadas.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento, acompanhamento e tomada de decisão (status report, kick-off e encerramento dos projetos)
  • Elaborar cronogramas, planos de trabalho, indicadores, relatórios gerenciais e painéis de acompanhamento.
  • Identificar riscos, impedimentos e oportunidades de melhoria, propondo ações preventivas e corretivas e apoiando a resolução de problemas.
  • Promover a padronização de processos, métodos, artefatos e documentos relacionados ao gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Realizar acompanhamento contínuo dos projetos, oferecendo suporte técnico e metodológico aos responsáveis.
  • Apoiar a gestão do portfólio de projetos, contribuindo para a priorização de iniciativas e para a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas institucionais, requisitos regulatórios, segurança da informação, LGPD e demais processos corporativos.

Perfil Profissional Desejado

Busca-se profissional com elevada capacidade de articulação institucional, excelente comunicação interpessoal e habilidade para construir relações colaborativas entre diferentes equipes, áreas e níveis hierárquicos.

É desejável que apresente perfil consultivo e orientador, demonstrando facilidade para transmitir conhecimentos de forma clara, didática e acessível, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das equipes e para a evolução da maturidade organizacional em gerenciamento de projetos.

O candidato deverá possuir visão sistêmica, iniciativa, organização, capacidade analítica, flexibilidade, proatividade e habilidade para atuar em ambientes multidisciplinares, conciliando demandas simultâneas e diferentes interesses institucionais.

Espera-se ainda capacidade para conduzir negociações, mediar conflitos, apoiar processos de tomada de decisão e atuar como referência na disseminação das melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos, contribuindo para o alcance dos objetivos estratégicos da organização.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de articulação e negociação.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Perfil colaborativo e orientador.
  • Inteligência emocional e habilidade para mediação de conflitos.
  • Organização e gestão do tempo.
  • Proatividade e foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade de escuta ativa.
  • Facilidade para construir relacionamentos profissionais.
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico.
  • Capacidade de influenciar e engajar stakeholders.
  • Adaptabilidade e atuação em ambientes de constante transformação.
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Senso de prioridade e gestão de múltiplas demandas simultâneas.

Competências Técnicas

  • Conhecimento em gerenciamento de projetos, preferencialmente com base nas boas práticas do PMBOK, metodologias ágeis ou híbridas.
  • Experiência na elaboração e gestão de cronogramas, planos de projeto, matrizes de risco e indicadores.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
  • Capacidade de elaboração de documentos técnicos, apresentações executivas e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de processos e melhoria contínua e governança corporativa.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de portfólio de projetos e acompanhamento de indicadores estratégicos.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos e análise de impacto para apoio à tomada de decisão.

Requisitos Mínimos

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento ou coordenação de projetos de média e alta complexidade.
  • Experiência na condução de reuniões, workshops, oficinas e ações de orientação técnica junto a equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders.
  • Domínio do pacote Microsoft Office ou ferramentas equivalentes, especialmente Excel, PowerPoint e Word.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos, preferencialmente PMBOK, Ágil ou modelos híbridos.
  • Experiência na elaboração e apresentação de relatórios gerenciais e executivos.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos.
  • Certificações em gerenciamento de projetos (PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, PMI-ACP ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência em Escritório de Projetos (PMO).
  • Experiência em órgãos públicos ou instituições de grande porte.
  • Vivência na implantação de metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Experiência em capacitação e desenvolvimento de equipes.

Resultados Esperados

  • Fortalecimento da cultura de gerenciamento de projetos na instituição.
  • Maior maturidade das equipes na condução de projetos.
  • Padronização de processos, métodos e documentos relacionados ao gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Melhoria da comunicação e integração entre as áreas envolvidas.
  • Aumento da taxa de sucesso dos projetos institucionais.
  • Desenvolvimento da autonomia dos gestores e equipes na aplicação das boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Maior previsibilidade na execução dos projetos, com melhoria do cumprimento de prazos, escopo, orçamento e qualidade.
  • Melhoria da gestão de riscos e redução de impactos decorrentes de desvios e retrabalhos.
  • Disponibilização de informações gerenciais que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a priorização de iniciativas.
  • Maior alinhamento dos projetos aos objetivos estratégicos e às necessidades da instituição

Strategic Pursuits team. title: Asset Manager (Journeyman)
description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Asset Manager to oversee IT asset lifecycle management, equipment accountability, inventory accuracy, maintenance records, audit support, and disposition activities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Asset Manager will support Hand Receipt Holders and the USMEPCOM Property Book Office in maintaining accurate records for Government-Furnished Property and other assets covered by the task order. This role will coordinate physical inventories, reconcile discrepancies, maintain maintenance and support agreements, prepare disposition packages, and produce Asset Audit Reports and Monthly Status Report inputs.

The successful candidate will work with Government property personnel, infrastructure teams, site personnel, procurement, finance, configuration management, cybersecurity, and program leadership to maintain complete and traceable asset records throughout the lifecycle.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. Travel or on-site support may be required for physical inventories, site validations, equipment transfers, or disposition activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Asset Manager will:

  • Manage IT assets throughout acquisition, receipt, assignment, deployment, maintenance, transfer, refresh, recovery, and disposition.
  • Maintain accurate records for hardware, software, appliances, network equipment, peripherals, and Government-Furnished Property covered by the task order.
  • Support primary Hand Receipt Holders in accordance with applicable DoD property-accountability requirements.
  • Coordinate with the USMEPCOM Property Book Office on property records, accountability, inventory, transfers, discrepancies, and disposition.
  • Maintain asset identifiers, serial numbers, model information, ownership, assigned users, custodians, locations, status, condition, warranty, and lifecycle dates.
  • Ensure asset repositories and systems of record contain current, complete, consistent, and traceable information.
  • Reconcile asset-management records with configuration-management, procurement, shipping, receiving, deployment, maintenance, and service records.
  • Investigate missing, duplicate, incorrectly assigned, retired, or otherwise discrepant asset records.
  • Coordinate corrective actions with Hand Receipt Holders, site personnel, technical teams, logistics personnel, vendors, and Government property personnel.
  • Plan, coordinate, and support physical asset inventories and audits at USMEPCOM and supported locations.
  • Develop inventory schedules, audit instructions, tracking sheets, evidence requirements, and reconciliation procedures.
  • Validate equipment existence, location, serial number, assignment, operational status, condition, and accountable custodian.
  • Document inventory results, discrepancies, corrective actions, responsible parties, deadlines, and resolution evidence.
  • Prepare formal Asset Audit Reports documenting scope, methodology, results, discrepancies, corrective actions, and recommendations.
  • Track audit findings and inventory discrepancies through validated closure.
  • Maintain maintenance agreements, warranties, licenses, support contracts, renewal dates, service coverage, and vendor contact information.
  • Identify expiring agreements, warranty gaps, unsupported assets, obsolete equipment, and upcoming renewal or refresh requirements.
  • Coordinate with procurement and financial personnel on maintenance renewals, support agreements, warranty coverage, and replacement planning.
  • Support lifecycle planning and equipment-refresh activities by identifying asset age, condition, support status, compatibility, and replacement needs.
  • Maintain records for equipment installations, moves, additions, changes, relocations, transfers, and removals.
  • Coordinate asset-record updates following equipment refreshes, site relocations, replacements, repairs, or configuration changes.
  • Prepare and maintain disposition packages for obsolete, excess, surplus, damaged, or no-longer-needed equipment, hardware, and software.

title: Casting Talent
description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Casting Talent specialist who can hunt down the fresh faces, authentic voices, and charismatic creators that define our brands.

Why This Role Matters

Authenticity, charisma, and connection are your playground. In the world of performance marketing, the "face" of the ad is often the biggest variable in its success. As a Casting Talent specialist, you are the detective and the connector. You aren't just filling roles; you are finding the specific personalities that make a viewer stop scrolling and start listening.

Your ability to distinguish between "cringe" acting and genuine influence will directly impact the ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) of our clients. If you have a natural eye for potential and love building relationships with creators, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Scout & Source Creators

    • Proactively hunt for new talent on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and casting platforms. You won't just wait for applications; you will go out and find the hidden gems.

    • Build a diverse roster of actors, models, UGC creators, and real-people testimonials suitable for beauty, fashion, and tech brands.

    • Identify talent that matches specific demographic and psychographic profiles provided by the Strategy team.

  2. Vet for Performance

    • Review self-tapes and past content to ensure talent has on-camera charisma, good lighting setups (for remote creators), and the ability to deliver lines naturally.

    • Conduct brief audition interviews to test communication skills and professionalism.

  3. Manage Talent Relationships

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for our talent roster, building strong, long-term relationships.

    • Brief talent clearly on project requirements, scripts, and visual direction to ensure they nail the shoot on the first try.

    • Negotiate rates and usage rights effectively, maximizing value for our clients.

  4. Database Management

    • Maintain an organized, tagged database of talent (e.g., "Mom aged 30-40," "Gen Z Skincare Enthusiast") for rapid deployment on new campaigns.

Who You Are

  1. A Social Media Native

    • 1–3 years of experience in casting, influencer marketing, or talent management.

    • You understand the "vibe" of different platforms. You know what a "TikTok face" looks like versus a "TV commercial face."

  2. A Good Judge of Character

    • You have high emotional intelligence. You can tell within seconds of a video if someone is authentic or "acting."

    • You are inclusive and adept at finding diverse talent that represents the real world.

  3. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You are comfortable negotiating with agents and guiding creators through a brief.

    • You are responsive and professional, representing High Scale well in the creator community.

  4. Organized & Fast

    • Casting often happens on tight timelines. You can manage multiple casting calls simultaneously without getting flustered.

    • You are diligent with paperwork, agreements, and contact details.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of global brands and grow into a Senior Casting Director or Producer role.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one perfectly cast role at a time.

title: Sr. Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to lead and advance the security tooling that tests and validates our software against compliance and cybersecurity standards. In this role, you will ensure our toolchain is consistently enforced, highly trustworthy, and continuously enhanced as our products, customer base, and regulatory requirements expand. You will also be a key early contributor as we design and implement our application security and security operations functions.

You will be the technical authority for how security checks are configured, tuned, and enforced across our software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will translate compliance and Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements into automated, risk-based controls that give engineers fast, actionable feedback early in development. Your expertise in AI-based automation will be key to success. The goal is a pipeline calibrated to the speed of organizational need: secure by default, automated wherever possible, and supported by clear human review when automation flags risk.

On the other end of the SDLC, you will help implement automated and manual pen-testing and other security-related testing capabilities across a range of deployment environments. You will help develop our security operations capabilities with faster and more automated incident response and incident management. Applying an AI-first approach to these functions will enable faster, more efficient, higher-quality outcomes.

This role supports regulated and security-sensitive environments, including systems hosted for Government customers, and partners closely with engineering, product, and cybersecurity leadership.

Core Responsibilities

    Own and evolve the security toolchain

  • Serve as the technical owner of our pipeline security tooling, including static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets detection, container scanning, and artifact signing

  • Assess tooling effectiveness and coverage, identify gaps, and recommend and lead improvements, consolidation, or replacement as needs evolve

  • Develop automated and manual pen-testing capabilities with rapid feedback loops into the engineering process.

  • Help mature the security operations and incident response capabilities of the company.

  • Define the long-term roadmap for security tooling and processes in partnership with Cybersecurity and Engineering leadership

    • Tune controls to compliance requirements

  • Translate National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, and RMF control requirements into enforceable pipeline gates, thresholds, and policies

  • Evolve and maintain risk-based pass/fail criteria that balance security assurance with delivery speed and minimize false positives

  • Ensure tooling outputs produce assessor-ready evidence that supports authorizations, continuous monitoring, and audits

  • Own the exception and manual-review process for findings that fail automated checks, so decisions are documented and traceable

    • Enforce integrity and consistency

  • Ensure security results cannot be bypassed or tampered with, including enforcement of artifact signing, signature verification before deployment, commit signing, branch protection, and repository rulesets

  • Automate the creation and maintenance of software bills of materials (SBOMs) and vulnerability exploitability exchange (VEX) data for delivered software

    • Drive shift-left adoption

  • Move security checks to the earliest practical point (developer workstation, pre-commit, pull request, etc.)

  • Partner with engineering teams to embed security into their workflows, supported by clear standards and guidance, so the secure path is the easy path

  • Apply artificial intelligence (AI) tooling to accelerate vulnerability triage, remediation, and security automation, and evaluate emerging AI capabilities for the toolchain

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in DevSecOps, application security, security operations and incident response, and general security engineering, including at least 3 years owning security tooling in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines

  • Deep hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and enforcing SAST, SCA, secrets detection, and container scanning tools in production pipelines, including risk-based gates, vulnerability thresholds, and exception processes

  • Demonstrated experience mapping security tooling and pipeline controls to NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, or RMF requirements, and producing evidence for assessments or authorizations

  • Track record of evaluating, selecting, or evolving security tooling, and influencing engineering teams without direct authority

  • Scripting or automation experience in Python, Bash, or similar

  • Security+ or equivalent Department of Defense (DoD) 8140 qualifying certification, or ability to obtain within 2 months of hire

  • U.S. citizen residing and working in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with tools such as GitHub, Argo CD, JFrog, and Snyk

  • Experience in DoD software factory or Government DevSecOps environments (for example, Platform One, Iron Bank, or Big Bang)

  • Experience supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) efforts, including control assessment and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) management

  • Experience with software supply chain integrity and policy-as-code practices, such as artifact signing, signature verification, SBOMs, Open Policy Agent (OPA), or Kyverno

  • Experience applying AI and large language model (LLM) tools to security engineering, such as AI-assisted triage, code review, or remediation

title: Chief of Staff Director
description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

Nerdio has an incredible opportunity for a hard-charging, rigorous, "learn it all" individual to partner closely with our President and Co-Founder. This is a front-row seat to how a fast-growing software company actually gets run. You will help drive and implement the biggest decisions in our GTM organization and be in a role with significant accountability and visibility into your decisions.

As Chief of Staff, GTM, you will own the rhythm of the business for Nerdio's entire Go-To-Market organization. The operating cadence, the metrics, the meetings and the follow-through that keep a fast-moving team pointed at the same goals. You'll prepare for and advise on our most important customer and partner engagements. You'll also work hand in hand with Revenue Operations, Finance, HR, IT and Sales leadership to make the whole GTM engine run better.

You will report to Nerdio's President and GTM leader. Your job is to turn strategy into focused priorities, processes that scale, and results we can measure. You'll be a core member of the GTM team’s Leadership Team and will work to get leaders aligned and clear out whatever is slowing us down across the customer journey. Removing friction and speeding up processes needs to be your superpower.

The ideal candidate loves figuring things out and crossing items off lists. You dig into a messy situation, form a point of view, and walk in with a clear recommendation for a senior leader. If you want to learn how to run a company by helping run one, this is the job.

This is a demanding, high-impact role that requires exceptional commitment, flexibility, and responsiveness to the evolving priorities of the President and the GTM organization. The hours are long, and your schedule will often follow the President's. The trade-off is worth it. In a few years you'll pick up more than most people learn in ten and you'll come out ready to run something big yourself.

What you'll do

  • Rhythm of the business for GTM: leadership meetings, MBR/QBR, AOP Planning cycles, operating cadence, executive business reviews, and additional internal meetings that keep the organization focused, aligned, and accountable.
  • GTM planning, strategic initiative execution, and follow-through and accountability on commitments made in leadership meetings.
  • Commercial and customer meeting preparation, including acting as a strategic advisor ahead of and following key customer, partner, and executive engagements.
  • Business insights, Sales Opex, budget partnership, and decision support for GTM leadership.
  • Internal GTM operations, partnering with HR, Finance, Revenue Operations, and IT to optimize rhythm of business, resourcing, and performance.
  • Process, systems, and AI-enabled improvements that help GTM teams operate with greater focus, speed, and accountability.
  • Tracking all follow ups and actions for the President.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the clarity of GTM priorities, effectiveness of cross-functional execution, the ability to build scalable operating practices that support Nerdio's next stage of growth and the speed by which you can process and get things done. Additionally, success will be measured on the President’s ability to focus time and attention on the highest-leverage priorities for Nerdio.

Your Partnership with the President

  • Drives the President's staff/leadership meetings, capturing decisions and action items, then owns follow-up and accountability for commitments made there, holding leaders to agreed actions and timelines.
  • Owns the internal GTM meetings and operating cadence (e.g., leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions): sets the agenda, prepares the materials, runs the meeting, and drives follow-through.
  • Prepares the President for commercial and customer engagements and serves as a strategic advisor on them: synthesizing account and pipeline context, framing key asks and risks, and following up on commitments afterward. Some travel will be required to accompany the President to customer and partner engagements.
  • Acts as a filter/prioritizes what reaches the President's desk; helps manage executive time and focus (the "business manager" piece).
  • May represent the President in certain forums when he isn't in the room.
  • Operates with a high degree of discretion and trust - will be exposed to confidential strategy, people, and performance information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive GTM operations strategy aligned with our overall business objectives. Work with executive leadership to make sure our strategy and annual plan are integrated and drive the success of the organization. Build trust with GTM leadership.
  • Cross Functional Partnership: Work closely with Finance, HR, IT, Revenue Operations, and other GTM teams to keep everyone aligned and collaborating well. Build processes that improve communication and coordination between departments and foster a culture of collaboration and efficiency.
  • Revenue Insights & Accountability: Partner closely with Revenue Operations to maintain visibility into pipeline e health, sales execution, and partner sales contribution on behalf of the President. Surface risks, gaps, and opportunities early. Translate these insights into recommendations for GTM leadership, driving accountability, and follow through on agreed actions.
  • AI and Technology Enablement: Act as the President’s connective tissue with Business Systems and IT on the GTM technology roadmap, helping inform where AI and automation could improve GTM productivity, forecasting and customer journey visibility, and championing pilots led by those functions.
  • Performance Metrics: Partner with GTM LT to establish KPIs and metrics that measure the effectiveness of GTM. Report regularly on performance and give the executive team the insight they need to make good decisions.

How You'll Live Our Values in This Role

Nerdio's values don't change by level, but the size of the impact on our culture does. You are expected to operate with broad, org wide scope. In this role, that looks like:

  • Put Our Customers and People First: Build customer and people outcomes into strategy from the start.
  • Move Fast: Set a clear operating rhythm for the GTM organization and remove friction that slows execution. Make timely decisions, create alignment quickly, and help teams move with focus even when information is incomplete.
  • Own It: Own outcomes across the GTM organization, including the parts you don't fully control. Own all tracking and follow-up of actions.
  • Have Fun: Create space for curiosity, craftsmanship, and practical experimentation while keeping the organization focused on outcomes. Model the belief that serious work and a positive team culture can reinforce each other.

Qualifications

  • Availability. You are expected to be available when the President is working and even when he Is not working. This is a role for someone who can make Nerdio their priority.
  • We are open to candidates earlier in their career (typically 5 to 7 years of experience) who demonstrate exceptional rigor, executive presence, and a track record of outperformance in a competitive environment. We value demonstrated potential over having already done every part of this role.
  • Experience engaging directly with senior executives, whether as a Chief of Staff, Business Manager, or similar internal partner, or as an advisor to executive clients or portfolio company leadership (e.g., in consulting or investing) - including managing executive priorities and follow through.
  • Thrives in ambiguity, exercises sound judgment, and adapts quickly to evolving executive and business priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead GTM planning, operating cadence, executive reporting, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional execution at scale.
  • Track record of running disciplined operating rhythms and holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and follow-through.
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to prepare for and advise in customer and partner meetings, synthesizing complex context into a clear point of view.
  • Strong analytical judgment and business acumen, with the ability to turn data into clear insights, recommendations, and executive-level decisions.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders across GTM, Finance, HR, Product, IT, and Revenue Operations.
  • Proven ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive alignment across teams, priorities, and time zones.

Level Calibration

Nerdio will calibrate the role as Director or Sr. Director based on the candidate's depth of experience, scope of prior leadership, executive operating experience, and ability to independently shape GTM strategy and operating systems.

Additional Information

We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Nerdio, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and real opportunities to grow your career, all while making work better for IT professionals everywhere.

If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you.

Benefits and Incentives

  • Competitive Base and Incentive Plan
  • Stock Options
  • Health and Welfare Plans*
  • Life and Disability Plans*
  • Retirement Plan*
  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
  • Collaborative Team Culture

* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Pharmacy Technician - Virginia
description:
About Waymark

Waymark is a mission-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits. We partner with communities to deliver technology-enabled, human-centered support that helps patients stay healthy and thrive. We’re designing tools and systems that bring care directly to those who need it most—removing barriers and reimagining what’s possible in Medicaid healthcare delivery.

Our Values

At Waymark, our values are the foundation of how we work, grow, and support one another:

  • Bold Builders: We tackle the toughest challenges in care delivery by harnessing the power of community and technology.
  • Humble Learners: We seek feedback, embrace diverse perspectives, and welcome challenges to our assumptions.
  • Experiment to Improve: We use data to inform decisions and continuously assess our performance.
  • Focused Urgency: Our mission drives us to act swiftly and relentlessly in pursuit of meaningful results.

If this resonates with you, we invite you to bring your creativity, energy, and curiosity to Waymark.

About this role

As a Pharmacy Technician, you will provide virtual (primarily telephonic) support for Medicaid patients. You will partner with Waymark pharmacists to help patients access medications, address barriers to medication non-adherence, access relevant durable medical equipment (DME), and elevate prescription needs to providers. You will report to the Clinical Pharmacist Lead in Virginia.

You will interact with patients through telehealth modalities (SMS, phone, and app-free video) as part of a broader team that includes community health workers who see patients in person and support patients in addressing social determinants of health, therapists who provide mental health counseling, and care coordinators who work closely with primary care providers to support wrap-around services. You should be familiar with pharmacist interventions in primary care that help patients overcome challenges gaining access to, and appropriately taking, their medications.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate patient medication needs with a multidisciplinary team including community health workers (CHW’s), care coordinators, and therapists.
  • Perform telephonic and SMS outreach to patients and providers/pharmacies to address medication access issues, medication non-adherence or other drug utilization activities to improve patient and quality outcomes. Outreach also includes addressing medication-related and disease-control HEDIS gaps.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare providers and Waymark care team colleagues to provide accurate and timely information on medications as well as facilitation of medication access, answering, resolving and triaging inbound inquiries in collaboration with the rest of your Waymark pharmacy team.
  • Communicate with patients and healthcare providers to assist in completing medication prior authorizations, navigate formulary changes, manage side effects, and identify therapeutic substitutions in conjunction with Waymark and primary care teams.
  • Facilitate timely responses to internal Waymark requests for pharmacy team assistance by obtaining and documenting medication information and verifying eligibility, formulary, benefits and allergy information as requested by your Waymark Pharmacist supervisor.
  • Provide accurate and timely documentation to ensure productivity and quality metrics are met.
  • Actively participate in innovation with an evolving startup environment by identifying trends, resolving problems, recommending improvements, and implementing process improvement changes, applying observations and recommendations to resolve operational issues, increasing productivity and quality, and achieving excellent customer experience.

Minimum qualifications

  • Current Virginia State Pharmacy Technician License in good standing.
  • PTCB CPhT Certification.
  • 2 or more years experience working in outpatient/primary care/clinic-based, or managed care settings.
  • Experience with and commitment to improving care for underserved populations.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively in a multidisciplinary team setting.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills, comfortable with proactively engaging patients telephonically, comfortable reaching out to on-site clinicians, payors, and pharmacies telephonically.
  • Detail-oriented, customer service-oriented mindset, motivated problem solver.
  • Ability to navigate proficiently within multiple computer systems including but not limited to spreadsheets, EHRs, and others.
  • Reside within the state of Virginia.

Preferred qualifications

  • 3 or more years experience working in outpatient/primary care/clinic-based, or managed care settings.Experience working in a call center handling pharmacy-related customer service requests and performing outbound calls.Experience in navigating Virginia Medicaid prescription benefits in addressing medication access issues for Medicaid and dual-eligible patients.
  • Experience with lean process improvement and/or other quality improvement initiatives and development and implementation of new operational workflows.
  • Experience with EHR documentation.

Hiring Range

$23.08 - 26.20/hr US Employees in Richmond or Hampton Roads

$22.38 - $25.42/hr all other locations within Virginia

In addition to salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Here’s what you can expect:

Stock Options: Opportunity to invest in the company’s growth.
Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office.
Incentive Program:Receive additional compensation through performance-based incentives that align with organizational goals and enhance patient outcomes.
Medical, Vision, and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive plans to keep you and your family healthy.
Life Insurance: Basic life insurance to give you peace of mind.
Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, accrued over the year, plus 11 paid holidays.
Parental Leave: 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents after six months of employment, and 8 weeks of bonding leave for non-birthing parents.
Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a company contribution, subject to a vesting schedule.
Commuter Benefits: Convenient options to support your commute needs.
Professional Development Stipend: A dedicated stipend supports professional development and growth.

Offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Employment history and advance degree verification (when applicable) are included as part of the standard background check process.

Waymark is dedicated to building a supportive, equal opportunity, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging – so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every preferred qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!

DecisionPoint seeks two Journeyman Cloud / System Engineers to support enterprise servers, operating systems, virtualization platforms, cloud services, infrastructure appliances, component lifecycle activities, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Cloud / System Engineers will provide hands-on technical support for server and operating-system administration, virtualization, appliance integration, cloud connectivity, infrastructure maintenance, technology refreshes, and service restoration. These positions will implement approved configurations, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support secure and reliable enterprise operations.

The successful candidates will work with the Cloud / System Engineering Lead, network teams, application teams, cybersecurity personnel, service-management teams, Government stakeholders, and vendors to maintain resilient and supportable enterprise services.

These positions are remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours work may be required during outages, deployments, upgrades, maintenance windows, and component-refresh activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

The Cloud / System Engineer will:

  • Install, configure, administer, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise servers and supporting infrastructure.
  • Support Windows Server, Linux, or other approved enterprise operating systems.

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

  1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
  2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
  3. Strong written English.
  4. Based in North Macedonia.
  5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (AI Platform)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, fault-tolerant, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products, merchants, and vendors. Ensuring that our infrastructure is transparently available to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of writing blameless postmortems as well as writing detailed tech specs and gathering feedback before large changes to systems.

The AI Platform team owns Affirm's paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Our customers are not only Affirm users, but also every engineer and a growing set of production workloads at Affirm. As a team, we are responsible for building and exposing simple, governed interfaces to models, tools, and agents, with identity, cost attribution, reliability, and security built in. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents.


What You'll Do

  • Plan, execute, and own technical decisions and projects within the AI Platform team, from design through launch and on-call.
  • Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions.
  • Make AI spend attributable and governable: build the identity, quota, routing, caching, and failover controls that let teams adopt new models and tools without re-solving the same platform problems.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to set the guardrails for agentic workloads and the on-behalf-of identity model for tool access.
  • Create and monitor metrics for your team's systems, and own the operational health of what you ship: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and on-call.
  • Set and improve code review and design standards, and advocate for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks.
  • Use AI tools and agentic workflows every day as a multiplier for your own code, design review, and operations, and push the team on what a small AI-native team can deliver.
  • Educate, mentor, and grow engineers in the team, and drive best practices around design, coding, and testing.


What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have practical experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI frameworks in production: inference APIs, LLM gateways (LiteLLM or similar), MCP, tool calling, evals, or agent runtimes.
  • You understand AI usage and the infrastructure needed to support and leverage AI workloads across different disciplines.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

This role will focus on identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity through the creation, deployment, and optimization of AI-powered tools that support the sales organization.

Deployment & Optimization

Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Track key metrics such as tool usage, time savings, productivity improvements, and contribution to sales efficiency.

AI Use Case Intake & Prioritization

  • Create and manage a structured intake process where sales representatives and leadership can submit ideas for GPT tools and AI-driven solutions.
  • Evaluate and prioritize requests based on impact, feasibility, and alignment with the Sales AI roadmap.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Integration

  • Work with Operations, IT, Marketing, and other departments as necessary to integrate GPT tools into existing systems, processes, and workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into broader operational processes.
  • Ensure AI tools align with organizational technology strategy and governance standards.

Success Metrics / KPIs

The success of the AI Productivity Lead – Sales will be measured through the following outcomes:

AI Tool Development & Deployment

  • Number of GPT tools successfully developed and deployed to support sales workflows.
  • Speed of delivery from idea submission to GPT rollout.
  • Percentage of prioritized roadmap initiatives delivered.

Adoption & Usage

  • Adoption rate of GPT tools across the sales team.
  • Active usage metrics for deployed GPT solutions.
  • Percentage of sales team trained on GPT best practices.

Efficiency & Productivity Gains

  • Documented time savings for activities such as prospect research, proposal drafting, meeting preparation, and email creation.
  • Reduction in manual or repetitive tasks within the sales workflow.

Sales Productivity Impact

  • Improved efficiency in preparing proposals, sales communications, and meeting materials.
  • Increased seller capacity for revenue-generating activities.

AI Program Management

  • Establishment and ongoing management of a Sales AI roadmap aligned with leadership priorities.
  • Implementation of a structured AI use-case intake and prioritization process.
  • Regular reporting to leadership on AI adoption, performance, and optimization opportunities.

  • A Sales AI roadmap outlining prioritized GPT initiatives.
  • A library of GPT tools and prompts supporting sales workflows.
  • A structured intake and prioritization process for AI use cases.
  • Training materials and enablement resources for the sales organization.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, North America
description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down.

We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive — US to accelerate Sonatype's growth across one of the most commercially significant and competitive enterprise technology markets in North America.

This is a pure new-logo acquisition role for an accomplished enterprise hunter who thrives on creating opportunities, displacing established competitors and winning complex, high-value enterprise business.

As artificial intelligence transforms how software is developed, organisations are facing unprecedented challenges around open source security, software supply chain integrity, developer productivity and governance.

Sonatype operates at the intersection of these challenges, helping some of the world's largest organisations build and deploy software securely through industry-leading software supply chain intelligence and an integrated platform spanning repository management, application security and malware prevention.

The US West territory presents an opportunity for a commercially ambitious seller to develop strategic enterprise relationships, challenge established technology providers and build a significant new-business pipeline.

You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise prospects across the United States, with a clear mandate to identify, develop and close new-logo opportunities.

This is not an account management position, nor is it a role designed around managing an inherited customer portfolio.

Your success will be defined by the new customers you acquire, the competitive opportunities you create and the revenue you generate.

You will be expected to operate confidently against an annual quota, bringing the commercial discipline, enterprise sales experience and competitive intensity required to deliver sustained performance.

We're particularly interested in speaking with consistently high-performing enterprise sellers who have achieved President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition and can demonstrate repeated success in complex, competitive technology markets.

Our role in detail:

    Territory Development & Strategic New-Logo Acquisition:

    • Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise territory strategy across an assigned portfolio of US accounts.

    • Take full accountability for new-logo acquisition, building and converting a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities.

    • Identify and prioritise strategic prospects based on enterprise size, software development complexity, security maturity, competitive landscape and commercial potential.

    • Build sophisticated account plans identifying organisational structures, executive stakeholders, buying committees, incumbent technology providers and potential entry points.

    • Generate significant self-sourced pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, executive engagement, targeted account-based campaigns and strategic networking.

    • Establish relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VP Engineering, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering and Application Security leadership.

    • Engage enterprise prospects before formal buying processes begin, helping customers recognise challenges and opportunities they may not yet be actively addressing.

    • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Channel and executive leadership to develop coordinated account acquisition strategies.

    • Identify opportunities to position Sonatype's broader software supply chain platform through compelling customer-specific business cases.

    • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline coverage, opportunity qualification, deal progression and forecasting.

      • Competitive Displacement & Enterprise Deal Execution:

      Competitive displacement will be a significant component of this role.

      We are looking for someone who understands the enterprise cybersecurity, DevSecOps and developer tooling landscape and is confident challenging established technology providers.

      You will be expected to:

      • Identify enterprise accounts using competing or incumbent software supply chain, repository management and application security technologies.

      • Develop account-specific competitive displacement strategies based on customer challenges, technical requirements and business outcomes.

      • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, including organisations such as JFrog, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, Checkmarx and Veracode.

      • Understand where Sonatype's intelligence, security capabilities, platform breadth and preventative approach provide meaningful customer differentiation.

      • Lead sophisticated enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, proofs of value, procurement and executive decision-making.

      • Develop strong economic buyer relationships and build compelling financial, operational and security business cases.

      • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to establish clear qualification, decision criteria, competitive positioning and mutual action plans.

      • Navigate complex negotiations and commercial discussions while maintaining strong customer relationships.

      • Build internal and external champions capable of influencing enterprise purchasing decisions.

      • Demonstrate the judgement to qualify out opportunities where genuine customer value or a viable purchasing path cannot be established.

        • We want a seller who knows how to win when the customer already has a solution, not someone who only succeeds when there is no competition.

        Industry Knowledge & Technical Credibility:

        This role requires a strong understanding of the market in which Sonatype operates.

        You should be comfortable discussing how modern enterprise organisations develop, secure and deploy software, and how AI is changing the speed and complexity of those processes.

        You will:

        • Understand the commercial and technical challenges associated with open source software, software composition analysis, DevSecOps and application security.

        • Engage confidently with technical and executive buyers around software supply chain risk, developer productivity, governance and security.

        • Position Sonatype's platform capabilities across Nexus Repository, Firewall, Lifecycle and related solutions.

        • Understand how software supply chain intelligence can help organisations identify vulnerable components, prevent malicious packages entering development and make better risk decisions.

        • Translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led selling.

        • Recognise opportunities to position Sonatype as a strategic enterprise platform rather than a standalone point solution.

        • Stay informed about emerging technology, AI-assisted development, competitive market movements and evolving enterprise security requirements.

          • Channel & Cross-Functional Enterprise Selling:

          Enterprise sales success requires the ability to bring the right expertise together around the customer.

          You will:

          • Build productive relationships with regional channel partners, systems integrators and enterprise solution providers.

          • Identify partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities that support new-logo acquisition.

          • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop effective technical validation strategies and proofs of value.

          • Partner with Marketing on account-based campaigns, executive engagement and targeted enterprise outreach.

          • Engage executive sponsors where appropriate to support strategic opportunities.

          • Coordinate internal resources effectively while retaining clear ownership of the commercial outcome.

          • Share competitive intelligence, customer insights and market feedback to improve Sonatype's broader enterprise go-to-market execution.

            • Role Outcomes:

            Success in this role means establishing a high-performing, predictable new-logo acquisition engine across the assigned US West territory.

            You will be expected to:

            • Deliver against an annual new-business quota.

            • Consistently originate and close new enterprise customer opportunities.

            • Build a sustainable, self-generated enterprise pipeline.

            • Win strategically important competitive displacement opportunities.

            • Establish relationships with senior technology and security decision-makers across priority accounts.

            • Increase Sonatype's presence within major enterprise organisations.

            • Demonstrate strong enterprise deal qualification, commercial judgement and forecast accuracy.

            • Build effective relationships with Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel partners.

            • Create repeatable territory development and enterprise acquisition practices that support long-term growth.

              • What Success Looks Like:

              First 30 Days — Understand, Assess & Prioritise

              You will develop a deep understanding of Sonatype's technology, competitive positioning, customer value proposition and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

              You will assess your assigned territory, identify priority accounts, evaluate competitive incumbents and develop relationships with the wider Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel teams.

              You will begin building an evidence-based view of where the strongest new-logo opportunities exist.

              First 60 Days — Build the Acquisition Strategy

              You will have developed a prioritised territory plan, identifying target accounts, executive stakeholders, competitive displacement opportunities and clear outbound engagement strategies.

              You will be actively building relationships with prospective customers, generating qualified pipeline and coordinating account-based activity with the wider go-to-market organisation.

              Your opportunities will reflect clear customer challenges, credible buying processes and measurable business value.

              First 90 Days — Demonstrate Commercial Momentum

              You will be independently driving enterprise pursuits, demonstrating meaningful self-generated pipeline creation and establishing relationships with key decision-makers.

              You will be progressing opportunities through technical validation, commercial discovery and structured enterprise qualification.

              Your territory plan, pipeline coverage and forecasting will provide leadership with confidence in your approach to delivering against quota.

              First 12 Months — Deliver High Performance

              You will have established a sustainable enterprise acquisition engine and demonstrated the ability to deliver against a quota circa $1.5-2m.

              You will have acquired new enterprise customers, progressed competitive displacement opportunities and built a strong forward-looking pipeline.

              You will be recognised for your commercial judgement, proactive hunting mentality, enterprise customer credibility and ability to win complex opportunities.

              Who You Are:

              You are an accomplished enterprise technology sales professional with a demonstrable track record of acquiring new customers, exceeding ambitious revenue targets and winning in highly competitive markets.

              You are a hunter by nature, motivated by opening doors, creating opportunities and winning business that would otherwise remain with a competitor.

              Essential Experience & Capabilities

              Proven Enterprise New-Business Performance

              • Demonstrated success carrying and achieving substantial enterprise new-business quotas, ideally around $2 million annually or at a comparable level of commercial complexity.

              • A track record of consistent quota attainment and strong new-logo acquisition.

              • Evidence of personally originating, developing and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

              • Ability to quantify pipeline creation, average contract values, competitive wins and revenue performance.

                • Consistent High Performance

                • A history of operating among the strongest performers within your sales organisation.

                • President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition is particularly attractive.

                • Evidence of sustained performance across multiple sales periods, rather than reliance on one exceptional transaction or favourable territory.

                  • Competitive Enterprise Selling

                  • Proven experience winning business against established technology providers.

                  • Ability to develop differentiated competitive strategies and challenge incumbent solutions.

                  • Strong negotiation, executive engagement and commercial deal leadership skills.

                    • Enterprise Territory Development

                    • Experience developing a geographic or named-account territory through proactive outbound activity.

                    • Strong account prioritisation, stakeholder mapping and territory planning.

                    • Ability to generate your own pipeline rather than relying predominantly on inbound demand.

                      • Technical & Industry Understanding

                      • Strong familiarity with cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application security, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or adjacent enterprise technology.

                      • Confidence engaging technical and executive stakeholders in complex buying environments.

                      • Ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial value.

                        • Sales Methodology & Commercial Discipline

                        • Experience applying structured enterprise qualification methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

                        • Strong forecasting, opportunity management and pipeline discipline.

                        • Ability to manage complex enterprise opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations and procurement processes.

                          • Preferred Experience:

                          We would particularly welcome candidates with experience from:

                          • Software supply chain security and software composition analysis.

                          • Application security and DevSecOps platforms.

                          • Repository management and developer infrastructure.

                          • Enterprise cybersecurity and cloud-native security.

                          • Enterprise platform selling and competitive displacement.

                          • Global 2000, Fortune 500 or similarly complex enterprise customers.

                          • Working with channel partners and enterprise systems integrators.

                          • Selling across the US West technology and enterprise ecosystem.

                          • Consumption-based, platform-led or land-and-expand commercial models.
