title: CX Technology Lead
description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

As our Digital Experience Lead, you’ll own how our Customer Experience team’s technology actually works. You’ll hold the roadmap for a stack of CX tools — think Zendesk, Zapier, Sprout and a handful of others — and make the call on what stays, what goes, and what gets replaced. You’ll lead the build-out of automations and AI-powered workflows that take the busywork off our CX team’s plate, partner closely with IT and Digital Product to land new tools properly, and lead and grow one direct report along the way. We’re moving into a new phase of scaling up our internal processes to match our growth, and this role is central to making that happen — think less “maintain what exists” and more “figure out how we do this better.”

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Reviewed our CX tech stack and made the case for consolidating two overlapping tools into one
  • Worked with the Analytics & Insights team to redesign our Zendesk issue-type taxonomy
  • Sketched out a 12-month roadmap of automation and AI experiments with Digital Product
  • Pushed back on a vendor renewal that didn’t stack up on cost, and proposed an alternative
  • Coached your direct report through a cross-functional roadblock with IT

Let’s talk about you

You lead without needing to be told howYou’ve led a team before and you’re used to making the call yourself, not waiting to be pushed into it. When something needs a recommendation, you bring one — with the reasoning attached.

You speak fluent tech, without needing to write the codeYou don’t need to be an engineer, but you understand technology well enough to pull apart a tool, weigh it against alternatives, and make a confident call on what we should actually be using. Hands-on time with tools like Zendesk, Sprout, Zapier, Kodif or similar CX platforms will help you hit the ground running.

You use AI as a toolkit, not a talking pointYou’re comfortable and confident using AI tools day to day, and you can see the practical ways they fit into automations and customer-facing workflows — not just the hype.

You give a crapDo you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off,as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world,generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

title: Senior Director Strategic Philanthropy
description:
Position Description

Position:Senior Director, Strategic Philanthropy

Employer:Vitamin Angels Alliance, Inc. (VA)

Department:Development

Location:Remote in the US – Eastern or Central Time Zone Preferred

Salary:$170,000-$190,000

About Vitamin Angels

Vitamin Angels (VA) is a 501(c)3 non-profit, global public health organization working towards ending malnutrition worldwide by distributing life-changing vitamins and minerals to at-risk mothers and children under five throughout the U.S., and around the world.

Vitamin Angels is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are a dedicated group of individuals who aim to foster a supportive environment where everyone can contribute, thrive, and grow.

Role or Purpose of Position

The Senior Director, Strategic Philanthropy will lead Vitamin Angels’ fundraising from public foundations; global philanthropic alliances; and other institutional funders working in malnutrition; maternal, newborn, and child health; global public health; and adjacent areas aligned with Vitamin Angels 2030.

Reporting to the Chief Development Officer (CDO) and working in close partnership with the Programs Team, the Senior Director will serve as a player-manager with initial responsibility for building the Strategic Philanthropy function. They will personally lead the cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of high-value, high-potential, and strategically important funder relationships while establishing the strategies, systems, and internal partnerships necessary for long-term revenue growth.

The Senior Director will initially hire and manage one direct report and will build additional capacity as revenue and organizational needs warrant. They will work closely with the CDO to develop long-term fundraising and partnership strategies that maximize revenue, diversify Vitamin Angels’ funding base, and position the organization’s programs, evidence, and impact effectively within the philanthropic marketplace.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Pipeline Development and Resource Generation

  • Build and manage a portfolio of high-value prospects and funders, including foundations, global philanthropic alliances, and other institutional partners focused on malnutrition; maternal, newborn, and child health; global public health; and adjacent areas.
  • Establish and achieve ambitious annual revenue goals in partnership with the CDO, with accountability for securing new funding, renewing existing commitments, and increasing funder investment.
  • Lead the full fundraising cycle, including prospect identification, research, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, negotiation, award management, stewardship, and renewal.
  • Personally cultivate, solicit, and steward high-priority funders, developing sophisticated, long-term partnerships that advance Vitamin Angels’ strategic and programmatic objectives.
  • Develop tailored engagement and solicitation strategies for priority prospects, ensuring that each opportunity has a clear strategy, owner, financial goal, next action, and timeline.
  • Maintain accurate and timely prospect, pipeline, activity, relationship, and revenue information in Salesforce.
  • Lead the development and submission of compelling proposals, concept notes, presentations, reports, and other funding communications in close partnership with Programs, Finance, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Partner with Programs and Finance to develop realistic project scopes, budgets, deliverables, and reporting commitments that accurately reflect the full cost of Vitamin Angels’ work.
  • Oversee funder stewardship, reporting, and renewal strategies, ensuring that commitments are fulfilled and opportunities to renew, expand, and deepen support are identified.
  • Provide the CDO with regular revenue forecasts, pipeline analysis, and assessments of emerging funding opportunities and potential risks.

Strategy and Organizational Leadership

  • Serve as Vitamin Angels’ internal expert on foundation and institutional philanthropy, advising leadership on funder priorities, philanthropic trends, and emerging opportunities.
  • Translate Vitamin Angels’ programmatic strategy, scientific evidence, and impact into compelling philanthropic investment opportunities.
  • Monitor trends in global health and philanthropy and identify innovative opportunities for engagement both within and beyond the sector.
  • Partner with the broader Development team to identify cross-functional funding opportunities while ensuring clear coordination with Corporate Partnerships and other revenue-generating functions.
  • Share programmatic knowledge, funder intelligence, and positioning strategies that help the broader Development team identify and pursue new revenue opportunities.
  • Build alignment and foster collaboration across Programs, Finance, Marketing, the Executive Office, and Development around priority funder relationships and funding opportunities.
  • Represent Vitamin Angels in funder meetings, conferences, philanthropic networks, and relevant global health forums.
  • Contribute to the strategic direction, revenue planning, and overall performance of the Development department.
  • Represent Development in management team meetings (as needed) and collaborate with the CDO and departmental leadership to advance organizational priorities and ensure the team’s overall success.

Team Development and Management

  • Build the Strategic Philanthropy function, initially hiring and managing one direct report and expanding the team as revenue and organizational needs warrant.
  • Establish clear roles, goals, processes, performance measures, and standards of accountability for the Strategic Philanthropy team.
  • Recruit, onboard, coach, and manage staff to achieve individual and collective fundraising goals.
  • Create a collaborative, high-performing team culture focused on proactive fundraising, continuous improvement, shared accountability, and measurable results.
  • Develop the systems, tools, resources, and internal partnerships necessary to support sustainable growth in institutional philanthropic revenue.

Level of Decision-Making

Within the bounds of VA’s mission, values and policies, and sound professional practices,the Senior Directorhasthe broad discretion to use independent judgement to manage their activities in whatever way will best serve VA clients, partners, employees, and mission.Specific authorities associated with this position and their implementation procedures will be determined in conjunction with Chief Development Officer.

Organizational Relationships

VA operates under a collaborative, matrix management model. The Senior Director of Strategic Philanthropyis supervised by the Chief Development Officer with respect to overall assignments and performance. S/he connects regularly and collaborates with the VA Programs team, Director of Business Development, the Director of Grants Management and the VA Finance Team, VP of Marketing, Senior Managers, the CEO, the CFO, and Chief Development Officer, and interacts daily with all members of the VA team.The Senior Director of Strategic Philanthropy establishes their own daily work priorities and ensures that all responsibilities are conducted with the accepted best practices, sound professional judgment, and within established schedules and budgets.

Reports to:

  • Chief Development Officer

Supervises:

  • One Position, TBD

Primary working relationships:

  • Chief Development Officer
  • VA Programs Team
  • Director of Grants Management and the VA Finance Team
  • Director of Business Development

Travel required

  • Yes (30-40%)

Qualifications and Skills (Required and Preferred)

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • At least 12 years of progressively responsible fundraising or related experience, including at least five years leading and managing high-performing teams.
  • Significant experience in foundation and institutional fundraising, with a proven record of personally cultivating, soliciting, negotiating, and securing significant grants and philanthropic commitments.
  • Demonstrated success meeting ambitious revenue goals, growing an institutional funding portfolio, and securing new and renewed multiyear support.
  • Strong knowledge of the foundation and global philanthropic funding landscape, with a demonstrated ability to establish and cultivate senior-level relationships with funders and other external stakeholders.
  • Experience developing complex proposals, concept notes, presentations, budgets, and funder reports in collaboration with programmatic, financial, and executive colleagues.
  • Experience managing restricted grants and ensuring compliance with funder requirements, deliverables, budgets, and reporting commitments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical, scientific, and programmatic information into clear and compelling cases for philanthropic investment.
  • Knowledge of global health and development funding trends.
  • Experience building or significantly expanding a fundraising function, team, or portfolio.
  • Strong financial acumen and demonstrated ability to work with Programs and Finance to develop accurate project budgets and funding requests that reflect the full cost of program delivery.
  • Proven ability to recruit, coach, develop, and hold staff accountable while fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with funders, executives, technical experts, and colleagues across the organization.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to manage complex projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Entrepreneurial, goal-oriented, self-directed, and comfortable building a new function while personally managing a high-value fundraising portfolio.
  • High standards for quality, accuracy, responsiveness, donor service, and accountability.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, as well as Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Commitment to Vitamin Angels’ global mission and willingness to embody its guiding behaviors: collaboration and inclusivity; integrity, kindness, and respect; solutions and action orientation; accountability and a growth mindset; and innovation and learning.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure with professionalism, humility, adaptability, and good humor.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Preferred:

  • Relevant Master’s Degree
  • Experience in nutrition or maternal, newborn, and child health
  • Knowledge of a non-English language

BENEFITS: Comprehensive benefit package includes Medical, Dental and Vision Care, Life Insurance, 401(k), Paid Time Off, Holidays, Wellness Program, paid parental leave and more.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer (AWS & GCP)
description:
Description

Quantum Sky is hiring a Senior Cloud Security Engineer (AWS & GCP) to join our team of cloud, security, and compliance experts. This role is primarily focused on day‑to‑day security engineering, including system hardening, vulnerability remediation, cloud operations, and security tool management across AWS & GCP environments.

In addition to regular business‑hours responsibilities, engineers participate in a structured after‑hours 24×7 on‑call rotation (primary or backup) to support response to incidents, alerts, and escalations for customers operating under FedRAMP, FISMA, and NIST 800‑53 frameworks.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform systems administration and maintenance including patching, vulnerability scanning, compliance scanning and remediation, backups, and recovery for cloud workloads.
  • Support AWS & GCP environments, including Windows and Linux virtual machines, container workloads, and cloud services such as EC2, EBS, S3, RDS, WorkSpaces (AWS), Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL (GCP), and Active Directory or equivalent identity services.
  • Configure, update, and maintain security tools for endpoint protection, log collection, vulnerability scanning, and compliance monitoring.
  • Troubleshoot issues across network, compute, application, and identity layers by reviewing logs, collecting data, and analyzing system behavior.
  • Implement hardening and compliance controls using CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, and FedRAMP requirements.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified by tools such as Tenable, Trivy, OpenSCAP, Anchore, Twistlock, and others.
  • Provide quality assurance feedback during system deployments to ensure architecture meets compliance and operational requirements.
  • Collaborate with Security Analysts to ensure uninterrupted delivery of security services to customers.
  • Create and maintain documentation including network diagrams, dataflow diagrams, SOPs, and security tool configuration guides.
  • Support client communications, deliverables, and issue resolution with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Support and mentor junior engineers as and when required.
  • After‑Hours 24×7 On‑Call Rotation:
    • Serve as primary or backup on‑call engineer during assigned rotation.
    • Respond to after‑hours security alerts, infrastructure incidents, outages, and ConMon events.
    • Perform initial triage, containment, and stabilization using established runbooks.
    • Investigate and respond to alerts generated.
    • Escalate complex issues to senior engineers, architects, or compliance teams.
    • Document incidents, actions taken, and recommended improvements.
    • Contribute to automation improvements and runbook enhancements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Six (6) or more years of IT engineering and/or cybersecurity experience, with at least three (4) years working in a dedicated cloud security engineering or similar position.
  • Hands‑on experience with both AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve issues across Linux and Windows systems, network infrastructure, and cloud services.
  • General systems administration and vulnerability management experience, including system patching and hardening, identity and access management (IAM), and related tasks.
  • Experience working in a DevSecOps environment, integrating security practices into cloud and infrastructure workflows.
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems such as Gitlab (preferred), Jira, ServiceNow, etc.
  • Ability to work independently during both business hours and on‑call periods.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for customer interaction and incident documentation.
  • Hands‑on experience with one or more of the following tools:
    • Splunk Enterprise
    • Tenable Security Center/Nessus
    • Invicti/Acunetix
    • Appgate
    • Okta
    • GitLab
    • Palo Alto Networks Firewalls
    • TrendMicro Deep Security
    • Trivy
    • Anchore
    • Terraform
    • CloudFormation
    • Ansible

Desired:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or other relevant field.
  • Experience supporting federal/government-facing customers or consulting engagements, ensuring compliance and operational requirements.
  • Experience with FedRAMP, FISMA, or NIST 800‑53 compliance frameworks.
  • Prior on‑call, SRE, SOC, or incident response experience.
  • Relevant AWS or Google Cloud Platform certifications.
  • Security+ or other relevant industry security certification.
  • Experience with infrastructure‑as‑code or automation tooling.
  • Experience with Kubernetes is highly desirable.

Location:

  • Remote (US)

Clearance:

  • Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain a security clearance

About Quantum Sky

Compensation:

  • Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically between $135,000-$160,000 This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above-stated range.

Benefits:

  • Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Time Off, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and parental leave.

The world the mission operates in is going post-quantum, contested, and machine-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it.

At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join #TeamQuantumSky?

Job Title: MSL or Sr. MSL Gastro Non-Alliance Mountain West AZ, NM, NV, UT, CO, ID GI MSL RD Central Immunology NA

  • Location: Remote, US

About the Job:

This position will report into the US Medical NextGen Immunology team, which is a segment of the Medical Specialty Care Organization. Our Medical Team serves as a valued strategic partner with Clinical, Commercial, Regulatory, and Market Access on therapeutic solutions to support patients’ needs. The US Medical NextGen Immunology team is proud to support Sanofi’s deep commitment to chasing the miracles of science to improve the lives of patients.

This position reports to the West Regional MSL Director, Next Gen Immunology (Gastroenterology/Rheumatology)

We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

This position is eligible for a company car through the Company’s FLEET program. Candidates must complete all fleet safety training and must maintain an acceptable driving record regarding accidents and incidents.

Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Utilize strong knowledge of relevant disease pathophysiology and management protocols, healthcare environment and competitors to articulate the medical and scientific value of our products with external stakeholders.
  • Cultivate and maintain robust, long-term peer relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and other stakeholders.
  • Effectively utilize the Scientific Engagement Model to plan territory and individual stakeholder (Key Opinion Leaders, HCPs, Clinical investigators, Payers) engagement interactions consistent with the Field Based Medical Activity Plan and medical function priorities.
  • Generate and execute activities aligned with medical objectives and quarterly focus document within assigned territory.
  • Critically and routinely evaluate information gained from published studies and stakeholder interactions to develop key insights that deepen our understanding of the market’s needs and opinions of external stakeholders and therefore contribute to enhancement of medical strategy.
  • Keep abreast of medical and scientific developments in the therapeutic field to help identify and critically assess research opportunities and play a supportive role in the execution of evidence generation plans to enhance the value of our products in a real-world setting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals.
  • Collaborate with the Field Medical Studies Directors and Clinical Studies Unit to support clinical trials.
  • Respond to unsolicited requests regarding interest in investigator sponsored studies (ISS) and support ISS submissions through appropriate internal processes.
  • Organize educational meetings or local scientific advisory boards when requested.
  • Support medical initiatives at global, national, and regional conferences.
  • Support speaker training.
  • Respond to unsolicited requests for medical information associated with supported products and disease state area.
  • Provide study site support and accelerate patient recruitment via scientific exchange.
  • Delivery and coordination of site engagement
  • Sharing/delivery of insights back to study teams and other relevant cross functional partners
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation by proposing novel solutions to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Uphold the highest professional and ethical standards in all interactions and communications.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and company policies.

About You:

Basic Requirements:


  • Advanced degree in a relevant scientific or medical field (e.g., MD, PhD, PharmD, or Advanced Practice Provider)
  • Minimum 1 year in a field medical role, pharmaceutical/biopharma/biotech industry, or clinical practice
  • Must reside in territory (AZ, NM, NV, UT, CO, or ID)

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience in Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), gastroenterology, or immunology
  • MSL experience strongly preferred
  • Experience with real world evidence generation
  • Experience supporting Investigator Sponsored Studies (ISS)
  • Established relationships with KOLs and healthcare providers in the Mountain West region
  • Experience at medical congresses or scientific advisory boards
  • Strong scientific communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently in a field-based, remote environment

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.
  • Help improve the lives of millions of people globally by making drug development quicker and more effective.
  • Achieve genuine work-life balance in a supportive R&D environment.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Omega CRM is a Merkle & Dentsu company, leader in development of Customer Experience services, with +20 years of experience in the use of Technology applied to Marketing and providing a unique Customer Relationship with mainly focus on Innovation is looking for a AI / Cloud Full Stack Developer.


We are building artificial intelligence solutions for customer-facing teams: assistants and agents that query data, reason over it, and help make day-to-day decisions, among other tasks.

We are looking for a full stack developer experienced with LLMs and AWS to design, build, and deploy these solutions into production.


What You Will Do


  • LLM-based agents: Design and development with tool calling, memory, and orchestration.
  • Documentation and information retrieval: Pipelines with embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and response quality evaluation.
  • AWS solutions: Deployment and operations on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, using infrastructure as code.
  • Full stack development and integrations: Backend (APIs, integrations, authentication), user interface, and integration with internal systems via MCP and APIs.
  • Measure and improve: Observability, costs, latency, and response quality.

Skills & Experience

  • Python, TypeScript, React, AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3), Pulumi, MCP, vector databases, Langfuse, Datahub.
  • Demonstrable experience taking LLMs and agents into production (not just prototypes).
  • Strong command of RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector search, and evaluation.
  • Solid knowledge of AWS, particularly Bedrock and AgentCore.
  • Cloud development experience: serverless, containers, IAM, networking, and CI/CD.
  • Infrastructure as Code with Pulumi.
  • Familiarity with backends in Python and/or TypeScript, and frontends built with a modern framework (React or similar).
  • Security best practices: OAuth/OIDC, secrets management, and per-user permissions.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • LLM observability (Langfuse or similar) and automated evaluation.
  • Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
  • Very fast adaptation to emerging developments and tools.
  • Highly proactive mindset: proposes ideas rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Sufficient experience to communicate in business terms and explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong critical judgment regarding AI: uses it as a tool and critically validates its outputs.
  • Ability to understand the business model and the broader purpose of the work being done.

Knowledge of Salesforce as a plus.

  • Oral and written fluent in English (+B2+)

WHAT DO WE OFFER


  • Permanent contract.
  • Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
  • Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
  • Home Office. You decide and we support you.
  • Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurant, …).
  • Health insurance.
  • OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention
  • Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go.

About us


Omega CRM, a Merkle Company, is a global digital company specialising in accelerating the Business Experience (BX) of our clients through customer-centric solutions, technology, and data – all enhanced by AI.

Together with Merkle, we form the largest Customer Experience Management (CXM) agency in Spain, and as part of the dentsu group, we offer end-to-end solutions that integrate media, creativity, content, technology, and strategy to deliver real business impact.

With over 23 years of experience, a team of 580+ professionals from 24 nationalities, and 2,500+ certifications, Omega CRM is a recognised leader in the Salesforce ecosystem in Spain.

We operate across key industries including Retail, Healthcare, Pharma, Real Estate, Education, and Non-Profit, delivering omnichannel experiences in Customer Service, eCommerce, Marketing, and Analytics.

Client satisfaction is at our core (rating: 4.9/5), and we’ve been recognised with awards such as Salesforce Partner of the Year FY23 and Most Innovative Project (Iberia).

At Omega CRM, we believe in growth through people – guided by our values: #Talent, #Flexibility, #Commitment, and #Innovation. We grow #Together.

title: Sr. Strategic Insights Manager
description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit to learn more about us.
The Strategic Insights team is made up of subject matter experts who drive client insight generation. We provide differentiated value to our customers by ensuring they get the most value from H1 whether that is from our platform, our underlying data or our people.
WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1As the Sr. Strategic Insights Manager, you will use your expertise to deliver data-driven solutions that address key business challenges for our life sciences clients. You will collaborate with both clients and internal teams to ensure that insights from H1’s platform and data sources drive informed decision-making and maximize value realization.

You will:

  • Be a key member of the Account Team(s) engaging with customers as a Subject Matter Expert in our data and their business
    - Use data to solve complex business challenges, particularly around scientific expert engagement and strategic collaboration
    - Lead strategic discovery processes to identify client needs and develop custom data-driven solutions.
    - Optimize the user platform experience by delivering bespoke analyses, data visualizations, and insights, offering proactive project ideas that support value creation and client expansion.
    - Partner with clients to understand their business challenges and translate them into actionable insights, providing best-in-class solutions and ideas tailored to their needs and goals.
    - Collaborate with H1 leadership and internal teams to ensure seamless project execution, delivering results that meet client objectives.
ABOUT YOUYou are a strategic, data-driven professional with a deep understanding of the life sciences industry, including drug development, therapeutic interventions, and key stakeholders.
- You have strong expertise in data extraction, manipulation, and analysis, and you can leverage data to uncover actionable insights that drive client success.
- You excel in project management, ensuring high-quality deliverables from planning through execution.
- Your ability to create clear and impactful data visualizations, combined with strong presentation skills, allows you to effectively communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- You are a skilled communicator, proficient in active listening and influencing others to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
- You thrive in collaborative environments, navigating cross-functional teams and leading efforts to deliver impactful results.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 4+ years of experience in the life sciences industry, preferably in roles related to data analytics, insights generation, or strategic consulting.
    - Proven experience working with clients to deliver data-driven solutions that solve business challenges.
    - Experience working on a cross functional team, with the ability to speak to engineers and data scientists
    - Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information in an understandable way.
    - Ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
    - Familiarity with the clinical trial landscape and expert engagement strategies is a plus.

COMPENSATION

This rolepays $130,000 to $160,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units.
Anticipated role close date: 12/21/2026

H1 OFFERS

  • Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
  • Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
  • Retirement options
  • Health & charitable donation stipends
  • Impactful Business Resource Groups
  • The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

title: Strategic Account Executive (EMEA)
description:
About Smartcat

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

You’ll win and grow Smartcat’s largest enterprise relationships, owning a small set of named strategic accounts and new enterprise prospects and running the full sales cycle. Our largest customers often start with Smartcat in a single team, and the opportunity is to change how the whole organization creates and adapts content across marketing, product, and other functions, replacing work it pays agencies, language service providers, and internal teams to do today. You’ll lead a cross-functional account team that includes AI Strategists, who run consulting-style assessments of a customer’s current and future state and develop the recommendations and business case you’ll use to win. As our offering grows, you’ll help shape how Smartcat sells to the enterprise.

MISSION

Win and grow Smartcat’s largest enterprise relationships by turning an initial foothold into a funded, multi-year content transformation across a customer’s functions, business units, and markets, building executive sponsorship from the project team to the C-suite.

OUTCOMES

  • Win new business and expand strategic accounts by running the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through negotiation, signature, and expansion
  • Turn an initial foothold into a broader content transformation across functions, business units, and markets, opening new buying centers before an active project exists
  • Build relationships from project teams to the C-suite, developing several champions and reaching the executive who owns the business outcome and the budget
  • Lead the value conversation yourself, building a quantified business case covering cost, speed, capacity, and quality, and partner with AI Strategists to deepen it through current- and future-state assessments
  • Negotiate customized multi-year agreements through procurement, legal, security, and AI governance reviews, protecting value rather than discounting
  • Lead the account team around one account strategy, including AI Strategists, Solutions Engineers, Technical Account Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Product, and executives, with delivery scope agreed before close
  • Forecast accurately, call risk early, and bring customer insight back to Product to shape our enterprise offering and sales playbook

HOW YOU’LL RAMP

By Day 30:

  • Learn Smartcat’s platform, AI agent capabilities, and enterprise value story, along with how AI Strategists, Solutions Engineers, Technical Account Managers, and Forward Deployed Engineers each contribute to an account
  • Get oriented on your named strategic accounts and target prospects: current footprint, key stakeholders, buying centers, and whitespace
  • Meet your account team partners across AI Strategy, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Product, and leadership

By Day 60:

  • Have an account strategy in place for each named account, with a plan to open new buying centers and build champions across functions
  • Be running outbound and discovery on selected new enterprise prospects
  • Begin building quantified business cases for priority accounts, with AI Strategists where an assessment will strengthen them

By Day 90:

  • Have active, multi-threaded opportunities in your accounts, with relationships reaching executive sponsors who own the business outcome and the budget
  • Present a business case to a customer executive, and be moving at least one opportunity toward a funded multi-year agreement
  • Deliver an accurate forecast, with risk called early

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, including 5+ years owning strategic or named enterprise accounts
  • A track record of personally creating and closing large, multi-year enterprise agreements, ideally eight figures in total contract value, and growing them afterward
  • Experience turning a narrow initial use case into a larger, funded initiative across a customer’s organization
  • Proven ability to sell to C-level executives and navigate complex buying groups across business, technical, finance, procurement, and legal stakeholders
  • Skill in building a quantified business case with customers, and fluency in structured methods such as MEDDPICC
  • Experience leading a virtual team of solution consultants, services, and customer success colleagues across reporting lines while keeping accountability for the deal
  • Comfort creating and closing opportunities with an evolving offering and lean infrastructure
  • Experience selling platform, data, security, or workflow software to large enterprises; experience with content, marketing, or localization technology is a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the judgment to challenge customers and disqualify weak opportunities

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

  • A global, connected team We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
  • Be part of an AI Native OrganizationWe are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
  • Innovating a $100 Billion industrySmartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
  • Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
  • Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High PerformanceAt Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

You’ll be assigned a portfolio of accounts, and on our largest accounts you’ll be the named technical resource and work directly with the account executive.

MISSION

Be the trusted technical expert behind Smartcat’s customers: meet their needs with passion and approachability, resolve complex escalations with AI-first problem solving, keep integrations and workflows healthy, and give customers around the world fast, expert technical support at any hour.

  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts, testers, success managers, and product managers, and relay customer technical feedback to influence the roadmap
  • Develop and maintain help center content, internal documentation, runbooks, and reusable integration patterns, using AI to keep them current
  • Support renewal and expansion conversations with technical proof points: performance data, integration health, and use-case expansion opportunities

On Enterprise and Corporate accounts, you’ll cover a larger number of accounts, with less day-to-day customer-facing time and more emphasis on efficient, AI-powered issue resolution.

RTI-HS psychometricians serve both a strategic and technical role within interdisciplinary research teams. title: Sales Enablement Program Manager
description:
Join Team CARFAX as a Sales Enablement Program Manager

Isn't it time you bragged about where you work? At CARFAX, we do, every day. We pride ourselves on being mission-focused on helping to grow a brand built on accuracy and integrity. We care deeply about our products and our customers. We’re more than just a company: We help millions of consumers make more-informed decisions every day. We know that our teammates are our most valuable asset, and we value a balanced life while tackling challenging projects in a fast-paced environment.

About the Role

CARFAX is investing in its Revenue Enablement function, and the Sales Enablement Program Manager is central to that effort. This is a hands-on, high-impact role focused on sharpening the skills, process discipline, and execution of our DBU sales teams — Field Sales, Hybrid Field Sales, Strategic Sales, and Inside Sales.

You’ll spend the majority of your time embedded in the flow of the sales org: coaching reps and frontline managers, reinforcing our sales process and methodology, and building the programs, content, and tools that help sellers win. You’ll also serve as a strategic partner to sales leadership — bringing field insight and enablement expertise into decisions about process, change, and go-to-market execution. This is a builder’s role on a growing team, so you’ll help shape how enablement operates at CARFAX while delivering results from day one.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Enable all DBU sales roles.Serve as the dedicated enablement partner to Field Sales, Strategic Sales, and Inside Sales — tailoring programs, coaching, and content to the distinct motions, customer profiles, and performance goals of each team. One size doesn’t fit all; what works for a field rep calling on independent dealers is different from what an inside seller needs to convert on the phone.
  • Build and lead training and coaching.Own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of sales training on core selling fundamentals — discovery, value articulation, objection handling, negotiation, and pipeline management. Provide hands-on coaching to reps and managers through field ride-alongs, call reviews, and deal reviews. Equip frontline managers to reinforce these skills with their own teams so your impact scales across the org. Best-in-class enablement functions treat training as a continuous discipline, not a one-time event — this mindset is the foundation of the role.
  • Reinforce process, methodology, and tools.Drive consistent adoption of CARFAX’s sales process and methodology through sustained, ongoing reinforcement. Champion adoption of the supporting tech stack — CRM, conversation intelligence, enablement platforms — so reps work smarter and sales leaders have the visibility they need to coach effectively.
  • Build assets and codify best practices.Create and maintain polished, field-ready sales assets — playbooks, battle cards, talk tracks, pitch decks, and process guides. Surface what top performers do differently through field observation, call reviews, and win/loss patterns, and systematically distribute those insights across the sales org. Ensuring reps have access to the right content at the right moment in the sales cycle is a core enablement discipline.
  • Partner on the onboarding handoff.Work closely with the Onboarding Lead to ensure a seamless transition from new hire onboarding into ongoing, role-based enablement. This role does not own onboarding, but its success depends on a tight partnership with the person who does.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to sales leadership.Act as a trusted advisor to DBU sales leadership on how to raise seller performance and execution quality. Bring the field’s perspective into internal decisions on process roll-outs, change management, and product launches — ensuring the field is ready to execute before go-to-market, not after.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally.Partner with Revenue Operations to define and track the KPIs that demonstrate enablement’s impact on pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue performance. Partner with Marketing on sales assets, messaging, and go-to-market motions — so programs are data-informed and what reps carry into the field is aligned, current, and on-brand.

What we’re looking for:

Required

  • 3+ years of sales enablement experience, ideally supporting multiple, distinct sales motions simultaneously.
  • Experience carrying a sales quota — you’ve sold, and you understand the seller’s world firsthand.
  • A demonstrated track record of designing and delivering training and coaching programs that measurably change rep behavior and drive revenue outcomes.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and coaching skills — both in-person and virtually — including the ability to create compelling, polished presentations in PowerPoint (or equivalent tools).
  • The ability to build trust and influence without authority across reps, managers, senior leadership, and cross-functional partners.
  • Comfort operating in a build-from-scratch environment where structure, programs, and processes don’t fully exist yet — and you’ll help create them.
  • Experience with a formal sales methodology (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Integrity Selling, Challenger, SPIN, or similar) and a track record of reinforcing it in the field over time.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time to coach reps in the field and support team events.

Preferred

  • Automotive industry or automotive technology experience — familiarity with how dealerships operate, how they buy, and what they value is a meaningful advantage in this role.
  • Experience supporting a blend of field, strategic/enterprise, and inside sales teams within a single organization.
  • Hands-on experience with conversation intelligence tools (e.g., Gong, Chorus), Salesforce, learning management systems (LMS), and content management systems (CMS).

What’s in it for you:

  • Competitive compensation, benefits and generous time-off policies
  • 4-Day summer work weeks and a winter holiday break
  • 401(k) / DCPP matching
  • Annual bonus program
  • Casual, dog-friendly, and innovative office spaces.

Don’t just take our word for it:

  • 13x VA Best Places to Work
  • 12x Top Workplaces in Washington (Presented by The Washington Post and WTOP)
  • 9x Washingtonian Great Place to Work
  • 5x USA Today Top Workplaces
  • 5x St. Louis Post-Dispatch Best Places to Work

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $150,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

Carfax is committed to providing competitive compensation that reflects local market conditions and individual contributions. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for incentive compensation, long-term incentives, and a comprehensive benefits package, where applicable.

title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The opportunity

You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to.

You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship. A dedicated level editor and an AI-powered level generation pipeline will be ready on day one, so you spend your time on what matters: making every level fun.

What you’ll do

  • Build. Design, build, and tune levels directly in Unity, covering layouts, encounters, pacing and difficulty.
  • Scale. Triple our level content by combining our AI pipeline with your own design judgment.
  • Balance. Model how health, damage, and stat changes affect the numbers before anything ships.
  • Polish. Bring existing levels to final quality and give them the feel and juice that make players stay.
  • Own. Set the level design roadmap, make design calls, and question whether each choice fits the game.
  • Specify. Write clear, detailed specs that developers can implement as written.
  • Learn from players. Use playtests and player data to see what works and iterate quickly.
  • AI. Use AI every day to generate layouts, prototype encounters, simulate balancing, and automate level work.

Requirements

  • Years of level design experience, with shipped levels on a hybrid casual, RPG or combat-based game.
  • Hands-on balancing skills: you’re comfortable with stats, health and damage maths, and spreadsheets.
  • Fluency in Unity: you build and iterate levels in the engine yourself.
  • A strong sense of game feel: you know when a level is fun, and you can explain why.
  • AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
  • The autonomy to build your own roadmap and make design decisions.
  • A data-driven approach to level tuning.
  • Feature design experience alongside level design.

For this role, you’ll also bring

  • Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don’t wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.
  • Hungry and motivated. You’re ambitious, high-energy, and grounded.

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership. You own the player experience of a game, and you’ll see your levels move the metrics.
  • The right tools from day one. A dedicated level editor and an AI level pipeline, so you focus on design.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and ambiti us, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You’ll have access to the best AI tools, and you’ll help shape how level design works in an AI-first company.

Benefits

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.

omodulation and demodulation

title: AI Content Creator
description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an AI Content Creator who lives on the bleeding edge of generative technology to build visuals that were previously impossible, expensive, or slow to produce.

Why This Role Matters

The barrier between imagination and reality has dissolved. As our AI Content Creator, you are the pioneer of our "Synthetic Production" arm. You aren't just writing prompts; you are integrating generative video, image, and audio tools into professional commercial workflows.

You will help us scale content production by generating hyper-realistic B-roll, impossible environments, and rapid-fire concepts that speed up our entire creative engine. If you spend your nights on Discord testing new models and your days dreaming of ComfyUI workflows, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Generate High-Fidelity Assets

    • Create stunning, photo-real images and video clips using Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Runway (Gen-2/Gen-3), Pika, and Sora (as available).

    • Generate specific creative assets: product backgrounds, atmospheric B-roll, and surreal visual effects that blend seamlessly with live-action footage.

    • Utilize AI audio tools (ElevenLabs, Suno) to generate realistic voice-overs and custom background tracks for testing and final delivery.

  2. Hybrid Editing & Compositing

    • Take AI-generated assets and integrate them into video timelines.

    • Use After Effects and Photoshop to "fix" AI artifacts (glitchy hands, text errors) and composite products into AI-generated environments.

    • Upscale and interpolate footage (Topaz Video AI) to ensure all AI output meets broadcast 4K standards.

  3. Rapid Concepting & Storyboarding

    • Replace traditional stick-figure storyboards with fully rendered AI animatics, allowing clients to visualize the final commercial before we even turn on a camera.

    • Speed up the pre-production process by visualizing lighting setups and set designs virtually.

  4. Stay on the Bleeding Edge

    • Constantly test new models, LoRAs, and control nets. You are the agency's R&D department for creativity.

    • Build efficient workflows (e.g., ComfyUI pipelines) that allow other editors to utilize AI tools easily.

Who You Are

  1. A "Prompt Engineer" & Artist

    • You have a deep understanding of prompt syntax, negative prompting, seeds, and weights. You know how to get exactly what you want from the AI.

    • You have a strong foundation in traditional art/photography principles (composition, lighting, color theory)—AI is just your brush.

  2. Technically Versatile

    • Proficiency in Midjourney, Runway, and ElevenLabs is required.

    • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. You need to be able to use what you generate.

    • Experience with Stable Diffusion (Automatic1111 or ComfyUI) is a massive plus.

  3. Problem Solver

    • AI is unpredictable. You have the patience to iterate 50 times to get the perfect 3-second clip.

    • You know how to troubleshoot consistency issues (keeping a character's face the same across multiple shots).

  4. Ethically Aware

    • You understand the legal landscape of AI. You know how to create commercially safe content (avoiding copyright infringement or deepfaking real celebrities without permission).

Perks & Benefits

  • Tool Access: We provide enterprise access to the top AI tools and unlimited compute credits.

  • Growth Opportunities: Define the AI strategy for a major agency and lead the shift toward hybrid production.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one generation at a time.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Join the mission to make the digital world safer.

About Team Cymru

Team Cymru’s mission is to save and improve human lives by helping public and private sector analysts track and take down cybercriminals. We provide visibility into global cyber threat activity and are a key intelligence source for leading cybersecurity and threat intelligence vendors.

Our Pure Signal™ platform gives enterprise security teams on-demand access to global internet traffic telemetry, providing clarity into what’s happening across the internet with a level of visibility comparable to their own internal networks. This allows organizations to close detection gaps, accelerate incident response, and get ahead of critical, recurring threats.

Team Cymru is a fast-paced, distribution-focused, private equity-backed company where your work directly supports a mission that protects millions worldwide.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build the Go services and pipelines that power our data lake. You’ll own how raw data lands, gets cleaned and conformed, and becomes trusted, business-ready datasets across our bronze, silver, and gold layers. You’ll operate with significant technical ownership, working closely with stakeholders to turn deep domain knowledge into reliable, production-grade systems. This role suits an engineer who can move fluidly between hands-on coding, system design, and mentoring, and who is energized by the mission-driven, high-signal nature of threat intelligence work.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Lake Design & Development

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput systems for collecting, processing, enriching, and ingesting threat intelligence data (network telemetry, indicators of compromise, or similar) into our data lake infrastructure
  • Own all layers of the data lake: bronze, silver, and gold
  • Choose and tune table formats, partitioning, compaction, and file layout to balance cost, latency, and query performance
  • Own significant components or services end-to-end, from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code in Go, and contribute to our engineering standards and practices
  • Participate in architectural decisions, design reviews, and technical planning; provide informed input on trade-offs around scale, latency, and data integrity

Collaboration & Domain Translation

  • Partner directly with threat intelligence analysts and researchers to translate investigative workflows and detection logic into scalable software
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and data teams to prioritize work that has direct impact on customer and analyst outcomes

Reliability & Operations

  • Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of existing systems, including on-call participation for services you own

Mentorship & Engineering Quality

  • Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance; help raise the bar for engineering quality across the team

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building and operating production Go systems at scale
  • Deep Go fluency: concurrency (goroutines, channels, context), profiling and performance tuning, memory management, and idiomatic testing
  • Hands-on experience building and running a data lake using the Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) in production
  • Strong working knowledge of an open table format such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi, and columnar formats like Parquet
  • Experience with object storage (S3, GCS, or ADLS) and with partitioning, compaction, and schema evolution at scale
  • Demonstrated experience designing distributed systems; you can reason clearly about trade-offs in scalability, reliability, latency, and cost
  • Experience working with large or high-velocity datasets; familiarity with streaming or batch data pipeline technologies is a strong plus
  • Experience building and maintaining ClickHouse and PostgreSQL databases

Additional Skills

  • Genuine interest in cybersecurity or threat intelligence; prior experience in the domain is a plus but not required for a strong engineer with the right curiosity and aptitude
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineering stakeholders
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to technical disagreement, mentorship, and cross-team problem-solving
  • Experience with the specific data domains relevant to threat intelligence (network flow data, DNS, malware analysis, OSINT, or similar)
  • Experience with AWS and infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Familiarity with security frameworks or standards relevant to the industry (MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII)
  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling engineering organization, including comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities
  • Open-source contributions or a public track record of technical writing or speaking

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Travel

Occasional travel for team meetings or industry events may be required.

Quarterly Execution & Linearity

  • Creating new pipeline every week.

  • Data center modernization

Sales Execution

Successful Commercial AEs at Spectro Cloud actively participate in creating their own success.

Channel & Partner Execution

What Makes You Successful Here

You are a hunter.

Enterprise infrastructure is undergoing one of its largest transformations in decades.

Kubernetes, virtualization modernization, distributed infrastructure, GPU computing, and AI are converging and changing how organizations design and operate technology.

Spectro Cloud sits at the center of that transformation.

If you want to build a territory, win new customers, work directly with customers and partners, and have a direct impact on the growth of the company, we'd like to hear from you.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

    We're hiring an experienced Sr.SDE for our Industries team within Special Projects. The team turns our core platform into purpose-built solutions for specific verticals, such as restaurants, healthcare, real estate, automotive, home services, and fitness.

    As an Sr.SDE, you'll build frontend-heavy full stack features that make our platform feel native to each industry. That means rich, interactive interfaces like floor plans, booking and scheduling views, industry dashboards, and guided setup flows. It also means configurable UI that adapts to each vertical's data models and workflows. You'll own the experience end-to-end, from component design to the APIs behind it, making sound technical trade-offs across UX, performance, scalability, and maintainability, while working closely with product, design, domain experts, and core platform teams.

    This role suits someone who cares about polished, fast, intuitive interfaces, is comfortable owning the backend that supports them, learns new domains quickly, and uses AI tools to work faster and better.

What You'll Do

  • Build rich, interactive industry experiences in Vue 3 and TypeScript, such as visual floor-plan editors, scheduling and resource views, dashboards, and multi-step onboarding flows
  • Design reusable, configurable UI components that render industry-specific objects, fields, and workflows without forking the core product
  • Lead the technical design of frontend-heavy features, turn product and design concepts into high-quality interfaces, and shape the UX with designers and domain experts
  • Evaluate frontend and full stack architectural trade-offs, balancing experimentation speed, user experience, performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability as solutions mature
  • Own frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile web, including views used live by staff on shared devices
  • Build and extend the APIs behind your features using Node.js/NestJS, with Firestore, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis as data layers
  • Handle real-time and async UI states, such as live updates, optimistic updates, background job status, and conflict handling
  • Work with core platform and app teams to reuse and improve shared components and design system patterns

  • Own the full development lifecycle for significant features and initiatives: technical design, building, testing, deploying, measuring, and maintaining.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance, sharing learnings and helping raise engineering quality across the team

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on frontend architecture and complex web applications
  • Deep expertise in Vue (Vue 3 preferred) or a comparable modern framework, plus TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Experience building complex interactive UI, such as drag-and-drop, canvas or SVG rendering, calendars and timelines, or data-dense dashboards
  • Strong understanding of state management, component architecture, and frontend performance optimization
  • Solid backend skills to work end-to-end: API design, data modeling, and Node.js (NestJS a plus)
  • Experience with real-time data, async workflows, and keeping UI state consistent with backend state
  • A strong eye for UX, accessibility, and detail, with the ability to make good product decisions when specs are incomplete
  • Openness to using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to speed up development and improve code quality
  • Curiosity about how different industries work, and comfort learning from non-technical domain experts

Bonus Points

  • Experience with canvas libraries like Konva, Fabric.js, or PixiJS
  • Experience building design systems or shared component libraries
  • Experience with metadata-driven or schema-driven UI, such as form builders, custom objects, or configurable layouts
  • Background in vertical SaaS or industry-specific products, such as restaurant POS, booking, healthcare, or real estate tools
  • Familiarity with GCP services like Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub
  • Experience with frontend testing (unit, component, and end-to-end, e.g. Playwright)

Why Join Us?

  • You'll shape what our platform looks and feels like for entire industries, often building the first screen a new vertical's customers see
  • You'll build interfaces that business owners and their staff use live, every day, to run their operations
  • You'll join a small, high-leverage team that values product thinking, craft, and moving fast with confidence, including using AI to build smarter
