title: Sr Data Analyst - Store Analytics
description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brandsinclude Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore,which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics, to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. The Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics serves as a strategic analytics partner to Stores leadership and enterprise leaders, driving deeper understanding of store performance through diagnostic and exploratory analysis. This role goes beyond reporting to identify root causes of business performance, uncover opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and influence decisions that improve sales, productivity, customer experience, and operational effectiveness.
The Sr Analyst independently leads complex analyses, develops scalable analytical frameworks, partners closely with business leaders and Data Engineering, and helps shape the evolution of the Store Insights capability.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Lead complex diagnostic and ad hoc analyses that identify root causes of store performance, quantify business opportunities, and guide strategic decision-making across Stores.
  • Independently frame ambiguous business questions, formulate analytical approaches, synthesize multiple data sources, and translate findings into executive-ready recommendations.
  • Perform root cause analysis to explain sales trends, labor productivity, conversion, customer behavior, and operational performance, developing hypotheses and validating findings through quantitative analysis.
  • Proactively identify emerging risks and opportunities across the store fleet by monitoring leading performance indicators and conducting exploratory analyses.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards and analytical solutions that enable leaders to self-serve insights while ensuring metric governance and reporting consistency.
  • Serve as a key analytics partner in the migration from Tableau to Power BI by leading report validation, metric reconciliation, user acceptance testing, and adoption of standardized reporting.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and business stakeholders to validate semantic-layer logic, metric definitions, data quality, and reporting consistency.
  • Drive development of scalable Store Insights capabilities by identifying repeatable analytical opportunities, automating recurring analyses, and advancing self-service analytics.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders, influencing business strategy through clear storytelling and data-driven insights.
  • Support store growth analytics initiatives through data preparation, exploratory analysis, performance tracking, and post-investment measurement for new stores, remodels, and market activations.
  • Develop repeatable analytics workflows that reduce manual reporting effort and improve the speed, quality, and consistency of insight delivery.
  • Create executive-ready charts, tables, dashboards, and written summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Apply advanced analytics tools and techniques, including SQL, Power BI, Python, and external data sources, to solve complex business problems and continuously improve analytical capabilities.
  • Recommend new metrics, analytical approaches, and measurement frameworks that improve how Stores evaluate performance and make decisions.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, retail analytics, or related quantitative disciplines, with demonstrated success solving complex business problems through data.
  • Demonstrated experience performing diagnostic, root cause, and exploratory analyses that influenced business decisions.
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal direction, prioritize competing initiatives, and manage multiple high-impact analytical projects.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings to senior leadership and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with experience optimizing complex queries and working with large enterprise datasets.
  • Strong experience with Power BI, semantic models, DAX, and modern BI best practices.
  • Working knowledge of Python, statistical analysis, and modern analytics workflows.
  • Experience applying statistical methods, experimentation, forecasting, or predictive techniques is preferred.
  • Experience in retail, multi-unit operations, consumer analytics, or store performance analytics strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience with data validation, KPI governance, and metric consistency.
  • Ability to synthesize findings into clear written and verbal recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with cross-functional partners to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:
  • Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
  • Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
  • Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday
The starting salary for this position is $106,800 – $145,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $222,394. Other compensation may include a 10% Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) bonus paid out according to policy. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.
Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.

title: Customer Experience Manager - Singapore
description:

Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Experience Manager – Singapore to own the end-to-end customer experience for OPSWAT customers in the Singapore market.

This role will be responsible for managing the local customer support team while acting as a trusted customer-facing leader throughout the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and deployment to adoption, expansion, and ongoing technical engagement.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical and customer-facing skills with the ability to build relationships with customers, drive successful outcomes, manage escalations, and work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Global Customer Experience teams.

This is a customer-facing leadership role with responsibility for coordinating technical support and Professional Services for OPSWAT customers in Singapore. The role operates in a matrix organization: you will lead local customer engagement and outcomes while working through global Support, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to align priorities, mobilize the right expertise, and deliver a consistent customer experience. Success requires influence without relying solely on direct reporting lines, strong ownership, and the ability to stay hands-on with complex technical issues.

We are specifically looking for a hands-on, technically strong, customer-facing leader who can manage technical support and Professional Services in a matrix organization. The successful candidate will engage directly with customers on complex technical issues, guide and coach support engineers, coordinate Professional Services delivery, personally drive critical escalations, and work closely with Product and Engineering to resolve root causes. This is a player-coach role that combines practical technical depth, customer ownership, and the ability to influence and align global teams without relying solely on direct reporting lines.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience & Success

  • Own the overall customer experience and satisfaction for OPSWAT customers in Singapore.
  • Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and become a trusted technical advisor.
  • Ensure customers successfully onboard, deploy, configure, and adopt the OPSWAT Platform.
  • Proactively monitor customer adoption, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to improve platform utilization.
  • Understand customers’ security challenges and identify opportunities to leverage additional OPSWAT capabilities and use cases.
  • Conduct regular customer reviews and technical/business discussions with strategic customers.

Local Support Team Management

  • Lead and manage the local customer support team in Singapore.
  • Ensure effective case management, prioritization, SLA adherence, and customer communication.
  • Coach and mentor support engineers to continuously improve technical capability and customer engagement.
  • Monitor team performance, customer satisfaction, escalations, and operational KPIs.
  • Collaborate with global support teams to ensure consistent processes and 24×7 customer coverage where required.

Escalation Management

  • Own critical and high-priority customer escalations in Singapore.
  • Act as the primary point of coordination between customers, Support, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.
  • Drive escalations to timely resolution while maintaining clear and proactive communication with customers.
  • Identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to eliminate root causes.

Product Adoption & Customer Advocacy

  • Identify new customer use cases and help customers maximize the value of the OPSWAT Platform.
  • Capture customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps and communicate them effectively to Product Management and Engineering.
  • Represent the voice of the customer within OPSWAT.
  • Identify opportunities for customers to expand their use of OPSWAT products and capabilities.
  • Develop customer references, success stories, and advocacy opportunities where appropriate.

Hands-on Technical Leadership

  • Remain actively involved in troubleshooting complex customer issues and critical incidents, partnering with engineers as needed.
  • Lead technical triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution planning for high-impact cases; ensure follow-through on corrective and preventive actions.
  • Review case trends and technical escalations to identify product gaps, recurring defects, and opportunities to improve support effectiveness.
  • Provide technical coaching, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to strengthen the capability and independence of the local team.

Matrix Leadership Across Support & Professional Services

  • Coordinate customer-facing technical support and Professional Services activities, ensuring customers receive joined-up guidance from issue resolution through deployment, implementation, and ongoing optimization.
  • Operate effectively in a matrix organization by aligning priorities, resources, and commitments with global Support and Professional Services leaders, even where teams do not report directly to this role.
  • Act as the local customer-facing owner for communication, expectations, and outcomes while engaging the appropriate global technical specialists and service delivery teams.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to align customer needs, service plans, escalations, and strategic account priorities.
  • Maintain clear ownership, action tracking, and communication across functions to avoid handoff gaps and deliver a consistent customer experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on customer strategy, renewals, expansion, and strategic opportunities.
  • Work with Professional Services to ensure successful deployments and project handoffs.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering on customer requirements, feature requests, and product improvements.
  • Work with the global Customer Experience organization to share best practices and continuously improve customer experience.

Key Success Metrics

  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Customer retention and renewal success
  • Successful onboarding and deployment
  • Platform adoption and utilization
  • Support SLA and escalation performance
  • Reduction in recurring customer issues
  • Customer engagement and executive relationships
  • Number and quality of customer use cases identified
  • Customer feedback and product improvement contributions
  • Team performance, capability, and employee engagement

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Support, Professional Services, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience managing or leading a technical support/customer-facing team.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise IT and cybersecurity environments.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and managing complex technical escalations.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Customer-first mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Strong business-level English communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on technical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate complex enterprise and cybersecurity issues rather than relying solely on team escalation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead from the front during critical customer incidents, including technical triage, root-cause analysis, and coordination of resolution.
  • Ability to coach engineers through practical technical problem-solving while maintaining accountability for customer outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cybersecurity products, enterprise security platforms, or critical infrastructure protection.
  • Experience with SaaS/platform deployments and enterprise adoption programs.
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers in Singapore.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as malware protection, file security, email security, data security, network security, cloud security, or endpoint security.
  • Experience managing strategic accounts and executive-level customer relationships.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the Customer Experience Manager will establish a strong local customer experience organization in Singapore, build trusted relationships with key customers, improve onboarding and platform adoption, create an effective escalation management process, and establish a strong feedback loop between local customers and OPSWAT’s global Product and Engineering teams.

The ultimate goal is simple: ensure every OPSWAT customer in Singapore realizes maximum value from the platform and views OPSWAT as a trusted security partner—not simply a technology vendor.

title: HR Generalist
description:
About Us

LTD Global, LLC is a certified woman-owned consulting firm based in Pleasanton, California, serving clients in the U.S. and abroad since 2003. We provide HR, accounting, and SaaS integration services to private, nonprofit, and government organizations, and we are Alameda SLEB certified and an SBA 8(a) program participant. Our HR team partners with nonprofits across the Bay Area and nationwide. We help them hire well, stay compliant, and build strong workplaces so they can focus on their missions.
Our clients do vital work, often with lean teams and limited budgets. We give them the HR expertise they need to hire well, stay compliant, and build healthy workplaces, so they can stay focused on their missions.

Position Summary

We are seeking a client-focused HR Generalist to deliver hands-on HR support to a portfolio of nonprofit clients. You will manage full-cycle recruitment, employee relations, compliance, payroll, and day-to-day HR operations.
This is a client-facing role. You will act as a trusted HR partner to executive directors, managers, and staff, often serving as the primary HR resource for organizations without an in-house HR team. The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, and comfortable supporting several clients at once.

Key Responsibilities

Client Partnership and Consulting

  • Serve as the day-to-day HR point of contact for an assigned portfolio of nonprofit clients.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive directors, board members, managers, and staff.
  • Assess client HR needs and recommend practical solutions that fit nonprofit budgets and culture.
  • Lead client meetings, present recommendations, and deliver HR updates clearly and professionally.
  • Manage multiple client priorities and deadlines while maintaining high service quality.
  • Document client work accurately and track hours for client billing.

Full-Cycle Recruitment

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role needs, write and update job descriptions, and set hiring timelines.
  • Post openings on job boards, nonprofit networks, social media, and community channels.
  • Screen resumes, conduct phone screens, and coordinate interview schedules.
  • Develop interview guides and support structured, equitable hiring practices.
  • Conduct reference checks and coordinate background checks in line with fair chance hiring laws.
  • Prepare offer letters and support salary negotiations within approved ranges.
  • Manage onboarding, including new hire paperwork, I-9 and E-Verify, orientation, and first-90-day check-ins.
  • Maintain applicant tracking records and report on recruitment metrics.

Employee Relations

  • Advise managers and employees on workplace concerns, conflicts, and policy questions.
  • Conduct or support workplace investigations and document findings objectively.
  • Coach managers on performance management, corrective action, and difficult conversations.
  • Support performance review cycles, improvement plans, and terminations.
  • Conduct exit interviews and identify retention trends.
  • Promote a respectful, inclusive, and equitable workplace culture.

Compliance

  • Ensure client practices comply with federal, California, and other applicable state and local employment laws, including FLSA, FMLA, CFRA, ADA, FEHA, Title VII, and Cal/OSHA.
  • Track multi-state requirements for clients with employees outside California.
  • Draft, review, and update employee handbooks, policies, and procedures.
  • Advise on wage and hour issues, including exempt versus non-exempt classification, meal and rest breaks, and overtime.
  • Coordinate required training, such as California harassment prevention training.
  • Manage required postings, notices, and filings, including EEO-1 reporting where applicable.
  • Support leave administration, including FMLA, CFRA, pregnancy disability, and paid sick leave.
  • Coordinate workplace accommodation requests through the interactive process.
  • Conduct HR audits and recommend corrective actions to reduce risk.

Payroll and Benefits

  • Process or review semi-monthly and bi-weekly payroll for multiple clients through platforms such as Paychex, Gusto, GoCo, Rippling, and Paycom.
  • Verify timekeeping, PTO accruals, deductions, and pay changes for accuracy.
  • Resolve payroll discrepancies and respond to employee pay questions.
  • Support benefits administration, including open enrollment, new hire enrollment, COBRA, and life event changes.
  • Coordinate with benefits brokers, payroll vendors, and client finance teams.
  • Support compensation reviews and salary benchmarking for nonprofit roles.

HR Operations and Other HR Tasks

  • Maintain accurate, confidential personnel files and HRIS records.
  • Prepare HR reports on headcount, turnover, and other metrics.
  • Create HR templates, forms, and process guides for client use.
  • Support organizational changes, including restructuring, layoffs, and mergers.
  • Assist with training and development programs for client staff and managers.
  • Support employee engagement surveys and recognition initiatives.
  • Assist with workers’ compensation claims and unemployment responses.
  • Perform other HR duties as assigned to meet client needs.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of HR generalist experience covering recruitment, employee relations, compliance, and payroll.
  • Working knowledge of federal and California employment law.
  • Hands-on experience processing payroll and administering benefits.
  • Experience with full-cycle recruitment, from job posting through onboarding.
  • Proficiency with HRIS, payroll, and applicant tracking systems.
  • Strong skills in Outlooks, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting to clients and leaders.
  • Proven ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.
  • Residence in the San Francisco Bay Area, with reliable high-speed internet and a private, quiet workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • HR certification strongly preferred: SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or PHRca.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience working in or supporting nonprofit organizations.
  • Prior experience in HR consulting, outsourcing, or a PEO environment.
  • Experience with multi-state compliance and payroll.
  • Familiarity with ADP, Paychex, Gusto, Paylocity, BambooHR, or similar platforms.
  • Experience conducting workplace investigations.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, Tagalog, or Vietnamese is a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Client service: Responsive, professional, and focused on client outcomes.
  • Mission alignment: Genuine commitment to the nonprofit sector and the communities it serves.
  • Judgment: Sound decision-making and knowing when to escalate.
  • Organization: Strong time management across multiple clients and deadlines.
  • Equity and inclusion: Commitment to fair, inclusive HR practices.
  • Adaptability: Comfort with shifting priorities and varied client cultures.
  • Independence: Self-directed and accountable in a remote environment.

Compensation and Benefits

This position pays $33.00–$35.00 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and HR certification. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off and paid holidays, and a 401(k) plan. We also host regular staff get-togethers and team events to stay connected.

Work Environment

  • Remote position based in the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Occasional travel to client sites within the Bay Area for meetings, trainings, or investigations.
  • Standard business hours, with some flexibility needed for client meetings across U.S. time zones.
  • Work is primarily computer-based and involves extended periods of virtual meetings.

How to Apply

Please send your resume and a brief cover letter to [email address or application link]. In your cover letter, share your HR experience and why you want to support nonprofit organizations.

Equal Opportunity Statement

LTD Global, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. title: Pharmaceutical Subject Matter Expert (SME) - AI Model Evaluation (USA)
description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $20-$50 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if your pharmaceutical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand regulatory requirements, scientific documentation, manufacturing processes, and quality standards?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical and biotechnology professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking pharmaceutical regulatory, quality, manufacturing, compliance, and technical development professionals who can apply their industry expertise, scientific judgment, and regulatory knowledge to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional pharmaceutical position. You won't be manufacturing products, preparing submissions, or managing quality systems. Instead, you'll assess complex scientific and regulatory content, identify technical inaccuracies, evaluate reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Pharmaceutical Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator (US Industry), helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated pharmaceutical and biotechnology content.

You'll analyze scientific, regulatory, manufacturing, and compliance-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in industry standards, regulatory frameworks, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

1. CMC Regulatory Affairs
Professionals experienced in Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) regulatory activities, regulatory submissions, lifecycle management, and global regulatory requirements.

2. Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance
Experts in quality systems, GMP compliance, deviation management, CAPA processes, quality oversight, and pharmaceutical quality operations.

3. CMC Science / Technical Development
Professionals involved in product development, formulation science, process development, scale-up activities, technology transfer, and product lifecycle support.

4. Regulatory CMC Submission Writing
Specialists experienced in CTD/eCTD authoring, Module 3 documentation, regulatory submissions, and technical regulatory writing.

5. Quality Control / Analytical Development
Experts in analytical testing, method validation, laboratory operations, data review, and analytical regulatory compliance.

6. GMP Compliance / Validation
Professionals with expertise in validation programs, qualification activities, GMP systems, and inspection readiness.

7. Regulatory Compliance Auditing
Experienced auditors who conduct internal, supplier, and compliance audits while evaluating quality systems and regulatory requirements.

8. Pharmaceutical Manufacturing / MSAT
Manufacturing and Manufacturing Science & Technology professionals experienced in process monitoring, troubleshooting, technology transfer, and operational excellence.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, missing context, and flawed reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference relevant FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way
Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your pharmaceutical or biotechnology career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy
Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely
Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location, with flexibility based on project needs and availability.

Explore the Future of Pharmaceutical Technology
Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while applying your existing scientific and regulatory expertise.

No AI Background Required
We're looking for professionals who can recognize accurate scientific reasoning, identify errors, and communicate expert assessments with clarity.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on clinical specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements. See rates per expertise:

Pharmaceutical Subject Matter Experts: $20-$50 USD/hour

Compensation may vary based on experience level, area of expertise, and assignment complexity.

    • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
    • Work Arrangement: Remote
    • Primary Location: United States preferred
    • Additional Markets: Professionals outside the United States may be considered if they possess substantial U.S. pharmaceutical industry experience
    • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
    • Project Type: Pharmaceutical AI content evaluation
    • Project Duration: Based on project requirements and assignment availability
    • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises prior to project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Pharmaceutical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced (US Industry) pharmaceutical or biotechnology professional who enjoys analyzing complex scientific information, applying regulatory and technical expertise, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of pharmaceutical AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced (US Industry) pharmaceutical and biotechnology professionals who bring more than familiarity with industry processes. You should be comfortable reviewing technical information, exercising independent judgment, and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of four years of relevant professional experience in the regulated US based pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Team:

The AlphaSense Finance team is responsible for efficiently driving the creation of enterprise value by supporting capital allocation decisions across the business. We exist to help the company make intelligent, data-driven decisions through financial analysis; scenario modeling; tracking, interpreting and disseminating key performance indicators; and by serving as a critical thought partner to senior leadership.

About the Role:

The Senior Accountant will own key areas of the monthly close including COGS, cost allocations, and various accruals. You will work as part of a growing team at a well-funded growth-stage, pre-IPO tech company with significant opportunities for rapid career advancement.

Who You Are:

  • 3-5+ years of accounting experience, preferably at a SaaS or technology company
  • Bachelors degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Experience with a Big 4 or public accounting firm preferred
  • A self starter who can operate independently and manage multiple deadlines during a fast-paced month end close process
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to partner with FP&A and other stakeholders
  • Advanced excel skills required
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP, including accrual accounting, multi-entity, and intercompany accounting
  • Exposure to usage-based or technology vendor costs a plus
  • Hands on experience with NetSuite and FloQast or similar ERP and close management tool preferred

What You’ll Do:

  • Ensure timely and accurate income statement recognition in accordance with US GAAP
  • Own key areas of the monthly COGS close, including cost allocations and related accruals
  • Prepare monthly accruals and reversals for content, technology, and other vendor costs
  • Maintain COGS summary analysis for manager review
  • Prepare intercompany entries and reclasses across multiple entities
  • Reconcile accrued expense and payable accounts, and prepare flux explanations for the monthly close review
  • Prepare journal entries in conformity with established procedures
  • Prepare and review analysis of various balance sheet and P&L accounts
  • Prepare month end journal entries and support the monthly close process to ensure timely and accurate monthly reconciliation of accounts for the various entities under the AlphaSense umbrella
  • Liaise closely with internal departments to ensure all monthly transactions are properly booked
  • Understand internal control design concepts sufficient to assess the effectiveness of controls in their area and to design new processes and controls for emerging and growing business activities
  • Ability to identify and implement process improvement and automation opportunities, including AI-enabled workflows, to drive positive change across the organization
  • Lead delivery of accounting tasks and projects
  • Assist with audit requests (Quarterly/Annual Audit, Stat Audit, and Sales Tax Audit)

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range
$79,000—$109,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Talent Lead Generation Specialist (Entry Level) | US Startups & Agencies | Remot
description:
Company Overview

atomic✳HR is a recruiting startup. We help talented people across Latin America land remote roles with fast-growing startups and marketing agencies in the US and Canada, and we help those companies hire people they'd never have found on their own. We're small, fully remote, and we treat hiring like a growth problem: we test the way we write to candidates and where we post roles, and we use AI tools to move faster. This role sits on our own internal team.

Your Role

This is lead generation pointed at people instead of customers. You'll work across many different roles and industries, and every search starts with two questions: who is this person, and what would actually make them reply? If you've done lead gen or marketing, it's the same muscle you already have. You research an audience and write messages that convert, except here a conversion is a great candidate writing back.

A lot of what you'll source for is marketing and creative work: creative strategists, paid media, performance, growth, and data roles. So if you come from a marketing or agency world, you already understand the people you're reaching and what they care about. You figure out where the right people are, write the outreach, post the role so the right people see it, and improve based on what actually gets responses. Some recruiters treat this as the boring first step of hiring. We think it's the most interesting part, and it's most of this job. No recruiting experience needed. You'll be mentored while you learn the talent side, and you'll have real tools, including a dedicated sourcing platform and AI, to do it at scale.

You'll:

  • Research each new role to understand who the ideal candidate is and where to find them
  • Write and personalize outreach, then test subject lines and openers to lift reply rates
  • Post and promote roles so the right people actually apply
  • Review incoming applicants and shortlist the ones worth talking to
  • Keep your pipeline organized and follow up so no good candidate goes cold
  • Use AI and sourcing tools to work through a large volume without losing the personal touch
  • Track what's working, and change your approach when the numbers say so

You Bring

  • Curiosity and a real drive to keep learning, since every role is a new puzzle
  • Strong written English, and the ability to write to a stranger like a human rather than a template
  • Resourcefulness: handed a new tool and no script, you'd rather figure it out than wait to be told
  • Organization and follow-through, so pipelines stay clean and nothing slips
  • A competitive streak and self-motivation, because a lot of this is chasing a number you want to hit
  • Comfort with basic metrics, and the instinct to test something and adjust
  • A concrete example of a time you used a tool, a tactic, or automation to work smarter or hit a goal

Bonus Points

  • A background in lead generation, marketing, growth, sales, business development, or customer success
  • Experience at a marketing or creative agency, since many of the people you'll reach are creative, paid media, performance, growth, and data professionals
  • Hands-on time with a CRM like HubSpot or Salesforce, or with outreach and prospecting tools
  • You already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) in your day-to-day work
  • A language beyond English and Spanish

What's Offered

  • Fully remote from anywhere in Latin America, part-time to start at roughly 20 to 30 hours a week with room to grow, on hours that overlap US time zones
  • Compensation based on experience, paid weekly in USD as a contractor. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there
  • A chance to move your lead-gen or marketing skills into a new field, with mentorship while you learn it
  • A modern stack (a dedicated sourcing platform and AI tools) so you can work at scale from day one
  • Recent graduates and career switchers are welcome, with no recruiting background required. We hire on how you think and how you write

Interview Process

1️⃣ Apply, including a short outreach exercise

2️⃣ Intro and screening call

3️⃣ A practical challenge close to the real work

4️⃣ Final conversation with the team

title: Business Development Manager (Nationwide, US)
description:
Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit www.eastman.com.

Role Profile

The Business Development Manager is expected to expand Eastman’s presence in strategically important markets, improve early access to projects and specifications, strengthen relationships across the value chain, increase the quality of the opportunity pipeline, support higher project win rates, and convert market insights into sustainable commercial growth.

The Business Development Manager is responsible for executing our business strategy at the downstream customer and key value chain partners level, enabling customer success through identifying, developing, and securing new specifications for Eastman Heat Transfer Fluids offerings in existing & emerging applications. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the way Eastman strategically develops its business through product specification working with process licensors, large engineering, procurement and construction companies & (OEM) Original Equipment Manufacturers in the conventional Oil & Gas Industries, downstream petrochemicals and derivatives and emerging renewable energy / sustainability markets. Approximately 50% + travel is required for this role.

This full-time, remote position is home-office based with a preference for candidates based in Houston, Atlanta, Chicago, St Louis, and Greenville. This is a critical role within the Specialty Fluids & Energy business reporting to the North America / Asia Sales Manager and offers an exciting opportunity to develop new business with our innovation-driven platform offerings in downstream applications.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the commercial team to understand market dynamics, industry trends, customer needs, end-market developments, and emerging applications relevant to the SFE- HTF business. Identify and prioritize attractive market segments, applications, investment projects, and growth opportunities by evaluating market potential, strategic fit, competitive intensity, customer value, and expected return.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the value chain, including customers, engineering, procurement, and construction companies, process licensors, consultants, technology providers, distributors, and other strategic partners. And, build and maintain a global ecosystem of value-chain partners and decision-makers, working directly or indirectly with the sales, technical, marketing, and regional teams to strengthen Eastman’s market position.
  • Engage with EPC companies, process licensors, engineering firms, and other validation partners involved in conventional markets and emerging growth areas, including renewable energy and sustainability-related applications. Identify opportunities to influence product specifications and technical standards at an early stage of project development, while ensuring that customer and value-chain requirements are clearly communicated to the relevant internal teams
  • Work closely with customers, account managers, and technical teams to understand application requirements, unmet needs and support the development, qualification, and specification of Eastman products and solutions. Translate market, customer, project, and value-chain insights into actionable business recommendations, including opportunity prioritization, commercial strategies, product-development needs, and market-entry plans.
  • Use available business tools, market intelligence, project databases, Salesforce Opportunity Management, Power BI and investment-outlook resources to assess global developments in conventional and emerging markets and to guide the allocation of business-development resources supporting product specification.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Monitor global investment activity, major projects, technology developments, regulatory trends, and sustainability priorities to anticipate future demand and identify opportunities for Eastman.
  • Provide market and competitive intelligence to commercial and business leadership, including insights on competitors, alternative technologies, customer strategies, project pipelines, value propositions, and potential risks. Collaborate with sales, marketing, product management, technical service, application development, supply chain, and other functional teams to develop coordinated customer and project strategies.
  • Support technical validation and commercialization activities by coordinating the required engagement among customers, engineering partners, process licensors, technical teams, and internal stakeholders. Develop and maintain strategic accounts, market, and project plans that define objectives, stakeholders, engagement priorities, value propositions, actions, and expected outcomes.
  • Promote a global, customer-centric approach to business development by encouraging collaboration across regions and avoiding regional silos, particularly on global accounts and projects involving multiple supply or customer locations. Facilitate effective handoffs from business development to the commercial and technical teams, ensuring that project information, customer requirements, timelines, risks, and agreed actions are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Track business-development activities, project progress, customer engagement, specifications, validation milestones, and commercial outcomes using established business processes and systems. Continuously assess the effectiveness of business-development strategies and recommend adjustments when market conditions, customer priorities, competitive dynamics, or investment plans change.
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with Eastman’s policies, applicable laws, ethical business practices, and health, safety, environmental, and security requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or related engineering field required. Master in business administration (MBA) is preferred.
  • 5–10+ years of advanced Sales / Business development in specialty chemicals, Engineering Procurement and Construction Companies or with Process Licensors. Strong process engineering background working with EPCs is preferred.
  • Extensive knowledge of Process Engineering.
  • Strong technical knowledge, market and customer strategy and planning experience
  • Experience with CRM ( Sales Force preferred), opportunity management and other sales systems and tools
  • Success in the role requires strong strategic thinking, global networking, customer and market orientation, commercial awareness, technical curiosity, influencing skills, collaboration, adaptability, and the ability to connect long-term market opportunities with practical business actions.

  • Note: Eastman will not accept applicants for this offered position who require visa sponsorship, including those whose status is F-1 visa OPT who subsequently would require ongoing visa sponsorship.

Travel Requirements

Required to spend minimum 50% of time on travel status for customer visits; trade shows; training; and regional/global meetings. Travel will mostly be in US and Canada however may also require additional international travel as needed.

Traits

Passion for Selling:

  • Is consistently obsessed with understanding and shaping customer and market behavior
  • Connects the dots to develop insights meaningful to customers’ and Eastman’s success
  • Leverages data for learning, decision making, and prioritization
  • Uses a disciplined approach in developing and following successful patterns in key sales processes

Tenacious:

  • Pursues goals with energy, drive and a need to finish
  • Seldom gives up before finishing, especially in the face of resistance, rejection or set-back
  • Always looks for the possibilities and skillfully does discovery to overcome obstacles
  • Breaks down or work around perceived barriers; gets to the right decision makers internally and externally

Inquisitive:

  • Leverages the skills of questioning, observation, listening and networking to gain a deep understanding of our customers’ goals, needs and issues
  • Takes the required action to resolve gaps in information, knowledge or understanding
  • Gathers all information needed to make informed choices
  • Leverages experts and other key individuals as important sources of information
  • Uncovers relevant information to make accurate judgments and sound decisions

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $137,500. ​

Not all postings display ranges due to factors like location, market conditions, or position specifics. Compensation is based on qualifications and experience. Candidates are encouraged to discuss their salary questions during the interview process.

Benefits

Your total rewards go far beyond a competitive salary. When you join Eastman, you gain access to an exceptional suite of programs designed to protect your health, grow your wealth, and fuel your career.

Compensation & Incentives
• Base pay plus performance-based incentive opportunities that let you share in our success.

Health & Wellness
• Comprehensive medical, prescription-drug, and dental coverage—paired with a Health Savings Account option to help you save tax-free dollars for care today or in the future.
• A robust menu of voluntary benefits—including vision, optional life, critical-illness protection, and more—so you can tailor coverage to fit your life.
• Holistic wellness support: financial-planning tools, family-building assistance (adoption, pregnancy, and fertility resources), parental leave, and confidential Employee Assistance Program counseling.

Retirement & Financial Strategies
• 401(k) with a company match—plus an additional annual retirement contribution from Eastman to accelerate your long-term savings.

Time Away
• Eleven paid holidays, one personal day, paid time off, and paid vacation to recharge, celebrate, or handle life’s moments.

Growth & Development
• Access to mentorship, learning resources, and leadership programs that empower you to thrive in your current role and chart the next steps in your career.

At Eastman, we invest in the whole you—so you can bring your best self to work every day and build a future you’re proud of.

title: Senior Manager of Strategy & Operations
description:

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360 is the family safety and connection platform trusted by more than 100 million monthly active users around the world. Our growth over the next several years will come from expanding internationally and moving into new business adjacencies, with AI acceleration underpinning both. This role helps shape those decisions.

You'll join a deliberately lean Strategy & Corporate Development team, working directly with the VP of Corporate Development and alongside senior leaders across the company. You'll own important analysis behind where we grow next, and you'll introduce the AI agents that let a small team cover far more ground. For the right person, this is a role with room to grow and a scope that expands as you earn the trust of our senior leaders.

About the Job

The decisions behind Life360’s next stage of growth, which international markets to enter, which adjacencies to pursue, and which companies to buy or invest in, depend on analysis our executive team can rely on. We’re hiring a strategy and corporate development practitioner to lead that analysis and turn it into decisions and deals.

You’ll frame the question, build the models, and make the recommendation, then stay with the work as it moves into live acquisitions and investments. You’ll also build the AI agents that help a small team move faster, from tracking potential targets to running repeatable target analysis. Your work will go directly to the VP of Corporate Development and our executive team.

The US-based salary range for this position is $163,500 to $242,500. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

In Your First Year

  • Two strategic analyses that earn executive support. You'll lead two strategic analysis processes from framing through recommendation. Your recommendations will hold up to challenges from our executive team and earn their support.
  • Two acquisition candidates worth championing. You'll find and recommend one international and one adjacent acquisition candidate. The quality of your analysis, and the way you work across teams, will turn colleagues into vocal supporters.
  • Our first agents. You'll be the catalyst for building agents on the team. Your first agents will identify and track potential targets in our agreed priority areas and run repeatable target analysis in a structured way, saving your colleagues hours of repetitive work.
  • Strong analytical work on live deals. You'll own key analytical workstreams on acquisitions and strategic investments, including market sizing, operating and valuation models, and diligence analysis, partnering with finance, legal, and product. We move light and fast, and your work will help keep it that way.

What We’re Looking For

These are must-haves, and we'll look for clear evidence of each.

  • You drive the work. You take an ambiguous problem and run it to a recommendation. You define the output, set the timeline, bring in the right people, and follow through on your own initiative.
  • You build and deploy AI agents. You're AI-native, and you have designed and deployed agents into real workflows using tools such as Claude, Claude Code, MCP connectors, or comparable frameworks. You direct AI to raise the speed and quality of your thinking, and you check its work with the same rigor you apply to your own.
  • You bring intellectual rigor. You build financial models and valuations from first principles, pressure-test your own assumptions, and can defend every number.
  • You work well with senior leaders. You communicate clearly in writing and in the room, welcome hard questions, and build the credibility that turns stakeholders into supporters.
  • You have the foundation. Roughly 5 to 8 years in investment banking, management consulting, private equity, venture, corporate development, or strategy at a high-growth technology company.

Nice to Have

Experience with B2C subscription or consumer technology businesses, hands-on M&A diligence or integration work, and comfort with SQL or BI tools.

How We'll Get to Know You

Our process is built around real work. You'll walk us through an agent or AI workflow you've built and the results it produced. You'll also join a working session where we share an open-ended strategic question and explore how you'd approach it.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

The Platform team builds the core capabilities that enable customers to run enterprise storage, data management, and modern infrastructure across on-prem, edge, regulated, sovereign, and emerging AI environments.

NetApp is seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive strategy, prioritization, and execution for core ONTAP Platform capabilities, while also supporting critical initiatives across the Google Distributed Cloud (GDC).

This role combines strong product management expertise with a practical understanding of enterprise storage systems, customer requirements, technical use cases, and go-to-market execution. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering, product leadership, customers, partners, field teams, and PMs across NetApp to define roadmap priorities, negotiate tradeoffs, and translate customer and market requirements into scalable ONTAP platform capabilities.

A key part of the role will be partnering across the NetApp product portfolio to support GDC requirements, unlock new customer use cases, and identify platform dependencies and opportunities that extend beyond individual products. The PM will help connect strategic customer requirements to broader NetApp platform priorities and ensure that investments can benefit both GDC and the wider NetApp customer base.

The role will also help shape future infrastructure requirements driven by the rapid growth of AI workloads, including evolving needs around performance, scale, data access, automation, Kubernetes, distributed infrastructure, and cloud-like operating models. The PM will work across NetApp product teams to identify where ONTAP platform capabilities need to evolve to support next-generation AI and data-intensive workloads while continuing to meet enterprise requirements for resiliency, security, scale, and efficiency. The role is expected to unlock new use cases, expand NetApp’s footprint, and support customers that need modern infrastructure experiences in on-prem, edge, regulated, or sovereign environments.

Job Requirements

  • Drive strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for core ONTAP Platform capabilities based on customer requirements, technical use cases, market needs, and business priorities.
  • Lead hyperscaler execution for Google Distributed Cloud, working across ONTAP, Trident, StorageGRID, and related NetApp teams to align requirements and deliver integrated portfolio capabilities.
  • Partner closely with engineering and product leadership to define feature scope, negotiate tradeoffs, sequence investments, and deliver solutions that meet both GDC needs and broader NetApp customer requirements.
  • Translate customer, partner, and field input into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories, success metrics, and adoption plans.
  • Identify new use cases, adoption blockers, and footprint expansion opportunities for ONTAP and NetApp portfolio capabilities in enterprise, edge, regulated, and sovereign environments.
  • Use competitive, market, partner, and customer insights to influence roadmap decisions, investment priorities, and business outcomes.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, synthesis, requirements, analysis, and communication while maintaining clear product judgment and ownership.
  • Represent NetApp in customer engagements, partner meetings, executive briefings, and internal roadmap discussions.

Qualifications and Education

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management, product marketing, business consulting, or business operations related relevant experience.
  • Experience defining and executing product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle plans for enterprise infrastructure products.
  • Strong inbound and outbound product management experience, including customer discovery, technical requirements, competitive analysis, positioning, launch readiness, and adoption.
  • Comfort leading customer-facing engagements, including executive briefings, workshops, and partner reviews.
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering and product leadership to prioritize roadmap work, negotiate tradeoffs, and deliver customer-ready features.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve product research, requirements analysis, communication, or workflow efficiency is a plus.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to influence executives and external partners.

  • Experience working in the enterprise storage and data management industry; familiarity with NetApp and competitors.
  • Experience in networking, protocols, security, and edge-cloud infrastructure domains is a plus.
  • Understanding of AI data infrastructure, automation, and storage requirements of AI-driven workloads.

Education

A bachelor's degree is required. Master of Business Administration (MBA) preferred and/or relevant experience.

This individual will be instrumental to supporting the development of streamlined processes that enables team collaboration for efficient service provision to farmers.

Essential Responsibilities

Farmer Services Team Support (60%)

  • Work with the Farmer Services team to streamline intake and case management processes, identify and develop outreach materials for addressing farmers’conservation needs, and ensure provision of assistance tailored to farmers’ needs.
  • Manage multiple team administrative activities, including scheduling team meetings and creating meeting agendas, completing program reports, submitting content for RAFI’s monthly e-newsletter, developing organization of program Google Drive files, and ensuring consistent adoption of metrics and evaluation processes across the team.
  • Work with the Farmers of Color Network and Farmer Service teams to plan, promote, and support events, gatherings, webinars, and trainings — including sending invitations, reminders, and follow-up communications through email, coordinating outreach; supporting cross-team coordination for multi-program events; and assisting with logistics for webinars and virtual or live gatherings.

Southeast Conservation Network Support (40%)

  • Provide administrative support to develop and maintain efficient project management progress for the Southeast Conservation Network
  • Serve as the main point of contact for network members and lead coordination of network gatherings, trainings, and workshops
  • Collect, review, and manage reporting and payment request processes for SE Conservation partners

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Active listener and learner. Self-starter: can take initiative both on projects and work plans, and seek information independently
  • Experience with data entry, data reporting, and working with a CRM. Proficiency in Salesforce preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Willingness to learn and work with remote staff
  • Attention to detail and strong ability to follow through on tasks
  • Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills
  • Dedication to RAFI’s values

Desired Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Fluency in Spanish
  • Experience working with nonprofit organizations
  • Comfort with ambiguity and flexibility
  • Experience in agriculture and working with farmers

Compensation: Part time, non-exempt. Hourly rate of $36.75 based on 20 hours/week. The ideal candidate will be available to work their hours during RAFI’s business hours of 9-5 p.m. Eastern. Part-time employees can participate in RAFI’s 401(k) program and paid holidays.

Location: Remote, with priority given to applicants based in the southeast US or Puerto Rico. Employees based in the Triangle area of North Carolina are encouraged to spend 2 days a month in our Pittsboro office.

How to Apply: Applicants should submit a resume, cover letter and professional references. We will accept applications until the position is filled. In your cover letter, please state why you are interested in working for RAFI and share any skills or experiences you have that make you an ideal candidate for this position. Please no calls or emails.

About RAFI:Rural Advancement Foundation International-USA (RAFI) challenges the root causes of unjust food systems, supporting and advocating for economically, racially, and ecologically just farm communities. We envision a thriving, sustainable, and equitable food system where farmers and farmworkers have dignity and agency; where they are supported by just agricultural policies; and where corporations and institutions are accountable to their community.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Remote B2B SaaS)
description:
About Ketch

Ketch is modern privacy management software that keeps customer data clean, permissioned, and AI-ready, so brands can power growth without regulatory or reputational risk.

The market came to us. GDPR and CCPA turned privacy from a legal afterthought into a funded, board-level requirement, and the wave of US state laws that followed means most enterprises are now managing a patchwork of overlapping obligations with tooling that was never built for it. AI sharpens the problem further: models are only as trustworthy as the permissions underneath them, and companies are finding that the data they have is not always data they are allowed to use.

That is the wedge. Ketch is a SaaS platform that sits underneath the customer data stack, capturing and enforcing permissions across every device, browser, system, and model a brand touches. It turns compliance spend into an asset by making previously unusable data available for advertising, analytics, and AI.

The results are measurable, and they are what you will sell on:

  • 80% improvement in operational efficiency through workflow automation
  • 23% lift in customer purchase intent when data collection practices are built around transparency, control, retention, and clear data sharing
  • 12x ROI against legacy tooling, with low-code maintenance and auditable records that stand up to a regulator

Customers back that up publicly. Ketch holds a 4.6 out of 5 satisfaction score on G2 across more than 140 verified reviews, and earned 22 badges across 41 reports in the Summer 2026 cycle, spanning consent management, DSAR, data privacy management, cookie tracking, and sensitive data discovery.

Ketch ranks #1 in Enterprise Usability, Results, and Relationship for consent management, and #1 in DSAR Momentum. Fewer than one in fifty products across G2's reports earn Leader recognition at all.

For a seller, this is a rare combination: a category with mandatory budget behind it, a buyer actively looking for an answer, third-party proof that shortens every deal, and a product that gets to talk about revenue rather than risk avoidance.

About Our Team:

The successful candidate will join our team of Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Inside Sales Representatives, and BDRs. Through our work, we bring Ketch values of passion, growth, grit, collaboration, and integrity to life. Ketch is growing rapidly and we’re scaling our team to help further accelerate our growth. Our new colleague will enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.

About The Role:

In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of potential customer challenges, appropriately map Ketch solutions to needs, understand organizational dynamics, quantify business value, shape the business case for action and close business. The successful candidate will work well with colleagues across other functions including marketing, customer experience, product management, legal, and finance.

Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Generation – Source and qualify new business opportunities that fit our ICP. Develop roughly 30% of your annual book of business. Advance inbound and partner generated opportunities. Maintain appropriate pipeline hygiene and coverage.
  • Relationship Development – Gain a deep understanding of the target customer’s business, relevant processes and challenges. Ensure the right questions are being asked and answered. Bring unique value to every interaction. Develop relationships with multiple buying personas within the account.
  • Value Framing – Connect a prospect’s business objectives (both functional and corporate) with the Ketch solution. Do the math. Construct a compelling business case. Pain the picture of a better future. Tell the story.
  • Sales Execution – Conduct effective account discovery. Apply MEDDPICC throughout the sales cycle. Develop pitch and proposal material as appropriate. Make responsible, effective use of company assets. Handle objections. Document activities in Salesforce. Drive opportunities to Closed/Won.
  • Product Knowledge – Develop high-level functional and technical understanding of Ketch products. Align product demonstrations to customer needs.

Experience

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying, consultative sales at a SaaS company

  • 2+ years of average deal sizes in range from $150K to $500K

Qualifications and Characteristics

  • Demonstrated ability to translate a technical solution into measurable business value
  • Results-driven mindset and proven ability to beat sales targets
  • History of success in working as part of a virtual global team environment
  • Exceptional time management and people alignment skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • Able to legally work in the United States
  • English language fluency (spoken and written)
