title: Sr. Product Manager (Oil & Gas)
description:
About Us:

Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality. We serve customers in the solar, wind, insurance, construction, real estate, and critical infrastructure industries. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions. Take a look at our latest achievements here!

This role in one paragraph:

Be the voice of the customer for an entire industry at Zeitview. You will be Zeitview's resident expert for our Oil & Gas vertical. You own problem definition: understanding what enterprise customers in your vertical actually need, why they need it, and what it's worth. You run discovery, build client relationships alongside sales, synthesize market signals, and translate all of that into clear, prioritized requirements that our platform product managers and engineering teams can execute against. You are responsible for competitive intel and defining metrics to demonstrate the success of the product and strategies. You should be growth focused. You will not just iterate on our existing product/service offerings but propose business cases and GTM for expanding our offerings. You do not own the product backlog or ship software directly, you own the "what" and "why," then work with solutions-side PMs to negotiate the "how" and "when."

What you'll actually do in the first 6 months:

  • Define what "success" looks like for the Oil & Gas vertical in terms that connect to revenue, retention, and customer outcomes, not just feature delivery
  • Embed with 3–5 strategic accounts within our Oil & Gas portfolio. Not to sell, but to understand their inspection workflows, pain points, and decision-making structures deeply enough to write requirements they'd recognize as their own
  • Run structured discovery across a mix of methods (customer interviews, operational ride-alongs, competitive analysis, usage data) and synthesize findings into a prioritized problem set for your vertical
  • Negotiate with platform PMs over engineering capacity, making the case for your vertical's priorities with data and customer evidence, not volume
  • Write requirements that hold up under engineering scrutiny: specific enough to build from, flexible enough to serve platform-wide
  • Build internal credibility as the person who knows your industry better than anyone else in the building

This role is NOT:

  • A platform-building role. You will not own a product backlog, write technical specs, or ship software with engineers day-to-day. If that's what you're looking for, see our Senior Product Manager - Asset Insights posting.
  • A pure strategy role, with no customer contact. You will be on calls with enterprise clients regularly. You will travel to sites. You will see the physical infrastructure your product serves.
  • A people management role. You will coordinate across functions and informally guide others, but you will not have direct reports.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in a science, technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 8+ years of professional experience, with 5+ years in product management, solutions consulting, technical sales, or a comparable customer-facing role in enterprise software
  • Deep domain expertise in Oil & Gas. "Deep" means you can walk onto a customer site and understand what you're looking at: the assets, the inspection workflows, the regulatory context, and the business model.
  • You have a track record of building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and converting those relationships into product insight, not just feature requests, but an understanding of underlying needs
  • You can run structured discovery and synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into a prioritized problem set that other teams can act on
  • You have commercial acumen: you understand how product decisions connect to pipeline, deal size, retention, and competitive positioning in your vertical
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can present to a customer's VP of Asset Management on Monday and translate that conversation into a product brief for solutions PMs and Engineering on Tuesday
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites and inspection locations

Strongly preferred: These will move you to the top:

  • Experience working with operational or service delivery teams (field inspection, drone operations, or similar)
  • Experience with geospatial data, remote sensing, or asset management platforms
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-powered products, enough to assess where these capabilities address real vertical problems vs. where they're a distraction
  • Experience with go-to-market strategy: product launches, positioning, pricing, or vertical-specific marketing
  • Experience in mobile application development

What’s Included:

  • Feel great about your work as you join a leading mission-driven intelligent aerial imaging company - our goal is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure, and you personally will play a large part in making this happen!
  • Competitive base salary, annual bonus and stock options
  • Your choice of multiple medical insurance plans, including options with an HSA and 100% coverage of the premium for yourself and your dependents
  • Unlimited PTO: We mean it when we say we prioritize work-life balance and mental health
  • Autonomy and upward mobility
  • Diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture: a place where your voice matters

This role has a base salary range of $160,000 - $180,000 USD, plus a target annual bonus and eligibility for stock options. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location within USA.

Zeitview is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At Zeitview, we believe in cultivating an environment where our team members can bring their authentic, whole selves to work. Encouraging identity and belonging is one of the many aspects of our culture that makes us stronger as an organization and drives innovation. We are committed to building and delivering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workforce that includes age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion or veteran status, that is representative of the world around us, where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity - and to act swiftly if this value is ever threatened. We are constantly striving to be better, and we continue to take strategic steps to advance representation.

We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for seriously held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law.

Our purpose is simple: building a better world through the power of photography. POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Manager - Innovations Waiver (IW) to join our Care Management Team! The Care Manager – IW is responsible for providing complex care coordination and monitoring to members having a primary Intellectual or Developmental Disability, which may include secondary mental health or substance abuse, and/or complex medical/physical health needs. This position requires a dynamic, proactive approach to assessment, monitoring, and complex coordination of care, to ensure quality support and consistent adherence to waiver requirements. The Care Manager – IW assists with integrated care management through multi-disciplinary collaboration and referrals. This position has a primary focus on members who have Intellectual Developmental Disability, serving both children, adolescents, and adults. The individual must be dependable, organized, able to multitask, and communicate effectively, with strong reasoning and problem‑solving skills, including in crisis situations.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Utilize person centered planning methods/strategies to gather information, to get to know the members supported and to adequately address specific needs of the individual.
  • Provide education and support to members in learning about and exercising rights and responsibilities.
  • Consistently complete Discovery activities (information gathering and assessment) as a component of the planning process.
  • Ensure that members/legally responsible people are informed of services available (all types of Medicaid and state-funded services), service options available (e.g. Individual/Family Direction for Innovations participants), processes (e.g. requirements for specific service), Natural and community services, and so forth.
  • Assist members/legally responsible people in choosing service providers, ensuring objectivity in the process.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must meet QP status.
  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR
  2. A graduate of a college or university with a Master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  4. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a field other than human services and has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling.
  • Additionally, If serving members with LTSS needs, the care manager, must meet the minimum QP requirements defined above (A-D) and shall additionally have at a minimum two (2) years of prior LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring and care management experience. This experience may be concurrent with the years of experience required to become a Qualified Professional.
  • License and/or certification may be accepted as noted above.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside in Trillium’s North Central Region, which includes the following counties: Beaufort, Dare, Edgecombe, Greene, Hyde, Nash, Pamlico, Pitt, Tyrrell, Washington and Wilson.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship for employment now or in the future (ex: OPT F-1, J-1).

Preferred:

  • Experience with the Innovation Waiver or IDD population.
  • Care management experience.

Deadline for Application:November 13, 2026 11:59 PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (Researcher) – Pricing
description:
We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist (Pricing) to design and evolve dynamic pricing systems for our marketplace. You will develop pricing as a feedback-driven decision system, balancing supply, demand, and business outcomes under uncertainty and delayed signals. Unlike traditional surge-based pricing, our marketplace operates on a unique bid-based pricing model, where prices are shaped through direct negotiation between riders and drivers. This creates a fundamentally different optimization problem, requiring advanced approaches to modeling user behavior, incentives, and marketplace dynamics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and improve dynamic pricing policies, including elasticity and supply/demand response modeling
  • Frame pricing as a decision system under uncertainty and delayed feedback
  • Develop, test, and deploy real-time pricing algorithms
  • Design and analyze A/B experiments to evaluate pricing impact
  • Productionize models in collaboration with engineering, ensuring scalability and robustness
  • Monitor system performance, including stability, feedback effects, and long-term behavior
  • Contribute to methodological choices (e.g., optimization, control, RL-inspired approaches)

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Research, or algorithmic product optimization, preferably in marketplaces or pricing systems
  • Strong background in statistics, optimization, and causal inference
  • Proven ability to move from problem formulation to production-grade solutions
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and experience with production ML systems

Nice to Have
  • Experience with economic modeling (elasticity, auctions, policy design)
  • Familiarity with control systems, RL, or online optimization
  • Experience working with real-time, high-load systems

Why join us

  • Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 1100+ cities in 48 countries
  • Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs
  • Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program
  • Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects
  • Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow
  • Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs

We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. title: Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE)
description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Information System Security Engineer (ISSE) to design, implement, and validate security controls for Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure and mission applications supporting Department of War mission partners. The ISSE will engineer secure solutions across development, deployment, and operations.

This hands-on role focuses on security architecture, hardening, AWS cloud and container security, automation, vulnerability remediation, and technical testing. The ISSE will work with engineers, the Information System Security Manager (ISSM), and the Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to implement controls and provide evidence supporting authorization and continuous monitoring.

This remote position requires an active Secret security clearance. Periodic travel may be required for integration, assessments, customer meetings, and access to approved facilities. All classified work must be performed in approved facilities.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Translate mission needs and security requirements into system architectures, control implementations, secure configurations, and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Perform threat modeling and security design reviews; identify trust boundaries, attack surfaces, data flows, dependencies, and technical risks before deployment.
  • Engineer and implement security controls for AWS infrastructure, Linux systems, containers, Kubernetes, application interfaces, and supporting services in coordination with system owners.
  • Configure and validate identity and access controls, least-privilege permissions, network segmentation, encryption, certificates, secrets management, audit logging, and security monitoring.
  • Apply Defense Information Systems Agency Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and approved hardening baselines; test changes for security effectiveness and mission impact.
  • Integrate security scanning and checks into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, including code, dependency, container-image, secrets, and infrastructure-configuration checks.
  • Use scripting, infrastructure as code, and configuration automation to deploy repeatable security controls, detect configuration drift, and collect technical evidence.
  • Analyze vulnerability findings, validate applicability, implement fixes, and retest remediation; propose compensating controls for authorized review when immediate correction is not feasible.
  • Develop and execute security verification tests, support authorized assessments, and troubleshoot issues involving application, network, cloud, identity, and container security controls.
  • Produce security diagrams, configuration baselines, control implementation details, and test evidence supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities and Authority to Operate (ATO) packages.
  • Coordinate technical remediation and closure evidence with the ISSO and ISSM; document residual risks and recommendations for government risk decisions without independently accepting risk.
  • Assess proposed system changes, maintain engineering documentation and runbooks, and support incident investigation, recovery, and corrective actions with responsible operations teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain Top Secret if required by the assignment.
  • Minimum of five years of relevant experience in systems security engineering, cybersecurity engineering, cloud security, secure platform engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, troubleshooting, and validating security controls. Policy review or compliance documentation experience alone does not satisfy this requirement.
  • Experience engineering or securing Department of Defense (DoD) information systems, including systems operating on or connected to the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN).
  • Demonstrated hands-on professional experience implementing, securing, operating, and troubleshooting AWS workloads. Candidates must be able to describe AWS environments they supported, security controls they personally implemented, and remediation they validated. AWS certification or coursework alone, or experience limited to other cloud providers, does not satisfy this requirement.
  • Practical experience with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), security groups, compute and storage security, encryption, and AWS logging and monitoring, including AWS CloudTrail and Amazon CloudWatch.
  • Experience hardening and troubleshooting Linux systems and containerized workloads, with working knowledge of Kubernetes security controls.
  • Experience using scripting, infrastructure as code, or configuration-management tools to automate security tasks, and working with source control and software delivery pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, firewalls, network segmentation, secure application connectivity, certificates, encryption, and identity and access management.
  • Experience applying RMF requirements, NIST SP 800-53 controls, STIGs, vulnerability scanning, and remediation practices to technical implementations and authorization evidence.
  • Current relevant cybersecurity certification and ability to meet applicable contractual workforce qualifications, including DoD 8140 work-role requirements where applicable.
  • Strong technical writing, troubleshooting, and coordination skills; ability to work independently with distributed engineering teams and support periodic travel. A college degree is not required.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience securing AWS GovCloud environments or Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), including workloads supporting DoD Impact Level 4, 5, or 6.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, GitLab, Helm, policy as code, hardened container images, software bills of materials, artifact signing, or automated security evidence collection.
  • Experience engineering Zero Trust controls, Common Access Card authentication, DoD public key infrastructure integration, or secure interfaces between approved mission environments.
  • Experience supporting eMASS or another government authorization system through engineering artifacts, control implementation details, assessment responses, and remediation evidence.
  • Experience supporting Special Operations Forces, combatant commands, mission software, AI-enabled platforms, or robotics and autonomous-system programs.
  • CISSP, ISSEP, CCSP, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist, cloud security, or another relevant advanced technical certification.
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline.

The target salary range for this position is $92,075 - $158,138.

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.  

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
Everyday Speech is a no-prep digital curriculum that makes teaching social, behavioral, and communication skills easy and effective. The MTSS-aligned curriculum combines evidence-based video modeling, interactive web games, and worksheets to provide educators everything they need to support both neurodiverse and neurotypical PK-12 students. Everyday Speech is trusted by 50,000+ special educators, speech-language pathologists, counselors, and other specialists for targeted interventions and whole-class lessons that help students build the skills they need to thrive.

Everyday Speech is right for you if:

You care about making a positive impact.

End each day knowing your work directly impacted educators across North America in our mission to build the most impactful PreK-12 social skills curriculum and make teaching it effortless. Success goes beyond shipping features here; we’re improving the lives of educators and their students. To achieve this, we create meaningful content, stay closely connected to our users, and maintain consistently high NPS scores as a fully bootstrapped company growing organically and sustainably.

You value being a part of a company that takes care of its team.

Not only do we have extremely happy team members, we also have incredible perks. Participate in our health/wellness and retirement benefit offerings, and between having every other Friday off (3-day weekends!) and our flexible PTO plan, that elusive work-life balance is an actual thing here. We’ve also never had an office and never will. We take remote work seriously and know how to support a distributed team. We give you the flexibility to work in a way that’s best for you, but still have high standards and accountability. These are just some of the reasons why our eNPS score from 2025 was 78.

You want to be at a company whose values are more than just words on a wall.

Our values are at the forefront of our decisions, how we recognize each other, how we challenge ourselves—everything we do. Our values mean something, and with that guiding light, we are able to land with clarity, create alignment, identify our strengths, and move with purpose. Hear it directly from a team member: “I love the values. I never imagined I could end up in a position that was so connected to the things that mattered to me most”.

As a member of the Growth team, the Demand Generation Manager will own how educators discover and choose to try Everyday Speech, through product-led content drawn from our product and the clinical expertise behind it. This is an individual contributor role for a strategic marketer and strong writer who can set the demand strategy and also do the work: create, publish, promote, measure, and iterate.

You will own net-new demand across webinars, community and creators, partnerships, email, paid social, website content and search, including AI answers. You'll partner closely with our clinical team, who bring the expertise that makes our content credible, and with the rest of the marketing team and Sales to make sure content reaches the right people and moves them forward.

The ideal candidate is extremely values aligned:

● We start with empathy— in the work we do and the people we do it with. Our strength comes from a culture that values candidness, trust, and valuing our teammates as whole human beings. We care, challenge, and communicate. We are serious about our responsibility to educators, who rely on us every day.

● We ruthlessly prioritize. We don ’t just say no to the obvious stuff, we say no to the things that feel important in the moment because we understand anything we say yes to is inherently saying no to something else.

● We create momentum. We don’t let the small stuff hold us back. We learn by shipping. We know most actions are reversible and that action always wins in the long run. If all else fails, bias towards action.

● We are fearlessly objective. We don't do things just because we're "supposed to." We constantly ask "why" and don’t let conventional norms define our efforts. We're not afraid to seek answers, even if that means discovering we were wrong. We focus on what delivers results, regardless of the source.

● We exercise agency. We have the ability to create systems that don’t yet exist to get what we need or to solve problems no one has identified. If something isn’t working, it’s within our control to fix it.

● We’re driven to grow. We set ambitious goals because we want to maximize our impact. We embrace challenges and take risks, seeing failures as opportunities to learn and improve. We seek out feedback and coaching and thrive in environments that push us.

Your work will have a significant impact on how we drive new contacts, product signups, and pipeline, and will shape how educators and district leaders come to know and trust Everyday Speech.

In this role, you will:

  • Own Everyday Speech's demand generation strategy and product-led content calendar, planned around the school year, choosing the topics and formats that drive new contacts, form submissions, and product sign-ups.
  • Decide which channels we invest in, including new ones, how we show up on each, and how each moves educators into and through the funnel.
  • Lead with product-led content: our free resources, lead magnets, and SEO pages come from the product itself, so educators experience Everyday Speech through the content they find.
  • Own all website content, including resources, blog posts, landing pages and lead magnets, and the path from content to signup: CTAs, gated and ungated offers, and conversion testing.
  • Own our webinar program end to end: topics, speakers, CEU partnerships, promotion, and follow-up.
  • Partner with our clinical team to turn their expertise into content, including organic social, and to put their credibility in front of the educators who trust it.
  • Grow co-marketing partnerships with associations, CEU providers, and aligned organizations, from co-hosted webinars to guest content.
  • Own and produce our monthly content email calendar, grow our email audience, and build campaigns that distribute content.
  • Own paid promotion as a core lever, building on our Meta ads strategy and testing other paid channels.
  • Own search as one channel among many, including SEO and especially AEO, so educators find us in search results and in AI-generated answers.
  • Partner with the marketing team on case studies, customer stories, account-based content, and enablement content for Sales and Customer Success, leading development where relevant.
  • Shape how we tell the Everyday Speech story and set the standards behind it: voice and style guide, clinical accuracy review, and a high bar for AI-assisted work.
  • Own demand results (new contacts, product signups, webinar registrations and pipeline contribution), treating content as an experiment and reporting on what works.

What We’re Looking For

In addition to values alignment…

  • 5+ years in growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or EdTech with a product-led motion, including time owning a content strategy rather than only executing one.
  • A track record of growing leads and pipeline across multiple channels. SEO experience and a point of view on how AI search is changing it are a plus.
  • Exceptional writing and editing. You make complex topics clear and useful, and you can tell expert content from generic content.
  • Experience translating subject-matter expertise (clinical, education, or similar) into content that practitioners trust.
  • Experience running webinars or events that drive registrations and follow-up engagement.
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and content promotion, including managing contractors or agencies.
  • A data-driven approach: you set goals, read the numbers in HubSpot, Google Analytics, or Semrush, and change course without being told.
  • Strong project management. You can run an editorial calendar across several stakeholders and contractors and ship on time.
  • Thoughtful use of AI in your workflow, paired with high standards for originality and accuracy.
  • Genuine interest in K-12 education and empathy for the SLPs, special educators, and counselors we serve. Familiarity with school audiences or district buying is a plus.
  • High ownership: you treat content like your part of the business and follow through.

We know great candidates come from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re passionate about what we’re building at Everyday Speech, don’t hesitate to apply—even if you’re not sure you meet every qualification.

In the short term (the first 3 months), you will:

  • Audit our existing website content, search performance, conversion paths, and content library to find what still works, what's outdated, and the biggest gaps to close first.
  • Build a 6-month content plan tied to Growth team goals, with clear success metrics for each channel.
  • Take over active SEO and AEO projects and contractor relationships as part of the broader channel plan.
  • Relaunch a regular webinar program, with a calendar of topics and speakers.
  • Set up a working rhythm with the clinical team for content and social, including review and approval workflows.
  • Learn our audience by talking with educators, shadowing Sales and Customer Success, and reviewing what our best-performing content has in common.
  • Establish a monthly reporting cadence on each channel's contribution to new contacts, signups, and pipeline.

In the Long term, you will:

  • Own a demand engine that reliably drives a measurable share of new contacts, product signups, and pipeline.
  • Grow organic search and AI answer visibility for the topics our audience cares about most.
  • Run a webinar program that educators look forward to and that consistently fills the top of the funnel.
  • Support district expansion with ABM content and the case studies and customer stories our teams need.
  • Build a community of educator advocates, creators, and partners who extend our reach well beyond our own channels.
  • Turn our clinical team's credibility into a durable trust asset across social, webinars, and the website.
  • Build the case for scaling demand, documenting what it produces, what it requires, and where more investment would pay off.

Salary: $112,200 USD annually, plus company performance-based bonuses, paid out twice per year, for $119,300 TCC.

Qualifications

title: Director, Marketing Technology
description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

Marketing at Step runs on data. Every acquisition channel, lifecycle campaign, rewards drop, and measurement decision depends on clean, connected, well-modeled data flowing between our product, our warehouse, and a dozen marketing platforms. Today, much of that work lands on engineering. We're hiring a Director, Marketing Technology, to own it end-to-end.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role for someone with a software or data engineering background who wants to apply that skill set to growth. You'll be the architect and operator of Step's marketing technology stack: owning our ad channel and attribution integrations, managing our vendor ecosystem (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and others), building the data models and analytical tooling the marketing team runs on, and shipping the monthly rewards and offers that drive engagement. You'll act as the bridge between Marketing, Product, and Engineering taking on the technical work that currently pulls engineers away from the core product, and raising the bar on what marketing can measure, automate, and personalize.

You'll start as a hands-on individual contributor with the opportunity to build and lead a marketing technology team as the function scales.

In this role, you will:

Own the marketing technology stack

  • Own the architecture, roadmap, and day-to-day operation of Step's martech ecosystem including CDP, MMP, lifecycle messaging, data aggregation, and analytics tooling along with the documentation, QA, and governance standards that keep it reliable and privacy-compliant
  • Manage all marketing technology partners (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and similar), including evaluation, implementation, optimization, and contract/renewal input

Build and optimize ad channel and measurement integrations

  • Configure, validate, and maintain integrations with paid channels (Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar), including server-side conversion APIs, event schemas, setup counting methods, attribution windows, and first-party audience syncs
  • Own attribution and mobile measurement (AppsFlyer/Segment): SKAN/postback configuration, conversion windows, deduplication, and channel-level data quality
  • Partner on GA4 implementation including event taxonomy, funnel conversion configuration, and custom reporting; leveraging GA4 data to fill attribution gaps across channels and inform incrementality analysis

Be the data backbone of the marketing team

  • Build and maintain the pipelines and data models that power marketing reporting, audience segmentation, and campaign measurement with identity, event, and audience definitions kept consistent across product, warehouse, and activation platforms
  • Develop self-serve analytical tools, dashboards, and automations so marketers can answer their own questions (ie. spend pacing, funnel conversion, LTV, incrementality)

Ship marketing programs

  • Own the technical build of Step's monthly rewards and offers program end to end targeting logic, delivery, tracking, and post-campaign readout
  • Support lifecycle and CRM campaign execution in Braze: triggers and data feeds

Partner across the company

  • Serve as marketing's technical counterpart to Product, Engineering, and Data scoping requests, setting priorities, and taking build work off engineering's plate

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 7+ years across software engineering, data engineering, or marketing technology, with meaningful time spent as a hands-on engineer
  • Proven experience owning a modern martech stack at a consumer company: CDP (Segment or similar), MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), and lifecycle platforms (Braze or similar)
  • Strong SQL and working proficiency in a scripting language (Python or JavaScript); comfortable with APIs, webhooks, event-driven architectures, and cloud data warehouses
  • Deep understanding of mobile and web attribution: conversion APIs, SKAdNetwork, postbacks, deduplication, and incrementality
  • A clear communicator who bridges marketing, engineering, and executive audiences
  • You are hungry for action and you'd rather ship a working solution this week than a perfect one next quarter
  • Experience operating martech at larger scale, ideally through viral moments or campaign-driven traffic spikes

Some of the technology we use:

  • Kotlin
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • Dagger
  • Postgres
  • JOOQ
  • BigQuery
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform

Logistics

Location: Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

title: Gestionnaire de livraison, IA
description:
Joignez-vous à nesto — fièrement nommée Canadian Rocketship 2025. Une entreprise Deloitte Fast 50 qui bouleverse une industrie hypothécaire de 2,1 milliards de dollars — en bâtissant l'écosystème hypothécaire de l'avenir.

Pourquoi nous joindre

  • Hypercroissance : Deloitte Fast 50 — 3 années consécutives
  • Crédibilité au sein de la communauté tech : TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Leadership dans l'industrie : CLA Lending Company of the Year — 4 années consécutives
  • Aimant à talents : CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025
  • Technologie de confiance : au service des grandes institutions financières partout au Canada
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale fondée sur la confiance, la rapidité, une ambition assumée, la force du collectif, et une obsession sans relâche pour nos clients.

À propos de nesto

Leader canadien en technologie hypothécaire. nesto gère plus de 73 G$ CA en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux, avec plus de 1 000 membres d'équipe répartis dans 12 bureaux à travers le pays. Nous combinons technologie, données et une approche axée sur l'humain pour réinventer la façon dont les Canadiens et Canadiennes vivent l'une des décisions financières les plus importantes de leur vie.

Lieu de travail

Ce poste est ouvert aux candidats du Québec et de l’Ontario. Il est principalement en télétravail, avec la possibilité de travailler à partir de l’un de nos bureaux dans les deux provinces. Le français est un atout important, puisque nous avons des partenaires partout au Canada.

Pourquoi nous recrutons
Nous permettons à nos partenaires d’améliorer et de simplifier leurs activités de prêt hypothécaire grâce au Nesto Mortgage Cloud. Notre solution SaaS est la technologie hypothécaire infonuagique la plus avancée au Canada. Elle offre une expérience omnicanale de calibre mondial qui accroît systématiquement les volumes, augmente la productivité et réduit les coûts technologiques.

Maestro, notre plateforme de souscription propulsée par l’IA, fonctionne déjà chez nesto. Des agents d’IA y prennent des décisions en temps réel, fondées sur les politiques de crédit. Nous la déployons maintenant auprès de nos clients institutions financières grâce à Nesto Cloud. Pour mener à bien nos prochains projets, nous recherchons un(e) Gestionnaire de livraison, IA pour Maestro, qui se concentrera sur la maîtrise fonctionnelle et la livraison SaaS.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Implémentation à travers les familles de conditions. Vous soutenez chaque agent du chantier du début à la fin : cadrage, cartographie des processus, files d’étiquetage du jeu de référence (golden set), journaux de configuration, ajustement (tuning) et files de divergences en mode fantôme (cas où le résultat de l’agent diffère de la décision du souscripteur).
  • L’équipe de souscripteurs du client. Vous dirigez l’équipe de souscripteurs du client comme un prolongement de votre propre équipe. Vous commencez par un exercice de calibration : les deux équipes étiquettent les mêmes 50 documents, vous mesurez les désaccords et rédigez les règles d’arbitrage. L’étiquetage en production débute ensuite, et vous en gérez le débit.
  • Arbitrage. Vous tranchez toute question ambiguë d’étiquetage ou de politique dans le respect des SLA. Vous faites un triage rigoureux pour que seules les véritables décisions de politique soient transmises à l’expert en souscription.
  • Cartographie des processus et bases de référence de valeur. Vous êtes coresponsable des plans de processus signés et des bases de référence de valeur (interventions, temps de cycle, reprises). Tous les résultats sont mesurés par rapport à celles-ci.
  • Le guide de référence (playbook). Vous documentez les modèles issus du premier chantier et élaborez un guide reproductible pour les implémentations futures.
  • Livrables de programme et dépendances. Vous êtes coresponsable, avec le chargé de projet, des registres RAID (risques, hypothèses, enjeux, dépendances) et des décisions. Vous animez la rencontre bimensuelle de synchronisation des dépendances plateforme-programme (données clients réelles, environnements, calendriers de livraison) et faites remonter les risques rapidement.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Expérience pertinente : de 3 à 5 ans comme gestionnaire d’implémentation, consultant(e) fonctionnel(le), analyste orienté(e) solutions ou dans un rôle similaire axé sur l’implémentation technologique ou la transformation opérationnelle.
  • Maîtrise des systèmes : vous apprenez rapidement des plateformes logicielles complexes et transformez ces connaissances en solutions concrètes pour les opérations du client.
  • Expérience client : vous animez avec assurance des ateliers clients et gérez des équipes clientes.
  • Aisance technique : vous n’avez pas besoin de coder. Vous parlez le langage des gestionnaires de produit techniques et pouvez mener des discussions approfondies sur la logique des systèmes.
  • Autonomie et responsabilité : vous avez dirigé des implémentations clients à titre de principal(e) responsable du résultat fonctionnel et géré des livraisons de bout en bout.
  • Influence : vous orientez les décisions de la haute direction chez le client et faites remonter des améliorations de produit à notre équipe.

Atouts

  • Connaissance du cycle de vie du prêt ou de l’industrie hypothécaire.
  • Expérience du déploiement de projets d’IA ou d’automatisation en contexte opérationnel (étiquetage, échantillonnage d’assurance qualité, gestion des exceptions).
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais.

Vous ne devriez pas postuler si

  • Vous ne souhaitez pas occuper un rôle comportant un contact fréquent avec la clientèle ou de nombreux échanges avec de multiples parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Vous préférez travailler avec des systèmes existants ou simples.
  • Vous n’avez aucune passion pour la technofinance ou la technologie hypothécaire et n’êtes pas prêt(e) à développer une expertise du domaine.

La récompense

  • L'équipe A : Travaillez aux côtés de talents hautement performants en produit, en technologie et dans l'industrie hypothécaire.
  • Croissance accélérée : la pente de votre courbe d'apprentissage ici sera verticale. Vous toucherez à plus de décisions stratégiques en un an que vous ne le feriez en cinq ans ailleurs.
  • Couverture de premier ordre : régime d'avantages sociaux haut de gamme entièrement payé par nesto, incluant une assurance complète et un accès illimité à la télémédecine et aux services de santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Repos et ressourcement : 4 semaines de vacances pour vous permettre de rester au sommet de votre performance.
  • Des outils de premier plan : tout ce dont vous avez besoin pour exécuter sans friction, y compris les outils d'IA qui vous rendent plus rapide.
  • Cadre de travail : l'environnement qui vous rend productif et favorise un véritable travail d'équipe.

Diversité et inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le fruit d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous nous engageons à favoriser une culture de diversité, d'équité, d'inclusion et d'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les personnes LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous.

title: Sr. Technical Recruiter
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Our people are critical to our mission at Jabil. As a result, we need strategic recruiters to build our organization, managing relationships with stakeholders and driving end-to-end sourcing, evaluation, and negotiation in highly competitive markets.


In your role you will:

  • Be responsible for owning the full-cycle recruiting process from intake meeting, to developing and implementing sourcing strategies, screening and interviewing candidates, through offer negotiation.
  • Partner closely with Human Resource Business Partners and Hiring Managers to develop and execute comprehensive sourcing strategies to generate a strong flow of candidates who meet our hiring teams' requirements.
  • Leverage market data along with strong knowledge of our employee value proposition to engage passive candidates and build future candidate pipelines.

Successful candidate will bring the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Deep understanding of how to engage and recruit passive candidates, attracting highly qualified slates and creating partnership with hiring teams to engage candidates and create strong candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
  • Ability to build and maintain network of potential candidates through pro-active market research and on-going relationship management.
  • Strong understanding of behavioral interviewing best practices.
  • Ability to work closely with hiring managers and business leaders to determine the human capital needs of the departments and positions identified to ensure efficient and effective hiring.

You will also support audits, enterprise risk management, policy governance, and continuous improvement across our GRC program.
This opportunity is suited to an early-career GRC or security professional who has moved beyond observation and is ready to independently execute recurring processes, coordinate with stakeholders, analyze evidence, maintain accurate records, and know when a risk or exception requires escalation.

You will independently execute defined GRC processes using established controls, criteria, and escalation paths. You will work across Security, Legal, Procurement, Sales, Customer Success, IT, and other business teams while partnering closely with senior GRC colleagues on higher-complexity risk and compliance matters.
Success means delivering reliable GRC operations, maintaining audit-ready information, identifying issues early, and continuously finding practical ways to make recurring work more efficient.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct third-party security and compliance assessments, reviewing SOC reports, ISO certifications, questionnaires, and other evidence; document findings and track remediation or approved risk treatment.
  • Coordinate vendor assessments from intake and due diligence through reassessment using established risk criteria.
  • Respond to customer security questionnaires, RFPs, and due-diligence requests, maintaining accurate reusable security and control content.
  • Coordinate approved security and compliance artifacts for customers and support internal teams with security-related contractual requests.
  • Administer security awareness activities, including training campaigns, phishing simulations, completion tracking, communications, and program metrics.
  • Plan and execute periodic user access reviews, coordinate with system owners, identify inappropriate or orphaned access, and track remediation and exceptions.

title: Director, Expert Insights and Delphi Methodology
description:
About the Hiring Group

RTI Health Solutions (RTI-HS), a wholly owned subsidiary of RTI International, is an independent and internationally recognized research organization. With offices in the US, UK, Spain, France, and Sweden, we provide healthcare consulting and research expertise to optimize decision making for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device products across the development and marketing lifecycle. Clients rely on our expertise, quality standards, and integrity to guide their product development and regulatory and market access strategies. Our various practice areas include Value, Access, and HEOR; Patient-Centered and Outcomes Research; Epidemiology and Biostatistics; Medical Communications; Global Business Operations; and Strategic Consulting and Growth.

We are seeking a Director to join our Expert Insights team within Medical Communications. As Director, Expert Insights and Delphi Methodology, you will join an experienced, collaborative team that helps clients obtain, interpret, and communicate insights from clinicians, payers, HTA experts, patients, and other stakeholders. You will provide senior methodological and project leadership across Delphi and other consensus-development studies, advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, and qualitative research. You will translate complex stakeholder input into clear findings, implications, recommendations, and scientifically rigorous deliverables that support medical affairs, clinical development, evidence communication, market access, and related business decisions. This role is suited to an experienced leader who can quickly take ownership of active Delphi work and provide expert leadership across ongoing projects

This role’s location is flexible, UK, Spain, France or Sweden and remote working options are available

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Independently design and lead modified and classic Delphi studies and other expert elicitation of consensus exercises from protocol development through expert recruitment, questionnaire development, iterative rounds, analysis, consensus interpretation, and final reporting
  • Define and apply appropriate consensus criteria, stopping rules, analytical approaches, and methods for integrating quantitative results with qualitative rationale
  • Design and lead virtual and in-person advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, and other structured expert-engagement activities
  • Facilitate or moderate discussions with clinicians, payers, patients, caregivers, health technology assessment stakeholders, and other experts
  • Conduct and analyze qualitative interviews using rigorous, fit-for-purpose methods
  • Advise clients and internal teams on the most appropriate methodology for insight-generation and consensus-development that is tailored to intended audiences
  • Develop study protocols, analysis plans, interview and discussion guides, questionnaires, moderator materials, and other data-collection tools
  • Translate stakeholder input and study findings into clear conclusions, implications, recommendations, and strategic narratives
  • Develop and review scientifically accurate, audience-appropriate reports, executive summaries, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, congress materials, and client presentations
  • Identify implications of expert insights for medical strategy, evidence communication, publication planning, stakeholder engagement, and market access
  • Apply appropriate standards for scientific rigor, publication ethics, authorship, transparency, data integrity, and project documentation
  • Manage complex, multidisciplinary projects to agreed scope, quality, timelines, and budgets, including development of workplans, cost estimates, and risk-mitigation approaches
  • Serve as a senior client contact, build trusted relationships, anticipate needs, and provide clear methodological and strategic guidance
  • Scope opportunities and develop proposals that align the research question, methodology, deliverables, schedule, and budget
  • Contribute to business development through capabilities presentations, solution development, thought leadership, and expansion of client relationships
  • Collaborate effectively with medical writers, scientific strategists, editors, project managers, analysts, and other cross-functional partners
  • Build the team’s scientific profile through publication and presentation of work

What You'll Need

  • Advanced degree and at least 5 years of experience in medical communications, clinical research, epidemiology, public health, outcomes research, health services research, health policy, qualitative research, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific discipline
  • Extensive, recent, hands-on experience independently designing and leading modified or classic Delphi studies, including protocol development, expert selection and recruitment, round development, analysis, consensus interpretation, and reporting all in adherence to current methodological guidelines
  • Demonstrated ability to assume leadership of active Delphi projects with limited methodological oversight or onboarding
  • Experience leading virtual and in-person advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, or comparable structured expert-engagement programs
  • Experience designing, conducting, and analyzing qualitative research, including development of protocols, analysis plans, interview guides, questionnaires, and reports
  • Strong scientific writing, synthesis, and data-interpretation skills, with the ability to convert complex evidence and stakeholder input into concise, actionable communications
  • Experience developing publication-quality reports, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, or presentations and familiarity with relevant ethical and reporting standards
  • Experience working directly with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare clients and providing senior-level methodological and strategic counsel
  • Demonstrated success managing complex projects, budgets, timelines, risks, and cross-functional teams
  • Experience scoping opportunities, writing proposals, and presenting capabilities or recommended approaches to clients
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, multitasking environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, collaborate across disciplines, and coach or mentor colleagues
  • A record of peer-reviewed publication, conference presentation, or other relevant scientific thought leadership

Desirable, but not essential:

  • Experience engaging a range of stakeholder types, including clinicians, payers, patients, caregivers, and health technology assessment representatives
  • Knowledge of US or international healthcare, health technology assessment, pricing, reimbursement, or market access environments
  • Experience connecting expert insights to Medical Affairs strategy, integrated evidence communication, publication planning, or stakeholder-engagement planning
  • Experience using virtual engagement platforms, digital collaboration tools, and emerging technologies to support expert panels, qualitative research, insight analysis, and scientific communication
  • Experience supporting health technology assessment, reimbursement, regulatory, or evidence-submission activities
  • Experience with additional research approaches, such as literature reviews, observational or retrospective analyses, patient-reported outcomes, utility assessment, or quality-of-life research

description:
We're looking for a remote Business Intelligence Analyst & Data Engineer for our client in Ireland, who can operate across the full data lifecycle — from building and maintaining reliable data pipelines to designing dashboards and reports that drive business decisions. This role sits at the intersection of data infrastructure and analytics: you'll own how data flows into our systems and how it's ultimately consumed by stakeholders across the organization.

This is a great fit for someone who enjoys both the technical rigor of data engineering and the storytelling/analytical side of BI work, and who wants ownership over an end-to-end data product rather than sitting in just one lane. AI-driven analytics is a growing part of our roadmap, so we're especially interested in candidates who are curious about applying AI/LLM tools to make data more accessible and self-service across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from multiple source systems (CRM, ERP, project management tools, spreadsheets, APIs) into centralized data warehouses or data marts
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across pipelines through validation, testing, and monitoring
  • Optimize data models (star/snowflake schemas) for reporting performance
  • Automate manual data processes and reduce reliance on ad hoc spreadsheet work
  • Manage data source connections, credentials, and refresh schedules
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, latency issues, and discrepancies

Business Intelligence & Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g., in Tableau, Power BI, or similar) that translate raw data into clear, actionable insights
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications
  • Define and maintain a single source of truth for key business metrics (a data dictionary / metrics glossary)
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support strategic decision-making
  • Monitor dashboard usage and proactively improve reports based on stakeholder feedback
  • Document data lineage, business logic, and calculation methodology for transparency and auditability

AI-Enabled Analytics

  • Design and maintain data structures (clean schemas, semantic layers, metric definitions) that are well-suited for consumption by AI agents and natural-language query tools, not just human-facing dashboards
  • Build or support AI-powered reporting assistants/chatbots that let stakeholders ask business questions in plain language and get accurate, governed answers
  • Evaluate and integrate LLM-based tools into the analytics stack (e.g., automated insight generation, anomaly detection, natural-language-to-SQL interfaces)
  • Establish guardrails for AI-generated analysis — certified data sources, citation of underlying data, and validation processes to ensure trustworthy outputs
  • Stay current on AI/BI tooling trends and proactively recommend where automation or AI can reduce manual reporting work

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with department leaders (Sales, Finance, Operations, Professional Services, etc.) to understand data needs and pain points
  • Act as a technical liaison between business teams and IT/engineering on data-related initiatives
  • Support the rollout of new tools, data sources, or automation initiatives (e.g., AI-powered reporting agents, workflow automation platforms)

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 6+ years of experience in a data engineering, BI analyst, or analytics engineering role
  • Strong SQL skills, including experience writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and working with large datasets
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines (custom scripts, or tools like Fivetran, dbt, Airflow, Workato, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with a BI/visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, normalization, star schemas)
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar)
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured data analysis
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or another scripting language for data manipulation and automation
  • Familiarity with CRM/ERP systems (Salesforce, NetSuite) and how operational data flows from them
  • Experience with API integrations and workflow automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) into data workflows — such as natural-language querying, automated report generation, or AI-driven data agents
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agent-based architectures as applied to analytics
  • Experience establishing data governance practices (certified data sources, metric definitions, documentation standards) suitable for both human and AI consumers
  • Prior experience in a Professional Services, Finance, or Operations analytics function

Why aren't they converting? Are we acquiring the right customers? Are they coming back? And most importantly, is any of this actually making the business more profitable?

At Shero Commerce, we help ecommerce brands grow by bringing together paid media, conversion optimization, email marketing, SEO, organic social, and the overall customer experience.

We're hiring a Junior Digital Marketing Strategist who understands how digital marketing channels work together and wants to develop into a well-rounded strategist. Someone who can connect the dots, think critically, use data to make recommendations, and understand how different channels contribute to business growth.

You'll work closely with senior strategists, account managers, and channel specialists to help turn client business goals into measurable marketing strategies and make sure those strategies translate into results.

What you'll do

Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

  • Help develop cross-channel marketing strategies that connect client business goals to measurable KPIs, channel priorities, and actionable initiatives.
  • Build and maintain 90-day marketing roadmaps across PPC, CRO, Email/SMS, SEO, and Organic Social, working with channel specialists to align priorities.
  • Analyze the customer journey, from acquisition and conversion to retention and repeat purchases, to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Research client businesses, competitors, audiences, and market trends to understand what influences performance.
  • Identify where marketing efforts are falling short and recommend what needs to change, whether that's the campaign, creative, offer, website, or retention strategy.
  • Help prioritize initiatives based on business impact rather than individual channel performance.

Cross-Channel Marketing & Paid Media

  • Apply a working understanding of paid media platforms like Meta Ads and Google Ads to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and contribute to broader marketing strategies.
  • Collaborate with paid media specialists on campaign planning, audience strategy, budget recommendations, creative testing, and performance improvements.
  • Understand how channels like PPC, SEO, CRO, Email/SMS, and Organic Social contribute to acquisition, conversion, retention, and overall business growth.
  • Evaluate marketing performance using metrics like ROAS, CAC, MER, CVR, AOV, and LTV, with an understanding of how these relate to business profitability.
  • Identify opportunities across landing pages, product pages, conversion funnels, customer journeys, and lifecycle marketing.
  • Work with channel specialists to ensure individual tactics support the client's overall strategy and business goals.

Analytics, AI & Strategic Execution

  • Analyze performance across marketing platforms, GA4, Shopify, and reporting dashboards to identify trends, challenges, and growth opportunities.
  • Turn data into clear insights and recommendations that clients and internal teams can act on.
  • Use AI tools regularly to support research, data analysis, competitive insights, strategy development, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  • Demonstrate good judgment when using AI, including validating outputs, questioning recommendations, and applying business context rather than relying on generated answers.
  • Stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and how they can improve marketing strategies, internal processes, and client results.
  • Support monthly performance reviews, quarterly business reviews, and client strategy presentations.
  • Work with project managers and channel teams to translate recommendations into clear priorities and deliverables.
  • Track strategic initiatives, flag delays, and help evaluate whether the work is producing the intended results.
  • Help determine what we should keep doing, what we should change, and what we should stop doing altogether.

What we're looking for

  • 2–3 years of digital marketing experience, ideally with exposure to multiple marketing channels and ecommerce businesses.
  • A strong understanding of cross-channel marketing strategy and how PPC, SEO, CRO, Email/SMS, and Organic Social work together to drive business growth.
  • Practical familiarity with Meta Ads and Google Ads, including campaign structure, targeting, budgets, optimization, and performance analysis. Hands-on campaign management experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with GA4, Shopify, reporting dashboards, and marketing performance data.
  • An understanding of ecommerce metrics like CAC, MER, ROAS, AOV, conversion rate, LTV, and retention.
  • Experience using AI tools in your daily work, with examples of how you've applied them to research, analysis, marketing strategy, reporting, or improving efficiency.
  • The ability to look beyond individual channel metrics and understand how marketing decisions affect overall business performance.
  • Experience contributing to marketing strategies, including setting KPIs, identifying opportunities, recommending channel priorities, and supporting actionable roadmaps.
  • Strong communication, research, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • A proactive approach to client work. You spot problems and opportunities, bring recommendations to the table, ask thoughtful questions, and follow up when something needs attention.
  • The ability to collaborate with channel specialists and project managers to keep marketing initiatives aligned with client goals.
  • Good judgment when prioritizing work based on potential business impact.
  • Comfort discussing performance insights and recommendations with internal teams and clients in clear, confident language.
  • Strong follow-through and accountability for assigned initiatives.

Bonus points: Experience with Shopify, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Looker Studio, StackAdapt, Google Tag Manager, ecommerce conversion optimization, or emerging advertising channels like TikTok, LinkedIn, programmatic, and AI-powered advertising.

You'll thrive here if...

You're naturally curious about how businesses grow. You understand what happens inside advertising platforms, but you don't automatically assume the solution to every marketing problem lives there. If acquisition costs are rising, you want to understand why. If traffic is increasing but sales aren't, you'll look at the website, the offer, and the customer journey. If customers aren't coming back, you'll want to know what we're doing to retain them. You're comfortable with data, enjoy solving problems, and can connect the dots between what the numbers are telling you and what the business actually needs.

You're proactive by nature. When you notice something in the data, you bring it forward with a recommendation instead of waiting for the next meeting. When a client hasn't responded, you follow up. When a project stalls, you find out why and help get it moving again. You already use AI to make your work more effective. You know how to ask better questions, research faster, analyze information, and improve your workflows without losing the critical thinking that makes a good strategist. You don't need to know everything. But you should be eager to learn, comfortable taking ownership, and willing to bring ideas to the table.

Why Shero?

At Shero Commerce, we don't believe in marketing for the sake of marketing. We care about understanding our clients' businesses, finding opportunities that will make a measurable difference, and bringing the right people and channels together to make it happen. You'll work alongside experienced strategists and specialists across paid media, CRO, email, SEO, creative, and ecommerce technology, gaining exposure to different industries, business models, and growth challenges. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to real client strategies, sharpen your analytical skills, explore emerging technologies, and develop into a strategist who can eventually own and lead client accounts. If you want to move beyond individual marketing channels and learn how to grow businesses, we'd love to meet you.

Benefits

Shero offers a competitive benefits package, including private medical insurance, pension, annual leave plus bank holidays, and opportunities for learning and development, within a supportive, inclusive, remote-first team culture. Full details will be provided separately during the hiring process.

Working requirements

Reasonable adjustments will be made in accordance with the Equality Act 2010, both during the recruitment process and in the role. If you need any adjustments to apply or interview, please let us know.

  • Communicate clearly by email, video call, and messaging tools.
  • Review website layouts, functionality, and design, and provide feedback.
  • Operate a computer and standard office equipment efficiently for extended periods.
  • Occasionally travel to internal events or industry conferences
  • Collaborate with diverse personalities, cultures, and work styles.
  • Follow documented processes and procedures with accuracy.

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), remote, UK-based position. We offer flexible working, with core hours of 9:00 am to 3:00 pm Eastern Time (New York), Monday to Friday. During core hours, you will be expected to be working and available for meetings, calls, and messages. This is 2:00 pm to 8:00 pm UK time for most of the year, or 1:00 pm to 7:00 pm UK time for a few weeks each spring and autumn when the U.S. and UK change their clocks on different dates. Your remaining hours can be scheduled flexibly outside the core window, in agreement with your manager.

Diversity and equal opportunity statement

Shero is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud of our diverse and global team and committed to fostering an environment of inclusion and belonging. Diversity is not just a metric; it is a practice we embed in our daily work, decision-making, and leadership. We are committed to fair hiring and employment practices, free from discrimination or harassment of any kind. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a growing team in an ever-evolving digital landscape. Shero is fueled by empathy, grit, curiosity, and collaboration. If you are passionate about your work and want to grow with a team that values you as a whole person, we would love for you to join us.

How to apply

Send us your resume and tell us about two things:

  1. A time you identified a marketing opportunity or solved a performance problem. What did you notice, how did you approach it, and what did you learn?
  2. An example of how you've used AI in your marketing work. Tell us which tools you used, what you used them for, and how they helped you work more effectively or make a better decision.

We're interested in how you think, how you approach problems, and how you use the tools available to you, not just which platforms you've worked in.

About Latino Legends

AtLatino Legends, we connect world-class Latin American professionals with high-growth, innovative companies in the United States. We champion top-tier regional talent, unlocking high-impact career opportunities with leading global brands.

About the Company

Our client is a high-growth, venture-backed connected fitness equipment brand revolutionizing the home and commercial fitness space. Best known for their innovative, tech-enabled stair climbers, they are rapidly expanding into high-performance treadmills, connected equipment, and fitness accessories.

They operate across an omnichannel footprint—spanning direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, top national retail partners, and commercial accounts.
