Description

Help get critical pricing updates in market for Small Commercial products! As the Product Owner for one of our Commercial Auto squads, you'll own the backlog behind the pricing changes that reach our Small Commercial customers and agents, balancing speed, quality, and capacity. You'll work side by side with pricing, product, and technology partners, with real visibility across the portfolio and a direct line to business results. If you love turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear priorities and delivered value, this is your seat.

As a member of the Agile team, the Product Owner represents the voice of the customer and the organization through the delivery of business value. This Product Owner role is within our Small Commercial Risk Pricing space, delivering critical pricing updates to our Small Commercial products. This person works closely with stakeholders (business and technology), including LOB leadership, to define and prioritize features and stories, ensuring alignment with customer needs and organizational goals. This person understands customers` problems in detail and ensures the problems are clearly defined, prioritized and the squad/team is focused on the most valuable work. The Product Owner is the team member always communicating with stakeholders to ensure an aligned understanding of how the squad/team can provide the highest value to the customer through the lens of the portfolio. This person collaborates with squads/teams, technologies and architects across portfolios to develop a deep understanding of the technologies and systems they support.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborates to create product vision and alignment with strategic priorities with stakeholders. Contributes to the development of the portfolio vision. Communicates product and portfolio vision to their squad/team and other squads/teams outside their portfolio/functional area.
  • With the squad/team, collaboratively accountable for developing and achieving product level KPIs. Manages product(s) with a moderate degree of strategy, scope, and complexity.
  • Owns and maintains the product backlog and is accountable for its contents and prioritization. Accountable for clear, actionable user stories.
  • Sets priorities and actively participates in squad/team quarterly planning. Collaborates with more senior Product Owners to set priorities for portfolio quarterly planning.
  • Sets expectations with stakeholders for delivery of new capabilities, features, and functionalities. Participates in squad/team demos, retrospectives, and all other ceremonies.

  • Understands regulatory, compliance, and other industry constraints on the product and prioritizes accordingly. Negotiates with internal and external squads/teams to ensure priorities are aligned across squads/teams both within and outside the portfolio.
  • Collaboratively builds the squad/team product roadmap, contributes to strategy inputs from stakeholders. May contribute to program/portfolio level planning. Influences stakeholder expectations for delivery of new capabilities, features, and functionalities.

  • Leads customer-driven design and usability testing for the squad/team. Collaborates on CDD and UT across the portfolio. Ensures a well-positioned product through market & industry analysis.

  • Hands-on experience as a Product Owner (or equivalent) on an agile team, including backlog ownership, writing clear and actionable user stories, and quarterly planning.

Customer Lifecycle Ownership & Value Realization

title: Regional Sales Manager, North America
description:
Sell Sweetspot to golf venues across North America, then stay with them as their main contact for the long run. Full-cycle sales and account ownership in one role, as one of our first hires in North America.

About Sweetspot

We make golf more valuable — to the player who shows up, the operator who runs the venue, and the game itself. It's the test we hold everything we build to.

Sweetspot is the commercial platform for modern golf facilities: bookings, payments, memberships, dynamic pricing, POS, the player app, revenue management agents and the reporting that finally tells an operator what all of it earns. We build for the facility because that's where golf actually happens. When a venue knows its players, it can give every one of them a reason to come back, and that's how the game grows. Golf will never be worth enough, so we'll never be done.

500+ facilities in 20 countries, built in Sweden — and North America is where we're growing fastest. This is one of the first hires on the ground, so you won't inherit a playbook. You'll write it with us, and every venue you sign is one more place where golf is worth more than it was the year before.

The opportunity

Most range and simulator operators here can't answer the question their business rests on: what is an hour of bay time worth, and when? They price the same bucket at 7am Tuesday as at 6pm Friday. They don't know which bays sit cold or which members quietly stopped coming. The data exists — it's just scattered across a booking tool, a POS, a Toptracer bay and somebody's spreadsheet, none of which talk.

We put it in one place and then do something with it: pricing that fills the cold hours, memberships that make revenue forecastable, utilization and yield reported per bay and per hour. It isn't a software sale. You show an owner what their venue could earn, then stay and make it happen.

What we believe about the relationship

Golf is a small industry and it runs on people. An operator who bought from you does not want to be handed to a stranger the week after go-live — so we don't do that. You keep your customers. You sign them, you see them through the switch, and you're still the name in their phone two years later when they're opening a second site.

That's a deliberate choice. It costs more per rep and it means we hire people who can do both halves of the job. It's also why our customers stay, and why they take our call when we have something new to sell them.

The job

  • Find the opportunities. Roughly 70% of your week. Your own pipeline, your own demos, your own closes. Nobody hands you leads.

  • Own the partner relationships. Toptracer and Range Servant are how much of this market gets built. Be the person their people in your territory actually call — joint visits, shared prospects, and enough standing with them to open doors we'd never open cold. This is your path to high velocity from Day 1.

  • Get customers through the transition. Switching systems is the scariest thing an operator does all year. You own the commercial side of go-live and you train their team yourself. Our Support team takes configuration, migration and the ticket queue, so your time goes into the relationship.

  • Don't be a stranger. Regular contact, on site, with their numbers in hand — what's underpriced, which hours are cold, which members drifted. Show up before they need you, not after.

  • Sell the whole portfolio. Then come back and grow them: memberships, dynamic pricing, vouchers, POS, Pay & Dispense, the app, the second site. Expansion sits in your number, not somebody else's.

Who you are

  • Well-connected in golf where you live. Range owners, simulator operators, academy directors — by first name.

  • A closer. Full-cycle B2B with multiple stakeholders and an install at the end.

  • Comfortable in the numbers. You can build the payback case in front of an owner and defend it without a spreadsheet to hide behind.

  • Someone who wants to own customers, not just deals. You'd rather have twenty operators who trust you than fifty logos you never see again.

  • Able to teach. Standing behind a counter walking a manager through pricing rules is part of this, and you're good at it.

Nice to have

  • Time spent operating a range, golf course, simulator venue or academy.

  • Existing relationships at Toptracer, Range Servant, or in the range-equipment channel.

  • Revenue management, yield or pricing experience from hotels, fitness or ticketing — same problem, different capacity.

  • PGA / LPGA Class A status.

What you get

  • CompetitiveBase + uncapped OTE + potential equity down the line for the right person.

  • Commission that pays on expansion as well as new logos, because you keep the customer.

  • A founder on any deal that needs one. No layers, no committee.

  • Support behind you on config, migration and tickets.

  • Travel covered. Flights, hotels, rental cars, mileage — the road is the job, so you're not funding your own territory.

  • Health, dental, vision, 401(k) match, generous PTO, and a golf budget that gets used.

  • The crew. Small enough that you'll know everyone.

Location

Remote, anywhere in the US. You’ll cover the whole country, so regular travel to venues and partners is part of the job.

You must be authorized to work in the United States. We’re unable to sponsor visas for this role.

How to apply

  • Tell us the three range or simulator operators in your territory you'd call first — and for one of them, what you think they're getting wrong about pricing. Skip the cover letter.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (Strategic Alliances)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

As a Senior Technical Account Manager (Senior TAM, L6) at Affirm, you will own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, delivering against SLAs, fielding technical inquiries, and performing investigations and analysis, while also driving technical initiatives that translate merchant business objectives into technical strategies and product optimizations. Senior TAMs are part of the Engineering team and collaborate closely with Affirm's Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and Frontline Technical Support teams.

This is an operations-heavy role to start. Expect the majority of your early focus to be on keeping merchant integrations healthy—monitoring, triage, troubleshooting, and SLA delivery—while you progressively take on more custom solutioning and cross-functional initiatives. Over your first 6–12 months, as you build operational mastery, you will grow into owning your own book of accounts and carrying it through to end-to-end account ownership.

A Senior TAM independently owns operational health across the strategic alliance portfolio, designs custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations, drives cross-team collaboration on initiatives, acts as a technical lead on team projects, and mentors less-experienced members of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and fielding technical inquiries—so integrations stay healthy and issues are resolved quickly.

  • Deliver against SLAs, proactively surfacing technical risks before they become customer-impacting and responding with urgency to merchant issues.

  • Perform in-depth investigations and root-cause analysis across logs, queries, and integration data, owning resolution end to end and escalating to cross-functional partners or executives when needed.

  • Drive technical initiatives and partner with internal and merchant stakeholders on launch initiatives—expansions, promotions, new product adoption, and integration optimizations—that grow the value of the accounts after launch.

  • Design and deliver high-scope, often-custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations—combining, extending, and tailoring them to complex, open-ended problems while balancing speed, quality, maintainability, reliability, and scalability.

  • Act as a technical lead for internal projects, defining and delivering well-scoped milestones and executing the project roadmap.

  • Operationalize best practices by creating and updating playbooks, runbooks, alerting, and UAT certification plans across the strategic alliance portfolio and continuously reduce keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) work.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering leads to identify, plan, and prioritize projects based on team goals and resources, acting as the voice of the merchant to influence the roadmap.

  • Mentor and level up less-experienced TAMs, share learnings from your integrations and investigations, and contribute to interviewing and team development.

  • Over your first 6–12 months, grow into owning a dedicated book of strategic alliance accounts—carrying operational ownership through to end-to-end account ownership.

What We Look For

  • Professional Background: at least six years in a technical, external-facing role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions/Partner Engineering, or Solutions Architecture—ideally within FinTech, payments, or SaaS—with a demonstrated track record of owning the operational health of technical accounts and delivering against SLAs.

  • Operational Ownership: proven ability to run alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and technical inquiries across a set of accounts, balancing reactive operational work with proactive initiatives.

  • Ownership & Autonomy: proven ability to independently scope and deliver complex, open-ended technical work, and to partner with stakeholders on launch initiatives, with strong project management and follow-through.

  • API Expertise: deep understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and the HTTP protocol, with hands-on experience using tools like Postman to debug and validate integrations.

  • Architecture Fluency: Experience in API integrations and the ability to design custom solutions on top of them to solve complex merchant challenges.

  • Coding & Code Fluency: ability to read and understand production-level code (HTML, JavaScript, SQL, and ideally one server-side language such as Python) and to author new, novel queries to diagnose merchant or system issues.

  • Troubleshooting Acumen: ability to diagnose issues using browser developer consoles, log analysis and observability platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Chronosphere), and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Notion).

  • Technical Communication: excellent verbal and written communication; able to tailor explanations to both non-technical leaders and technical teams, read a room and adjust in real time, and synthesize technical challenges back to internal teams.

  • Relationship Management: ability to discover and develop relationships with technical decision-makers, secure written consensus on integration milestones, and drive cross-team collaboration.

  • Leadership & Mentorship: demonstrated ability to mentor teammates, set best practices, and lead technical initiatives; a growth mindset with self-awareness and a habit of seeking and acting on feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the payments ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with web/mobile application architecture.

  • Experience implementing or customizing e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, or in-store point-of-sale systems.

  • Experience acting as a technical lead on cross-functional projects and influencing product roadmaps.

Equity Grade - 6

FDA approval of AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK delivered the first therapy for women living with recurrent KRAS-mutated low-grade serous ovarian cancer, a rare cancer with significant unmet need. We’ve launched this novel/novel combination therapy in the U.S. and are exploring pathways for Europe and Japan. We continue to advance our pipeline of drugs to help block cancer cell survival, inhibit tumor growth, and overcome treatment resistance. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of cancer care and make a meaningful impact in the lives of patients.

Position Summary

The Associate Director, Medical Training & Medical Information is a key member of the Medical Affairs organization and serves as the central point of contact for accurate, balanced, and compliant medical information to healthcare practitioners and other external stakeholders, as well as internal stakeholders. This role is has two key areas of responsibility: 1) support the design, delivery, and continuous refinement of scientific, disease state, product, and capabilities training strategies for Medical Affairs, with a particular focus on ensuring Field Medical colleagues have the knowledge, resources, and materials necessary to communicate accurate, balanced, and scientifically rigorous medical information; and 2) manage the day-to-day Medical Information operations, including responses to unsolicited medical information requests, content strategy, vendor oversight, and adverse event and product quality complaint intake and reporting.

The role will partner closely with Medical Affairs, Field Medical, Regulatory, Clinical Development, Safety/Pharmacovigilance, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams to ensure medical information responses, field medical materials, and training content are accurate, compliant, timely, and aligned with approved product information.

This individual will serve as the subject matter expert and primary point person for therapeutic area and product-related medical information and will help establish a scalable Medical Information and Field Medical support infrastructure as the organization grows.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Training & Field Medical Enablement

  • Support the development and implementation of learning and development strategies for Medical Affairs, with a focus on the Field Medical organization.
  • Serve as a key Medical Affairs resource for training the Field Medical organization on Medical Information processes, disease state and product information, scientific content, and appropriate use of approved medical materials.
  • Develop and deliver onboarding and ongoing training for MSLs and other Medical Affairs colleagues on product-related medical information, frequently asked questions, scientific data, and available medical resources.
  • Partner with Medical Directors and Field Medical leadership to identify content or training needs based on evolving scientific data, field insights, medical information inquiries, and changes to product information.
  • Develop and maintain training materials, resources, and core content used by Field Medical to support consistent and accurate communication of medical and scientific information, ensuring materials are scientifically accurate, balanced, appropriately referenced, and consistent with approved product information and Medical Affairs strategy.
  • Support preparation for product launches, new data readouts, major congresses, publications, and other significant scientific milestones through appropriate Medical Affairs training.
  • Manage external training vendors, speakers, and subject-matter experts, as appropriate.

Support documentation and tracking of required Medical Affairs training and completion, as applicable.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging scientific data, publications, congress presentations, treatment guidelines, and other information relevant to the product and therapeutic area.

Medical Information

  • Own and manage the Medical Information operations for the company's marketed product(s), serving as the primary point of contact for medical information requests.
  • Ensure responses to unsolicited medical information requests are timely, accurate, balanced, and scientifically rigorous.
  • Translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, accurate, and compliant medical information materials for internal and external audiences.
  • Lead the development, review, and maintenance of standardized medical information responses and resources for frequently received medical inquiries.
  • Establish and maintain processes, workflows, systems support, and service standards for handling, documenting, and reporting medical information inquiries in alignment with company policies, applicable regulatory standards, and industry standards.
  • Support vendor management, where applicable, for Medical Information services, content development, or technology platforms.
  • Monitor trends in medical information requests to identify emerging questions, knowledge gaps, and opportunities to proactively develop new resources.
  • Establish metrics and dashboards to monitor Medical Information activities and lead reporting to Medical Affairs leadership on insights and trends derived from medical information inquiries and field requests.
  • Partner with Pharmacovigilance/Safety to ensure appropriate identification, documentation, and escalation of adverse events and other safety-related information.
  • Maintain a comprehensive library of approved medical information resources and supporting scientific references.
  • Support the medical information presence at scientific/medical congresses.
  • Serve as the central Medical Affairs point person for product information and ensure consistent, accurate communication of approved medical and scientific information across the organization.
  • Support periodic review and updating of medical information content as new clinical data, publications, regulatory information, or safety information becomes available.
  • Ensure appropriate inspection readiness and documentation of Medical Information activities.
  • Participate in cross-functional product and launch-readiness planning activities as the Medical Information subject matter expert.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific or healthcare-related discipline required; advanced scientific, medical, pharmacy, nursing, or related degree preferred.
  • 6–8+ years of relevant experience in Medical Training, Medical Communications, Field Medical, or a related pharmaceutical/biotechnology function.
  • Experience supporting a commercial-stage pharmaceutical or biotechnology product strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing and maintaining medical/scientific content for Field Medical or Medical Affairs teams.
  • Demonstrated experience managing medical information inquiries and developing scientifically rigorous medical information responses.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical product information, approved labeling, and the distinction between promotional and non-promotional medical communications.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Commercial, Legal, and Compliance teams.
  • Strong scientific and clinical writing skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise, audience-appropriate content.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to scientific accuracy and compliance.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree such as PharmD, PhD, MSN, PA, NP, or equivalent healthcare/scientific training.
  • Experience supporting an oncology product or oncology Medical Affairs organization.
  • Experience supporting product launch or pre-launch Medical Affairs activities.
  • Experience developing and delivering Medical Training strategies and working directly with MSL/Field Medical teams
  • Experience with Medical Information databases, inquiry management platforms, or content management systems.
  • Experience managing external Medical Information vendors or service providers.

Key Competencies

Scientific & Medical Acumen

Strong ability to understand, evaluate, and communicate clinical and scientific information.

Medical Information Expertise

Demonstrated understanding of medical inquiry management, response development, and appropriate medical information practices.

Content Development

Ability to create clear, accurate, balanced, and scientifically compelling medical content and training materials.

Training & Facilitation

Ability to translate complex scientific information into effective training and educational experiences for scientific and non-scientific audiences.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Builds effective partnerships across Medical Affairs and the broader organization.

Attention to Detail

Maintains a high standard of scientific accuracy, consistency, compliance, and content governance.

Project Management

Effectively manages multiple concurrent projects, timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables.

Business Acumen

Understands how Medical Information, Medical Training, and field medical materials support the broader Medical Affairs strategy and needs of a commercial organization.

Ownership & Accountability

Serves as the subject matter expert and takes end-to-end ownership of the Medical Information and Medical Training functions.

Communication

Communicates complex scientific concepts effectively through written materials, presentations, training, and cross-functional interactions.

Success in This Role

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

  • A well-organized, responsive, and scalable Medical Information function.
  • Timely and scientifically rigorous responses to external medical inquiries.
  • A centralized and well-governed library of current product information and medical resources.
  • High-quality, compliant materials that effectively support the Field Medical organization.
  • Effective onboarding and ongoing training of Field Medical and Medical Affairs colleagues.
  • Consistent understanding and appropriate use of product information and approved medical materials across the organization.
  • Strong partnership between Medical Information, Medical Directors, Field Medical, Regulatory, Safety, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Identification of trends in medical inquiries that generate meaningful insights for Medical Affairs strategy.
  • Clear processes, metrics, and governance that enable the Medical Affairs organization to scale as the business grows.

  • Cross-Selling erkennen: In den Onboarding-Sessions erkennst du Chancen für unsere Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services und koordinierst das Follow-up eng mit den Cyber- und Sales-Teams.

Projektmanagement

  • Prozesse skalieren: Du hilfst dabei, den Onboarding-Prozess stetig zu verbessern, um die Implementierungsrate unserer Cyber-Tools zu steigern. Dem Product-Team lieferst du wertvolles Feedback und konkrete Empfehlungen.

  • Content erstellen: Du erstellst Leitfäden, Dokumente und Schulungsmaterialien, die das Onboarding einfacher und schneller machen.

  • Schnittstellen nutzen: Du durchdringst unsere Unternehmensstruktur und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams (Cyber, Tech, Product, Marketing) zusammen, um Kundenbedürfnisse schnell und effizient zu lösen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Cybersecurity-Erfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Bereich Cybersicherheit ist bei uns ein absolutes Must-have.

  • Kommunikationstalent: Stark in Kommunikation und Präsentation, empathisch im Umgang mit Menschen und erfahren in der Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams.

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Prozessorientierte Denkweise mit einer klaren "Hands-on"-Mentalität – du lernst schnell und bringst Dinge einfach über die Ziellinie.

  • Vertriebs-Gespür: Eine leichte Vertriebsorientierung und das Händchen dafür, Zusatzleistungen überzeugend einzubringen.

  • Sprachen: Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

title: Vehicle Operations Specialist
description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing
Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.

The Role

We are looking for a Vehicle Operations Specialist to join our growing Vehicle Operations team as our fleet continues to scale.

Based within our Downtime team, this role will focus on the performance and commercial management of our hire vehicle portfolio, while also supporting wider operational reporting and process improvement across Vehicle Operations.

You will work closely with Vehicle Operations Specialists, Team Leads and external partners to ensure hire vehicles are managed effectively, recovery opportunities are followed through and agreed processes are being followed.

This role requires someone who is commercially minded, organised, confident working with data and comfortable challenging others constructively when performance or processes are not where they need to be.

You will also play an important role in helping us improve how we work, using data, technology and new ideas to build more effective and scalable processes.

What you'll do...

    Manage Hire Vehicle Performance

    Maintain oversight of hire vehicles across active cases, ensuring we have clear visibility of hire duration, cost, extensions, expected repair timelines and next actions.

    Identify aged, high-cost or unusual cases and work with the team to reduce avoidable spend while ensuring drivers remain appropriately supported.

    Support Cost Recovery

    Track recovery opportunities and outstanding contributions from manufacturers, dealerships and partners.

    Vehicle Operations Specialists will remain responsible for leading commercial conversations, while you will provide the administration, tracking and follow-up needed to ensure agreed processes are completed and money is actively chased.

    You will help maintain clear visibility of amounts requested, agreed, received and outstanding.

    Analyse Operational Performance

    Use operational data to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities across Downtime and the wider Operations department.

    This may include reviewing hire costs, aged cases, recovery performance, supplier performance, process compliance and operational workloads.

    Turn data into clear insights and actions rather than simply maintaining reports.

    Build and Maintain Reporting

    Create, maintain and improve trackers, reports and dashboards using tools such as Excel and Google Sheets.

    Ensure data is accurate, accessible and useful, and look for opportunities to simplify or automate manual reporting wherever possible.

    Provide Feedback and Create Accountability

    Identify where actions, processes or expectations have not been followed and provide constructive feedback to Vehicle Operations Specialists.

    You will need to be confident holding people accountable for agreed actions while maintaining strong and positive working relationships.

    The aim is always to improve performance and consistency, not simply identify mistakes.

    Improve Processes

    Look for opportunities to improve the way we work.

    You should be able to take an existing process or project, understand where it could be stronger and help develop it into something more efficient, scalable and innovative.

    This may involve improving controls, redesigning workflows, introducing better reporting or using new technology to reduce manual work.

    Use Technology and AI Effectively

    Be confident using technology and learning new systems.

    Experience using AI or automation tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or similar would be advantageous, particularly where they have been used to improve reporting, analysis or productivity.

    You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about how technology can improve operational performance.

    Support Repair Progress Where Required

    Repair chasing will not be the primary focus of the role, but there will be occasions where you need to contact dealerships, manufacturers, repairers or other partners to understand delays or resolve blockers affecting hire duration.

    You should therefore have a basic understanding of how automotive repair and service processes operate.

What you'll need...

    Commercial Awareness

    You understand how operational decisions can impact cost and are comfortable questioning whether spend remains necessary, sustainable and appropriately recovered.

    Strong Analytical Skills

    You are confident working with data, spotting trends and identifying where

title: AI Customer Support Specialist
description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

We’re looking for an AI Customer Support Specialist.


You are someone who blends a deep understanding of customer support with a curiosity for how systems and AI tools can streamline operations.

You don’t need to be a developer, but you should feel energized by the idea of connecting platforms, crafting prompts, and automating repetitive workflows. If you're driven by improving customer experience and love figuring out how things work under the hood, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze support workflows to identify pain points and automation opportunities
  • Design and maintain scalable automations that improve efficiency and customer satisfaction
  • Experiment with and optimize AI prompts for real-world support use cases
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and iterate on workflow logic, APIs, and system integrations
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering (for integrations), Product (for tooling), and Operations (for process changes)
  • Drive adoption of automation solutions across the support organization
  • Own and execute on a clear automation roadmap with measurable impact

What We're Looking For

  • 5–7+ years of hands-on experience in customer support, technical support, or automation operations

Customer-Centric + Process-Minded

  • Deep understanding of customer service dynamics and support tooling
  • Ability to break down complex workflows into clear, logical steps
  • A mindset that prioritizes customer outcomes, not just ticket volume
  • Detail-oriented and constantly refining systems based on real-world feedback

Technically Curious

  • Experience crafting, testing, and refining AI prompts (prompt engineering)
  • Familiarity with how data flows between systems and APIs
  • Able to parse JSON, investigate workflow logs, and spot API failures
  • Understands how systems like ticketing platforms, webhooks, and automations connect

Project Leadership

  • Comfortable driving cross-functional initiatives and removing roadblocks
  • Able to influence and report up to leadership on progress and ROI
  • Manages competing priorities and stakeholders with clarity and ownership

What Success Looks Like

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Think "this could be automated" when you see a repeated task
  • Balance customer empathy with a love of systems thinking and tooling
  • Translate technical concepts for non-technical colleagues
  • Learn quickly, experiment fearlessly, and push ideas forward
  • Ship improvements regularly, not just strive for perfection

Who You Might Be Today

We’re especially excited about candidates from roles like:

  • Support Operations Managers who’ve led tool rollouts or automation efforts
  • Technical Support Engineers who’ve optimized their own workflows
  • Implementation Consultants from SaaS companies
  • Support-focused Business Analysts with an eye for data and improvement
  • Solutions Engineers working alongside support or success teams
  • Zendesk/Intercom/Salesforce Admins who’ve built internal tooling and workflows

Unexpected but Excellent Backgrounds

  • QA Engineers who’ve worked closely with support or product
  • Revenue or Product Ops folks from B2B SaaS with automation chops
  • Customer Success Managers who are “the technical one” on the team

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: SOC Analyst Internship Program - LSU Students Only
description:
Have you thought about a career in cybersecurity? Ever daydreamed about sleuth-level mastery the likes of Charlotte Justice, Easy Rawlins, or Veronica Mars... or perhaps captivated by the show Mr. Robot, national news like the Log4Shell Zero-Day vulnerability and major ransomware incidents, or the topic of election security? Our Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst internship may be for you!

Let’s face it - Finding hands-on opportunities to learn about cybersecurity can be tough, and there isn’t one set path into this field. The industry needs organizations that are willing and able to train and equip the next generation of cybersecurity leaders, to secure our organizations, businesses, and nation. There is an imperative to break the mold of who is typically considered a cybersecurity professional, and it takes more than technical ability to succeed. With that in mind, we see the cybersecurity skills gap as an opportunity and are eager to be an on-ramp for those who want to learn and find a pathway into the constantly evolving, challenging world of online security.

Sure, our team has plenty of people with traditional IT-related backgrounds, but we also have team members who have crossed into cybersecurity from completely unrelated fields ranging from Education to Emergency Medical Technicians. We believe that having technically competent analysts with diversity of thought, culture, and experiences not only creates a better world but also fosters a more inclusive work environment. This gives us a competitive advantage to better protect our range of clients with the ability to consider threats from more diverse perspectives.

SOC analysts are the first line of defense for any of C3’s clients. Analysts have the critical responsibility to initially triage and make key decisions about how to identify, investigate, and address potentially malicious activity in a client’s network. This internship is designed to give students and aspiring cybersecurity professionals an opportunity to gain real-world experience working within a SOC, providing exposure to the technology, data, processes, and expectations that accompany a SOC analyst role. Guided coaching, paired with independently driven, hands-on activities will help you develop vital technical skills as well as soft skills. The internship offers ambitious students an opportunity to move from theoretical knowledge to practical experience.

Intrigued? Awesome! Here’s what you need to know about us: Our SOC began as a homegrown Louisiana-based company, focused on establishing Louisiana as a cybersecurity center of excellence. That means being the best at what we do so that we can bring 5,000 industry jobs to the state of “Union, Justice, and Confidence”. We would love to provide this internship opportunity to a student or resident of the state. As such, this cohort is only accepting applicants who are or will be enrolled in a Computer Science or Cybersecurity focused degree program within the LSU System Schools in January 2027

C3's Core Values:

  • Team Human: Respecting all humans is a critical part of who we are at C3. We practice integrity in all interactions, we empathize with others, we create a supportive work environment, and we support the communities in which we live and operate.
  • Security First: At the cornerstone of our business, we prioritize security above convenience, cost or efficiency. A “security-first” approach means we practice what we preach and we lead by example for our clients.
  • Be an Advocate: We are passionate in our advocacy for our customer’s success and a path to the best solution for their business. We embrace feedback, put ourselves in your shoes and advocate for your interests as our own.
  • Embrace Change: It's a practical necessity in an industry that never stands still. As a new entity born from the merger of two top-ranked CMMC-focused IT services companies, we're keenly aware that our success hinges on our ability to adapt - whether that means integrating new platforms, refining processes, or keeping pace with changing guidelines.
  • Resilience: Our ability to withstand adversity and accomplish objectives while maintaining professionalism and discipline is critical to successful crisis management and risk avoidance.

Internship Selection Process

Phase I - Application (until Nov 14)

Applicants complete Internship applications.
The C3 SOC Leadership Team will review and screen applicants and select candidates for Phase II.

Phase II - Assessment

Assessments will be assigned to candidates selected for Phase II.
The C3 SOC Leadership Team will review Assessment results and select candidates for Phase III.

Phase III - Interview

Phase III candidates will be scheduled for a (virtual) interview with the Internship Panel.
The Internship Panel and the C3 SOC Leadership Team will select Interns and Intern Alternates.

Responsibilities

As part of our Security Operations Center (SOC) team of analysts who actively monitor security alerts, perform threat hunting, and escalate tickets in order to manage potential threats/risks within our client environments, responsibilities include:

  • Complete the C3 SOC Analyst training program
  • Learn the basics of Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), threat detection, and cybersecurity incident response (IR)
  • Monitor, detect and respond to security events from reviewing logs and alerts, and provide support when analysis confirms actionable incidents
  • Conduct network forensics, log analysis, and malware triage in support of threat hunting and investigations
  • Assist with auditing client security tool policies and configurations
  • Assist in projects to streamline, improve and create required operational tools, rule sets, processes, and documentation related to SOC workflows.
  • Assist in testing, analyzing, and evaluating existing or proposed SOC team tools, utilities, systems, and processes
  • Perform threat intelligence research with newly identified threats and vulnerabilities
  • Develop, document, and correlate recommendations for cybersecurity incidents and alert tickets

Basic Qualifications

  • Enrolled in a relevant IT/Cybersecurity degree program in LSU or LSU satellite campus.
  • Basic understanding of networks and technical environments, including conceptual knowledge of administering, defending, and analyzing servers or workstations
  • Experience working with Operating Systems (Windows, macOS, or Linux)
  • Basic analytical, problem-solving, time management, organizational, and project management skills
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment, multitask, and prioritize during high-stakes security situations
  • Comfortable using and/or learning tools such as Teams and Office
  • Ability to follow defined processes and procedures, work independently and make decisions with minimal direction

Advanced Qualifications
For students further along in their IT/Information Security studies or individuals who have decided to pursue a career in cyber and have work experience or completed self-study training via platforms such as LetsDefend, TryHackMe, Hack The Box, RangeForce, Udemy, Cybrary, Coursera, etc.).

  • Experience with security tools in a work or lab* environment (lab = academic lab or home lab set up with servers, big data, and security tools set up to conduct tasks specific to analysis and triage of security data and events)
  • If you meet these advanced qualifications, we might even have a job for you so definitely reach out!

Schedule: 16-38 hrs/wk

Compensation: $11 - $14 hourly, depending on experience. We will work with your academic institution if they offer academic credit.
Internship Length: January 11, 2027 – May 14, 2027.

Location: Remote (Louisiana)

We're looking for a Marketing Director to run our marketing engine across both sides of the business: design-minded consumers and our trade program, which is our biggest growth priority. You'll own performance across paid, email and SMS, and on-site, and make sure every dollar earns its keep. You'll also bring creative and channel thinking together, because on today's platforms the creative is the targeting.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set strategy, lead a small team and partners, and still be close enough to the numbers and the work to know what's really happening. Your first priorities are profitable performance marketing, building a clear, well-run team, and growing trade.

What you'll do

  • Own performance marketing. Set budgets and allocation across Google, Meta, affiliates, and other paid channels, with gross profit after variable costs as the measure of success.
  • Build marketing for our trade program. B2B is a strategic focus. Use our channels, content, and lifecycle programs to attract and retain high-value interior designers, architects, and hospitality clients, and partner with our B2B sales team.
  • Own the marketing budget and vendors. Manage the full marketing budget, plus vendor and partner contracts and renewals.
  • Bring creative and performance together. Build campaigns where creative testing drives results, and work with our creative team to brief, test, and learn.
  • Lead email, SMS, and lifecycle for both consumer and trade audiences, treating email as a performance channel as well as a content channel.
  • Own promotions with merchandising, within agreed margin guardrails.
  • Oversee organic social and reviews, including Instagram, Pinterest, and Trustpilot.
  • Run affiliates end to end, from partner performance to editorial and publisher relationships.
  • Build trusted measurement with finance and our data team, across channels and customer types.
  • Own go-to-market and the marketing calendar. Turn quarterly brand and trend direction from our Chief Brand Officer into a clear plan for launches, campaigns, and seasonal moments, and lead it from planning through execution with merchandising, creative, and our trade team.
  • Lead and shape the team. Manage and develop email and SMS, creative, copy, and agency partners, and shape the team as we grow, including whether and when to add roles.

What success looks like in year one

  • Profitable growth across our marketing channels
  • A stronger trade program, with marketing as a real driver of new trade relationships
  • Trusted measurement that the whole business uses to make decisions
  • A team that's clear on priorities and growing in its roles

Requirements

What you bring

  • 7+ years in e-commerce marketing, with at least 3 years leading performance marketing and managing budgets.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta, and affiliates, and a track record of growing profitably, not just growing revenue.
  • Experience marketing to B2B or trade audiences (designers, architects, hospitality, or other professional buyers), or a clear point of view on how to build it.
  • A strong partnership with finance. You've owned a marketing P&L or budget, worked with finance on forecasting and contribution margin, and made spend decisions based on profitability.
  • Real understanding of how creative drives performance today. You can brief, structure, and read creative tests.
  • A strong eye for design and brand. You can tell a great product story from an average one.
  • Comfort with data, including GA4 and BigQuery or similar tools.
  • Experience managing and developing a small team and outside partners.
  • Bonus: experience in home, furniture, or design-led retail; email and SMS on Klaviyo; organic social on Instagram and Pinterest.
  • A builder's mindset. You like bringing structure to a lean team, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves.

Team and logistics

  • Reports to: Greg Finney, CEO and Founder.
  • Team: email and SMS lead, creative and design, copywriting, and performance marketing partners.
  • Key partners: merchandising, finance, B2B sales, and our Chief Brand Officer.
  • Location: remote, location independent.
  • Compensation: $150,000 to $200,000 base, plus annual bonus.

Benefits

401k Plan + Employer Matching

Vision

Dental

PTO

title: Virtualization / Automation Engineer (Senior)
description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Virtualization / Automation Engineer to design, operate, secure, automate, and modernize the virtualization and Software-Defined Data Center platforms supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior engineering position owns the hypervisor and SDDC platform layers, including VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager, and associated infrastructure-automation capabilities.

The Virtualization / Automation Engineer maintains reliable, secure, and scalable platform services across production, development, testing, COOP, disaster-recovery, and hybrid-hosting environments. The position develops Infrastructure as Code and configuration-automation solutions that improve consistency, deployment speed, recoverability, security, and operational visibility.

This role is focused on virtualization-platform engineering and automation. Routine ownership of guest operating systems, applications, databases, and cloud workloads remains with the appropriate system, application, database, and cloud teams. The engineer establishes and maintains the underlying platform capabilities those teams consume and coordinates closely with them to resolve cross-layer issues.

The engineer also supports the transition of applicable services from on-premises infrastructure to centralized DISA-hosting platforms. This includes discovery, dependency analysis, platform readiness, migration planning, technical validation, cutover support, and post-transition stabilization.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional on-site support, after-hours maintenance, incident response, and travel may be required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Virtualization / Automation Engineer will:

  • Design, configure, administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise hypervisor and Software-Defined Data Center platforms.
  • Serve as the senior engineering owner for VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager, and associated platform-management capabilities.
  • Establish platform architecture, configuration standards, operational procedures, and engineering roadmaps.
  • Build and maintain highly available virtualization clusters supporting production, development, testing, and recovery environments.
  • Configure and optimize vSphere High Availability, Distributed Resource Scheduler, resource pools, clusters, hosts, datastores, distributed switches, and related platform services.
  • Manage ESXi hosts, vCenter services, platform certificates, licensing, upgrades, patches, firmware dependencies, and approved security configurations.
  • Monitor platform capacity, availability, utilization, performance, health, and configuration compliance.
  • Analyze processor, memory, storage, network, and cluster utilization and recommend scaling, balancing, or remediation actions.
  • Engineer and maintain vSAN clusters, disk groups, storage policies, fault domains, capacity controls, health monitoring, and recovery processes.
  • Troubleshoot vSAN performance, availability, resynchronization, capacity, hardware, and policy-compliance issues.
  • Engineer and support NSX network-virtualization capabilities, including segments, transport zones, gateways, routing, switching, distributed security controls, and platform connectivity.
  • Coordinate NSX changes with network, cybersecurity, application, and cloud teams.
  • Administer and maintain VMware Site Recovery Manager configurations, protection groups, recovery plans, inventory mappings, network mappings, and recovery priorities.
  • Develop, test, document, and maintain automated failover and failback procedures.
  • Support COOP exercises, disaster-recovery tests, system-restoration activities, and actual continuity events.
  • Validate platform recovery objectives and document exercise results, deficiencies, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
  • Design and implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, PowerCLI, APIs, or comparable tools.
  • Develop reusable modules, playbooks, scripts, templates, and pipelines for provisioning, configuration, validation, patching, compliance, and recovery.
  • Store automation code in approved version-control repositories and follow established review, testing, approval, and release practices.
  • Implement appropriate error handling, logging, secrets protection, state management, rollback, and validation within automation solutions.
  • Eliminate repetitive manual activities through secure, tested, and supportable automation.
  • Establish automated configuration checks and identify drift from approved platform baselines.
  • Support infrastructure provisioning while preserving the division between virtualization-platform ownership and guest operating-system, application, database, or workload ownership.
  • Coordinate with system administrators and workload owners on resource requirements, virtual-machine placement, templates, snapshots, virtual hardware, and platform dependencies.
  • Coordinate with storage, network, cloud, cybersecurity, and application teams to diagnose cross-platform incidents.
  • Provide Tier 4 engineering support for complex virtualization, storage, network-virtualization, automation, and recovery incidents.
  • Support outage response by isolating platform faults, restoring affected capabilities, implementing approved workarounds, and providing technical status information.
  • Conduct root-cause analyses and develop corrective and preventive actions for recurring platform incidents.
  • Maintain current backups of applicable platform configurations and test restoration procedures.
  • Develop and enforce platform standards aligned with DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, vulnerability directives, and approved security requirements.
  • Support Risk Management Framework control implementation, technical evidence collection, remediation, and assessment activities for the virtualization platform.
  • Evaluate platform vulnerabilities, vendor advisories, security patches, and configuration changes for operational impact.
  • Support technology refreshes and modernization initiatives involving compute, storage, network virtualization, hyperconverged infrastructure, and SDDC capabilities.
  • Assess existing virtualization capabilities, technical debt, capacity constraints, security gaps, and lifecycle risks.
  • Develop platform roadmaps, technical options, migration approaches, rough-order cost estimates, and implementation recommendations.
  • Support the transition of applicable infrastructure and services to centralized DISA-hosting platforms.
  • Perform discovery and document platform inventories, configurations, interdependencies, interfaces, network requirements, storage requirements, recovery requirements, and migration constraints.
  • Assess workload and platform readiness while coordinating with the teams responsible for guest operating systems, applications, databases, and cloud workloads.
  • Develop and support migration waves, test plans, rollback plans, cutover procedures, validation criteria, and stabilization activities.
  • Coordinate with DISA, Government stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams during hosting-transition activities.
  • Integrate SDDC capabilities with cloud, COOP, and on-premises environments to support workload mobility, resilient operations, and enterprise service orchestration.
  • Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, as-built documentation, configuration baselines, standard operating procedures, automation documentation, recovery procedures, and engineering records.
  • Follow approved change, release, configuration, incident, problem, security, and quality-management processes.
  • Provide platform metrics, capacity data, risks, issues, accomplishments, and modernization status for program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • Minimum of eight years of relevant experience in virtualization, systems engineering, data-center infrastructure, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience engineering or administering enterprise hypervisor or Software-Defined Data Center platforms.
  • Experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience supporting vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager, or comparable software-defined storage, network-virtualization, and disaster-recovery technologies.
  • Experience developing or maintaining infrastructure-automation solutions.
  • Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical enterprise infrastructure.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex issues across compute, storage, network, virtualization, and automation layers.
  • Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup, restoration, capacity management, performance management, and infrastructure lifecycle practices.
  • Ability to develop architecture diagrams, technical procedures, automation documentation, recovery plans, and engineering recommendations.
  • Ability to support after-hours maintenance, disaster-recovery exercises, and critical incident response when required.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Formal Terraform training.
  • Formal Ansible training.
  • VMware Certified Professional certification.
  • VMware Certified Advanced Professional or another advanced VMware certification.
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate certification.
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation or comparable automation certification.
  • Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Aria automation and operations capabilities.
  • Experience with PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or comparable scripting technologies.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense virtualization environments.
  • Experience supporting DISA-hosted services or migrations to DISA enterprise-hosting platforms.
  • Experience with DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides, Risk Management Framework controls, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance.
  • Experience integrating virtualization platforms with hybrid-cloud, COOP, and disaster-recovery environments.
  • Experience developing Infrastructure as Code within controlled CI/CD and version-control workflows.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, peer review, code scanning, and configuration-drift detection.
  • Experience supporting large-scale platform migrations, data-center modernization, or hosting transitions.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • Relevant cloud, security, storage, or network certification.

Skills and Competencies

  • Enterprise virtualization and SDDC engineering.
  • VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, and SRM.
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration automation.
  • High availability, disaster recovery, and COOP support.
  • Platform capacity, performance, and lifecycle management.
  • Secure platform configuration and compliance.
  • Complex infrastructure troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
  • Hybrid-hosting and migration planning.
  • Architecture and technical-documentation development.
  • Cross-functional engineering coordination.
  • Controlled change and release implementation.
  • Strong attention to detail and configuration discipline.
  • Ability to distinguish platform responsibilities from guest operating-system and workload ownership.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

We’re looking for a Senior Director of Design to lead the experience strategy for Reddit’s Search & Feeds experiences. Reporting to our Head of Design, you’ll lead a design team shaping how people find relevant conversations, discover communities, and build connections to the topics they care about. Your impact will extend across Reddit, connecting discovery to the experiences that turn initial interest into ongoing participation.

This role combines product vision, design leadership, and a high bar for craft. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science across Reddit to make discovery more useful, intuitive, and distinctly Reddit driving growth and retention by helping people connect with communities that matter to them.

What you’ll do

  • Set the design vision for Search & Feeds. Define a cohesive experience strategy across search, feed experiences, recommendations, and community discovery, connecting near-term improvements to a longer-term vision.
  • Lead and develop the team. Coach design leaders and individual contributors, build clear ownership, and create an environment where people can do ambitious work and grow.
  • Shape product direction. Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and guide investment decisions grounded in user needs and business goals.
  • Raise the bar for quality. Drive thoughtful interaction design, clear information architecture, accessible experiences, and strong execution from early concepts through launch.
  • Make relevance understandable. Help people understand and influence what they see, bringing clarity and user control to ranking, personalization, and recommendations.
  • Design for different discovery needs. Support people seeking a specific answer, exploring a new interest, or returning to communities they already value.
  • Connect discovery to community health. Consider how search and feeds affect participation, conversation quality, and the communities that make Reddit valuable.
  • Establish how success is measured. Use research, experimentation, and behavioral data to evaluate usefulness, satisfaction, and the quality of discovery alongside engagement.
  • Influence across Reddit. Communicate a clear point of view, build alignment across teams, and contribute to the broader design organization’s standards and practices.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience leading design for complex consumer products at scale, with meaningful work in search, discovery, feeds, recommendations, or related experiences.
  • A track record of building and developing design teams, including managing managers and supporting individual contributors.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and compelling experiences.
  • Deep expertise in interaction design and information architecture, with a portfolio demonstrating both design quality and measurable user impact.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering, Product, Research, and Data Science on experiences shaped by ranking and personalization systems.
  • The ability to balance user needs, business priorities, technical constraints, and the health of a broader product ecosystem.
  • Clear communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve competing priorities, and make decisions with incomplete information.
  • An appreciation for community-driven products and the different ways people seek information, participate, and build trust online.

title: Director, Expert Insights and Delphi Methodology
description:
About the Hiring Group

RTI Health Solutions (RTI-HS), a wholly owned subsidiary of RTI International, is an independent and internationally recognized research organization. With offices in the US, UK, Spain, France, and Sweden, we provide healthcare consulting and research expertise to optimize decision making for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device products across the development and marketing lifecycle. Clients rely on our expertise, quality standards, and integrity to guide their product development and regulatory and market access strategies. Our various practice areas include Value, Access, and HEOR; Patient-Centered and Outcomes Research; Epidemiology and Biostatistics; Medical Communications; Global Business Operations; and Strategic Consulting and Growth.

We are seeking a Director to join our Expert Insights team within Medical Communications. As Director, Expert Insights and Delphi Methodology, you will join an experienced, collaborative team that helps clients obtain, interpret, and communicate insights from clinicians, payers, HTA experts, patients, and other stakeholders. You will provide senior methodological and project leadership across Delphi and other consensus-development studies, advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, and qualitative research. You will translate complex stakeholder input into clear findings, implications, recommendations, and scientifically rigorous deliverables that support medical affairs, clinical development, evidence communication, market access, and related business decisions. This role is suited to an experienced leader who can quickly take ownership of active Delphi work and provide expert leadership across ongoing projects.

This role’s location is flexible, and remote working options are available, with a preference for candidates located on the East Coast.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Independently design and lead modified and classic Delphi studies and other expert elicitation of consensus exercises from protocol development through expert recruitment, questionnaire development, iterative rounds, analysis, consensus interpretation, and final reporting
  • Define and apply appropriate consensus criteria, stopping rules, analytical approaches, and methods for integrating quantitative results with qualitative rationale
  • Design and lead virtual and in-person advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, and other structured expert-engagement activities
  • Facilitate or moderate discussions with clinicians, payers, patients, caregivers, health technology assessment stakeholders, and other experts
  • Conduct and analyze qualitative interviews using rigorous, fit-for-purpose methods
  • Advise clients and internal teams on the most appropriate methodology for insight-generation and consensus-development that is tailored to intended audiences
  • Develop study protocols, analysis plans, interview and discussion guides, questionnaires, moderator materials, and other data-collection tools
  • Translate stakeholder input and study findings into clear conclusions, implications, recommendations, and strategic narratives
  • Develop and review scientifically accurate, audience-appropriate reports, executive summaries, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, congress materials, and client presentations
  • Identify implications of expert insights for medical strategy, evidence communication, publication planning, stakeholder engagement, and market access
  • Apply appropriate standards for scientific rigor, publication ethics, authorship, transparency, data integrity, and project documentation
  • Manage complex, multidisciplinary projects to agreed scope, quality, timelines, and budgets, including development of workplans, cost estimates, and risk-mitigation approaches
  • Serve as a senior client contact, build trusted relationships, anticipate needs, and provide clear methodological and strategic guidance
  • Scope opportunities and develop proposals that align the research question, methodology, deliverables, schedule, and budget
  • Contribute to business development through capabilities presentations, solution development, thought leadership, and expansion of client relationships
  • Collaborate effectively with medical writers, scientific strategists, editors, project managers, analysts, and other cross-functional partners
  • Build the team’s scientific profile through publication and presentation of work

What You'll Need

  • Advanced degree and at least 5 years of experience in medical communications, clinical research, epidemiology, public health, outcomes research, health services research, health policy, qualitative research, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific discipline
  • Extensive, recent, hands-on experience independently designing and leading modified or classic Delphi studies, including protocol development, expert selection and recruitment, round development, analysis, consensus interpretation, and reporting all in adherence to current methodological guidelines
  • Demonstrated ability to assume leadership of active Delphi projects with limited methodological oversight or onboarding
  • Experience leading virtual and in-person advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, or comparable structured expert-engagement programs
  • Experience designing, conducting, and analyzing qualitative research, including development of protocols, analysis plans, interview guides, questionnaires, and reports
  • Strong scientific writing, synthesis, and data-interpretation skills, with the ability to convert complex evidence and stakeholder input into concise, actionable communications
  • Experience developing publication-quality reports, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, or presentations and familiarity with relevant ethical and reporting standards
  • Experience working directly with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare clients and providing senior-level methodological and strategic counsel
  • Demonstrated success managing complex projects, budgets, timelines, risks, and cross-functional teams
  • Experience scoping opportunities, writing proposals, and presenting capabilities or recommended approaches to clients
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, multitasking environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, collaborate across disciplines, and coach or mentor colleagues
  • A record of peer-reviewed publication, conference presentation, or other relevant scientific thought leadership

Desirable, but not essential:

  • Experience engaging a range of stakeholder types, including clinicians, payers, patients, caregivers, and health technology assessment representatives
  • Knowledge of US or international healthcare, health technology assessment, pricing, reimbursement, or market access environments
  • Experience connecting expert insights to Medical Affairs strategy, integrated evidence communication, publication planning, or stakeholder-engagement planning
  • Experience using virtual engagement platforms, digital collaboration tools, and emerging technologies to support expert panels, qualitative research, insight analysis, and scientific communication
  • Experience supporting health technology assessment, reimbursement, regulatory, or evidence-submission activities
  • Experience with additional research approaches, such as literature reviews, observational or retrospective analyses, patient-reported outcomes, utility assessment, or quality-of-life research

As a Principal Engineer at Dropbox, you will own company critical, loosely defined technical problems with multi year impact, operating at the intersection of technology, product, business strategy, and applied AI.   • Influence and align roadmaps across organizations, resolving structural bottlenecks and changing how Dropbox builds and operates.
  • Architect and evolve foundational systems(this may involve both frontend and backend systems) and platforms that enable new product capabilities and operate reliably at the scale of hundreds of millions of users.

At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose.
