At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity


As a dedicated Business Applications Analyst II for Property Pricing and Underwriting Modernization, you will provide analysis and business information related to specific business functions, processes, and applications/IT platforms. Works at a developing skill-level to create, implement and maintain application solutions to meet the needs of a business or organization.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, Colorado Springs, CO, Chesapeake, VA, Charlotte, NC or Tampa, FL. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.


What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and opportunities specifically related to application/IT platform solutions.
  • Provides analysis for planning and implementation of low to medium complexity systems and upgrades and process changes.
  • Reviews new or upgraded application functionality with business partners (including training) to help them prepare appropriate training and procedures updates for their teams.
  • Performs and coordinates business and application/IT platform support; analyzes discrepancies and system failures.
  • Facilitates and performs application/IT platform resolution activities to minimize business impact and avoid future exposure; informs team leadership and business partners of business implications associated with those events and develops recommendations to mitigate future impact.
  • Maintains understanding of business processes, supporting applications/IT platform, and strategic direction.
  • Collaborates and exchanges information with team members, stakeholders, and information services to ensure dependencies, risks, and opportunities are identified.
  • Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What you have:

  • Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
  • Experiences that will support your success.
  • 2 years work experience in analyzing IT business processes, software application/IT platform design and/or IT documentation, with an understanding of application/IT platform data systems and operations.
  • Developing knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.

What sets you apart:

  • P&C Insurance experience – Pricing and/or UW experience.
  • Strong programming skills (Python, R, VBA).
  • Experience implementing within the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Experience in iterative development using Agile principles.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills.
  • Ability and desire to learn new technology and programming methods.
  • US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $63,590.00 - $121,530.00.

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Area Director, Electrophysiology & Structural Heart- North
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Provides deep technical knowledge in an assigned portfolio and advices both sales organization and customers in capabilities and options how to use and integrate Siemens products effectively.

The National Director, Electrophysiology & Structural Heart (EP/SH) provides strategic and commercial leadership for the Siemens Healthineers Procedural Ultrasound portfolio, including intracardiac echocardiography (ICE), ultrasound systems, and related cardiovascular imaging solutions across the United States.


The Director leads four Zone Directors and a team of 4-6 Clinical Applications Specialists and is responsible for translating national strategy into consistent execution across markets. The role works closely with Boston Scientific (BSC), which will primarily lead 4D ICE catheter sales and commercial execution, to align priorities, identify and activate target sites, accelerate adoption, and deliver a coordinated customer experience.


The Director is accountable for building an effective SHS-BSC partnership while ensuring Zone Directors maintain strong KOL, physician, and customer relationships and identify clinical and market opportunities. The Clinical Applications team will work closely with BSC and customers to support product demonstrations and evaluations, clinical education and training, and successful adoption of 4D ICE.


The long-term objective is to establish 4D ICE as a new standard of care for WATCHMAN left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) and Structural Heart procedures, evolving clinical practice beyond its current reliance on transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) guidance to advance patient care, improve clinical outcomes, enhance procedural efficiency, and deliver greater economic value for healthcare systems.


The Director will also lead market development for 4D ICE across mitral, tricuspid, and other transcatheter valve procedures, working with physicians, KOLs, device companies, and Siemens Healthineers teams to expand the role of advanced intracardiac imaging in Structural Heart.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead U.S. strategy and execution to accelerate adoption of 4D ICE across EP and Structural Heart procedures.
  • Lead, coach, and develop four Zone Directors and 4-6 Clinical Applications Specialists, ensuring consistent execution across markets.
  • Build and manage the strategic partnership with Boston Scientific, aligning priorities, target sites, and market development activities.
  • Drive effective SHS-BSC field collaboration to identify, activate, and grow priority accounts.
  • Advance KOL and physician engagement to build advocacy, clinical adoption, and market development.
  • Expand 4D ICE across LAAC, mitral, tricuspid, and other appropriate Structural Heart procedures.
  • Ensure effective demonstrations, evaluations, training, and clinical support through the Clinical Applications team to enable successful adoption and utilization.
  • Monitor adoption, utilization, customer, and market trends to identify opportunities, remove barriers, and inform commercial, marketing, and product strategy.
  • Ensure compliance with Siemens policies, quality standards, and health and safety requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of cardiovascular medical device, procedural imaging, or related MedTech experience, preferably within EP and/or Structural Heart.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing commercial and/or clinical field teams across multiple geographies.
  • Strong understanding of cardiovascular procedures, physician workflows, and hospital decision-making.
  • Demonstrated success developing and managing strategic partnerships or channel relationships.
  • Experience developing markets and driving adoption of new medical technologies or clinical workflows.
  • Strong KOL, physician, and executive customer relationship experience.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Strong strategic, business, communication, and people leadership skills.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Ability to travel up to 75%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise and established relationships within EP and Structural Heart.
  • Advanced knowledge of LAAC, ICE, and transcatheter valve procedures.
  • Experience launching or developing markets for new cardiovascular technologies.
  • Experience leading both commercial and clinical applications teams.
  • Experience with strategic device-company partnerships, ultrasound imaging, and/or capital equipment.
  • Advanced degree in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field.

This role is governed by our Fleet Safety Policy. To be eligible for employment, applicants must hold a valid driver's license in the state in which they reside and maintain a satisfactory driving record.

Who we are: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Philippines.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1000 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

title: Product Manager Intern, ShopX(Rewards)
description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

  • Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

  • Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

  • Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

  • Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

  • Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
  • A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
  • Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
  • Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
  • Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
  • Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.

description:
Senior Electrical Estimator
Location: Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate (must reside in the U.S.). Otherwise, hybrid office locations include: Hebron, KY / Cincinnati, OH; Nashville, TN; Denver, CO area; Indianapolis, IN.
Salary Range: $140,000–$165,000, depending on experience. Bonus opportunities.


Company Overview

Would you enjoy being involved in executing large-scale, complex infrastructure projects?

Connico is a national construction consultancy known for its experienced team and commitment to exceptional client service. With deep experience in aviation and complex infrastructure, we are continuing to expand our work across energy, federal, and defense markets.

Our work is technical, but how we do the work matters just as much as the quality of what we deliver. Our core values of Respect, Integrity, Innovation, Resiliency, Inclusivity, and Thoughtfulness guide how we work with our clients and with one another.

The Role

As a Senior Electrical Estimator, you will lead complex electrical cost estimating efforts from early conceptual planning through final construction documents. You will use your technical experience and judgment to develop accurate estimates, identify scope gaps and risks, reconcile costs, and help clients make informed decisions, even when project information is limited or evolving.

This is a hands-on senior technical role. You will independently develop and review estimates while also helping strengthen Connico's electrical estimating practice through mentoring, quality control, knowledge sharing, and the development of repeatable estimating practices.

You will work across disciplines and directly with clients, project teams, contractors, designers, and other estimators on complex infrastructure projects.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and independently develop electrical cost estimates across all design stages, from conceptual and Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimates through final construction documents, including Level 1–5 estimates for projects of varying size and complexity.
  • Develop detailed material and labor estimates for electrical systems including Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, Communications, Audio-Visual, Security, Video Surveillance, and Fire Alarm systems. Research and develop unit pricing, cost assemblies, and supporting assumptions using current market information and sound estimating judgment.
  • Think beyond the plans and specifications. Identify missing information, scope gaps, inconsistencies, interdisciplinary conflicts, and potential cost risks. Develop well-supported assumptions and solutions when complete project information is not available.
  • Lead estimate reconciliations, technical and quality-control reviews, contractor bid analyses, value engineering assessments, life-cycle and benefit-cost analyses, and coordination across disciplines to produce comprehensive and defensible estimates.
  • Manage multiple complex estimating assignments and priorities while maintaining accuracy, meeting deadlines, and helping project teams deliver high-quality work that reflects Connico's standards and core values.
  • Mentor and train developing estimators in conceptual estimating, quantity takeoffs, cost buildups, reconciliations, technical reviews, interdisciplinary plan analysis, reporting, and Connico estimating practices. Help create training resources and repeatable best practices that strengthen the broader team.
  • Take ownership of estimating data, cost assemblies, templates, and reporting practices by helping maintain accurate, current, consistent, and accessible information that supports repeatable results.
  • Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted technical advisor through clear communication, sound judgment, reliability, and expert guidance. Participate in client meetings, project site visits, and industry events as needed.
What You'll Bring
  • 10+ years of full-time, hands-on electrical estimating experience.
  • A Journeyman Electrician License, Master Electrician License, Electrical Engineering degree, or equivalent combination of electrical knowledge and experience.
  • An industry-recognized professional certification, license, or advanced credential, such as CCP, CPE, PCSE, CEP, CCE, PE, or another relevant advanced credential.
  • Proven ability to independently develop high-quality electrical estimates across Levels 1–5 and all stages of design, including conceptual and ROM estimates developed with limited information.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex estimating assignments, integrating estimate elements across multiple disciplines, meeting deadlines, maintaining quality, and communicating professionally with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to interpret architectural, civil, electrical, and other engineering drawings and specifications across all levels of design.
  • Expertise with electrical estimating or takeoff software such as IntelliBid, Accubid, On-Screen Takeoff, MII, MCACES, or comparable systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Teams, Outlook, and Word.
Preferred Experience
  • Electrical estimating experience supporting aviation or airport projects is highly preferred.
  • Experience with other large-scale or complex project environments, including federal government, Department of Defense or military facilities, energy and utilities, transportation and infrastructure, industrial, mission-critical, or similar technically complex work, is valuable.

Work Location Options
Hybrid (T/W/TH in-office):

  • Hebron, KY (Cincinnati area)
  • Mt. Juliet, TN (Nashville area)
  • Denver, CO
  • Indianapolis, IN

Fully Remote:

  • Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate. Must reside full-time in the U.S.
  • Minimal travel required, up to 10% (site visits, meetings, conferences)

Why Join Connico?

This is an opportunity to do more than produce estimates. You will help solve complex cost challenges, influence the quality of major infrastructure projects, strengthen estimating practices, and develop the next generation of Connico estimators.

As Connico continues to grow beyond its established aviation and infrastructure work into energy, federal, and defense markets, you will also have the opportunity to apply your expertise across an expanding range of complex projects.

We value people who take ownership, bring solutions, share their expertise, challenge thinking thoughtfully, and build trust with clients and teammates. At the Senior level, you will be expected not only to demonstrate technical excellence, but also to help strengthen the people and practice around you.

If you are an experienced electrical estimator who combines strong technical expertise with sound judgment, leadership, and a commitment to quality, we would like to hear from you!

We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

About the Role:

As Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you’ll develop and execute partner marketing plans that support our go-to-market strategy, with an initial focus on AirDial and enterprise communications solutions.

You’ll work closely with channel sales, strategic partners, distributors, technology alliances, and agents to build integrated go-to-market programs that help partners uncover opportunities, generate demand, and win customers. Your work will grow partner-led pipeline, deepen reseller engagement, and contribute to revenue growth.

You’ll bring channel marketing expertise, demand generation experience, and an understanding of B2B telecommunications, cloud communications, networking, or managed services to turn partner and market insights into effective campaigns and practical sales resources.

In your first year, you’ll focus on growing partner-sourced pipeline, increasing partner engagement, and improving visibility into marketing’s contribution to revenue.

  • Build annual and quarterly partner marketing plans that support Ooma’s revenue and growth priorities.

  • Develop messaging and value propositions that help partners explain Ooma’s solutions and sell with confidence.

  • Support partner onboarding, training, and certification to improve readiness, engagement, and use of marketing resources.
  • Manage market development funds (MDF) and co-op marketing investments, refining spending based on partner participation, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Establish reporting and attribution that connect marketing investment to partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.
  • Bring partner feedback into cross-functional planning and align channel sales, marketing, and product teams around shared priorities.
  • Use AI tools to support marketing activities and improve efficiency.

Experience We’re Looking For:

  • Demonstrated success generating partner-sourced pipeline and contributing to revenue growth.

  • Familiarity with enterprise technology buying cycles would be helpful.
  • Experience managing MDF programs and partner marketing investments is preferred.
  • Knowledge of channel operations, partner onboarding, and enablement frameworks would be an added advantage.

Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And,you'll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks.

Consensus is a trailblazer in our industry and believes that data transformation will reshape the world of healthcare.

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

Consensus leads the industry in data exchange solutions and we’re only getting started! With exciting new initiatives on the horizon, we are continuing our strategic expansion and we are looking to add to our diverse team of innovators.

Now is the ideal time to join us in our mission to solve healthcare’s biggest challenges, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of like-minded self-starters and partners to accomplish it.

How you will impact the organization…

The organization is seeking a pragmatic developer who understands that the landscape of software engineering is shifting. The purpose of this role is to balance leveraging AI for rapid, intuitive "Vibe Coding" with the technical discipline of "Spec-Driven Development" to build superior products. This individual must know how to utilize LLMs for creative exploration while pinning down maintainability through strict technical specifications.

The value you will deliver…

  • Hybrid Development: Transition effectively between rapid AI-assisted iteration and disciplined, manual engineering throughout the feature lifecycle.
  • Tooling Integration: Utilize Amazon Kiro as a primary driver within the AWS environment while remaining proficient in the broader ecosystem, including Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

  • 7+ years of professional full-stack development experience.

  • Experience building and shipping products using AI-assisted engineering disciplines or "vibe-to-spec" workflows.

  • Full-Stack Architecture: Strong grasp of CS fundamentals, including system design, API architecture, and database management (SQL/NoSQL).

ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This role applies generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) to analyze financial information, reconcile financial statements, prepare general and standard journal entries, assist in budget development, and prepare standard accounting and financial reports for management.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Compiles and analyzes financial information in preparation for entry into various financial statements and accounting reports, and makes appropriate journal entries for recording in the general ledger by checking calculations, reviewing basis for figures, and balancing and reconciling figures.
  • Reviews budget, revenue, expense, payroll entries, invoices, and other accounting documents, and researches and resolves discrepancies as necessary.
  • Performs bank reconciliations and wire transfers for deposit, makes mortgage payments and distributions, and ensures accuracy.
  • Maintains and coordinates accounting control procedures by analyzing revenue and expenditure trends and recommending appropriate budget levels to ensure expenditure control.
  • Analyzes and reviews accounting and financial resources for property acquisitions, dispositions, and closings and budgets and expenditures for local, state, federal, private funding, contracts, grants, and other corporate financial and accounting transactions.
  • Acts as liaison to internal and external auditors by explaining journal entries and financial transactions, providing research data and information as requested, and answering questions necessary to complete the audit in a timely manner.
  • Communicates with on-site and other property managers to assist in completing pre-close and close activities, answer questions, provide support, and ensure timely completion of accounting processes for on-time client and Company reporting.
  • Completes various financial, accounting, administrative, and other reports and analyses, and performs other duties as assigned or as necessary.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field, from an accredited college or university.
  • 3 years of minimum relevant experience in accounting or a financial setting, with experience that demonstrates the application and usage of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).
  • Employment history that demonstrates the application and usage of an accounting and financial background sufficient to analyze financial data and prepare financial reports in accordance with accounting, finance, budgeting, and cost control principles.
  • Must be proactive, self-directed, highly motivated, and possess skills in time management in order to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS:

  • Demonstrated proficiency in internet, word processing, spreadsheet, and database management programs in order to complete required reports.
  • Strong analytical skills and familiarity with financial and property management systems (Yardi, One Site, etc.).
  • Comprehensive understanding of accounting and finance best practices as well as relevant laws and regulations.

TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Team members work in an office or a remote work environment. No special physical demands are required.
  • Rare or occasional travel may be required to attend business meetings, training programs, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Job demands may require long periods of sitting.

title: Plant Process Simulation Engineer II
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Plant Process Simulation Engineer to join our engineering team. We are looking to fill this position immediately.

Position Description

Oklo is looking for an experienced process simulation engineer to be responsible for the development and ownership of the plant process simulation model for the Aurora power plant to inform design, operations, and plant dynamics.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Generate and own a plant process simulation model in AVEVA Process Simulation, ASPEN/HYSYS, Siemens Flomaster, or similar tool, that models and creates both transient and steady state plant performance results.
  • Iteratively model existing and future plant equipment and maintain the model as new design parameters and drawings are produced.
  • Establish automated plant model development to accelerate design decision making and inform plant economics and operations.
  • Use equipment specifications and performance results to generate and implement detailed equipment component models.
  • Work in cross disciplinary teams, including process engineering, instrumentation and control, power generation and distribution teams.
  • Generate technical documentation and reports to be included in regulatory filings and internal/external technical reports showing plant and equipment performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in chemical, mechanical, nuclear, aerospace engineering or related engineering discipline
  • At least 5 years of experience in the development or modeling of plant processes in the power generation, petroleum, chemical, or other similar industries
  • Broad familiarity with engineering principles, with strong systems engineering and operations intuition
  • Strong knowledge of plant thermodynamic cycle and process fluid modeling at an equipment and plant-level

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with building power conversion system process simulation models
  • Experience with designing process systems in power or chemical industries

Competencies

We are looking for a Plant Process Simulation Engineer that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • Able to communicate technical content and results both verbally and in writing

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $115,000 - $150,000 base salary, performance incentives, and equity.

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

The Compliance Administrator at Ampacity keeps the company audit-ready year-round. You own the day-to-day work behind SOC reporting, PII and data privacy controls, NetSuite access governance, and IT general controls (ITGC): collecting evidence, tracking requests, and making sure controls operate as documented.

SOC Compliance (SOC 1 / SOC 2)

  • Monitor control testing, log exceptions, and track remediation to closure

PII and Data Privacy

NetSuite Access Governance

ITGC Requests and Evidence

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain the central repository of policies, procedures, and audit artifacts, and update them on a regular schedule

  • Maintain the compliance calendar for recurring activities such as quarterly access reviews and annual policy reviews

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel


Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Clinical Data Associate to join our team in South Africa in a remote capacity.


As a Senior Clinical Data Associate, you will support global clinical research programs by delivering high-quality data management activities across Phase I-IV clinical studies. This position plays a key role in clinical data quality, regulatory compliance, study execution, and cross-functional collaboration.


You will partner with clinical teams, statisticians, programmers, CRAs, vendors, and study management teams to ensure accurate and timely data collection, review, reconciliation, and database management activities. Responsibilities include supporting and leading data management activities, coordinating Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, developing study documentation, and contributing to database lock and study deliverables.


You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment dedicated to a single sponsor and supporting important commercial and development programs worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to clinical research that advances new therapies while expanding your expertise across data management processes, clinical technologies, and cross-functional study operations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead a small clinical study or co-lead larger studies with moderate guidance.
  • Support multiple clinical studies while ensuring high standards of data quality and delivery.
  • Manage and monitor data management activities performed by CROs and external vendors.
  • Review study protocols and evaluate data capture requirements, including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.
  • Collaborate with CRAs, programmers, study managers, and statisticians to develop annotated eCRFs and CRF completion guidelines.
  • Develop data edit check specifications and generate study data listings as required.
  • Coordinate the design, testing, and issue resolution of Electronic Data Capture systems in accordance with company standards.
  • Develop and maintain study Data Management Plans and supporting documentation
  • Perform query management, external data reconciliations, and Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities.
  • Support database upgrades, migrations, user acceptance testing, database freeze activities, and database lock activities.
  • Maintain study workbooks and data management files while ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of data management SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation.

Candidate Profile


You'll thrive in this role if you bring:


  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.
  • Experience working within clinical research and regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams as well as with external partners and vendors.
  • A patient-focused mindset with a commitment to data quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Comfort working with Electronic Data Capture systems, clinical databases, and multiple technology platforms.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's Degree in a scientific or healthcare-related field.
  • At least five years' experience in Data Management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Understanding of Phase I-IV clinical studies and demonstrated ability to perform core Data Management activities and work with vendors.
  • Knowledge of ICH/FDA guidance, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR Part 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, and related industry standards.
  • Experience with Electronic Data Capture systems and clinical data management technologies. RAVE experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication, organization, technical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in Oncology or CNS therapeutic areas.
  • Experience supporting Phase III pivotal studies.

Benefits and Compensation


  • Medical Aid Contribution
  • Gap Cover
  • Life Assurance
  • Provident Fund (8%)
  • 13th Cheque

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: Senior Global Compensation Partner
description:
Overview

Compensation is one of the most powerful tools a company has. Done well, it pays people to do the work that makes the company exceptional, and it shares the upside with them when they do. As a Senior Global Compensation Partner at Seismic, you'll be a trusted advisor to our HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition team and business leaders on their most complex pay questions, across North America (United States, Canada), Europe (United Kingdom, Germany, France) and Asia-Pacific (Australia, China, India). You'll also own the execution of our annual merit cycle, the moment each year when pay for performance becomes real for every employee.This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Total Rewards.

We're looking for someone who wants to be at the forefront of compensation. You'll use frontier AI models to rethink how the work gets done from first principles: pricing every job against the market in hours, modeling a program change across 1,700 employees in an afternoon, and building tools that didn't exist a year ago. If that sounds like the work you've been waiting for, we want to meet you.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years of compensation experience, ideally at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience running an annual merit cycle end to end, from system configuration through communications, training and execution.
  • Deep experience with global benchmarking, job pricing and salary structures across multiple countries. Radford experience is a plus.
  • A record of advising HR Business Partners, Talent Partners and business leaders on complex pay decisions.
  • Experience with equity compensation programs.
  • Experience integrating compensation after an acquisition is a plus.
  • Hands-on use of frontier AI models, including tools you've built that other people use. You're energized by how fast the field is moving.
  • First-principles thinking and strong independent judgement on complex problems with many variables.
  • Advanced Excel and modeling skills. Python, SQL or a similar tool is a plus.
  • The ability to persuade leaders beyond your own area.
  • A high bar for your own work, and discretion with confidential data.
  • We are targeting candidates based near our San Diego, Seattle, or Boston offices, though we may consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the execution of our global annual merit cycle from start to finish. Working within the merit guidelines and budget set by Total Rewards leadership, you'll configure the cycle in Payscale, write the manager communications and training, run calibration with HR Business Partners, and land final results in payroll through ADP. Then you'll measure how it went and recommend how to improve next year's cycle.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners on organization changes, promotions and complex individual cases, and bring a clear recommendation.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition on competitive offers, hard-to-fill roles and the pay ranges on our job postings.
  • Lead global benchmarking and job pricing across our eight countries, and choose the right market data for each.
  • Lead critical role analysis: identify the roles that matter most to our growth, test how we pay them against the market, and recommend where to invest.
  • Lead how employees from acquired companies move onto Seismic's level structure and pay programs as we grow through M&A.
  • Support our equity programs, from modeling through rollout.
  • Build with frontier AI models to do work at a scale and speed that wasn't possible before, and share what you build with the team.
  • Take on complex problems with many variables. Go back to first principles, choose the method and bring a recommendation.

This is an opportunity to deepen your technical leadership, influence the evolution of our systems, and contribute meaningfully to a collaborative and innovative engineering culture—all while staying hands-on with code and close to the team’s day-to-day work.

This position is eligible for remote work, but quarterly travel will be required to Avalon's corporate office located in Tampa, Florida.

Technical Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and support the growth of junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and technical excellence.

  • Consistently demonstrates ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
  • Actively mentors junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working in regulated industries or with sensitive data, with a strong understanding of data privacy and security standards such as HIPAA, PHI, and IIHI.

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description:
United States — Remote

Role Overview

Nasuni is seeking a Senior Security Operations Analyst to strengthen enterprise security operations across cloud, identity, endpoint, email, and collaboration environments. You will independently lead complex investigations, improve detection quality, mature SOC processes, and turn operational data into measurable gains in detection, containment, and response.

This role is for an experienced, hands-on SOC practitioner who has owned incidents and operational improvements in a distributed enterprise or SaaS environment. It is not an entry-level, GRC-only, or advisory-only position.

Level & Scope Definition

You will operate as a senior individual contributor with authority to make incident triage, severity, and escalation decisions within Nasuni’s response framework. You will own cases from signal through containment, remediation coordination, documentation, and post-incident learning; improve detections, playbooks, dashboards, and procedures; and mentor other analysts. You will influence Security, IT, Cloud, Identity, Engineering, and external providers, while enterprise strategy, company-wide policy, and people management remain outside this role.

Responsibilities

  • Lead advanced investigations across endpoint, identity, cloud, email, SaaS, and network telemetry; determine scope, impact, root cause, containment, and follow-up actions.
  • Operate and improve an enterprise security stack that includes Sumo Logic Cloud SIEM, Wiz, Rapid7 InsightIDR and InsightVM/Exposure Command, and Darktrace / EMAIL, or comparable platforms.
  • Build and tune queries, correlation rules, detections, enrichments, threat hunts, dashboards, case workflows, and SOAR playbooks; improve MITRE ATT&CK coverage and reduce false positives.
  • Own the accuracy, reporting, and continuous improvement of SOC measures such as MTTD, MTTC, and MTTR, along with alert fidelity, aged backlog, escalation quality, and SLA attainment.
  • Improve SOC runbooks, incident procedures, severity criteria, escalation paths, analyst handoffs, case documentation, and post-incident review practices.
  • Partner with system owners to prioritize vulnerability and cloud-risk remediation using business context, exploitability, asset criticality, and compensating controls.
  • Use Nasuni-approved AI capabilities to accelerate log analysis, alert enrichment, case summarization, query development, and playbook drafting while validating outputs and protecting sensitive data.
  • Participate in the global on-call rotation and mentor analysts through case reviews, threat scenarios, and practical feedback.

Expected Outcomes

  • Reliable SOC metrics with documented, measurable improvement actions.
  • Consistent high-severity response, including timely escalation, containment, remediation follow-through, and post-incident learning.
  • Stronger detection coverage, alert fidelity, telemetry health, and reusable analyst playbooks.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of security experience, including 3+ years in an enterprise SOC, incident response, or detection-and-response function.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex or high-severity investigations from triage through containment and remediation coordination.
  • Strong hands-on SIEM experience, including search, correlation, rule tuning, log onboarding, dashboards, and investigation workflows.
  • Experience improving SOC processes and using operational metrics to identify bottlenecks and validate improvement.
  • Working knowledge across cloud security, EDR, identity, vulnerability management, and email security.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct hands-on experience with two or more of Sumo Logic, Wiz, Rapid7 InsightIDR/InsightVM, and Darktrace / EMAIL.
  • Detection engineering, SOAR, threat hunting, PowerShell or Python, multi-cloud monitoring, or MDR coordination experience.
  • Responsible use of AI-assisted security or observability workflows with clear validation and data-handling controls.

Ideal Qualifications

  • Measurably improved MTTD, MTTC, MTTR, false-positive rates, backlog health, or response SLA performance.
  • Led post-incident reviews, established reusable SOC operating practices, or coached other analysts.

Experience Guidelines

Typically 5–9 years of relevant experience, with evidence of enterprise-scale ownership weighted more heavily than tenure alone.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
description:
About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About Delivery Engineering

Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil.

Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on.

We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.
  • Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on.
  • Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate.
  • Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done.
  • Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns.
  • Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage.
  • Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows.

What You'll Bring

  • Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work.
  • Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics.
  • A platform mindset. You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption.
  • Backend depth in Go. You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration.
  • A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed.
  • Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

Canada Base Pay Range
$195,000—$265,000 CAD
United Kingdom Base Pay Range
£125,000—£170,000 GBP

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on prepress experience with a commercial offset printing company, either sheetfed or web.
  • Proven experience imposing print, and preparing files for production.
  • Daily, practical experience with professional prepress workflows and imposition software. Kodak Prinergy and Preps are preferred; experience with Fujifilm XMF, Screen Trueflow, Heidelberg Prinect, or Agfa Apogee is also relevant.
  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat Pro on a Mac.

Master's degree or certification in change management, organizational development, communications, design thinking, Agile change, Prosci/ADKAR, CCMP, or Lean preferred
